# Arcane Rush

## Overview
The Spellblade learns to channel mana directly into movement, allowing them to cross short distances with unnatural speed. Rather than relying purely on physical strength, they infuse their body with arcane energy, creating a sudden burst of acceleration that carries them across the battlefield in the blink of an eye.

To an observer, the movement appears almost impossible to follow. One moment the Spellblade stands still, and the next they have surged forward, leaving only a faint trail of arcane energy in their wake.

At Rank 1, Arcane Rush is a simple but highly effective mobility technique. It allows the Spellblade to rapidly reposition, close the distance to an enemy, escape danger, or reach advantageous terrain without relying on conventional movement.

While the technique lacks the sophistication of higher ranks, it establishes the foundation upon which future mobility techniques will be built.

## Rank 1
### Description

The Spellblade learns to channel mana directly into movement, allowing them to cross short distances with unnatural speed. Rather than relying purely on physical strength, they infuse their body with arcane energy, creating a sudden burst of acceleration that carries them across the battlefield in the blink of an eye.

To an observer, the movement appears almost impossible to follow. One moment the Spellblade stands still, and the next they have surged forward, leaving only a faint trail of arcane energy in their wake.

At Rank 1, Arcane Rush is a simple but highly effective mobility technique. It allows the Spellblade to rapidly reposition, close the distance to an enemy, escape danger, or reach advantageous terrain without relying on conventional movement.

While the technique lacks the sophistication of higher ranks, it establishes the foundation upon which future mobility techniques will be built.

### Effects

- Spend **12 MP** to activate Arcane Rush.
- Instantly move up to **4 metres** to a visible location.
- This movement does not provoke Opportunity Attacks.
- Arcane Rush may be used to:
  - Engage enemies.
  - Escape melee range.
  - Reposition around obstacles.
  - Reach advantageous terrain.
- Does not grant additional attacks.
- Does not increase movement speed outside of activation.

#### Movement Rules

- The destination must be within line of sight.
- You may move through enemy spaces during the rush.
- You cannot activate if you are engaged with an enemy.
- You cannot pass through solid walls, magical barriers, or completely blocked terrain.
- You must end the movement in a valid unoccupied space.

### Lore

Among Spellblades, Arcane Rush is often the first mobility technique taught after basic mana control. The ability demonstrates one of the core principles of the class: mana is not merely used for casting spells, but can be woven into every aspect of combat.

Veteran instructors frequently encourage students to master Arcane Rush before pursuing more advanced techniques. Proper positioning often determines the outcome of a battle long before the first strike is made.

Many duellists describe their first successful Arcane Rush as a transformative experience. For a brief moment, distance ceases to feel absolute, and the battlefield becomes something that can be navigated rather than endured.

Though simple in execution, countless Spellblades have survived impossible situations thanks to a well-timed Arcane Rush.

> "The quickest path is not always the shortest. Sometimes it is the one shaped by mana."
>
> — Blademaster Kaelis Vorn, Instructor of the Azure Path

## Rank 2
### Description

As the Spellblade's mastery of Arcane Rush grows, they learn to channel mana through their body more efficiently, allowing them to travel greater distances with each burst of arcane acceleration.

The technique becomes smoother and more controlled. Rather than forcing mana through the body in a sudden surge, the Spellblade learns to guide it naturally through their movements, extending both the range and reliability of the rush.

At Rank 2, Arcane Rush remains a mobility technique first and foremost. The Spellblade becomes capable of covering greater distances across the battlefield, allowing them to engage enemies, reposition, or escape danger with increased effectiveness.

Experienced Spellblades often describe this stage as the point where Arcane Rush begins to feel natural rather than forced, becoming a regular part of their combat style rather than a technique used only in emergencies.

### Effects

- Spend **15 MP** to activate Arcane Rush.
- Instantly move up to **6 metres** to a visible location.
- This movement does not provoke Opportunity Attacks.
- Arcane Rush may be used to:
  - Engage enemies.
  - Escape melee range.
  - Reposition around obstacles.
  - Reach advantageous terrain.
- Does not grant additional attacks.
- Does not increase movement speed outside of activation.

#### Movement Rules

- The destination must be within line of sight.
- You may move through enemy spaces during the rush.
- You cannot activate if you are engaged with an enemy.
- You cannot pass through solid walls, magical barriers, or completely blocked terrain.
- You must end the movement in a valid unoccupied space.

### Lore

Among seasoned Spellblades, Rank 2 is often called the stage of refinement. The practitioner has moved beyond simply forcing mana into motion and begins to understand how arcane energy can enhance movement without overwhelming the body.

Many instructors encourage students to use Arcane Rush repeatedly during training exercises, not to increase speed, but to improve control. A rushed movement may reach its destination, but a controlled movement arrives exactly where it is needed.

Those who master this stage often find themselves viewing the battlefield differently. Obstacles become opportunities, distance becomes less intimidating, and positioning becomes a weapon in its own right.

> "The first rush teaches movement. The second teaches control."
>
> — Blademaster Kaelis Vorn, Instructor of the Azure Path

## Rank 3
### Description

The Spellblade's command over Arcane Rush reaches a level where distance begins to lose its meaning. Mana flows effortlessly through their body, carrying them across the battlefield with remarkable speed and precision.

What once felt like a burst of movement now feels like a natural extension of combat itself. The Spellblade no longer thinks about where they are standing, but where they need to be. Every engagement, retreat, and reposition becomes smoother as the technique evolves.

At Rank 3, Arcane Rush allows the Spellblade to traverse significant distances in an instant, making them increasingly difficult to pin down. Enemies who rely on controlling positioning often find themselves struggling to keep pace with a practitioner capable of appearing where they are least expected.

Many veterans consider this the stage where Arcane Rush transforms from a useful technique into a defining part of the Spellblade's combat identity.

### Effects

- Spend **18 MP** to activate Arcane Rush.
- Instantly move up to **8 metres** to a visible location.
- This movement does not provoke Opportunity Attacks.
- Arcane Rush may be used to:
  - Engage distant enemies.
  - Escape melee range.
  - Reposition around obstacles.
  - Reach advantageous terrain.
  - Bypass enemy frontlines.
- Does not grant additional attacks.
- Does not provide offensive bonuses at this rank.

#### Movement Rules

- The destination must be within line of sight.
- You may move through enemy spaces during the rush.
- You may ignore difficult terrain during the movement.
- You cannot pass through solid walls, magical barriers, or completely blocked terrain.
- You must end the movement in a valid unoccupied space.

### Lore

Among experienced Spellblades, Rank 3 is often referred to as the Path Between Moments. Practitioners describe a strange sensation during movement, as though the distance travelled becomes shorter than it should be.

Some scholars argue that Arcane Rush does not truly increase speed, but instead allows the Spellblade to briefly slip through the spaces between mana currents that flow throughout the world. Whether this theory is true remains the subject of debate among arcane researchers.

What is certain is that those who master this stage become exceptionally difficult to contain. Opponents learn quickly that distance offers little protection against a Spellblade capable of crossing the battlefield in the blink of an eye.

Many legendary duels have been decided by a single perfectly timed Arcane Rush, carrying the practitioner to exactly the right place at exactly the right moment.

> "The battlefield belongs to the one who decides where the fight happens."
>
> — High Spellblade Arkanis Thorne, Warden of the Azure Depths

## Rank 4
### Description

The Spellblade has mastered the fundamentals of Arcane Rush, allowing them to move across the battlefield with extraordinary speed and precision. What was once a method of repositioning has evolved into a technique that directly influences combat itself.

Mana now surges through the Spellblade's body with such efficiency that the momentum of the rush can be carried into their next action. The transition between movement and attack becomes seamless, creating openings that slower opponents struggle to react to.

At Rank 4, Arcane Rush no longer serves only as a mobility tool. The sudden acceleration and perfect positioning generated by the technique provide the Spellblade with a brief but valuable combat advantage immediately after arriving at their destination.

Veteran Spellblades often describe this stage as the point where movement and combat become one. Every rush becomes part of an attack, and every attack begins with movement.

### Effects

- Spend **21 MP** to activate Arcane Rush.
- Instantly move up to **12 metres** to a visible location.
- This movement does not provoke Opportunity Attacks.
- Arcane Rush may be used to:
  - Engage distant enemies.
  - Escape melee range.
  - Reposition around obstacles.
  - Reach advantageous terrain.
  - Bypass enemy frontlines.
- Does not grant additional attacks.
- Does not provide offensive bonuses at this rank.

#### Arcane Momentum

After completing Arcane Rush:

- Your next attack before the end of your turn gains:
  - **+1 to Hit**

The bonus is consumed whether the attack hits or misses.

#### Movement Rules

- The destination must be within line of sight.
- You may move through enemy spaces during the rush.
- You may ignore difficult terrain during the movement.
- You cannot pass through solid walls, magical barriers, or completely blocked terrain.
- You must end the movement in a valid unoccupied space.

### Lore

Among the great Spellblade Orders, Rank 4 is often called the Stage of Momentum. At this point, practitioners no longer think of movement and combat as separate disciplines. Every reposition becomes an opportunity, and every opportunity becomes a potential strike.

Masters frequently train their students to attack immediately after an Arcane Rush, teaching them to exploit the brief confusion created by their sudden relocation. To outside observers, the technique can appear almost unfair, as the Spellblade seems to arrive already prepared to attack.

Historical accounts describe veteran Spellblades using Arcane Rush to cross entire battle lines before striking enemy commanders, mages, or siege crews. Their ability to appear where they were least expected often proved more dangerous than the attacks themselves.

Many duelists spend years attempting to predict where a Spellblade will move next. Most eventually learn the same lesson: by the time you see the rush, it is already too late.

> "The greatest advantage is not speed. It is arriving before your enemy understands that you have moved."
>
> — Grand Spellblade Aethon Vale, Master of the Sapphire Hall

## Rank 5
### Description

Arcane Rush reaches its ultimate form, transforming the Spellblade into a blur of motion and arcane energy. Distance becomes little more than a suggestion as the practitioner moves across the battlefield with breathtaking speed and precision.

The mana flowing through the Spellblade no longer merely enhances movement—it becomes movement. Every rush is executed with absolute confidence, carrying the Spellblade exactly where they need to be while creating the perfect opportunity for a decisive strike.

At Rank 5, Arcane Rush embodies one of the core principles of the Spellblade path: superior positioning creates superior opportunities. The Spellblade can appear where they are least expected, exploit weaknesses in enemy formations, and strike before opponents can properly react.

Among Spellblades, reaching this rank is considered a mark of mastery. Few possess the control, experience, and arcane endurance necessary to wield Arcane Rush at its highest level.

### Effects

- Spend **24 MP** to activate Arcane Rush.
- Instantly move up to **15 metres** to a visible location.
- This movement does not provoke Opportunity Attacks.
- Arcane Rush may be used to:
  - Engage distant enemies.
  - Escape melee range.
  - Reposition around obstacles.
  - Reach advantageous terrain.
  - Bypass enemy frontlines.
  - Rapidly relocate across the battlefield.
- Does not grant additional attacks.
- Does not provide offensive bonuses at this rank.

#### Arcane Momentum

After completing Arcane Rush:

- Your next attack before the end of your turn gains:
  - **+2 to Hit**
  - **+1d4 Arcane Damage**

The bonus is consumed whether the attack hits or misses.

#### Movement Rules

- The destination must be within line of sight.
- You may move through enemy spaces during the rush.
- You may ignore difficult terrain during the movement.
- You cannot pass through solid walls, magical barriers, or completely blocked terrain.
- You must end the movement in a valid unoccupied space.

### Lore

The highest masters of Arcane Rush are often spoken of in legends and battlefield tales. Witnesses describe them as appearing and disappearing across the battlefield so quickly that it becomes difficult to determine where they truly are.

Military historians frequently record accounts of elite Spellblades crossing entire engagements to strike critical targets before defenders could react. Commanders learned to fear the sudden appearance of a Spellblade more than the approach of an army.

Among the Azure Orders, Rank 5 is known as the Horizon Step. The name comes from the belief that a true master sees no meaningful difference between where they stand and where they wish to be. Distance becomes an obstacle that can simply be ignored.

Those who achieve this rank have mastered more than movement. They have mastered opportunity itself, arriving precisely where fate demands and striking at the moment their enemies are least prepared.

> "The battlefield is not measured in distance. It is measured in opportunities. Arcane Rush simply ensures I reach them first."
>
> — Grandmaster Aetherion Lux, First Blade of the Infinite Well

# Arcane Tempo

## Overview
A Spellblade's greatest strength is not their sword or their magic, but the rhythm between the two. Arcane Tempo teaches the practitioner to seamlessly flow from spellcasting into swordplay, then back again, creating an ever-changing dance of steel and mana that keeps opponents constantly off balance.

Upon activating Arcane Tempo, mana courses through the Spellblade's body, synchronising every movement with their spellcasting. Each successful spell naturally leads into a more precise weapon strike, while every successful strike prepares the mind and body to cast with greater focus. The technique rewards versatility rather than repetition, encouraging the Spellblade to weave martial combat and magic together as a single discipline.

At Rank I, the rhythm is still fragile and easily broken, but even novice Spellblades quickly discover that maintaining their Tempo allows them to fight with greater efficiency than relying on blade or spell alone.

## Rank 1
### Description

A Spellblade's greatest strength is not their sword or their magic, but the rhythm between the two. Arcane Tempo teaches the practitioner to seamlessly flow from spellcasting into swordplay, then back again, creating an ever-changing dance of steel and mana that keeps opponents constantly off balance.

Upon activating Arcane Tempo, mana courses through the Spellblade's body, synchronising every movement with their spellcasting. Each successful spell naturally leads into a more precise weapon strike, while every successful strike prepares the mind and body to cast with greater focus. The technique rewards versatility rather than repetition, encouraging the Spellblade to weave martial combat and magic together as a single discipline.

At Rank I, the rhythm is still fragile and easily broken, but even novice Spellblades quickly discover that maintaining their Tempo allows them to fight with greater efficiency than relying on blade or spell alone.

### Effects

- Spend **20 MP** to activate **Arcane Tempo**.
- Arcane Tempo remains active for **5 Turns**.
- After successfully casting a spell, your **next melee weapon attack** gains **+1 to its Attack Roll**.
- After successfully hitting with a melee weapon attack, your **next spell** gains **+1 to its Spell Attack Roll** or **Spell Save DC** (whichever is applicable).
- Each bonus is consumed after it is applied.
- Arcane Tempo only functions while alternating between spellcasting and melee weapon attacks.
- Repeating the same action (casting a spell after a spell, or attacking after an attack) does not generate a new bonus.

### Lore

Among the Spellblade Orders, Arcane Tempo is often called the **Rhythm of Battle**. Masters teach that a true Spellblade should never become predictable. Every spell should naturally flow into a strike, and every strike should prepare the next spell, creating a combat style that is fluid, relentless, and impossible to anticipate.

Many apprentices struggle with this lesson, instinctively favouring either magic or swordsmanship. Only through discipline do they learn that the greatest strength lies not in choosing one path, but in mastering the rhythm that unites them.

> *"Do not think of casting, then striking. Think only of the rhythm, and both will become one."*

> — Grand Spellblade Aetherion Lux, First Blade of the Infinite Well

## Rank 2
### Description

The Spellblade's understanding of Arcane Tempo deepens, allowing the rhythm between sword and spell to become far more natural. No longer forcing the transition between martial and magical techniques, the Spellblade begins to move instinctively, allowing each action to flow seamlessly into the next.

Mana circulates continuously throughout the Spellblade's body, synchronising every strike and every spell into a single combat rhythm. As this tempo builds, attacks become more accurate and spells are woven with greater precision, making it increasingly difficult for opponents to predict what will come next.

At Rank II, maintaining the rhythm becomes easier and more rewarding. Experienced Spellblades understand that every successful transition strengthens the flow of battle, while hesitation or repetition causes the tempo to falter. Those who master this balance become exceptionally adaptable, shifting effortlessly between blade and sorcery as the battle unfolds.

### Effects

- Spend **25 MP** to activate **Arcane Tempo**.
- Arcane Tempo remains active for **6 Turns**.
- After successfully casting a spell, your **next melee weapon attack** gains **+2 to its Attack Roll**.
- After successfully hitting with a melee weapon attack, your **next spell** gains **+2 to its Spell Attack Roll** or **Spell Save DC** (whichever is applicable).
- Each bonus is consumed after it is applied.
- Arcane Tempo only functions while alternating between spellcasting and melee weapon attacks.
- Repeating the same action (casting a spell after a spell, or attacking after an attack) does not generate a new bonus.
- This rank replaces the effects of **Arcane Tempo — Rank I**.

### Lore

Within the Spellblade Orders, Rank II is known as the **Flowing Rhythm**, where combat begins to resemble a carefully choreographed dance rather than a series of separate actions. Masters teach that the blade should prepare the spell, and the spell should prepare the blade, creating a cycle that never truly ends.

Many apprentices discover that maintaining Arcane Tempo requires discipline rather than speed. A reckless warrior quickly loses their rhythm, while a patient Spellblade allows every action to naturally lead into the next. This philosophy becomes the foundation upon which all advanced Spellblade techniques are built.

> *"A true rhythm cannot be rushed. Every strike has a spell waiting behind it, and every spell already knows where the next strike will fall."*

> — Grand Spellblade Aetherion Lux, First Blade of the Infinite Well

## Rank 3
### Description

The Spellblade has begun to master the rhythm between blade and spell, maintaining a continuous flow of martial and arcane techniques throughout combat. Every successful transition strengthens their momentum, allowing attacks to become more precise while spells are cast with unwavering confidence.

Mana pulses through the Spellblade in perfect harmony with each movement, linking every strike and spell into a single, uninterrupted sequence. Rather than viewing swordsmanship and spellcasting as separate disciplines, the Spellblade embraces them as two halves of the same combat style. Opponents quickly find themselves overwhelmed by the relentless change in tempo, unable to predict whether the next attack will be steel or sorcery.

Rank III represents the point where Arcane Tempo becomes instinctive. The Spellblade no longer needs to consciously maintain the rhythm—it simply becomes part of the way they fight.

### Effects

- Spend **30 MP** to activate **Arcane Tempo**.
- Arcane Tempo remains active for **7 Turns**.
- After successfully casting a spell, your **next melee weapon attack** gains **+3 to its Attack Roll**.
- After successfully hitting with a melee weapon attack, your **next spell** gains **+3 to its Spell Attack Roll** or **Spell Save DC** (whichever is applicable).
- Each bonus is consumed after it is applied.
- Arcane Tempo only functions while alternating between spellcasting and melee weapon attacks.
- Repeating the same action (casting a spell after a spell, or attacking after an attack) does not generate a new bonus.
- This rank replaces the effects of **Arcane Tempo — Rank II**.

### Lore

Among veteran Spellblades, Rank III is known as the **Battle Rhythm**. Reaching this stage signifies that the practitioner has stopped thinking about when to attack or when to cast. Instead, every action naturally leads into the next, creating a seamless dance of steel and mana.

Masters often describe watching an accomplished Spellblade as listening to a symphony. Every spell, every strike, and every movement flows together with perfect timing, leaving opponents unable to anticipate the next beat. It is this unpredictable rhythm that has earned the Spellblade their reputation as one of Asteria's most versatile warriors.

> *"The finest battles are never won through strength alone, but through perfect rhythm. When steel and sorcery share the same heartbeat, victory follows."*

> — Grand Spellblade Aetherion Lux, First Blade of the Infinite Well

## Rank 4
### Description

The Spellblade's rhythm has become unwavering, allowing them to recover from mistakes without losing the flow of battle. Where lesser practitioners falter after a missed strike or disrupted spell, a master of Arcane Tempo adapts instantly, seamlessly continuing the dance between steel and sorcery.

Every movement is guided by instinct. Mana circulates effortlessly throughout the Spellblade's body, ensuring that every spell naturally transitions into a weapon strike and every successful strike prepares the next spell. Even when an attack fails to find its mark, the Spellblade's rhythm remains intact, denying their opponent the opportunity to disrupt their momentum.

Rank IV represents the mastery of consistency. The Spellblade no longer relies upon perfect execution to maintain their Tempo, making them an exceptionally difficult opponent to slow or interrupt.

### Effects

- Spend **35 MP** to activate **Arcane Tempo**.
- Arcane Tempo remains active for **8 Turns**.
- After successfully casting a spell, your **next melee weapon attack** gains **+4 to its Attack Roll**.
- After successfully hitting with a melee weapon attack, your **next spell** gains **+4 to its Spell Attack Roll** or **Spell Save DC** (whichever is applicable).
- Each bonus is consumed after it is applied.
- If your empowered melee attack misses, the bonus is retained until your next melee weapon attack.
- If your empowered spell fails to hit or the target succeeds on its saving throw, the bonus is retained until your next spell.
- Arcane Tempo only functions while alternating between spellcasting and melee weapon attacks.
- This rank replaces the effects of **Arcane Tempo — Rank III**.

### Lore

Spellblade Masters call this stage the **Endless Rhythm**, for the flow of battle can no longer be broken by simple mistakes. The practitioner has learned that true mastery is measured not by perfection, but by the ability to recover instantly and continue fighting without hesitation.

Veterans often compare Arcane Tempo to the beating of a heart. It does not stop because one step is misplaced or one strike goes astray. Instead, it continues without interruption, carrying the Spellblade forward until the battle is won.

To witness a master of Arcane Tempo is to see steel and sorcery move with absolute harmony, every action flowing effortlessly into the next without pause.

> *"Perfection is not never stumbling. Perfection is never losing the rhythm when you do."*

> — Grand Spellblade Aetherion Lux, First Blade of the Infinite Well

## Rank 5
### Description

Arcane Tempo reaches its highest form, becoming more than a combat technique—it becomes the natural rhythm of the Spellblade's soul. Every spell seamlessly transitions into a strike, and every strike naturally prepares the next spell. The distinction between martial skill and spellcasting disappears entirely, replaced by a flawless cycle of steel and sorcery.

The Spellblade no longer fights by making individual decisions. Instead, they surrender to the flow of battle itself, allowing instinct and discipline to guide every movement. Opponents struggle to keep pace as the Spellblade effortlessly shifts between devastating spells and precise weapon strikes, maintaining relentless pressure without ever losing momentum.

Masters of Arcane Tempo are recognised throughout Asteria as living embodiments of the Spellblade philosophy. To face one is to battle a warrior whose every action strengthens the next, creating an unbroken chain of perfectly timed attacks and spells.

### Effects

- Spend **40 MP** to activate **Arcane Tempo**.
- Arcane Tempo remains active for **10 Turns**.
- After successfully casting a spell, your **next melee weapon attack** gains **+5 to its Attack Roll**.
- After successfully hitting with a melee weapon attack, your **next spell** gains **+5 to its Spell Attack Roll** or **Spell Save DC** (whichever is applicable).
- Each bonus is consumed after it is applied.
- If your empowered melee attack misses, the bonus is retained until your next melee weapon attack.
- If your empowered spell fails to hit or the target succeeds on its saving throw, the bonus is retained until your next spell.
- Each time you successfully alternate between casting a spell and landing a melee weapon attack, **extend Arcane Tempo's remaining duration by 1 Turn**, up to its original maximum duration.
- This rank replaces the effects of **Arcane Tempo — Rank IV**.

### Lore

Within the oldest Spellblade Orders, Rank V is known as the **Perfect Tempo**. It is said that those who achieve this level no longer think about whether to cast or strike, for both actions have become a single expression of their will.

Legend speaks of masters who fought for entire battles without ever breaking their rhythm, maintaining an endless cycle of blade and magic that left their opponents unable to predict or interrupt their relentless assault. Every successful transition renewed their momentum, allowing them to dictate the pace of the fight until victory was inevitable.

To master Arcane Tempo is to understand the heart of the Spellblade. Steel and sorcery are not separate disciplines, but two notes within the same song.

> *"Do not master the blade. Do not master the spell. Master the rhythm between them, and both will follow."*

> — Grand Spellblade Aetherion Lux, First Blade of the Infinite Well

# Artificer

## Overview
# Class Overview

The Artificer is a master inventor, engineer, researcher, and creator who blends magic, science, craftsmanship, and innovation into a single discipline. Unlike traditional spellcasters who channel magic through faith, instinct, or study alone, Artificers view magic as a resource to be understood, refined, and engineered.

Where a Wizard studies spells, an Artificer studies systems.

Through experimentation and invention, Artificers create gadgets, constructs, enchanted equipment, dimensional technologies, alchemical compounds, and soul-powered creations capable of reshaping the world around them. Their workshops produce wonders that many consider impossible, while their inventions often blur the line between magic and technology.

Artificers are natural problem-solvers. Every challenge presents an opportunity for innovation. Every obstacle is simply a puzzle waiting to be solved.

Whether constructing mechanical companions, crafting legendary artifacts, manipulating matter itself through Arcane Exchange, or carrying entire buildings in their pockets, Artificers are defined by one principle:

> If it does not exist, build it.

## Class Identity

The Artificer excels through preparation, creativity, and invention rather than direct magical power.

### Primary Roles

- Crafter
- Inventor
- Enchanter
- Researcher
- Support Specialist
- Resource Manager
- Utility Expert

### Secondary Roles

- Construct Commander
- Battlefield Controller
- Alchemist
- Engineer
- Explorer

## Artificer Motto

> "Magic is not a mystery. It is a system waiting to be understood."

## Talent Tree
Talent pathways live in the talent folders for this class. Each talent has its own page under `talents/tier-*`.

## Lore
# Origins of the Artificers

Long before the modern age, magic was viewed as a force to be worshipped, feared, or studied. Few considered building with it.

The earliest Artificers were craftsmen, miners, alchemists, blacksmiths, and scholars who became frustrated by the limitations of conventional magic. While Wizards debated theory and Clerics sought divine guidance, these pioneers sought practical solutions.

They asked questions others ignored: why cast the same spell every day when a device could perform the task indefinitely, why rely on magical talent alone when power could be stored, and why learn a spell when a machine could replicate its effect?

## The First Innovators

The first true Artificers appeared during the Age of Discovery. These individuals began combining smithing, enchanting, alchemy, runecraft, engineering, and arcane theory into a new field of study.

The earliest inventions were simple: self-heating cookware, enchanted lanterns, automated pumps, and reinforced tools. Over time these creations became more ambitious, eventually producing devices capable of rivaling spellcasters.

## The Great Debate

The rise of the Artificers sparked controversy across Asteria. Traditional scholars argued that magic should be studied. Artificers argued that magic should be used. Traditional enchanters argued that magic is sacred. Artificers argued that magic is a resource.

## The Age of Invention

As Artifice spread throughout the world, entire industries emerged around Artificer creations: arcane lighting systems, mana-powered tools, mechanical transports, automated workshops, and dimensional storage devices.

Many cities owe their growth to inventions developed by Artificers. Some kingdoms owe their survival to them. Others blame them for countless disasters. Both are often correct.

## The Soul Revolution

The greatest breakthrough in Artificer history came with the discovery of Soul Integration. Researchers discovered that soul energy could be captured, refined, and utilized within crafted objects.

This led to the creation of Soul-Bound Items, Arcane Reactors, Scaling Creations, Living Constructs, and Sentient Artifacts. The discovery revolutionized the profession, and also created some of its greatest dangers.

## The Philosophy of Creation

Artificers do not view creation as a finished act. Nothing is truly complete. Everything can be improved. Every invention may be refined. Every design may evolve. Every problem has a solution.

## Artificers and Society

Artificers may become master craftsmen, guild engineers, royal inventors, researchers, explorers, merchants, treasure hunters, relic seekers, dungeon delvers, monster researchers, or independent inventors.

Many travel the world searching for lost schematics, ancient technologies, rare materials, and forgotten knowledge. To an Artificer, every ruin is a library, every artifact is a lesson, and every mystery is an opportunity.

## The Artificer Creed

> We build.
>
> We improve.
>
> We discover.
>
> We create.
>
> We fail.
>
> We learn.
>
> We build again.

## Legacy

The greatest Artificers are remembered for what they leave behind: a bridge that still stands, a reactor that still burns, a construct that still walks, a fortress that still protects, or an invention that changed the world.

# artificer

## overview
# class overview

the artificer is a master inventor, engineer, researcher, and creator who blends magic, science, craftsmanship, and innovation into a single discipline. unlike traditional spellcasters who channel magic through faith, instinct, or study alone, artificers view magic as a resource to be understood, refined, and engineered.

where a wizard studies spells, an artificer studies systems.

through experimentation and invention, artificers create gadgets, constructs, enchanted equipment, dimensional technologies, alchemical compounds, and soul-powered creations capable of reshaping the world around them. their workshops produce wonders that many consider impossible, while their inventions often blur the line between magic and technology.

artificers are natural problem-solvers. every challenge presents an opportunity for innovation. every obstacle is simply a puzzle waiting to be solved.

whether constructing mechanical companions, crafting legendary artifacts, manipulating matter itself through arcane exchange, or carrying entire buildings in their pockets, artificers are defined by one principle:

> if it does not exist, build it.

## class identity

the artificer excels through preparation, creativity, and invention rather than direct magical power.

### primary roles

- crafter
- inventor
- enchanter
- researcher
- support specialist
- resource manager
- utility expert

### secondary roles

- construct commander
- battlefield controller
- alchemist
- engineer
- explorer

## artificer motto

> "magic is not a mystery. it is a system waiting to be understood."

## talent tree
talent pathways live in the talent folders for this class. each talent has its own page under `talents/tier-*`.

## lore
# origins of the artificers

long before the modern age, magic was viewed as a force to be worshipped, feared, or studied. few considered building with it.

the earliest artificers were craftsmen, miners, alchemists, blacksmiths, and scholars who became frustrated by the limitations of conventional magic. while wizards debated theory and clerics sought divine guidance, these pioneers sought practical solutions.

they asked questions others ignored: why cast the same spell every day when a device could perform the task indefinitely, why rely on magical talent alone when power could be stored, and why learn a spell when a machine could replicate its effect?

## the first innovators

the first true artificers appeared during the age of discovery. these individuals began combining smithing, enchanting, alchemy, runecraft, engineering, and arcane theory into a new field of study.

the earliest inventions were simple: self-heating cookware, enchanted lanterns, automated pumps, and reinforced tools. over time these creations became more ambitious, eventually producing devices capable of rivaling spellcasters.

## the great debate

the rise of the artificers sparked controversy across asteria. traditional scholars argued that magic should be studied. artificers argued that magic should be used. traditional enchanters argued that magic is sacred. artificers argued that magic is a resource.

## the age of invention

as artifice spread throughout the world, entire industries emerged around artificer creations: arcane lighting systems, mana-powered tools, mechanical transports, automated workshops, and dimensional storage devices.

many cities owe their growth to inventions developed by artificers. some kingdoms owe their survival to them. others blame them for countless disasters. both are often correct.

## the soul revolution

the greatest breakthrough in artificer history came with the discovery of soul integration. researchers discovered that soul energy could be captured, refined, and utilized within crafted objects.

this led to the creation of soul-bound items, arcane reactors, scaling creations, living constructs, and sentient artifacts. the discovery revolutionized the profession, and also created some of its greatest dangers.

## the philosophy of creation

artificers do not view creation as a finished act. nothing is truly complete. everything can be improved. every invention may be refined. every design may evolve. every problem has a solution.

## artificers and society

artificers may become master craftsmen, guild engineers, royal inventors, researchers, explorers, merchants, treasure hunters, relic seekers, dungeon delvers, monster researchers, or independent inventors.

many travel the world searching for lost schematics, ancient technologies, rare materials, and forgotten knowledge. to an artificer, every ruin is a library, every artifact is a lesson, and every mystery is an opportunity.

## the artificer creed

> we build.
>
> we improve.
>
> we discover.
>
> we create.
>
> we fail.
>
> we learn.
>
> we build again.

## legacy

the greatest artificers are remembered for what they leave behind: a bridge that still stands, a reactor that still burns, a construct that still walks, a fortress that still protects, or an invention that changed the world.

# Aura of Courage

## Overview
A Paladin's courage is more than personal resolve—it is a beacon that strengthens the spirits of those who stand beside them. Through unwavering faith and an unbreakable oath, you project a divine aura that steels the hearts of your allies against fear and despair.

While your aura remains active, those who fight within its protective embrace find their resolve strengthened before terror can take hold. Even allies already gripped by fear may find the courage to rise again as they draw close to your presence, though true protection belongs to those who never abandon the light of your conviction.

Aura of Courage is the first manifestation of a Paladin's divine presence upon the battlefield. It marks the beginning of your journey as a guardian whose faith protects not only their own heart, but the hearts of every companion willing to stand beside them.

## Rank 1
### Description

A Paladin's courage is more than personal resolve—it is a beacon that strengthens the spirits of those who stand beside them. Through unwavering faith and an unbreakable oath, you project a divine aura that steels the hearts of your allies against fear and despair.

While your aura remains active, those who fight within its protective embrace find their resolve strengthened before terror can take hold. Even allies already gripped by fear may find the courage to rise again as they draw close to your presence, though true protection belongs to those who never abandon the light of your conviction.

Aura of Courage is the first manifestation of a Paladin's divine presence upon the battlefield. It marks the beginning of your journey as a guardian whose faith protects not only their own heart, but the hearts of every companion willing to stand beside them.

### Effects

- Spend **15 MP** to activate **Aura of Courage**.
- Create a **5 metre radius Aura** centred on yourself for **3 Rounds**.
- The aura moves with you.
- Allies already within the aura gain **+2 to Saving Throws against the Fear condition**.
- If an ally is targeted by a Fear effect while already inside the aura, the **+2 bonus** is applied to their Saving Throw.
- An ally that enters the aura while already suffering the **Fear** condition may immediately attempt **one new Saving Throw** to end the effect.
- This Saving Throw gains **+1** *(half the aura's normal bonus, rounded down)*.
- This reroll may only be attempted **once per aura activation** for each creature.
- Multiple **Aura of Courage** effects do not stack. If affected by more than one, only the strongest version applies.

### Lore

Within every holy order of Asteria, courage is considered a gift that grows stronger when shared. Veteran Paladins teach that fear cannot be defeated through words alone—it is overcome by standing shoulder to shoulder with those who refuse to yield.

The first lesson every initiate learns is that an aura is not a shield that follows the fearful. It is a sanctuary for those who place their trust in the Paladin's conviction. Those who remain within its light discover that even the darkest horrors lose their power when faced together.

> *"Courage is not the absence of fear. It is the decision to stand firm despite it—and to help others do the same."*  
> **— Lady Seraphine, Shieldbearer of the Eternal Dawn**

## Rank 2
### Description

Your courage grows into an unwavering beacon that shines brighter across the battlefield. Allies fighting beside you find their resolve strengthened, allowing them to face horrors that would break the spirits of lesser warriors. Your faith stands as a constant reminder that fear only has power over those who surrender to it.

As your divine presence matures, your aura reaches farther and lingers longer, encouraging companions to remain close to your side where your conviction is strongest. Those who flee may still find refuge by returning to your light, but the greatest protection belongs to those who never leave it.

Veteran Paladins often describe this stage of mastery as the moment their companions stop looking at the monsters before them and instead draw confidence from the steadfast guardian standing at their side.

### Effects

- Spend **25 MP** to activate **Aura of Courage**.
- Create a **7 metre radius Aura** centred on yourself for **4 Rounds**.
- The aura moves with you.
- Allies already within the aura gain **+3 to Saving Throws against the Fear condition**.
- If an ally is targeted by a Fear effect while already inside the aura, the **+3 bonus** is applied to their Saving Throw.
- An ally that enters the aura while already suffering the **Fear** condition may immediately attempt **one new Saving Throw** to end the effect.
- This Saving Throw gains **+1** *(half the aura's normal bonus, rounded down)*.
- This reroll may only be attempted **once per aura activation** for each creature.
- Multiple **Aura of Courage** effects do not stack. If affected by more than one, only the strongest version applies.

### Lore

The oldest knightly orders teach that courage is not born from victory, but from trust. Warriors who stand beside a seasoned Paladin often find themselves confronting impossible odds with a calm they cannot fully explain. It is not the absence of fear that strengthens them, but the certainty that they do not stand alone.

Many commanders intentionally place experienced Paladins where enemy terror is expected to be greatest. Their presence has turned collapsing battle lines into legendary last stands, proving that a single steadfast soul can become the foundation upon which an entire army refuses to break.

> *"Stand with me, and let your courage become greater than your fear."*  
> **— Dame Elowyn, Captain of the Silver Wardens**

## Rank 3
### Description

Your unwavering faith becomes a beacon that reaches beyond courage alone. Allies who stand within your divine presence find their minds fortified against both terror and manipulation, allowing them to remain steadfast when others would falter.

The aura you project is no longer simply a source of bravery—it becomes a sanctuary of resolve. Those who fight beneath your protection discover that fear loses its grip, while attempts to cloud their judgement or sway their will are met with remarkable resistance. Although those who seek refuge after succumbing to such effects may still recover, the greatest protection is reserved for those who remain within your light from the beginning.

As your mastery grows, your companions begin to place complete trust in your presence, knowing that while your aura surrounds them, neither fear nor deception can easily break their resolve.

### Effects

- Spend **35 MP** to activate **Aura of Courage**.
- Create a **10 metre radius Aura** centred on yourself for **5 Rounds**.
- The aura moves with you.
- Allies already within the aura gain **+4 to Saving Throws against the Fear and Charm conditions**.
- If an ally is targeted by a Fear or Charm effect while already inside the aura, the **+4 bonus** is applied to their Saving Throw.
- An ally that enters the aura while suffering the **Fear** or **Charm** condition may immediately attempt **one new Saving Throw** to end one of those effects.
- This Saving Throw gains **+2** *(half the aura's normal bonus, rounded down)*.
- This reroll may only be attempted **once per aura activation** for each creature.
- Multiple **Aura of Courage** effects do not stack. If affected by more than one, only the strongest version applies.

### Lore

To witness a veteran Paladin standing firm amid impossible odds is to understand why courage is considered contagious. Their presence inspires more than confidence—it reminds those around them who they are, what they fight for, and why no force should be allowed to bend their will.

Many scholars believe this is the stage at which a Paladin's faith begins to resonate with the souls of those nearby. Whether divine miracle or simple inspiration, those who stand within the aura often recall hearing the Paladin's voice clearly above the chaos of battle, guiding them back to themselves when fear and enchantment sought to steal their resolve.

> *"A frightened heart may stumble. A faithful heart always finds its way home."*  
> **— High Justicar Alaric, Keeper of the Sacred Bastion**

## Rank 4
### Description

Your courage has become an unwavering bastion of the mind. Those who stand beside you find their thoughts steadied, their resolve strengthened, and their spirits shielded from forces that seek to overwhelm, deceive, or corrupt them. Fear no longer stands alone as your enemy—any assault upon the will itself struggles against the divine conviction you project.

The aura surrounding you radiates calm amidst chaos. Companions fighting beneath your protection discover that even the darkest horrors and most insidious enchantments lose much of their power. While those who seek refuge after succumbing to such effects may still recover, those who remain steadfast within your presence receive the greatest blessing of your unwavering faith.

The strongest Paladins understand that courage is not merely the absence of fear. It is the strength to remain true to yourself when every force in the world attempts to make you someone else.

### Effects

- Spend **40 MP** to activate **Aura of Courage**.
- Create a **12 metre radius Aura** centred on yourself for **6 Rounds**.
- The aura moves with you.
- Allies already within the aura gain **+5 to Saving Throws** against the **Fear**, **Charm**, and **Mental** conditions or effects.
- If an ally is targeted by a Fear, Charm, or Mental effect while already inside the aura, the **+5 bonus** is applied to their Saving Throw.
- An ally that enters the aura while suffering from one of these effects may immediately attempt **one new Saving Throw** to end a single qualifying effect.
- This Saving Throw gains **+2** *(half the aura's normal bonus, rounded down)*.
- This reroll may only be attempted **once per aura activation** for each creature.
- Multiple **Aura of Courage** effects do not stack. If affected by more than one, only the strongest version applies.

### Lore

By the time a Paladin reaches this level of mastery, their presence has become a sanctuary for the minds and hearts of those around them. Countless tales tell of warriors standing firm against eldritch horrors, ancient dragons, and master enchanters simply because they refused to leave the reassuring light of a Paladin's aura.

Many theologians believe this is where divine courage transcends emotion and becomes something greater—a sacred certainty that cannot easily be shaken. Those who have fought beside such champions often recall feeling as though no darkness, however terrible, could truly reach them while they remained within the Paladin's light.

> *"Darkness first seeks to conquer the mind. Stand within the light, and let your resolve answer instead."*  
> **— Saint Aurelia, Keeper of the Eternal Flame**

## Rank 5
### Description

Your courage has become a divine sanctuary upon the battlefield. Those who fight beside you stand beneath the protection of an unwavering spirit, their resolve fortified by the sacred conviction that radiates from your very soul. Terror, manipulation and despair struggle to take hold against those sheltered within your presence.

Your aura is no longer simply a source of inspiration—it is a bastion against the forces that seek to break the will. Allies who remain within your light find themselves standing firm against horrors that would send entire armies fleeing, while those who return to your protection after succumbing to darkness are given one final opportunity to reclaim themselves.

Among the greatest Paladins, Aura of Courage is remembered as the defining symbol of their leadership. It is said that when such champions stand their ground, hope itself refuses to retreat.

### Effects

- Spend **455 MP** to activate **Aura of Courage**.
- Create a **15 metre radius Aura** centred on yourself for **8 Rounds**.
- The aura moves with you.
- Allies already within the aura have **Advantage on Saving Throws** against the **Fear**, **Charm**, and **Mental** conditions or effects.
- If an ally is targeted by a qualifying effect while already inside the aura, they make the Saving Throw with **Advantage**.
- An ally that enters the aura while already suffering one of these effects may immediately attempt **one new Saving Throw** to end a single qualifying effect.
- This Saving Throw gains **+4**.
- This reroll may only be attempted **once per aura activation** for each creature.
- Multiple **Aura of Courage** effects do not stack. If affected by more than one, only the strongest version applies.

### Lore

The oldest legends speak of Paladins whose courage burned so brightly that despair itself could not enter their presence. Their companions marched into impossible battles without hesitation, not because they believed victory was certain, but because they knew they would never face the darkness alone.

To stand within the Aura of Courage is to be reminded of every oath sworn, every sacrifice made, and every reason worth fighting for. In those moments, fear becomes merely another obstacle to overcome, and hope becomes as tangible as the shield held before you.

> *"Hope is not a feeling. It is the courage to stand when every voice tells you to flee."*  
> **— Saint Aurelian, First Warden of the Radiant Host**

## Prerequisites
None

## Synergy

the oldest knightly orders teach that courage is not born from victory, but from trust. warriors who stand beside a seasoned paladin often find themselves confronting impossible odds with a calm they cannot fully explain. it is not the absence of fear that strengthens them, but the certainty that they do not stand alone.

many commanders intentionally place experienced paladins where enemy terror is expected to be greatest. their presence has turned collapsing battle lines into legendary last stands, proving that a single steadfast soul can become the foundation upon which an entire army refuses to break.

> *"stand with me, and let your courage become greater than your fear."*  
> **— dame elowyn, captain of the silver wardens**

your unwavering faith becomes a beacon that reaches beyond courage alone. allies who stand within your divine presence find their minds fortified against both terror and manipulation, allowing them to remain steadfast when others would falter.

the aura you project is no longer simply a source of bravery—it becomes a sanctuary of resolve. those who fight beneath your protection discover that fear loses its grip, while attempts to cloud their judgement or sway their will are met with remarkable resistance. although those who seek refuge after succumbing to such effects may still recover, the greatest protection is reserved for those who remain within your light from the beginning.

as your mastery grows, your companions begin to place complete trust in your presence, knowing that while your aura surrounds them, neither fear nor deception can easily break their resolve.

- spend **35 mp** to activate **aura of courage**.
- create a **10 metre radius aura** centred on yourself for **5 rounds**.

- allies already within the aura gain **+4 to saving throws against the fear and charm conditions**.

- an ally that enters the aura while suffering the **fear** or **charm** condition may immediately attempt **one new saving throw** to end one of those effects.
- this saving throw gains **+2** *(half the aura's normal bonus, rounded down)*.

to witness a veteran paladin standing firm amid impossible odds is to understand why courage is considered contagious. their presence inspires more than confidence—it reminds those around them who they are, what they fight for, and why no force should be allowed to bend their will.

> *"a frightened heart may stumble. a faithful heart always finds its way home."*  
> **— high justicar alaric, keeper of the sacred bastion**

your courage has become an unwavering bastion of the mind. those who stand beside you find their thoughts steadied, their resolve strengthened, and their spirits shielded from forces that seek to overwhelm, deceive, or corrupt them. fear no longer stands alone as your enemy—any assault upon the will itself struggles against the divine conviction you project.

the aura surrounding you radiates calm amidst chaos. companions fighting beneath your protection discover that even the darkest horrors and most insidious enchantments lose much of their power. while those who seek refuge after succumbing to such effects may still recover, those who remain steadfast within your presence receive the greatest blessing of your unwavering faith.

the strongest paladins understand that courage is not merely the absence of fear. it is the strength to remain true to yourself when every force in the world attempts to make you someone else.

many theologians believe this is where divine courage transcends emotion and becomes something greater—a sacred certainty that cannot easily be shaken. those who have fought beside such champions often recall feeling as though no darkness, however terrible, could truly reach them while they remained within the paladin's light.

# Aura of Valor

## Overview
The courage of a true Paladin is infectious. Through unwavering faith and steadfast resolve, your presence inspires those around you to stand firm against impossible odds. Allies fighting beside you find renewed confidence in their own abilities, emboldened by the certainty that they do not stand alone.

Unlike miraculous blessings that must be consciously invoked, the Aura of Valor is a constant expression of your devotion. Whether defending a village, charging into battle, or standing as the last line between darkness and the innocent, your conviction strengthens the hearts of those who choose to fight at your side.

Though every patron manifests this aura differently, its purpose remains the same—to inspire greatness in those who share your cause. Radiant light, spectral ravens, blooming life, celestial flame, infernal embers, or countless other divine manifestations remind friend and foe alike that true courage can change the course of any battle.

## Rank 1
### Description

The courage of a true Paladin is infectious. Through unwavering faith and steadfast resolve, your presence inspires those around you to stand firm against impossible odds. Allies fighting beside you find renewed confidence in their own abilities, emboldened by the certainty that they do not stand alone.

Unlike miraculous blessings that must be consciously invoked, the Aura of Valor is a constant expression of your devotion. Whether defending a village, charging into battle, or standing as the last line between darkness and the innocent, your conviction strengthens the hearts of those who choose to fight at your side.

Though every patron manifests this aura differently, its purpose remains the same—to inspire greatness in those who share your cause. Radiant light, spectral ravens, blooming life, celestial flame, infernal embers, or countless other divine manifestations remind friend and foe alike that true courage can change the course of any battle.

### Effects

- While you are **conscious**, project a **5 metre Aura of Valor**.
- Allies within the aura gain **+2 on Attack Rolls**.
- Allies within the aura gain **+2 damage** with melee and ranged weapon attacks.
- A creature only benefits from one **Aura of Valor** at a time.
- The visual appearance of the aura is determined by your chosen patron.
- Additional effects granted by your patron's **Divine Authority** apply where applicable.

### Lore

Military commanders throughout Asteria have long sought the companionship of Paladins, not merely for their martial prowess, but for the remarkable effect their presence has upon those around them. Warriors who would normally falter often find themselves standing resolute, driven onward by the unwavering conviction radiating from the Paladin's soul.

Many songs tell of hopeless battles won because a single champion refused to yield. Those who survived rarely speak of overwhelming strength or divine miracles. Instead, they remember the feeling that, so long as the Paladin still stood, victory remained possible.

> *"Valor is not the absence of fear. It is the courage to inspire others even while fear stands beside you."*  
> **— Sir Aldren, First Shield of the Covenant**

## Rank 2
### Description

Your unwavering courage continues to inspire those who fight beside you. Warriors within your presence find themselves acting with greater confidence, striking with renewed determination and refusing to surrender even against overwhelming odds. Your patron's influence strengthens every ally who chooses to stand alongside you, forging a united front that is far greater than the sum of its parts.

As your mastery grows, the Aura of Valor becomes more than simple inspiration—it becomes a symbol of unity. Allies instinctively fight with greater discipline, trusting in one another and drawing strength from your steadfast leadership. Whether charging into battle or holding the line against impossible enemies, your presence reminds every companion that courage shared is courage multiplied.

### Effects

- While you are **conscious**, project a **7 metre Aura of Valor**.
- Allies within the aura gain **+2 on Attack Rolls**.
- Allies within the aura gain **+4 damage** with melee and ranged weapon attacks.
- The first melee weapon attack an ally makes each round while within the aura deals an additional **+1 Patron Damage**.
- A creature only benefits from one **Aura of Valor** at a time.
- The visual appearance and Patron Damage type are determined by your chosen patron.
- Additional effects granted by your patron's **Divine Authority** apply where applicable.

### Lore

Paladins who reach this level of mastery become natural rallying points upon the battlefield. Soldiers often recount that fear fades when they stand beside such champions, replaced instead by an overwhelming desire to protect those fighting alongside them. Entire companies have been known to hold impossible defensive lines simply because a Paladin's banner still flew above the battlefield.

Temples teach that true valor is not measured by the strength of a single warrior, but by the courage they awaken in others. Through unwavering faith, a Paladin becomes the heart of every formation, binding companions together through shared conviction and divine purpose.

> *"One brave soul may begin the charge, but true valor is measured by how many find the courage to follow."*  
> **— Sir Aldren, First Shield of the Covenant**

## Rank 3
### Description

Your presence has become a symbol of unwavering heroism, inspiring extraordinary acts of courage from those who fight beside you. Allies no longer draw strength solely from your conviction—they begin to fight with greater precision, coordination, and confidence, trusting completely in the leadership of your patron's chosen champion.

Every advance becomes more decisive, every strike more deliberate, and every victory more achievable. Warriors who once hesitated now press forward with renewed determination, emboldened by the knowledge that they stand beneath the watchful blessing of your patron. Whether leading a handful of companions or an entire army, your Aura of Valor transforms ordinary soldiers into steadfast heroes.

Though every patron expresses this blessing differently, all share the same purpose: to inspire courage through action and reward those willing to stand together against overwhelming darkness.

### Effects

- While you are **conscious**, project a **10 metre Aura of Valor**.
- Allies within the aura gain **+4 on Attack Rolls**.
- Allies within the aura gain **+4 damage** with melee and ranged weapon attacks.
- The first successful weapon attack each round made by an ally within the aura deals an additional **1d4 Patron Damage**.
- Allies within the aura gain **+2 on Critical Confirmation Rolls** (or **+2 to confirm Critical Hits**, if your system uses confirmation rolls).
- A creature may only benefit from one **Aura of Valor** at a time.
- The appearance of the aura and the Patron Damage type are determined by your chosen patron.
- Additional effects granted by your patron's **Divine Authority** apply where applicable.

### Lore

As legends spread across Asteria, veteran soldiers speak not only of the Paladin's strength, but of the impossible feats accomplished by those who fought beside them. Entire companies have stood firm against impossible odds, inspired by the unwavering conviction radiating from a single champion whose faith never faltered.

Many commanders believe that true valor is contagious. While courage may begin within one heart, it is through shared conviction that armies accomplish the impossible. Those blessed by a master's Aura of Valor often leave the battlefield believing they achieved far more than they ever thought themselves capable of.

> *"A hero may win a duel. A true champion gives others the courage to win a war."*  
> **— Sir Aldren, First Shield of the Covenant**

## Rank 4
### Description

Your unwavering courage has become legendary, inspiring extraordinary acts of heroism from all who fight beside you. Your patron's blessing radiates far beyond your own strength, urging companions to strike boldly, defend one another, and press the attack with unwavering confidence. Those who stand within your presence feel as though victory is always within reach, no matter how overwhelming the enemy.

Veteran warriors often describe this aura as impossible to ignore. Doubt fades, hesitation disappears, and every ally instinctively fights with greater purpose. Your patron's divine will flows through your leadership, transforming a band of adventurers into a unified force capable of overcoming challenges that would otherwise seem impossible.

To enemies, your presence is equally terrifying. Every successful strike delivered by your companions serves as another reminder that they are not facing a lone Paladin, but the united conviction of an entire company blessed by the divine.

### Effects

- While you are **conscious**, project a **12 metre Aura of Valor**.
- Allies within the aura gain **+2 on Attack Rolls**.
- Allies within the aura gain **+6 damage** with melee and ranged weapon attacks.
- The first successful weapon attack each round made by an ally within the aura deals an additional **1d6 Patron Damage**.
- Once per round, when an ally within the aura scores a **Critical Hit**, they immediately gain **+2 AC** until the start of their next turn.
- A creature may only benefit from one **Aura of Valor** at a time.
- The appearance of the aura and the **Patron Damage** type are determined by your chosen patron.
- Additional effects granted by your patron's **Divine Authority** apply where applicable.

### Lore

The greatest generals throughout Asteria have long sought the companionship of Paladins whose Aura of Valor could inspire entire armies to achieve what should have been impossible. Tales tell of defenders who held broken walls, exhausted soldiers who found renewed strength, and desperate charges that became glorious victories simply because one faithful champion refused to yield.

Such Paladins become living banners upon the battlefield. Wherever they stand, courage flourishes, hope endures, and even the darkest conflicts become opportunities for heroes to rise above fear and embrace the ideals their patron represents.

> *"Valor is not measured by the strength of one champion, but by the greatness they awaken in every soul willing to stand beside them."*  
> **— Sir Aldren, First Shield of the Covenant**

## Rank 5
### Description

Your courage has become an unshakable beacon of hope, inspiring extraordinary acts of heroism in all who stand beside you. The battlefield itself seems to rally around your presence as your patron's divine blessing flows through every ally who shares your cause. Fear is replaced by determination, hesitation gives way to decisive action, and even the darkest battles become opportunities to prove the strength of unwavering conviction.

Veteran Paladins who reach this level are remembered not only for their own deeds, but for the heroes they inspire. Entire companies fight harder beneath their banner, companions discover reserves of strength they never knew they possessed, and impossible victories become legendary tales passed down through generations. Wherever your Aura of Valor shines, your patron's ideals become a living force that unites those willing to stand together.

Though every patron manifests this blessing differently, each reminds friend and foe alike that true valor is never the work of one champion alone—it is the courage shared by all who fight with unwavering faith.

### Effects

- While you are **conscious**, project a **15 metre Aura of Valor**.
- Allies within the aura gain **+2 on Attack Rolls**.
- Allies within the aura gain **+8 damage** with melee and ranged weapon attacks.
- The first successful weapon attack each round made by an ally within the aura deals an additional **1d8 Patron Damage**.
- Once per round, when an ally within the aura scores a **Critical Hit**, they immediately gain **+2 AC** until the start of their next turn.
- Once per round, an ally within the aura may **reroll one missed weapon attack**. The second result must be used.
- A creature may only benefit from one **Aura of Valor** at a time.
- The appearance of the aura and the **Patron Damage** type are determined by your chosen patron.
- Additional effects granted by your patron's **Divine Authority** apply where applicable.

### Lore

The greatest Paladins in history are remembered not because they stood alone against impossible odds, but because they inspired others to do the same. Their courage became contagious, their conviction unwavering, and their presence transformed ordinary soldiers into legendary heroes whose names would be remembered for centuries.

The oldest temples teach that this is the highest expression of valor—not personal glory, but the ability to awaken greatness within others. Those blessed with such an aura become living symbols of their patron's ideals, carrying hope wherever they travel and reminding all who witness them that true courage is strongest when it is shared.

> *"A single hero may save a life. A true champion teaches others they were heroes all along."*  
> **— Sir Aldren, First Shield of the Covenant**

- a creature may only benefit from one **aura of valor** at a time.
- the appearance of the aura and the **patron damage** type are determined by your chosen patron.
- additional effects granted by your patron's **divine authority** apply where applicable.

### lore

the greatest paladins in history are remembered not because they stood alone against impossible odds, but because they inspired others to do the same. their courage became contagious, their conviction unwavering, and their presence transformed ordinary soldiers into legendary heroes whose names would be remembered for centuries.

the oldest temples teach that this is the highest expression of valor—not personal glory, but the ability to awaken greatness within others. those blessed with such an aura become living symbols of their patron's ideals, carrying hope wherever they travel and reminding all who witness them that true courage is strongest when it is shared.

> *"a single hero may save a life. a true champion teaches others they were heroes all along."*  
> **— sir aldren, first shield of the covenant**
