# Aura Reading

## Overview
Every magical element leaves behind a unique essence that permeates the world around it. Through meditation and years of study, Druids learn to open their senses beyond ordinary sight, allowing them to perceive these elemental auras.

Unlike other forms of magical detection, Aura Reading is limited by the Druid's own understanding. You can only perceive the elemental essences of magical elements you have personally mastered. As your knowledge of magic grows, so too does your ability to interpret the unseen world.

Because Earth is the foundation of every Druid's training, its essence speaks more clearly than any other. The land willingly reveals details that remain hidden within other elemental auras.

---

## Rank 1
### Description

Every magical element leaves behind a unique essence that permeates the world around it. Through meditation and years of study, Druids learn to open their senses beyond ordinary sight, allowing them to perceive these elemental auras.

Unlike other forms of magical detection, Aura Reading is limited by the Druid's own understanding. You can only perceive the elemental essences of magical elements you have personally mastered. As your knowledge of magic grows, so too does your ability to interpret the unseen world.

Because Earth is the foundation of every Druid's training, its essence speaks more clearly than any other. The land willingly reveals details that remain hidden within other elemental auras.

---

### Effects

- Activate **Aura Reading** by spending **10 MP**.
- While active, Aura Reading costs **5 MP every 5 seconds** to maintain.
- Aura Reading lasts for up to **5 minutes**, or until manually dismissed.
- Detect the **elemental essence** of all magical elements you currently know within **10 metres**.
- Each known magical element appears as a distinct aura, allowing you to identify its elemental affinity.
- **Earth Essence** reveals whether the aura originates from a **creature**, an **enchanted object**, or an **active Earth spell**.
- Gain **+1 to D20 Perception Checks** when locating creatures, magical objects, or magical effects emitting a known elemental essence.
- Aura Reading requires **line of sight** and cannot perceive through solid objects such as walls, dense stone, metal, or sealed containers.
- At this rank, Aura Reading only reveals the **presence** and **elemental affinity** of an aura. It does not reveal the aura's strength, duration, magical effect, or lingering magical residue.

---

### Lore

The oldest Druids teach that every element sings its own silent song. Stone hums with patience, rivers whisper with change, flames roar with passion, and the wind carries stories beyond the horizon. To those without training, these voices are forever silent. To a Druid, they become as clear as daylight.

Every apprentice begins by learning to recognise the steady heartbeat of Earth. Only after mastering this first elemental essence can they hope to understand the countless other energies that weave together the natural world.

Aura Reading is not about seeing magic—it is about recognising the elemental truths that lie beneath it. Every new magical element a Druid learns adds another voice to the chorus, slowly revealing the hidden tapestry of Asteria.

---

> *"Magic hides from the eyes, but never from the elements that gave it form."*  
> — **Grand Archdruid Rowan Thornbark, First Warden of the Emerald Wilds**

## Rank 2
### Description

Your connection to the elemental essences of the world has strengthened, allowing you to perceive them with greater clarity and understanding. Where once you could only identify an elemental affinity, you can now begin to interpret the condition of that essence and recognise subtle differences between natural, sustained, and fading magic.

As your mastery grows, every magical element you know becomes easier to distinguish. The Earth, however, continues to offer deeper insight than any other, revealing details that remain hidden within other elemental essences.

---

### Effects

- Activate **Aura Reading** by spending **15 MP**.
- While active, Aura Reading costs **5 MP every 5 seconds** to maintain.
- Aura Reading lasts for up to **10 minutes**, or until manually dismissed.
- Detect the **elemental essence** of all magical elements you currently know within **15 metres**.
- Each known magical element appears as a distinct aura, allowing you to identify its elemental affinity.
- You can determine whether a known elemental aura is:
  - **Natural**
  - **Enchanted**
  - **Actively channelled**
  - **Lingering**
- **Earth Essence** reveals whether the aura originates from a **creature**, **object**, **active spell**, or **lingering magical residue**.
- Gain **+2 to D20 Perception Checks** when locating creatures, magical objects, or magical effects emitting a known elemental essence.
- Aura Reading requires **line of sight** and cannot perceive through solid objects such as walls, dense stone, metal, or sealed containers.
- Aura Reading still does not reveal an aura's exact spell, enchantment, strength, or magical effects.

---

### Lore

To an experienced Druid, every elemental essence carries its own rhythm. Some burn brightly with active power, while others linger like fading footprints left behind by ancient magic. Learning to distinguish these subtle differences is the first step towards truly understanding the language of the elements.

The elder circles teach that the Earth is the oldest witness to every spell ever cast. Though other elements reveal their presence, it is the patient memory of stone and soil that often uncovers truths long after the magic itself has faded.

With practice, a Druid begins to realise that Aura Reading is not merely about seeing magic—it is about listening to the stories each element leaves behind.

---

> *"The wise do not ask whether magic was used. They ask what the elements remember."*  
> — **Grand Archdruid Rowan Thornbark, First Warden of the Emerald Wilds**

## Rank 3
### Description

Your understanding of elemental essences has grown beyond simple observation. You no longer perceive magic as isolated auras, but as flowing energies that interact with the world around them. Every known element leaves behind a unique signature, allowing you to distinguish recent magic from ancient enchantments and stable energies from those on the verge of collapse.

The Earth continues to guide your perception more clearly than any other element. Its patient nature reveals traces of magic that others overlook, preserving echoes of events long after they have passed.

As your magical knowledge expands, Aura Reading automatically adapts, allowing every magical element you have mastered to be interpreted with the same growing level of understanding.

---

### Effects

- Activate **Aura Reading** by spending **20 MP**.
- While active, Aura Reading costs **5 MP every 5 seconds** to maintain.
- Aura Reading lasts for up to **15 minutes**, or until manually dismissed.
- Detect the **elemental essence** of all magical elements you currently know within **20 metres**.
- Each known magical element appears as a distinct aura, allowing you to identify its elemental affinity.
- You can determine whether an aura is:
  - **Natural**
  - **Enchanted**
  - **Actively channelled**
  - **Lingering**
- You can judge the **relative strength** of a known aura as **Faint**, **Moderate**, or **Powerful**.
- **Earth Essence** additionally reveals whether the aura was created **recently** or has remained in the area for an extended period.
- Gain **+3 to D20 Perception Checks** when locating creatures, magical objects, or magical effects emitting a known elemental essence.
- Aura Reading requires **line of sight** and cannot perceive through solid objects such as walls, dense stone, metal, or sealed containers.
- Aura Reading does not reveal the exact spell, enchantment, or magical effect responsible for an aura.

---

### Lore

To the untrained eye, magic appears as little more than flashes of power. To an experienced Druid, every elemental essence carries a history. Stone remembers every enchantment carved into it, rivers carry the echoes of ancient rituals, and even the wind bears traces of spells cast moments before.

The elders teach that understanding the age and strength of an aura is often more valuable than knowing its purpose. A fading essence may speak of a traveller long gone, while a powerful aura lingering in silence may warn of dangers yet to awaken.

Only those who patiently study the language of the elements begin to realise that magic is never truly fleeting—it always leaves a story for those capable of reading it.

---

> *"Magic may fade from sight, but the elements never forget who called upon them."*  
> — **Grand Archdruid Rowan Thornbark, First Warden of the Emerald Wilds**

## Rank 4
### Description

Your perception of elemental essences has become exceptionally refined. Every magical element you have mastered reveals not only its presence, but also the story behind its use. The invisible currents of magic are no longer isolated traces—they become interconnected patterns that reveal how elemental forces shape the world.

The Earth remains your greatest teacher. Stone and soil preserve echoes of magic long after other elements have faded, allowing you to uncover details hidden from less experienced practitioners. As you continue to master new magical elements, Aura Reading expands alongside your knowledge, granting deeper understanding of every essence you have learned.

To veteran Druids, the world itself becomes an open tome, its pages written not with ink, but with the lingering essence of elemental magic.

---

### Effects

- Activate **Aura Reading** by spending **25 MP**.
- While active, Aura Reading costs **5 MP every 5 seconds** to maintain.
- Aura Reading lasts for up to **20 minutes**, or until manually dismissed.
- Detect the **elemental essence** of all magical elements you currently know within **25 metres**.
- Each known magical element appears as a distinct aura, allowing you to identify its elemental affinity.
- You can determine whether an aura is:
  - **Natural**
  - **Enchanted**
  - **Actively channelled**
  - **Lingering**
- You can determine whether an aura is **Weak**, **Minor**, **Greater**, or **Strengthened**.
- You can recognise whether multiple known elemental essences are interacting with one another.
- **Earth Essence** additionally reveals whether the magical essence is **stable**, **fractured**, or **corrupted**, helping identify damaged enchantments, unstable rituals, or tainted Earth magic.
- Gain **+4 to D20 Perception Checks** when locating creatures, magical objects, or magical effects emitting a known elemental essence.
- Aura Reading requires **line of sight** and cannot perceive through solid objects such as walls, dense stone, metal, or sealed containers.
- Aura Reading still cannot identify the exact spell, enchantment, or technique responsible for an aura.

---

### Lore

Among the oldest Druidic Circles, reaching this level of Aura Reading is considered the mark of a true elemental scholar. Few possess the patience required to study the subtle differences between magical essences, and fewer still can interpret the countless interactions that occur whenever multiple elements converge.

The Earth is said to remember every spell ever cast upon it. Ancient standing stones, forgotten temples, and sacred groves often bear echoes of powerful rituals that only the most accomplished Druids can perceive. By reading these lingering impressions, entire histories have been uncovered without a single written record.

Those who witness a master of Aura Reading often believe they are simply staring into empty space. In truth, the Druid is observing a vibrant tapestry of elemental essences woven together across the world, each one telling a story to those capable of understanding its silent language.

---

> *"The greatest mysteries are never hidden. They are simply written in a language few have learned to read."*  
> — **Grand Archdruid Rowan Thornbark, First Warden of the Emerald Wilds**

## Rank 5
### Description

Your understanding of elemental essences has reached its pinnacle. Every magical element you have mastered reveals itself with remarkable clarity, allowing you to read the invisible tapestry of magic woven throughout the world. To you, elemental auras are no longer fleeting glimmers of power—they are expressions of the forces that shape life, nature, and the world itself.

Each magical element tells a different story, and your growing mastery allows you to interpret only those elements you truly understand. A Druid who has devoted themselves to Earth sees the silent memories preserved within stone, while one who has studied Water perceives its endless flow and purity. No two Druids perceive the world in exactly the same way, for Aura Reading reflects the magical knowledge of its wielder.

The Earth remains your greatest teacher. Its essence reveals truths hidden even from the most experienced practitioners of other magical disciplines, making it the cornerstone of every Druid's perception.

---

### Effects

- Activate **Aura Reading** by spending **30 MP**.
- While active, Aura Reading costs **5 MP every 5 seconds** to maintain.
- Aura Reading lasts for up to **30 minutes**, or until manually dismissed.
- Detect the **elemental essence** of all magical elements you currently know within **30 metres**.
- Each known magical element appears as a distinct aura, allowing you to immediately identify its elemental affinity.
- You can determine whether an aura is:
  - **Natural**
  - **Enchanted**
  - **Actively Channelled**
  - **Lingering**
- You can determine an aura's magical strength as:
  - **Weak**
  - **Minor**
  - **Greater**
  - **Strengthened**
- You can recognise when multiple elemental essences are interacting and identify each known element involved.
- **Earth Essence** reveals whether the aura originates from a **creature**, **object**, **spell**, **enchantment**, or **ritual**, and whether the Earth's essence is **stable**, **fractured**, or **corrupted**.
- Gain **+5 to D20 Perception Checks** when locating creatures, magical objects, enchantments, or magical effects emitting a known elemental essence.
- Aura Reading requires **line of sight** and cannot perceive through solid objects such as walls, dense stone, metal, or sealed containers.
- Aura Reading only interprets the elemental essences you have personally learned. Unknown magical elements remain visible as unidentified magical auras.

---

### Lore

To the Archdruids of old, Aura Reading was never considered a spell—it was a way of perceiving the world as the elements themselves do. Every stone remembers, every river carries echoes, every flame leaves passion in its wake, and every breeze whispers of distant lands. Those who master this talent become living interpreters of these silent voices.

It is said that the greatest Druids could walk through forgotten ruins and recount centuries of magical history simply by observing the elemental essences lingering within the walls. They needed no written records, for the world itself preserved every story in the language of the elements.

Though many practitioners of magic seek greater power, Druids believe true wisdom comes from understanding. Aura Reading stands as the embodiment of that belief, reminding every Druid that magic is not merely cast—it is woven into the very fabric of Asteria.

---

> *"The elements have never hidden their truths. They have only waited for someone patient enough to learn their language."*  
> — **Grand Archdruid Rowan Thornbark, First Warden of the Emerald Wilds**

None

# Avatar of Conviction

## Overview
Your unwavering faith has earned the greatest honour a mortal champion can receive. For a brief moment, your patron allows a fragment of their divine essence to flow directly through your body, transforming you into their chosen Avatar upon the mortal plane.

While this transformation endures, your presence alone radiates overwhelming divine authority. Every action you perform reflects your patron's ideals, every strike carries their judgement, and every miracle manifests with unparalleled clarity. Though your mortal form cannot withstand such power for long, those few moments are often enough to alter the fate of an entire battle.

Every Avatar is unique to their patron. Some radiate blinding celestial light, others are surrounded by spectral ravens, crimson blood, divine storms, flourishing life, sacred flames, or manifestations beyond mortal understanding. Regardless of appearance, all who witness an Avatar know they stand before the living champion of a god.

## Rank 1
### Description

Your unwavering faith has earned the greatest honour a mortal champion can receive. For a brief moment, your patron allows a fragment of their divine essence to flow directly through your body, transforming you into their chosen Avatar upon the mortal plane.

While this transformation endures, your presence alone radiates overwhelming divine authority. Every action you perform reflects your patron's ideals, every strike carries their judgement, and every miracle manifests with unparalleled clarity. Though your mortal form cannot withstand such power for long, those few moments are often enough to alter the fate of an entire battle.

Every Avatar is unique to their patron. Some radiate blinding celestial light, others are surrounded by spectral ravens, crimson blood, divine storms, flourishing life, sacred flames, or manifestations beyond mortal understanding. Regardless of appearance, all who witness an Avatar know they stand before the living champion of a god.

### Effects

- Spend **500 MP** and **100 SP** to assume your **Avatar of Conviction**.
- **Cooldown:** **Long Rest**.
- Avatar of Conviction lasts for **5 Rounds**.
- While transformed:
  - Gain **Advantage on all Saving Throws.**
  - Gain **+2 AC**.
  - Increase all **Patron Damage** by **25%**.
  - Increase all healing granted by your patron's abilities by **25%**.
  - Your movement speed increases by **2 metres**.
  - You count as both your normal creature type and a **Divine Avatar**.
  - Your appearance transforms to reflect your patron's divine nature.
- All abilities continue to use your patron's **Divine Resonance**, **Divine Opposition**, and **Divine Authority**.
- Avatar of Conviction ends immediately if you become unconscious.

### Lore

Only a handful of mortals throughout history have ever been recognised as true Avatars. Such champions are remembered not for their own strength, but because the gods themselves chose to act through them. During these fleeting moments, the boundary between the mortal and divine realms grows thin, allowing a fragment of the patron's essence to manifest within their faithful servant.

The transformation is neither comfortable nor without risk. Mortal bodies were never meant to contain divine power, and even the greatest champions can sustain it only briefly before the strain becomes unbearable. Yet for those few moments, hope itself walks beside the faithful, and the enemies of the divine witness the full majesty of a patron's chosen champion.

> *"For a single heartbeat, the heavens do not merely answer—they walk beside us."*  
> **— High Hierophant Cassiel, Keeper of the Sacred Covenant**

## Rank 2
### Description

Your patron now entrusts you with a greater measure of their divine essence. The transformation no longer merely empowers your body—it begins to reshape your very presence, allowing your conviction to radiate across the battlefield as a living symbol of your patron's authority. Allies fight with renewed confidence while enemies instinctively recognise the overwhelming power standing before them.

Though still fleeting, the Avatar endures longer and carries greater divine strength. Every miracle, every strike, and every act of protection reflects the unwavering bond between champion and patron. During these moments, your actions cease to represent your own will alone—they become an extension of the divine purpose you have sworn to uphold.

Every manifestation remains unique to your patron. Whether clothed in celestial radiance, sacred storms, spectral ravens, flourishing life, crimson blood, or another divine form, the Avatar is unmistakably recognised as one chosen by the gods.

### Effects

- Spend **600 MP** and **120 SP** to assume your **Avatar of Conviction**.
- **Cooldown:** **Long Rest**.
- Avatar of Conviction lasts for **6 Rounds**.
- While transformed:
  - Gain **Advantage on all Saving Throws**.
  - Gain **+3 AC**.
  - Increase all **Patron Damage** by **35%**.
  - Increase all healing granted by your patron's abilities by **35%**.
  - Increase your Movement Speed by **4 metres**.
  - Gain **Advantage on Saving Throws against conditions** inflicted by creatures aligned with your patron's **Divine Opposition**.
  - You count as both your normal creature type and a **Divine Avatar**.
  - Your appearance transforms to reflect your patron's divine nature.
- All patron abilities continue to use your patron's **Divine Resonance**, **Divine Opposition**, and **Divine Authority**.
- Additional Avatar blessings granted by your chosen patron apply while transformed.
- Avatar of Conviction ends immediately if you become unconscious.

### Lore

Throughout history, only the greatest champions have sustained the divine presence for more than a fleeting instant. Their names are carved into temple walls not because they possessed unmatched strength, but because they remained worthy vessels through which their patron's will could be expressed. Every transformation is both a blessing and a burden, for the mortal soul was never intended to contain such overwhelming power.

As your covenant deepens, your patron places greater trust in you, allowing more of their divine essence to flow through your body. Each transformation strengthens the bond between deity and champion, preparing you for the day when your name will stand beside the greatest Avatars recorded in the sacred histories.

> *"Power alone does not create an Avatar. Only unwavering conviction can bear the weight of the divine."*  
> **— High Hierophant Cassiel, Keeper of the Sacred Covenant**

## Rank 3
### Description

Your patron's divine essence now flows through you with remarkable clarity, allowing you to briefly transcend the limitations of mortality. During your transformation, you no longer resemble a mere champion of the divine—you become a living extension of your patron's will upon the battlefield.

The divine presence surrounding you inspires unwavering courage in the faithful while causing those who oppose your patron to hesitate before striking. Every movement carries supernatural grace, every miracle is amplified by your unbreakable conviction, and every enemy witnesses the terrifying reality of a mortal chosen to bear divine power.

Although the transformation remains temporary, your body has grown capable of sustaining a greater portion of your patron's essence. Legends tell of champions who stood alone against overwhelming armies during this sacred state, their conviction proving stronger than any blade.

### Effects

- Spend **700 MP** and **140 SP** to assume your **Avatar of Conviction**.
- **Cooldown:** **Long Rest**.
- Avatar of Conviction lasts for **7 Rounds**.

While transformed:

- Gain **Advantage on all Saving Throws**.
- Gain **+4 AC**.
- Increase all **Patron Damage** by **50%**.
- Increase all healing granted by your patron's abilities by **50%**.
- Increase your Movement Speed by **6 metres**.
- Gain **Advantage on Saving Throws** against effects originating from creatures aligned with your patron's **Divine Opposition**.
- Become **immune to the Frightened condition**.
- You count as both your normal creature type and a **Divine Avatar**.
- Your appearance transforms to reflect your patron's divine nature.
- Additional Avatar Blessings granted by your chosen patron apply while transformed.

- Avatar of Conviction immediately ends if you become unconscious.

### Lore

Few champions throughout history have ever attained this degree of divine embodiment. At this stage, the distinction between mortal servant and divine instrument begins to blur, allowing a greater portion of the patron's will to manifest through the Avatar. Entire battlefields have fallen silent upon witnessing such transformations, for even enemies recognise they stand before one chosen by powers far beyond the mortal realm.

Within the oldest temples, Rank III is regarded as the point where conviction itself becomes a weapon. The faithful no longer fight beside an ordinary Paladin—they march beside a living symbol of their patron's unwavering resolve, whose very presence inspires hope and challenges despair.

> *"Faith gives strength. Conviction gives purpose. An Avatar possesses both, and through them the gods change the course of history."*  
> **— High Hierophant Cassiel, Keeper of the Sacred Covenant**

## Rank 4
### Description

Your conviction has reached a level where your mortal body can barely contain the divine essence entrusted to it. When your patron's power flows through you, the distinction between champion and deity begins to fade. Your presence alone inspires unwavering courage within the faithful while striking doubt into the hearts of those who oppose your patron's divine will.

During this transformation, the world itself seems to acknowledge your patron's authority. The ground beneath your feet trembles with sacred energy, your voice carries supernatural weight, and your body radiates the unmistakable presence of the divine. Every movement reflects absolute purpose, every miracle becomes a declaration of your patron's power, and every enemy understands they face more than a mortal warrior.

Although the transformation remains temporary, few beings can witness an Avatar of this magnitude without believing they have stood before a living legend.

### Effects

- Spend **800 MP** and **160 SP** to assume your **Avatar of Conviction**.
- **Cooldown:** **Long Rest**.
- Avatar of Conviction lasts for **8 Rounds**.

While transformed:

- Gain **Advantage on all Saving Throws.**
- Gain **+5 AC.**
- Increase all **Patron Damage** by **65%**.
- Increase all healing granted by your patron's abilities by **65%**.
- Increase your **Movement Speed by 8 metres.**
- Gain **Advantage on Saving Throws** against effects originating from creatures aligned with your patron's **Divine Opposition**.
- Become **immune to the Frightened condition.**
- Gain **Divine Levitation**, allowing you to hover up to **30 centimetres** above the ground. While levitating, you ignore difficult terrain and may move across water, unstable ground, and similar surfaces, but you do **not** gain the ability to fly.
- You count as both your normal creature type and a **Divine Avatar**.
- Your appearance transforms to reflect your patron's divine nature.
- Additional **Avatar Blessings** granted by your chosen patron apply while transformed.

- Avatar of Conviction immediately ends if you become unconscious.

### Lore

The oldest scriptures describe this transformation as the threshold where a champion's soul becomes capable of bearing an extraordinary fragment of divine essence. During these sacred moments, the Avatar no longer walks as an ordinary mortal. Every heartbeat echoes with unwavering conviction, every miracle reflects the ideals of their patron, and every action serves a purpose greater than themselves.

Many who have witnessed such Avatars claim that the champion never truly touched the earth. Whether this was divine illusion or undeniable truth remains the subject of theological debate, but all agree upon one certainty—those chosen to bear such power are remembered long after kingdoms have fallen and empires have faded.

> *"When conviction becomes absolute, the earth itself no longer dares burden the feet of the faithful."*  
> **— High Hierophant Cassiel, Keeper of the Sacred Covenant**

## Rank 5
### Description

There exists no greater honour for a mortal champion than to be acknowledged as the living Avatar of their patron. Through absolute faith, unwavering conviction, and countless acts of devotion, you have earned the right to bear a fragment of your patron's divine essence without hesitation or fear. For a brief time, your patron walks the mortal realm through you, transforming your body into a vessel of sacred purpose.

During this transformation, your very existence radiates divine authority. Allies stand emboldened by your presence, while those who oppose your patron feel the crushing weight of an undeniable truth—they do not face an ordinary warrior, but the chosen champion of a god.

Every Avatar reflects the nature of their patron. Some blaze with radiant light, others command celestial storms, crimson blood, sacred waters, spectral ravens, flourishing life, or manifestations beyond mortal understanding. Regardless of form, all who witness an Avatar understand that they stand before a living legend whose conviction has become inseparable from the divine.

### Effects

- Spend **1000 MP** and **200 SP** to assume your **Avatar of Conviction**.
- **Cooldown:** **Long Rest**.
- Avatar of Conviction lasts for **10 Rounds**.

#### While transformed

- Gain **Advantage on all Saving Throws**.
- Gain **+6 AC**.
- Increase all **Patron Damage** by **100%**.
- Increase all healing granted by your patron's abilities by **100%**.
- Increase your **Movement Speed by 10 metres**.
- Become **immune to the Frightened condition**.
- Gain **Divine Levitation**, allowing you to hover above the ground. While levitating, you ignore difficult terrain and may move across water, unstable terrain, and similar surfaces, but you do not gain true flight.
- Your patron's abilities **ignore Resistance** to their damage type (Immunity still applies).
- You count as both your normal creature type and a **Divine Avatar**.
- Your appearance completely transforms to reflect your patron's divine nature.
- All **Avatar Blessings** granted by your chosen patron remain active throughout the transformation.
- Avatar of Conviction immediately ends if you become unconscious.

### Lore

Only a handful of mortals throughout all of Asterian history have attained this sacred state. Their names are preserved within holy scripture, their deeds immortalised through song and legend, and their sacrifices remembered wherever faith endures. To become an Avatar is not to replace one's patron, nor to rival them, but to become the purest expression of their will upon the mortal plane.

Many scholars believe the transformation is less a gift than a burden. Mortal flesh was never meant to contain divine essence, and every moment spent as an Avatar tests the limits of both body and soul. Yet those chosen accept this burden willingly, knowing that their purpose is not to wield power for themselves, but to serve as the instrument through which their patron protects, judges, and inspires the world.

When the transformation finally ends, the memory of witnessing it remains forever etched into the hearts of friend and foe alike.

> *"An Avatar does not ask the gods for strength. They become the strength the gods choose to send."*  
> **— High Hierophant Cassiel, Keeper of the Sacred Covenant**

None

- gain **+6 ac**.
- increase all **patron damage** by **100%**.
- increase all healing granted by your patron's abilities by **100%**.
- increase your **movement speed by 10 metres**.
- become **immune to the frightened condition**.
- gain **divine levitation**, allowing you to hover above the ground. while levitating, you ignore difficult terrain and may move across water, unstable terrain, and similar surfaces, but you do not gain true flight.
- your patron's abilities **ignore resistance** to their damage type (immunity still applies).
- you count as both your normal creature type and a **divine avatar**.
- your appearance completely transforms to reflect your patron's divine nature.
- all **avatar blessings** granted by your chosen patron remain active throughout the transformation.
- avatar of conviction immediately ends if you become unconscious.

### lore

only a handful of mortals throughout all of asterian history have attained this sacred state. their names are preserved within holy scripture, their deeds immortalised through song and legend, and their sacrifices remembered wherever faith endures. to become an avatar is not to replace one's patron, nor to rival them, but to become the purest expression of their will upon the mortal plane.

many scholars believe the transformation is less a gift than a burden. mortal flesh was never meant to contain divine essence, and every moment spent as an avatar tests the limits of both body and soul. yet those chosen accept this burden willingly, knowing that their purpose is not to wield power for themselves, but to serve as the instrument through which their patron protects, judges, and inspires the world.

when the transformation finally ends, the memory of witnessing it remains forever etched into the hearts of friend and foe alike.

> *"an avatar does not ask the gods for strength. they become the strength the gods choose to send."*  
> **— high hierophant cassiel, keeper of the sacred covenant**

# Avatar of the Blade

## Overview
Avatar of the Blade is the ultimate expression of the Spellblade's lifelong pursuit of harmony between steel and mana. Upon activating this legendary technique, the Spellblade ceases to fight as an ordinary warrior. Every movement becomes instinctive, every strike perfectly balanced, and every thread of mana flows effortlessly through their body and weapon.

As the transformation begins, Arcane energy erupts around the Spellblade, surrounding them in a radiant aura matching their chosen magical affinity. Their Arcane Weapon shines with overwhelming power, leaving brilliant trails of mana through the air as reality itself seems to bend around every swing.

Only the greatest Spellblades in history have ever achieved this state. To allies it is a symbol of hope. To enemies it is the terrifying realization that they are no longer facing a warrior—they are facing the living embodiment of the Spellblade Orders.

## Rank 1
### Description

Avatar of the Blade is the ultimate expression of the Spellblade's lifelong pursuit of harmony between steel and mana. Upon activating this legendary technique, the Spellblade ceases to fight as an ordinary warrior. Every movement becomes instinctive, every strike perfectly balanced, and every thread of mana flows effortlessly through their body and weapon.

As the transformation begins, Arcane energy erupts around the Spellblade, surrounding them in a radiant aura matching their chosen magical affinity. Their Arcane Weapon shines with overwhelming power, leaving brilliant trails of mana through the air as reality itself seems to bend around every swing.

Only the greatest Spellblades in history have ever achieved this state. To allies it is a symbol of hope. To enemies it is the terrifying realization that they are no longer facing a warrior—they are facing the living embodiment of the Spellblade Orders.

### Effects

Spend **1 Action Point**, **150 MP**, and **50 SP** to enter **Avatar of the Blade**.

Avatar of the Blade lasts for **3 Turns**.

**1 Use per Long Rest.**

While Avatar of the Blade is active:

- Your Arcane Weapon immediately manifests if one is not already active.
- Your Arcane Weapon deals an additional **+2d6** damage.
- You gain **+2 Weapon Attack Rolls**.
- You gain **+2 Spell Attack Rolls**.
- You gain **+10 Movement Speed**.
- Arcane Edge may be activated without paying its Mana Cost.
- Arcane Arsenal may be reshaped without spending an Action Point.
- Arcane Cut no longer requires charging if both required Action Points are available during your turn.
- Spellbreaker gains **+2** to its Spellbreaker Roll.
- Arcane Phase Mana Cost is reduced by **50%**.

When Avatar of the Blade ends:

- Gain **Arcane Fatigue** until the end of your next turn.

### Lore

Within the oldest Spellblade Orders, Avatar of the Blade is spoken of with almost mythical reverence. It is said that only those who have achieved complete harmony between martial discipline and arcane mastery may awaken this legendary state. Those fortunate enough to witness it often describe the Spellblade as becoming less like a mortal warrior and more like living arcane energy wrapped in the shape of one.

Ancient records speak of legendary masters who single-handedly held fortress gates, shattered armies, and dueled archmages beneath the light of the stars while empowered by Avatar of the Blade. Though these stories have undoubtedly grown through centuries of retelling, every Spellblade agrees on one truth: no ordinary warrior can hope to match someone who has become one with both blade and mana.

To awaken the Avatar is not merely to gain power—it is to embody everything the Spellblade Orders have spent generations striving to achieve.

> *"The blade was never your weapon. It was always your soul waiting to take shape."*

> — Grand Spellblade Aetherion Lux, First Blade of the Infinite Well

## Rank 2
### Description

The Spellblade's connection to the Avatar deepens, allowing them to maintain the transformation with greater stability and far less strain upon their body. The Avatar is no longer simply a burst of overwhelming power, but a state of complete harmony where blade, body, and mana act as one.

As the transformation begins, the Spellblade becomes surrounded by a brilliant aura reflecting their chosen magical affinity. Every movement appears effortless, every strike perfectly controlled, and every spell flows naturally through their weapon without hesitation. Veteran Spellblades describe this state as feeling less like wielding mana and more like becoming part of it.

Although still considered an extraordinary technique, Rank II marks the beginning of true mastery. The Avatar no longer merely enhances the Spellblade—it begins awakening the full potential of every technique they have mastered throughout their journey.

### Effects

- Spend **1 Action Point**, **140 MP**, and **45 SP** to activate **Avatar of the Blade**.
- Avatar of the Blade lasts for **4 Turns**.
- **2 Uses per Long Rest.**

While Avatar of the Blade is active:

- Your Arcane Weapon immediately manifests if one is not already active.
- Your Arcane Weapon gains **+2d6** additional damage.
- Gain **+3** to Weapon Attack Rolls.
- Gain **+3** to Spell Attack Rolls.
- Increase your Movement Speed by **15 metres**.
- Arcane Edge may be activated without paying its Mana Cost.
- Arcane Arsenal may be reshaped without spending an Action Point.
- Arcane Cut no longer requires charging if both required Action Points are available during your turn.
- Spellbreaker gains **+3** to Spellbreaker Rolls.
- Arcane Phase Mana Cost is reduced by **50%**.
- Arcane Dominion increases its radius by **5 metres** while Avatar of the Blade is active.

When Avatar of the Blade ends:

- Gain **Arcane Fatigue** until the end of your next turn.

### Lore

Within the oldest Spellblade Orders, Rank II is known as the **Awakened Avatar**. It is said that this is the point where the Spellblade no longer borrows power from the Avatar—they begin to live as one with it. Their mastery over mana becomes instinctive, allowing every technique to flow seamlessly into the next without hesitation or wasted motion.

Ancient journals describe Awakened Avatars as impossible opponents to predict. Every movement appeared effortless, every weapon transformation occurred without thought, and every spell seemed to arrive precisely when it would have the greatest effect. Enemies often believed they were facing several masters at once, when in truth it was a single Spellblade moving with perfect harmony.

The Awakened Avatar represents the first step towards true transcendence, proving that mastery is not measured by strength alone, but by absolute unity between steel and mana.

> *"When your blade follows your thoughts before your hands, the Avatar has truly awakened."*

> — Grand Spellblade Aetherion Lux, First Blade of the Infinite Well

## Rank 3
### Description

The Avatar of the Blade has fully awakened within the Spellblade, transforming them into the perfect union of martial discipline and arcane mastery. No longer fighting as separate swordsman and mage, every movement, spell and strike becomes part of a single flawless rhythm. Mana responds instantly to every thought, allowing techniques that once required preparation to flow naturally into one another.

The Spellblade's chosen magical affinity engulfs their Arcane Arsenal, leaving radiant trails of elemental energy with every movement. To allies, the Avatar appears as a legendary guardian of the battlefield. To enemies, it is as though they are fighting a warrior whose blade exists everywhere at once.

Veteran masters describe Rank III as the point where the Avatar ceases to be a transformation and instead becomes the Spellblade's true nature. Every technique learned throughout their life reaches a level of perfection impossible under normal circumstances.

### Effects

- Spend **1 Action Point**, **130 MP**, and **40 SP** to activate **Avatar of the Blade**.
- Avatar of the Blade lasts for **5 Turns**.
- **3 Uses per Long Rest.**

While Avatar of the Blade is active:

- Your Arcane Weapon immediately manifests if one is not already active.
- Your Arcane Weapon gains **+3d6** additional damage.
- Gain **+4** to Weapon Attack Rolls.
- Gain **+4** to Spell Attack Rolls.
- Increase your Movement Speed by **20 metres**.
- Arcane Edge costs **no Mana** to activate.
- Arcane Arsenal may be reshaped **without spending an Action Point**.
- Arcane Cut no longer requires charging if both required Action Points are available.
- Spellbreaker gains **+4** to Spellbreaker Rolls.
- Arcane Phase Mana Cost is reduced by **75%**.
- Arcane Dominion increases its radius by **10 metres** while Avatar of the Blade is active.
- Bladestorm gains **one additional weapon attack** while Avatar of the Blade is active.

When Avatar of the Blade ends:

- Gain **Arcane Fatigue** until the end of your next turn.

### Lore

Within the Spellblade Orders, Rank III is known as the **Perfect Avatar**. It is said that this is the point where a Spellblade no longer commands mana—it willingly answers every command before the thought is fully formed. Their blade moves with impossible speed, their magic flows without hesitation, and every technique reaches heights thought unattainable by ordinary masters.

Ancient texts tell of Perfect Avatars standing alone against impossible odds, effortlessly weaving swordsmanship and magic together until even veteran archmages struggled to distinguish where steel ended and mana began. Those fortunate enough to witness the transformation often claim that the Spellblade no longer appears mortal, but instead resembles a living incarnation of their chosen magical affinity.

The Perfect Avatar is not simply stronger than an ordinary Spellblade. It is the embodiment of everything the Spellblade Orders have spent centuries striving to achieve—a warrior whose body, weapon and mana exist in complete harmony.

> *"When your blade no longer follows your hand, but your very soul, the Avatar has become complete."*

> — Grand Spellblade Aetherion Lux, First Blade of the Infinite Well

## Rank 4
### Description

The Avatar of the Blade has become an almost divine manifestation of martial and arcane perfection. Upon awakening the Avatar, the Spellblade enters a state where every strike, every spell, and every movement becomes effortless. Their body is no longer constrained by the hesitation of mortal thought, allowing them to fight with flawless precision and impossible speed.

The Spellblade radiates overwhelming arcane power, their chosen magical affinity engulfing both their body and Arcane Arsenal. Every step leaves shimmering traces of mana, while every swing appears capable of cutting both steel and magic alike. To those who witness it, the Avatar resembles an ancient guardian forged from blade and arcane energy rather than flesh and blood.

Among the Spellblade Orders, Rank IV is regarded as the threshold of legend. Those capable of maintaining this form are said to have mastered every lesson their Order can teach, becoming living examples of perfect harmony between swordsmanship and magic.

### Effects

- Spend **1 Action Point**, **120 MP**, and **35 SP** to activate **Avatar of the Blade**.
- Avatar of the Blade lasts for **6 Turns**.
- **4 Uses per Long Rest.**

While Avatar of the Blade is active:

- Your Arcane Weapon immediately manifests if one is not already active.
- Your Arcane Weapon gains an additional **+3d6** damage.
- Gain **+5** to Weapon Attack Rolls.
- Gain **+5** to Spell Attack Rolls.
- Increase your Movement Speed by **25 metres**.
- Arcane Edge costs **no Mana**.
- Arcane Arsenal may be reshaped freely without spending an Action Point.
- Bladestorm gains **one additional weapon attack**.
- Arcane Cut no longer requires charging if you have **2 Action Points** available.
- Spellbreaker gains **+5** to Spellbreaker Rolls.
- Arcane Phase costs **no Mana** to activate.
- Arcane Dominion increases its radius by **10 metres**, and compatible Spellblade talents may originate from **any point** within the Dominion.

#### Avatar Mastery

While Avatar of the Blade is active:

- Your Spellblade talents ignore effects that would normally interrupt their activation unless you become **Unconscious**.
- Arcane Weapons cannot be disarmed or destroyed.
- You gain **Advantage** on all Concentration Checks.

When Avatar of the Blade ends:

- Gain **Arcane Fatigue** until the end of your next turn.

### Lore

Within the oldest Spellblade Orders, Rank IV is known as the **Ascendant Avatar**. Very few Spellblades ever reach this state, for it demands not only unmatched martial skill but complete unity with one's mana. Masters describe the transformation as becoming the perfect expression of the Order's ideals, where every action is instinctive and every technique flows together without conscious thought.

Legends tell of Ascendant Avatars walking unharmed through storms of magic, reshaping their weapons in the blink of an eye, and answering every attack with flawless precision. To allies they inspire absolute confidence. To enemies they represent the terrifying realisation that they are no longer fighting a mortal warrior, but the living incarnation of the Spellblade's ancient traditions.

To achieve the Ascendant Avatar is to prove that mastery is not measured by power alone, but by absolute control over every aspect of one's blade, body, and soul.

> *"The Avatar is not awakened by power. It is awakened when there is no longer any difference between the warrior, the blade, and the mana that binds them together."*

> — Grand Spellblade Aetherion Lux, First Blade of the Infinite Well

## Rank 5
### Description

Avatar of the Blade reaches its ultimate form, transforming the Spellblade into the perfect union of warrior and mage. No longer merely wielding steel or commanding mana, the Spellblade becomes the living embodiment of both. Every movement flows with impossible precision, every spell is cast without hesitation, and every strike carries the overwhelming authority of a true master.

As the Avatar awakens, the Spellblade is engulfed by an immense aura of their chosen magical affinity. Their Arcane Arsenal shines with legendary brilliance, the battlefield itself trembling beneath the pressure of condensed mana. To allies, the Avatar inspires unwavering courage. To enemies, it is a terrifying reminder that they face someone who has surpassed the limits of mortal mastery.

Only the greatest Spellblades in history have ever achieved this transformation. Their names are remembered not for the battles they fought, but for the impossible victories they made appear effortless.

### Effects

- Spend **1 Action Point**, **100 MP**, and **30 SP** to activate **Avatar of the Blade**.
- Avatar of the Blade lasts for **8 Turns**.
- **5 Uses per Long Rest.**

While Avatar of the Blade is active:

- Your Arcane Weapon immediately manifests if one is not already active.
- Your Arcane Weapon gains **+3d6** additional damage.
- Gain **+6** to Weapon Attack Rolls.
- Gain **+6** to Spell Attack Rolls.
- Increase your Movement Speed by **30 metres**.
- Gain **Advantage** on all Concentration Checks.
- Arcane Weapons cannot be disarmed or destroyed.
- Arcane Edge costs **no Mana**.
- Arcane Arsenal may be reshaped freely without spending an Action Point.
- Bladestorm gains **one additional weapon attack**.
- Arcane Cut no longer requires charging if both required Action Points are available.
- Spellbreaker gains **+6** to Spellbreaker Rolls.
- Arcane Phase costs **no Mana** to activate.
- Arcane Dominion gains **+10 metres** radius, and compatible Spellblade talents may originate from **any point** within the Dominion.

#### Perfect Harmony

While Avatar of the Blade is active:

- All **Spellblade Talents** cost **50% less Mana** (minimum cost of 1 MP).
- **Once per turn**, after using a Spellblade Talent, you may activate a **different Spellblade Talent** without paying its Mana Cost. Normal Action Point costs still apply.
- Whenever you reduce a hostile creature to **0 HP**, immediately recover **20 MP** and **10 SP**.

#### Avatar's End

When Avatar of the Blade ends:

- Gain **Arcane Fatigue** until the end of your next turn.
- Arcane Fatigue reduces your Movement Speed by **5 metres** and prevents the activation of **Avatar of the Blade** again until the current cooldown has been refreshed.

### Lore

Within the Spellblade Orders, Rank V is known simply as **The Eternal Avatar**. It is the final lesson taught only through legend, for no master can truly instruct another how to achieve it. The transformation is said to occur only when a Spellblade has completely abandoned the distinction between blade, body and mana, allowing all three to exist as a single perfect expression of their will.

Stories speak of Eternal Avatars standing alone against dragons, breaking the spells of archmages with a single swing, and defending entire kingdoms through unmatched mastery rather than overwhelming force. Every technique they had ever learned flowed together seamlessly, each becoming stronger because of the others. Their enemies often believed they fought many warriors at once, unable to comprehend that every impossible feat came from a single Spellblade.

The Eternal Avatar is regarded as the highest achievement of the Order—not because it grants unmatched power, but because it represents perfect balance. Steel without magic is incomplete. Magic without steel is uncontrolled. Together, they become something worthy of legend.

> *"When there is no longer a difference between your blade, your magic, and your soul... you have become the Avatar."*

> — Grand Spellblade Aetherion Lux, First Blade of the Infinite Well

the spellblade's chosen magical affinity engulfs their arcane arsenal, leaving radiant trails of elemental energy with every movement. to allies, the avatar appears as a legendary guardian of the battlefield. to enemies, it is as though they are fighting a warrior whose blade exists everywhere at once.

veteran masters describe rank iii as the point where the avatar ceases to be a transformation and instead becomes the spellblade's true nature. every technique learned throughout their life reaches a level of perfection impossible under normal circumstances.

### effects

- spend **1 action point**, **130 mp**, and **40 sp** to activate **avatar of the blade**.
- avatar of the blade lasts for **5 turns**.
- **3 uses per long rest.**

while avatar of the blade is active:

- your arcane weapon immediately manifests if one is not already active.
- your arcane weapon gains **+3d6** additional damage.
- gain **+4** to weapon attack rolls.
- gain **+4** to spell attack rolls.
- increase your movement speed by **20 metres**.
- arcane edge costs **no mana** to activate.
- arcane arsenal may be reshaped **without spending an action point**.
- arcane cut no longer requires charging if both required action points are available.
- spellbreaker gains **+4** to spellbreaker rolls.
- arcane phase mana cost is reduced by **75%**.
- arcane dominion increases its radius by **10 metres** while avatar of the blade is active.
- bladestorm gains **one additional weapon attack** while avatar of the blade is active.

when avatar of the blade ends:

- gain **arcane fatigue** until the end of your next turn.

### lore

within the spellblade orders, rank iii is known as the **perfect avatar**. it is said that this is the point where a spellblade no longer commands mana—it willingly answers every command before the thought is fully formed. their blade moves with impossible speed, their magic flows without hesitation, and every technique reaches heights thought unattainable by ordinary masters.

ancient texts tell of perfect avatars standing alone against impossible odds, effortlessly weaving swordsmanship and magic together until even veteran archmages struggled to distinguish where steel ended and mana began. those fortunate enough to witness the transformation often claim that the spellblade no longer appears mortal, but instead resembles a living incarnation of their chosen magical affinity.

the perfect avatar is not simply stronger than an ordinary spellblade. it is the embodiment of everything the spellblade orders have spent centuries striving to achieve—a warrior whose body, weapon and mana exist in complete harmony.

> *"when your blade no longer follows your hand, but your very soul, the avatar has become complete."*

> — grand spellblade aetherion lux, first blade of the infinite well

## rank 4
### description

the avatar of the blade has become an almost divine manifestation of martial and arcane perfection. upon awakening the avatar, the spellblade enters a state where every strike, every spell, and every movement becomes effortless. their body is no longer constrained by the hesitation of mortal thought, allowing them to fight with flawless precision and impossible speed.

the spellblade radiates overwhelming arcane power, their chosen magical affinity engulfing both their body and arcane arsenal. every step leaves shimmering traces of mana, while every swing appears capable of cutting both steel and magic alike. to those who witness it, the avatar resembles an ancient guardian forged from blade and arcane energy rather than flesh and blood.

among the spellblade orders, rank iv is regarded as the threshold of legend. those capable of maintaining this form are said to have mastered every lesson their order can teach, becoming living examples of perfect harmony between swordsmanship and magic.

### effects

- spend **1 action point**, **120 mp**, and **35 sp** to activate **avatar of the blade**.
- avatar of the blade lasts for **6 turns**.
- **4 uses per long rest.**

while avatar of the blade is active:

- your arcane weapon immediately manifests if one is not already active.
- your arcane weapon gains an additional **+3d6** damage.
- gain **+5** to weapon attack rolls.
- gain **+5** to spell attack rolls.
- increase your movement speed by **25 metres**.
- arcane edge costs **no mana**.
- arcane arsenal may be reshaped freely without spending an action point.
- bladestorm gains **one additional weapon attack**.
- arcane cut no longer requires charging if you have **2 action points** available.
- spellbreaker gains **+5** to spellbreaker rolls.
- arcane phase costs **no mana** to activate.
- arcane dominion increases its radius by **10 metres**, and compatible spellblade talents may originate from **any point** within the dominion.

#### avatar mastery

while avatar of the blade is active:

- your spellblade talents ignore effects that would normally interrupt their activation unless you become **unconscious**.
- arcane weapons cannot be disarmed or destroyed.
- you gain **advantage** on all concentration checks.

when avatar of the blade ends:

- gain **arcane fatigue** until the end of your next turn.

### lore

within the oldest spellblade orders, rank iv is known as the **ascendant avatar**. very few spellblades ever reach this state, for it demands not only unmatched martial skill but complete unity with one's mana. masters describe the transformation as becoming the perfect expression of the order's ideals, where every action is instinctive and every technique flows together without conscious thought.

legends tell of ascendant avatars walking unharmed through storms of magic, reshaping their weapons in the blink of an eye, and answering every attack with flawless precision. to allies they inspire absolute confidence. to enemies they represent the terrifying realisation that they are no longer fighting a mortal warrior, but the living incarnation of the spellblade's ancient traditions.

to achieve the ascendant avatar is to prove that mastery is not measured by power alone, but by absolute control over every aspect of one's blade, body, and soul.

> *"the avatar is not awakened by power. it is awakened when there is no longer any difference between the warrior, the blade, and the mana that binds them together."*

> — grand spellblade aetherion lux, first blade of the infinite well

## rank 5
### description

avatar of the blade reaches its ultimate form, transforming the spellblade into the perfect union of warrior and mage. no longer merely wielding steel or commanding mana, the spellblade becomes the living embodiment of both. every movement flows with impossible precision, every spell is cast without hesitation, and every strike carries the overwhelming authority of a true master.

as the avatar awakens, the spellblade is engulfed by an immense aura of their chosen magical affinity. their arcane arsenal shines with legendary brilliance, the battlefield itself trembling beneath the pressure of condensed mana. to allies, the avatar inspires unwavering courage. to enemies, it is a terrifying reminder that they face someone who has surpassed the limits of mortal mastery.

only the greatest spellblades in history have ever achieved this transformation. their names are remembered not for the battles they fought, but for the impossible victories they made appear effortless.

### effects

- spend **1 action point**, **100 mp**, and **30 sp** to activate **avatar of the blade**.
- avatar of the blade lasts for **8 turns**.
- **5 uses per long rest.**

while avatar of the blade is active:

- your arcane weapon immediately manifests if one is not already active.
- your arcane weapon gains **+3d6** additional damage.
- gain **+6** to weapon attack rolls.
- gain **+6** to spell attack rolls.
- increase your movement speed by **30 metres**.
- gain **advantage** on all concentration checks.
- arcane weapons cannot be disarmed or destroyed.
- arcane edge costs **no mana**.
- arcane arsenal may be reshaped freely without spending an action point.
- bladestorm gains **one additional weapon attack**.
- arcane cut no longer requires charging if both required action points are available.
- spellbreaker gains **+6** to spellbreaker rolls.
- arcane phase costs **no mana** to activate.
- arcane dominion gains **+10 metres** radius, and compatible spellblade talents may originate from **any point** within the dominion.

#### perfect harmony

while avatar of the blade is active:

- all **spellblade talents** cost **50% less mana** (minimum cost of 1 mp).
- **once per turn**, after using a spellblade talent, you may activate a **different spellblade talent** without paying its mana cost. normal action point costs still apply.
- whenever you reduce a hostile creature to **0 hp**, immediately recover **20 mp** and **10 sp**.

#### avatar's end

when avatar of the blade ends:

- gain **arcane fatigue** until the end of your next turn.
- arcane fatigue reduces your movement speed by **5 metres** and prevents the activation of **avatar of the blade** again until the current cooldown has been refreshed.

### lore

within the spellblade orders, rank v is known simply as **the eternal avatar**. it is the final lesson taught only through legend, for no master can truly instruct another how to achieve it. the transformation is said to occur only when a spellblade has completely abandoned the distinction between blade, body and mana, allowing all three to exist as a single perfect expression of their will.

stories speak of eternal avatars standing alone against dragons, breaking the spells of archmages with a single swing, and defending entire kingdoms through unmatched mastery rather than overwhelming force. every technique they had ever learned flowed together seamlessly, each becoming stronger because of the others. their enemies often believed they fought many warriors at once, unable to comprehend that every impossible feat came from a single spellblade.

the eternal avatar is regarded as the highest achievement of the order—not because it grants unmatched power, but because it represents perfect balance. steel without magic is incomplete. magic without steel is uncontrolled. together, they become something worthy of legend.

> *"when there is no longer a difference between your blade, your magic, and your soul... you have become the avatar."*

> — grand spellblade aetherion lux, first blade of the infinite well

# Bastion of Faith

## Overview
Your faith becomes an unshakable foundation, allowing you to assume a defensive stance that transforms you into a steadfast protector. Rather than seeking swift victory, you prepare yourself to endure the enemy's assault, trusting your patron to strengthen your resolve against every blow.

While Bastion of Faith is active, your movements become deliberate and unwavering. Every step is taken with purpose, every stance rooted in conviction. Though enemies may attempt to force you aside, your devotion anchors both body and spirit, making you increasingly difficult to displace.

To a seasoned Paladin, the greatest victory is not measured by the enemies they defeat, but by the allies who remain standing because they refused to yield.

## Rank 1
### Description

Your faith becomes an unshakable foundation, allowing you to assume a defensive stance that transforms you into a steadfast protector. Rather than seeking swift victory, you prepare yourself to endure the enemy's assault, trusting your patron to strengthen your resolve against every blow.

While Bastion of Faith is active, your movements become deliberate and unwavering. Every step is taken with purpose, every stance rooted in conviction. Though enemies may attempt to force you aside, your devotion anchors both body and spirit, making you increasingly difficult to displace.

To a seasoned Paladin, the greatest victory is not measured by the enemies they defeat, but by the allies who remain standing because they refused to yield.

### Effects

- Spend **25 MP** and **10 SP** to enter **Bastion of Faith**.
- Bastion of Faith lasts for **5 Rounds**.
- Gain **+2 AC** while Bastion of Faith is active.
- Gain **+2 on all checks or Saving Throws made to resist forced movement**, being shoved, knocked back, pulled, grappled, or otherwise repositioned against your will.
- The visual manifestation of Bastion of Faith is determined by your chosen patron.
- Additional defensive blessings granted by your patron's **Divine Authority** apply where applicable.

### Lore

Among every holy order, the Bastion is admired not for overwhelming strength, but for unwavering resolve. These champions willingly stand where others would retreat, trusting that their patron will grant them the courage to endure whatever darkness lies ahead.

The oldest fortresses of Asteria are said to have been inspired by such warriors. Their walls were built to imitate the same unyielding conviction displayed by the first Paladins who stood firm against impossible odds, refusing to surrender even when the world itself seemed determined to move them.

> *"The mountain does not resist the storm through strength alone. It stands because it refuses to move."*  
> **— Sir Garrick, Warden of the Eternal Gate**

## Rank 2
### Description

Your conviction grows stronger with every battle fought in your patron's name. While others rely upon strength alone, you have learned that true resilience comes from unwavering faith and the willingness to place yourself between danger and those who cannot protect themselves.

While Bastion of Faith is active, your presence becomes a rallying point for allies. Enemies find it increasingly difficult to force you from your position, while your steadfast resolve allows you to intervene whenever your companions are threatened. Every successful defence strengthens your reputation as an unyielding guardian whose faith cannot be shaken.

To your allies, you become a reassuring presence upon the battlefield. To your enemies, you become an obstacle that refuses to yield.

### Effects

- Spend **30 MP** and **10 SP** to enter **Bastion of Faith**.
- Bastion of Faith lasts for **5 Rounds**.
- Gain **+3 AC** while Bastion of Faith is active.
- Gain **+4 on all checks or Saving Throws made to resist forced movement**, being shoved, knocked back, pulled, grappled, or otherwise repositioned against your will.
- **Once per round**, when a creature within your melee reach targets an allied creature with a melee attack, you may use your **Reaction** to impose **Disadvantage** on that attack.
- The visual manifestation of Bastion of Faith is determined by your chosen patron.
- Additional defensive blessings granted by your patron's **Divine Authority** apply where applicable.

### Lore

Every great fortress begins with a single stone that refuses to break. Likewise, every legendary guardian begins with a single vow—to stand firm regardless of the danger before them. Through years of faithful service, a Paladin learns that the strongest defence is often their own willingness to become the shield others need.

Many temples teach that a Bastion is not defined by the armour they wear, but by the lives they protect. Those who master this sacred stance become symbols of hope, standing as unwavering guardians while chaos crashes harmlessly against their unbreakable resolve.

> *"Walls are built from stone. A true bastion is built from conviction."*  
> **— Sir Garrick, Warden of the Eternal Gate**

## Rank 3
### Description

Your devotion has become an unbreakable foundation upon which others may stand. While Bastion of Faith is active, every blow endured and every attack turned aside strengthens your resolve, allowing your patron's blessing to reinforce both body and spirit. Your enemies soon realise that attempting to break your defence only serves to strengthen your determination.

Veteran Paladins understand that true endurance is not measured by how little damage they suffer, but by their ability to continue standing when others would have fallen. Through absolute conviction, your patron rewards your steadfast defence with renewed strength, enabling you to hold the line against even the fiercest assault.

As your reputation spreads, allies instinctively rally behind your unwavering presence, while enemies begin to recognise the futility of attempting to force aside a guardian whose faith has become stronger than steel.

The greatest bastions are remembered not because they never fell, but because they endured long enough for hope to triumph. Every strike deflected, every ally protected, and every step held against overwhelming odds becomes another testament to the strength granted through unwavering faith.

The oldest military orders teach that a Bastion's greatest weapon is not their sword, but their refusal to yield. Legends tell of champions who stood alone at broken gates, holding back entire armies until reinforcements arrived, their conviction becoming an inspiration that outlived them by centuries.
