# Bladestorm

## Overview
Bladestorm is one of the most demanding martial techniques taught within the Spellblade Orders. Rather than relying upon destructive magic, the Spellblade channels a small amount of mana through their body to enhance their speed, allowing them to unleash a rapid succession of perfectly controlled strikes in the time most warriors make a single attack.

The technique demands immense physical endurance. Every muscle is pushed to its limit as the Spellblade flows from one strike to the next with blinding speed. To onlookers, the blade appears to split into shimmering afterimages as steel flashes through the air, leaving enemies struggling to defend against the relentless assault.

At Rank I, Bladestorm is still a taxing technique that can only be sustained for a brief moment. Even so, a skilled Spellblade can overwhelm an opponent's guard or pressure multiple nearby enemies before they have time to react.

## Rank 1
### Description

Bladestorm is one of the most demanding martial techniques taught within the Spellblade Orders. Rather than relying upon destructive magic, the Spellblade channels a small amount of mana through their body to enhance their speed, allowing them to unleash a rapid succession of perfectly controlled strikes in the time most warriors make a single attack.

The technique demands immense physical endurance. Every muscle is pushed to its limit as the Spellblade flows from one strike to the next with blinding speed. To onlookers, the blade appears to split into shimmering afterimages as steel flashes through the air, leaving enemies struggling to defend against the relentless assault.

At Rank I, Bladestorm is still a taxing technique that can only be sustained for a brief moment. Even so, a skilled Spellblade can overwhelm an opponent's guard or pressure multiple nearby enemies before they have time to react.

### Effects

- Spend **1 Action Point**, **5 MP**, and **25 SP** to activate **Bladestorm**.
- Immediately make **2 melee weapon attacks**.
- You may direct both attacks against **one creature**, or split them between **two different creatures** within your weapon's reach.
- Resolve each attack separately using your normal Weapon Attack Roll.
- Each successful attack deals **normal weapon damage**, including any applicable weapon enchantments or active Spellblade talents.
- Bladestorm counts as a single Attack Action.
- This talent cannot be used with ranged weapons.

### Lore

Within the Spellblade Orders, Bladestorm is regarded as a test of martial discipline rather than magical ability. Apprentices quickly discover that speed alone is meaningless without precision, and that every unnecessary movement wastes valuable stamina.

Masters often teach that the technique should resemble the calm eye of a storm rather than uncontrolled fury. Every strike is deliberate, every movement efficient, and every breath measured. Only through absolute control can a Spellblade unleash a true Bladestorm without exhausting themselves.

Those who witness the technique often describe it as though several swords were striking at once, unable to follow the impossible speed of the Spellblade's blade.

> *"A single strike may win a duel. A storm of strikes wins the battle before your enemy can answer."*

> — Grand Spellblade Aetherion Lux, First Blade of the Infinite Well

## Rank 2
### Description

The Spellblade's mastery of Bladestorm continues to develop, allowing them to unleash an even greater flurry of attacks without sacrificing precision. Their body has adapted to the immense physical strain, enabling each strike to flow seamlessly into the next while maintaining complete control over their weapon.

Rather than relying on brute force, the Spellblade embraces momentum. Every swing naturally carries into another, creating a relentless assault that overwhelms an opponent's ability to defend. To those witnessing the technique, the Spellblade appears surrounded by a whirlwind of flashing steel, each strike arriving before the last has fully finished.

At Rank II, Bladestorm becomes a feared battlefield technique capable of pressuring multiple enemies or relentlessly driving a single opponent onto the defensive. Though physically exhausting, experienced Spellblades understand that a perfectly timed Bladestorm can end a battle before their enemy has the opportunity to recover.

### Effects

- Spend **1 Action Point**, **5 MP**, and **30 SP** to activate **Bladestorm**.
- Immediately make **3 melee weapon attacks**.
- You may direct the attacks against **one creature**, or divide them among **multiple creatures** within your weapon's reach.
- Resolve each attack separately using your normal Weapon Attack Roll.
- Each successful attack deals **normal weapon damage**, including any applicable weapon enchantments or active Spellblade talents.
- Bladestorm counts as a single Attack Action.
- This talent cannot be used with ranged weapons.
- This rank replaces the effects of **Bladestorm — Rank I**.

### Lore

Within the Spellblade Orders, Rank II is known as the **Raging Tempest**. Apprentices who achieve this milestone have learned that Bladestorm is not about attacking wildly, but about maintaining perfect control while striking with extraordinary speed.

Masters often compare the technique to a violent storm sweeping across the battlefield. Each strike appears independent, yet every movement is connected through flawless timing and discipline. Opponents quickly discover that attempting to defend against one strike only leaves them exposed to the next.

To veteran Spellblades, Bladestorm is more than a display of martial skill—it is proof that disciplined technique will always surpass reckless aggression.

> *"The untrained swing harder. The master simply strikes more often than the eye can follow."*

> — Grand Spellblade Aetherion Lux, First Blade of the Infinite Well

## Rank 3
### Description

The Spellblade has mastered the rhythm of Bladestorm, transforming it into a devastating display of speed and martial precision. Every movement flows effortlessly into the next as mana subtly reinforces the body, allowing the Spellblade to push beyond normal physical limits without relying upon destructive magic.

To observers, the technique resembles a raging storm of flashing steel. The Spellblade seems to appear in several places at once, delivering a relentless sequence of perfectly controlled strikes that leaves opponents with little opportunity to defend themselves. Every swing is deliberate, every step measured, and every strike contributes to an overwhelming offensive rhythm.

At Rank III, Bladestorm has become one of the defining techniques of the Spellblade. Whether facing a single powerful foe or several nearby enemies, the Spellblade can unleash a barrage of attacks capable of shifting the momentum of battle in an instant.

### Effects

- Spend **1 Action Point**, **5 MP**, and **35 SP** to activate **Bladestorm**.
- Immediately make **4 melee weapon attacks**.
- You may direct the attacks against **one creature**, or divide them among **multiple creatures** within your weapon's reach.
- Resolve each attack separately using your normal Weapon Attack Roll.
- Each successful attack deals **normal weapon damage**, including any applicable weapon enchantments and active Spellblade talents.
- Bladestorm counts as a single Attack Action.
- This talent cannot be used with ranged weapons.
- This rank replaces the effects of **Bladestorm — Rank II**.

### Lore

Among the Spellblade Orders, Rank III is known as the **Tempest Dance**. It is the point where speed and discipline become inseparable, allowing the practitioner to unleash a continuous flurry of strikes while maintaining flawless technique.

Masters teach that Bladestorm is never about losing control. A true Spellblade remains calm within the chaos, allowing every movement to naturally guide the next. Those who rely on reckless speed quickly exhaust themselves, while those who embrace precision become an unstoppable force upon the battlefield.

Veteran warriors often recognise a master of Bladestorm before the first strike lands, for the silence before the storm is every bit as terrifying as the storm itself.

> *"Speed without discipline is merely panic. A true storm strikes with purpose."*

> — Grand Spellblade Aetherion Lux, First Blade of the Infinite Well

## Rank 4
### Description

The Spellblade has pushed Bladestorm beyond mortal swordsmanship, achieving a level of speed and precision that few warriors can comprehend. Every movement flows without hesitation, each strike naturally leading into the next as the Spellblade maintains complete control over the storm they unleash. Only a small amount of mana is required to reinforce the body, while sheer martial discipline drives the technique forward.

To those caught within its reach, Bladestorm becomes a relentless barrage of flashing steel. Opponents struggle to react as strike after strike falls from seemingly every direction, forcing even veteran warriors onto the defensive. Despite the incredible speed, every blow remains measured and deliberate, reflecting years of relentless training.

At Rank IV, the Spellblade can overwhelm groups of enemies or relentlessly pressure a powerful foe with a storm of perfectly executed attacks. Few can withstand the assault once the storm has begun.

### Effects

- Spend **1 Action Point**, **5 MP**, and **40 SP** to activate **Bladestorm**.
- Immediately make **5 melee weapon attacks**.
- You may direct the attacks against **one creature**, or divide them among **multiple creatures** within your weapon's reach.
- Resolve each attack separately using your normal Weapon Attack Roll.
- Each successful attack deals **normal weapon damage**, including any applicable weapon enchantments and active Spellblade talents.
- Bladestorm counts as a single Attack Action.
- This talent cannot be used with ranged weapons.
- This rank replaces the effects of **Bladestorm — Rank III**.

### Lore

Within the Spellblade Orders, Rank IV is known as the **Eye of the Storm**. It represents the point where the practitioner no longer forces the technique through sheer effort. Instead, they become the calm centre of the storm, allowing flawless discipline to guide every strike while chaos erupts around them.

Veteran masters teach that Bladestorm is not won through speed alone. Every strike must carry intent, every movement must preserve balance, and every breath must maintain the rhythm that defines the Spellblade. Those who lose themselves within the storm become reckless; those who master it become legends.

Stories of Rank IV practitioners speak of battlefields where enemies believed they faced an entire company, only to discover it was a single Spellblade moving faster than the eye could follow.

> *"Become the calm within the storm, and your enemies will remember only the sound of your blade."*

> — Grand Spellblade Aetherion Lux, First Blade of the Infinite Well

## Rank 5
### Description

Bladestorm reaches its ultimate expression, becoming the pinnacle of martial mastery within the Spellblade Orders. The Spellblade no longer thinks about each individual strike; body, blade, and instinct move as one, unleashing a relentless torrent of perfectly executed attacks that few opponents can hope to withstand. Only a faint pulse of mana is required to reinforce the body, while years of discipline and physical conditioning drive the technique beyond mortal limits.

To onlookers, the Spellblade appears as a storm of flashing steel. Their weapon becomes a blur, striking with such speed that enemies struggle to determine where one attack ends and the next begins. Every movement is efficient, every step deliberate, and every strike delivered with unwavering precision.

Only the greatest Spellblades ever achieve this level of mastery. A master of Bladestorm can dominate the space around them, carving through multiple foes or unleashing an overwhelming assault upon a single enemy before they have the opportunity to respond.

### Effects

- Spend **1 Action Point**, **5 MP**, and **45 SP** to activate **Bladestorm**.
- Immediately make **6 melee weapon attacks**.
- You may direct the attacks against **one creature**, or divide them among **multiple creatures** within your weapon's reach.
- Resolve each attack separately using your normal Weapon Attack Roll.
- Each successful attack deals **normal weapon damage**, including any applicable weapon enchantments and active Spellblade talents.
- Bladestorm counts as a single Attack Action.
- This talent cannot be used with ranged weapons.
- This rank replaces the effects of **Bladestorm — Rank IV**.

### Lore

Within the oldest Spellblade Orders, Rank V is known as the **Endless Storm**. It is a technique so demanding that only the greatest masters are capable of wielding it without collapsing from exhaustion. Every strike flows effortlessly into the next, creating a flawless sequence of attacks that embodies the perfect union of martial discipline and arcane enhancement.

Legends tell of Spellblades who stood alone against overwhelming numbers, their blades moving with such impossible speed that survivors believed they had faced an entire company rather than a single warrior. Whether these stories have grown through centuries of retelling is unknown, but every apprentice dreams of one day reaching the Endless Storm.

To master Bladestorm is to prove that the greatest weapon of a Spellblade is not magic, but the discipline to wield both steel and mana in absolute harmony.

> *"A storm does not ask how many stand before it. It simply sweeps across the battlefield until nothing remains in its path."*

> — Grand Spellblade Aetherion Lux, First Blade of the Infinite Well

## overview
bladestorm is one of the most demanding martial techniques taught within the spellblade orders. rather than relying upon destructive magic, the spellblade channels a small amount of mana through their body to enhance their speed, allowing them to unleash a rapid succession of perfectly controlled strikes in the time most warriors make a single attack.

the technique demands immense physical endurance. every muscle is pushed to its limit as the spellblade flows from one strike to the next with blinding speed. to onlookers, the blade appears to split into shimmering afterimages as steel flashes through the air, leaving enemies struggling to defend against the relentless assault.

at rank i, bladestorm is still a taxing technique that can only be sustained for a brief moment. even so, a skilled spellblade can overwhelm an opponent's guard or pressure multiple nearby enemies before they have time to react.

# Blessed Resilience

## Overview
Your unwavering devotion has begun to transform both body and soul. Through your sacred oath, your patron's divine essence becomes a permanent part of your being, strengthening your resolve against the forces that seek to oppose your faith.

This blessing is not armour forged from steel, but a quiet resilience carried within your spirit. Each trial endured strengthens the bond between champion and patron, allowing you to withstand hardships that would break ordinary mortals. Though the blessing is subtle at first, its influence grows with every act of devotion.

Every deity grants resilience in a different form. Rather than shielding all Paladins equally, your patron fortifies you against the divine forces it understands best, preparing you to confront those that stand in opposition to its will.

## Rank 1
### Description

Your unwavering devotion has begun to transform both body and soul. Through your sacred oath, your patron's divine essence becomes a permanent part of your being, strengthening your resolve against the forces that seek to oppose your faith.

This blessing is not armour forged from steel, but a quiet resilience carried within your spirit. Each trial endured strengthens the bond between champion and patron, allowing you to withstand hardships that would break ordinary mortals. Though the blessing is subtle at first, its influence grows with every act of devotion.

Every deity grants resilience in a different form. Rather than shielding all Paladins equally, your patron fortifies you against the divine forces it understands best, preparing you to confront those that stand in opposition to its will.

### Effects

- Blessed Resilience is a **Passive Talent** and is always active.
- Gain **+2 on Saving Throws** against effects originating from your patron's **Divine Opposition**.
- Gain **Resistance** to one damage type or supernatural effect determined by your patron's Religious pages.
- Gain **+2 on checks or Saving Throws** made to resist conditions specifically associated with your patron's Divine Opposition.
- If multiple abilities would grant the same resistance, only the strongest applies unless another rule states otherwise.
- The exact resistances and protections granted by Blessed Resilience are determined by your patron's Religious pages.

### Lore

Every divine champion bears the mark of their patron, whether visible to the eye or hidden within the soul. Over time, this sacred bond reshapes the Paladin into someone capable of enduring hardships that would overwhelm lesser warriors. Their resilience is not born of stubbornness alone, but from the certainty that their patron walks beside them.

Among the great religious orders, seasoned Paladins often recognise one another by this quiet strength. Though they may serve different deities, each carries a resilience uniquely shaped by the divine power that chose them, standing firm against the very forces their patron opposes.

> *"Faith is not proven when life is easy. It is proven by the strength to endure what seeks to break you."*  
> **— High Warden Cassian, Keeper of the Eternal Oath**

## Rank 2
### Description

The bond between you and your patron grows stronger with every trial you endure. Divine power no longer simply shields you from harm—it begins to temper your body and spirit, allowing you to withstand the very forces your deity was created to oppose.

Every wound survived and every temptation resisted reinforces your sacred connection. Your patron's essence quietly shapes your resilience, ensuring that the powers most hostile to your divine purpose find it increasingly difficult to overcome your resolve. While others may falter beneath such forces, you remain steadfast, carrying your faith as both armour and sanctuary.

To experienced Paladins, this blessing is a constant reminder that resilience is not the absence of suffering, but the ability to endure it without abandoning one's oath. Their strength is drawn not from themselves alone, but from the eternal bond shared with the divine.

### Effects

- **Blessed Resilience** is a **Passive Talent** and is always active.
- Gain **+4 on Saving Throws** against effects originating from your patron's **Divine Opposition**.
- Gain **Resistance** to one or more damage types, conditions, or supernatural effects determined by your patron's Religious pages.
- Once per **Short Rest**, when you fail a Saving Throw against your patron's Divine Opposition, you may immediately reroll that Saving Throw. You must use the second result.
- Gain **+4 on checks or Saving Throws** made to resist conditions specifically associated with your patron's Divine Opposition.
- If multiple abilities would grant the same resistance, only the strongest applies unless another rule states otherwise.
- The exact resistances, protections, and additional blessings granted by **Blessed Resilience** are determined by your patron's Religious pages.

### Lore

As the years pass, the divine blessing carried by a Paladin becomes inseparable from their very being. Their patron's influence no longer answers only when called upon—it quietly strengthens them every moment of every day, preparing them for the inevitable confrontation with the powers that stand in opposition to their faith.

Many scholars believe that this resilience is the first outward sign of true divine favour. Though different patrons bestow different blessings, all share a common purpose: to ensure their chosen champion can endure the trials they were destined to face.

> *"Steel is forged through fire. Faith is forged through adversity."*  
> **— High Warden Cassian, Keeper of the Eternal Oath**

## Rank 3
### Description

Your patron's blessing has become deeply woven into your soul, transforming your resilience from simple endurance into steadfast divine protection. The forces that oppose your deity find it increasingly difficult to weaken your resolve, as your body and spirit instinctively reject influences that seek to break your sacred oath.

Every trial survived strengthens the divine bond between champion and patron. What once required conscious determination has become second nature, allowing you to endure hardships that would overwhelm even seasoned warriors. Whether facing corrupting magic, overwhelming divine power, or supernatural afflictions tied to your patron's eternal enemies, your faith stands as an unyielding shield.

To the greatest Paladins, resilience is not measured by how little they suffer, but by how often they rise again without allowing darkness to take hold. Their patron's blessing ensures that no matter how fierce the opposition becomes, their resolve remains unbroken.

### Effects

- **Blessed Resilience** is a **Passive Talent** and is always active.
- Gain **+6 on Saving Throws** against effects originating from your patron's **Divine Opposition**.
- Gain the resistances and protections granted by your patron's Religious pages.
- Once per **Short Rest**, when you fail a Saving Throw against your patron's Divine Opposition, you may immediately reroll that Saving Throw. You must use the second result.
- If you successfully resist an effect originating from your patron's Divine Opposition, you become **immune to that same effect from the same source until the end of your next turn**.
- Gain **+6 on checks or Saving Throws** made to resist conditions specifically associated with your patron's Divine Opposition.
- If multiple abilities would grant the same resistance, only the strongest applies unless another rule states otherwise.
- The exact resistances, protections, and additional blessings granted by **Blessed Resilience** are determined by your patron's Religious pages.

### Lore

Veteran Paladins are recognised not by the absence of scars, but by the certainty with which they continue to stand against impossible odds. Their patron's blessing has become so deeply intertwined with their soul that opposing divine forces struggle to gain even the briefest foothold.

Religious scholars often describe these champions as living testaments to their deity's will. Each victory over corruption, temptation, or supernatural oppression reinforces the sacred bond they share, proving that true resilience is born not from invulnerability, but from unwavering devotion.

> *"A faithful soul does not become unbreakable by avoiding hardship. It becomes unbreakable by surviving it."*  
> **— High Warden Cassian, Keeper of the Eternal Oath**

## Rank 4
### Description

Your patron's blessing has become an inseparable part of your being. Divine power no longer merely protects you—it instinctively responds whenever opposing forces attempt to weaken your resolve. Every trial endured has forged your body, mind, and spirit into a vessel capable of withstanding extraordinary hardship.

The champions who reach this level of devotion are often described as immovable pillars of faith. They continue advancing through corruption, fear, divine opposition, and supernatural assaults that would overwhelm lesser warriors. Their resilience is no longer a conscious effort but an instinct born from absolute trust in their patron.

Those who witness such unwavering determination often mistake it for invulnerability. In truth, a Paladin still feels pain and hardship—but their faith refuses to let those burdens define them.

### Effects

- **Blessed Resilience** is a **Passive Talent** and is always active.
- Gain **+6 on Saving Throws** against effects originating from your patron's **Divine Opposition**.
- Gain all resistances and protections granted by your patron's Religious pages.
- Once per **Short Rest**, when you fail a Saving Throw against your patron's Divine Opposition, you may immediately reroll that Saving Throw. You must use the second result.
- If you successfully resist an effect originating from your patron's Divine Opposition, you become **immune to that same effect from the same source until the end of your next turn**.
- The first time each **Long Rest** that you would gain a condition associated with your patron's **Divine Opposition**, you may choose to ignore that condition entirely.
- If multiple abilities would grant the same resistance or immunity, only the strongest applies unless another rule states otherwise.
- The exact resistances, immunities, and blessings granted by **Blessed Resilience** are determined by your patron's Religious pages.

### Lore

The oldest scriptures speak of champions whose faith became so complete that the divine itself seemed to shield them from corruption. Though wounds still marked their bodies, their spirits remained beyond the reach of the powers that sought to break them.

Among the greatest Paladins, Blessed Resilience is viewed not as a reward, but as a sacred responsibility. Those entrusted with such unwavering protection are expected to stand where others cannot, shielding the innocent from the very forces their patron has sworn to oppose.

> *"The faithful are not those who never fall. They are those who rise every time darkness believes it has finally won."*  
> **— High Warden Cassian, Keeper of the Eternal Oath**

## Rank 5
### Description

Your soul has become a living reflection of your patron's divine will. Every hardship you have endured, every temptation resisted, and every oath upheld has strengthened the sacred bond between you and the deity you serve. What was once a blessing has become an inseparable part of your very existence.

Opposing divine forces no longer see you as merely another mortal champion—they recognise you as an extension of the power they oppose. Your faith shields your body, your spirit, and your resolve, allowing you to stand before supernatural threats that would overwhelm even the greatest heroes.

Though no mortal is beyond suffering, your patron ensures that you will never stand alone. Their presence surrounds you in every battle, every trial, and every act of devotion, making you one of the truest embodiments of their divine purpose.

### Effects

- **Blessed Resilience** is a **Passive Talent** and is always active.
- Gain **Advantage on Saving Throws** against effects originating from your patron's **Divine Opposition**.
- Gain all resistances, protections, and passive blessings granted by your patron's Religious pages.
- Once per **Short Rest**, when you fail a Saving Throw against your patron's Divine Opposition, you may immediately reroll that Saving Throw. You must use the second result.
- If you successfully resist an effect originating from your patron's Divine Opposition, you become **immune to that same effect from the same source for 1 minute**.
- The first time each **Long Rest** that you would gain a condition associated with your patron's Divine Opposition, you may ignore that condition entirely.
- Gain your patron's **Legendary Blessing**, as described in your patron's Religious pages.
- If multiple abilities would grant the same resistance, protection, or immunity, only the strongest applies unless another rule states otherwise.

### Lore

Few Paladins ever achieve such complete harmony with their patron. Those who do become living symbols of divine conviction, carrying the essence of their deity wherever they travel. Entire orders look to these champions for guidance, believing their unwavering resilience to be proof that absolute faith can overcome even the greatest darkness.

# blessed resilience

## overview
your unwavering devotion has begun to transform both body and soul. through your sacred oath, your patron's divine essence becomes a permanent part of your being, strengthening your resolve against the forces that seek to oppose your faith.

this blessing is not armour forged from steel, but a quiet resilience carried within your spirit. each trial endured strengthens the bond between champion and patron, allowing you to withstand hardships that would break ordinary mortals. though the blessing is subtle at first, its influence grows with every act of devotion.

every deity grants resilience in a different form. rather than shielding all paladins equally, your patron fortifies you against the divine forces it understands best, preparing you to confront those that stand in opposition to its will.

## rank 1
### description

your unwavering devotion has begun to transform both body and soul. through your sacred oath, your patron's divine essence becomes a permanent part of your being, strengthening your resolve against the forces that seek to oppose your faith.

this blessing is not armour forged from steel, but a quiet resilience carried within your spirit. each trial endured strengthens the bond between champion and patron, allowing you to withstand hardships that would break ordinary mortals. though the blessing is subtle at first, its influence grows with every act of devotion.

every deity grants resilience in a different form. rather than shielding all paladins equally, your patron fortifies you against the divine forces it understands best, preparing you to confront those that stand in opposition to its will.

### effects

- blessed resilience is a **passive talent** and is always active.
- gain **+2 on saving throws** against effects originating from your patron's **divine opposition**.
- gain **resistance** to one damage type or supernatural effect determined by your patron's religious pages.
- gain **+2 on checks or saving throws** made to resist conditions specifically associated with your patron's divine opposition.
- if multiple abilities would grant the same resistance, only the strongest applies unless another rule states otherwise.
- the exact resistances and protections granted by blessed resilience are determined by your patron's religious pages.

### lore

every divine champion bears the mark of their patron, whether visible to the eye or hidden within the soul. over time, this sacred bond reshapes the paladin into someone capable of enduring hardships that would overwhelm lesser warriors. their resilience is not born of stubbornness alone, but from the certainty that their patron walks beside them.

among the great religious orders, seasoned paladins often recognise one another by this quiet strength. though they may serve different deities, each carries a resilience uniquely shaped by the divine power that chose them, standing firm against the very forces their patron opposes.

> *"faith is not proven when life is easy. it is proven by the strength to endure what seeks to break you."*  
> **— high warden cassian, keeper of the eternal oath**

## rank 2
### description

the bond between you and your patron grows stronger with every trial you endure. divine power no longer simply shields you from harm—it begins to temper your body and spirit, allowing you to withstand the very forces your deity was created to oppose.

every wound survived and every temptation resisted reinforces your sacred connection. your patron's essence quietly shapes your resilience, ensuring that the powers most hostile to your divine purpose find it increasingly difficult to overcome your resolve. while others may falter beneath such forces, you remain steadfast, carrying your faith as both armour and sanctuary.

to experienced paladins, this blessing is a constant reminder that resilience is not the absence of suffering, but the ability to endure it without abandoning one's oath. their strength is drawn not from themselves alone, but from the eternal bond shared with the divine.

### effects

- gain **+4 on saving throws** against effects originating from your patron's **divine opposition**.

- gain **+4 on checks or saving throws** made to resist conditions specifically associated with your patron's divine opposition.

- the exact resistances, protections, and additional blessings granted by **blessed resilience** are determined by your patron's religious pages.

### lore

as the years pass, the divine blessing carried by a paladin becomes inseparable from their very being. their patron's influence no longer answers only when called upon—it quietly strengthens them every moment of every day, preparing them for the inevitable confrontation with the powers that stand in opposition to their faith.

many scholars believe that this resilience is the first outward sign of true divine favour. though different patrons bestow different blessings, all share a common purpose: to ensure their chosen champion can endure the trials they were destined to face.

> *"steel is forged through fire. faith is forged through adversity."*  
> **— high warden cassian, keeper of the eternal oath**

## rank 3
### description

your patron's blessing has become deeply woven into your soul, transforming your resilience from simple endurance into steadfast divine protection. the forces that oppose your deity find it increasingly difficult to weaken your resolve, as your body and spirit instinctively reject influences that seek to break your sacred oath.

to the greatest paladins, resilience is not measured by how little they suffer, but by how often they rise again without allowing darkness to take hold. their patron's blessing ensures that no matter how fierce the opposition becomes, their resolve remains unbroken.

- gain **+6 on saving throws** against effects originating from your patron's **divine opposition**.
- gain the resistances and protections granted by your patron's religious pages.
- once per **short rest**, when you fail a saving throw against your patron's divine opposition, you may immediately reroll that saving throw. you must use the second result.
- if you successfully resist an effect originating from your patron's divine opposition, you become **immune to that same effect from the same source until the end of your next turn**.
- gain **+6 on checks or saving throws** made to resist conditions specifically associated with your patron's divine opposition.
- if multiple abilities would grant the same resistance, only the strongest applies unless another rule states otherwise.
- the exact resistances, protections, and additional blessings granted by **blessed resilience** are determined by your patron's religious pages.

> **— high warden cassian, keeper of the eternal oath**

as the years pass, the divine blessing carried by a paladin becomes inseparable from their very being. their patron's influence no longer answers only when called upon—it quietly strengthens them every moment of every day, preparing them for the inevitable confrontation with the powers that stand in opposition to their faith.

many scholars believe that this resilience is the first outward sign of true divine favour. though different patrons bestow different blessings, all share a common purpose: to ensure their chosen champion can endure the trials they were destined to face.

> *"steel is forged through fire. faith is forged through adversity."*  
> **— high warden cassian, keeper of the eternal oath**

## rank 3
### description

your patron's blessing has become deeply woven into your soul, transforming your resilience from simple endurance into steadfast divine protection. the forces that oppose your deity find it increasingly difficult to weaken your resolve, as your body and spirit instinctively reject influences that seek to break your sacred oath.

every trial survived strengthens the divine bond between champion and patron. what once required conscious determination has become second nature, allowing you to endure hardships that would overwhelm even seasoned warriors. whether facing corrupting magic, overwhelming divine power, or supernatural afflictions tied to your patron's eternal enemies, your faith stands as an unyielding shield.

to the greatest paladins, resilience is not measured by how little they suffer, but by how often they rise again without allowing darkness to take hold. their patron's blessing ensures that no matter how fierce the opposition becomes, their resolve remains unbroken.

### effects

- **blessed resilience** is a **passive talent** and is always active.
- gain **+6 on saving throws** against effects originating from your patron's **divine opposition**.
- gain the resistances and protections granted by your patron's religious pages.
- once per **short rest**, when you fail a saving throw against your patron's divine opposition, you may immediately reroll that saving throw. you must use the second result.
- if you successfully resist an effect originating from your patron's divine opposition, you become **immune to that same effect from the same source until the end of your next turn**.
- gain **+6 on checks or saving throws** made to resist conditions specifically associated with your patron's divine opposition.
- if multiple abilities would grant the same resistance, only the strongest applies unless another rule states otherwise.
- the exact resistances, protections, and additional blessings granted by **blessed resilience** are determined by your patron's religious pages.

### lore

veteran paladins are recognised not by the absence of scars, but by the certainty with which they continue to stand against impossible odds. their patron's blessing has become so deeply intertwined with their soul that opposing divine forces struggle to gain even the briefest foothold.

religious scholars often describe these champions as living testaments to their deity's will. each victory over corruption, temptation, or supernatural oppression reinforces the sacred bond they share, proving that true resilience is born not from invulnerability, but from unwavering devotion.

> *"a faithful soul does not become unbreakable by avoiding hardship. it becomes unbreakable by surviving it."*  
> **— high warden cassian, keeper of the eternal oath**

## rank 4
### description

your patron's blessing has become an inseparable part of your being. divine power no longer merely protects you—it instinctively responds whenever opposing forces attempt to weaken your resolve. every trial endured has forged your body, mind, and spirit into a vessel capable of withstanding extraordinary hardship.

the champions who reach this level of devotion are often described as immovable pillars of faith. they continue advancing through corruption, fear, divine opposition, and supernatural assaults that would overwhelm lesser warriors. their resilience is no longer a conscious effort but an instinct born from absolute trust in their patron.

those who witness such unwavering determination often mistake it for invulnerability. in truth, a paladin still feels pain and hardship—but their faith refuses to let those burdens define them.

### effects

- **blessed resilience** is a **passive talent** and is always active.
- gain **+6 on saving throws** against effects originating from your patron's **divine opposition**.
- gain all resistances and protections granted by your patron's religious pages.
- once per **short rest**, when you fail a saving throw against your patron's divine opposition, you may immediately reroll that saving throw. you must use the second result.
- if you successfully resist an effect originating from your patron's divine opposition, you become **immune to that same effect from the same source until the end of your next turn**.
- the first time each **long rest** that you would gain a condition associated with your patron's **divine opposition**, you may choose to ignore that condition entirely.
- if multiple abilities would grant the same resistance or immunity, only the strongest applies unless another rule states otherwise.
- the exact resistances, immunities, and blessings granted by **blessed resilience** are determined by your patron's religious pages.

### lore

the oldest scriptures speak of champions whose faith became so complete that the divine itself seemed to shield them from corruption. though wounds still marked their bodies, their spirits remained beyond the reach of the powers that sought to break them.

among the greatest paladins, blessed resilience is viewed not as a reward, but as a sacred responsibility. those entrusted with such unwavering protection are expected to stand where others cannot, shielding the innocent from the very forces their patron has sworn to oppose.

> *"the faithful are not those who never fall. they are those who rise every time darkness believes it has finally won."*  
> **— high warden cassian, keeper of the eternal oath**

## rank 5
### description

your soul has become a living reflection of your patron's divine will. every hardship you have endured, every temptation resisted, and every oath upheld has strengthened the sacred bond between you and the deity you serve. what was once a blessing has become an inseparable part of your very existence.

opposing divine forces no longer see you as merely another mortal champion—they recognise you as an extension of the power they oppose. your faith shields your body, your spirit, and your resolve, allowing you to stand before supernatural threats that would overwhelm even the greatest heroes.

though no mortal is beyond suffering, your patron ensures that you will never stand alone. their presence surrounds you in every battle, every trial, and every act of devotion, making you one of the truest embodiments of their divine purpose.

### effects

- **blessed resilience** is a **passive talent** and is always active.
- gain **advantage on saving throws** against effects originating from your patron's **divine opposition**.
- gain all resistances, protections, and passive blessings granted by your patron's religious pages.

### lore

few paladins ever achieve such complete harmony with their patron. those who do become living symbols of divine conviction, carrying the essence of their deity wherever they travel. entire orders look to these champions for guidance, believing their unwavering resilience to be proof that absolute faith can overcome even the greatest darkness.

legends speak of these heroes standing against impossible odds without yielding, not because they were invincible, but because their devotion could not be shaken. whether defending sacred shrines, confronting ancient evils, or leading armies into hopeless battles, they become a testament to the enduring strength of the divine.

> *"the body may tire. the armour may break. even the sword may fail. but a soul truly bound to the divine will never surrender."*  
> **— high warden cassian, keeper of the eternal oath**

# Blessing Aura

## Overview
Through unwavering faith, you become a living conduit for your patron's divine presence. Rather than calling upon a single miracle, you invite a fragment of your deity's essence into the mortal world, surrounding yourself with a sacred aura that reflects their domains and ideals.

No two Blessing Auras are ever the same. A Cleric devoted to a god of life may radiate gentle warmth and flourishing vitality, while a servant of death may be cloaked in silent shadows and drifting souls. Patrons of fate may weave shimmering threads through the air, whereas patrons of war may surround their followers with the echoes of distant battle.

At this rank, your connection is still developing, allowing only a small manifestation of your patron's power. Even so, those who stand within the aura quickly realise they are no longer standing beside a mere mortal, but within the presence of something far greater.

## Rank 1
### Description

Through unwavering faith, you become a living conduit for your patron's divine presence. Rather than calling upon a single miracle, you invite a fragment of your deity's essence into the mortal world, surrounding yourself with a sacred aura that reflects their domains and ideals.

No two Blessing Auras are ever the same. A Cleric devoted to a god of life may radiate gentle warmth and flourishing vitality, while a servant of death may be cloaked in silent shadows and drifting souls. Patrons of fate may weave shimmering threads through the air, whereas patrons of war may surround their followers with the echoes of distant battle.

At this rank, your connection is still developing, allowing only a small manifestation of your patron's power. Even so, those who stand within the aura quickly realise they are no longer standing beside a mere mortal, but within the presence of something far greater.

### Effects

- As an Action, expend **20 MP** to manifest your **Blessing Aura**.
- Your Blessing Aura is centred on you and moves with you.
- The aura has a **5 metre radius**.
- The aura lasts for **2 rounds**.
- Allies and enemies are immediately affected upon entering the aura and cease being affected when they leave it.
- The effects of the Blessing Aura are **entirely determined by your chosen patron**.
- Blessing Aura has no innate effects of its own and instead acts as the vessel through which your patron's divine influence is expressed.
- If multiple Blessing Auras overlap, a creature can only be affected by one Blessing Aura at a time. If a conflict occurs, the GM determines which aura takes precedence.
- Blessing Aura is considered **Divine Magic**.

### Lore

The oldest temples teach that a Cleric does not command divine power—they are entrusted with it. Blessing Aura is often the first miracle granted to newly ordained priests, marking the moment their patron acknowledges them as a worthy vessel.

Many theologians believe every Blessing Aura is unique, carrying subtle signs of the deity behind it. Some are unmistakable, while others are understood only by devoted followers. To those who witness them, these manifestations are reminders that the gods are never truly absent from the world.

As a Cleric's faith deepens, so too does the strength of their Blessing Aura. What begins as a faint divine presence may one day become a manifestation so overwhelming that entire battlefields are transformed by the will of a single god.

> *"Do not mistake the aura for the miracle. The aura is merely the doorway through which the divine chooses to enter our world."*
>
> — High Hierophant Elaris, Keeper of the Sacred Testament

## Rank 2
### Description

Your bond with your patron grows stronger, allowing their divine presence to linger longer and reach farther across the battlefield. What was once a faint manifestation now becomes an unmistakable symbol of your deity's influence, inspiring both reverence and caution from those who witness it.

As your faith deepens, your patron entrusts you with a greater measure of their power. The aura expands naturally around you, extending its influence over more allies and enemies alike. Every step you take carries your patron's presence, making you the centre of a moving sanctuary—or a warning to those who oppose your deity.

Although every Blessing Aura remains unique to the patron it represents, all share one truth: the faithful do not stand alone. Wherever a Cleric walks, the will of their deity walks with them.

### Effects

- As an Action, expend **25 MP** to manifest your **Blessing Aura**.
- Your Blessing Aura is centred on you and moves with you.
- The aura has a **7.5 metre radius**.
- The aura lasts for **3 rounds**.
- Allies and enemies are immediately affected upon entering the aura and cease being affected when they leave it.
- The effects of the Blessing Aura are **entirely determined by your chosen patron**.
- Blessing Aura has no innate effects of its own and instead serves as the vessel through which your patron expresses their divine influence.
- If multiple Blessing Auras overlap, a creature can only be affected by one Blessing Aura at a time. If a conflict occurs, the GM determines which aura takes precedence.
- Blessing Aura is considered **Divine Magic**.

### Lore

Senior priests often describe this stage of mastery as the moment a Cleric ceases to merely invoke their patron and instead begins to embody their presence. Those familiar with the signs of the gods can often identify a Cleric's patron long before a word is spoken, simply by observing the aura that surrounds them.

Across Asteria, temples preserve countless accounts of battlefields transformed by the arrival of a devoted Cleric. Soldiers speak of impossible courage, unnatural silence, blooming flowers, spectral ravens or radiant light appearing moments before the tide of battle changed. Whether these tales are miracles or legends is a matter of faith, but few deny the profound influence a true Blessing Aura can have.

> *"The faithful need not announce whom they serve. Their patron speaks through every step they take."*
>
> — Archbishop Maelor, Voice of the Divine Conclave

## Rank 3
### Description

Your unwavering devotion has strengthened the bond between yourself and your patron, allowing a greater portion of their divine presence to manifest within the mortal realm. Your Blessing Aura no longer feels like a fleeting miracle, but a sacred domain where your deity's influence is undeniable.

Those who enter the aura instinctively sense the presence of something beyond mortal understanding. To the faithful, it is a place of comfort, purpose or reassurance. To those who stand opposed to your patron's ideals, it may become a place of unease, judgement or overwhelming reverence. Every manifestation remains unique, shaped entirely by the deity who grants your power.

As your mastery grows, your Blessing Aura becomes a symbol recognised by clergy and scholars alike. It is no longer merely evidence of your faith—it is proof that your patron trusts you to carry a greater fragment of their divine will into the world.

### Effects

- As an Action, expend **30 MP** to manifest your **Blessing Aura**.
- Your Blessing Aura is centred on you and moves with you.
- The aura has a **10 metre radius**.
- The aura lasts for **4 rounds**.
- Allies and enemies are immediately affected upon entering the aura and cease being affected when they leave it.
- The effects of the Blessing Aura are **entirely determined by your chosen patron**.
- Blessing Aura has no innate effects of its own and instead serves as the vessel through which your patron expresses their divine influence.
- If multiple Blessing Auras overlap, a creature can only be affected by one Blessing Aura at a time. If a conflict occurs, the GM determines which aura takes precedence.
- Blessing Aura is considered **Divine Magic**.

### Lore

Within the great temples of Asteria, reaching this level of mastery is considered a significant milestone in a Cleric's journey. It marks the point where the faithful cease to simply invoke miracles and instead become recognised as enduring vessels of divine influence.

Some believe the gods themselves can perceive the world through these sacred manifestations, watching over their followers from beyond the veil. Whether this belief is truth or tradition, few can deny that those who stand within a powerful Blessing Aura often feel the unmistakable presence of something far greater than themselves.

The appearance of such an aura has become a symbol of hope, judgement or destiny throughout history, its meaning forever shaped by the patron whose power it carries.

> *"Faith is not measured by the prayers you offer, but by the presence your patron entrusts you to bear."*
>
> — Saint Aveline, First Oracle of the Divine Concord

## Rank 4
### Description

The divine presence surrounding you has become a beacon of your patron's authority. No longer a simple manifestation of faith, your Blessing Aura now establishes a sacred domain wherever you stand. Within its boundaries, the influence of your deity is undeniable, and those who enter it instinctively recognise they have crossed into ground touched by the divine.

Your patron's power flows effortlessly through you, requiring little conscious effort to maintain. Every movement extends their reach, every prayer strengthens their presence, and every ally standing beside you shares in the blessings your deity chooses to bestow. Likewise, those who oppose your patron cannot escape the consequences of entering their sacred domain.

Veteran Clerics are often identified long before they reveal themselves. Their Blessing Aura becomes synonymous with their reputation, leaving behind stories of miraculous salvation, unwavering courage, inevitable judgement or peaceful serenity—each one reflecting the ideals of the patron they faithfully serve.

### Effects

- As an Action, expend **35 MP** to manifest your **Blessing Aura**.
- Your Blessing Aura is centred on you and moves with you.
- The aura has a **12.5 metre radius**.
- The aura lasts for **5 rounds**.
- Allies and enemies are immediately affected upon entering the aura and cease being affected when they leave it.
- The effects of the Blessing Aura are **entirely determined by your chosen patron**.
- Blessing Aura has no innate effects of its own and instead serves as the vessel through which your patron expresses their divine influence.
- Your Blessing Aura is considered a **Sacred Domain** for the purpose of patron abilities and future Cleric talents.
- If multiple Blessing Auras overlap, a creature can only be affected by one Blessing Aura at a time. If a conflict occurs, the GM determines which aura takes precedence.
- Blessing Aura is considered **Divine Magic**.

### Lore

Only the most devoted servants are entrusted with carrying such a powerful manifestation of their patron's presence. Across Asteria, these Clerics are regarded not merely as priests but as living sanctuaries, capable of bringing a fragment of the divine into even the darkest corners of the world.

Pilgrims often travel great distances simply to witness a master Cleric invoke their Blessing Aura. Some seek healing, others guidance or judgement, while many come only to experience what it feels like to stand within the unmistakable presence of a god.

The oldest scriptures teach that the strength of a Blessing Aura is not measured by its brilliance or size, but by the depth of the bond between patron and servant. Those chosen to wield such power are forever changed, carrying a part of their deity wherever they walk.

> *"When the faithful gather around their Cleric, they do not stand beside a priest—they stand within the shadow of a god."*
>
> — Grand Hierophant Solenar, Keeper of the Eternal Sanctum

## Rank 5
### Description

Your faith has reached its pinnacle, allowing you to become a true vessel of your patron's divine presence. Your Blessing Aura no longer represents a fleeting miracle—it is a manifestation of your deity's will upon the mortal plane. Wherever you walk, the influence of your patron follows, transforming the battlefield into sacred ground shaped by their domains, ideals and purpose.

The aura itself is unique to every Cleric, reflecting the patron they serve. It may appear as radiant light, blooming life, drifting souls, roaring storms, flowing waters, shimmering threads of fate or countless other divine manifestations. Those who stand within its boundaries cannot mistake its origin, for the presence of a god is unmistakable.

To friend and foe alike, a master Cleric is more than a priest—they are the living embodiment of divine authority. Entire armies have rallied around such individuals, while others have abandoned the field rather than face the overwhelming presence of a deity made manifest through mortal hands.

### Effects

- As an Action, expend **40 MP** to manifest your **Blessing Aura**.
- Your Blessing Aura is centred on you and moves with you.
- The aura has a **15 metre radius**.
- The aura lasts for **10 rounds**.
- Allies and enemies are immediately affected upon entering the aura and cease being affected when they leave it.
- The effects of the Blessing Aura are **entirely determined by your chosen patron**.
- Blessing Aura has no innate effects of its own and instead serves as the vessel through which your patron expresses their divine influence.
- Your Blessing Aura is considered a **Sacred Domain** for the purpose of all Cleric talents, Patron abilities and divine effects.
- While your Blessing Aura is active, you are considered to be **Channeling your Patron**.
- If multiple Blessing Auras overlap, a creature can only be affected by one Blessing Aura at a time. If a conflict occurs, the GM determines which aura takes precedence.
- Blessing Aura is considered **Divine Magic**.

### Lore

Among the oldest religions of Asteria, only a handful of Clerics throughout history have achieved this level of communion with their patron. Such individuals are remembered not for the miracles they performed, but for the unmistakable presence they carried wherever they travelled. Entire cities would fall silent as they passed, sensing that the veil between the mortal and divine had grown impossibly thin.

Scholars often debate whether these legendary Clerics merely carried their patron's blessing or whether, for brief moments, the gods themselves looked upon the world through their faithful servant. Whatever the truth, every account speaks of the same feeling—a presence so overwhelming that it inspired hope, fear, peace or judgement before a single word was spoken.

To master Blessing Aura is to surrender completely to one's faith. The Cleric no longer calls upon the divine—they become the means through which the divine touches the world.

> *"The greatest miracle is not the power of the gods, but the mortal they trust to bear it."*
>
> — Saint Aurelius, First Voice of the Divine Conclave

- as an action, expend **35 mp** to manifest your **blessing aura**.
- your blessing aura is centred on you and moves with you.
- the aura has a **12.5 metre radius**.
- the aura lasts for **5 rounds**.
- allies and enemies are immediately affected upon entering the aura and cease being affected when they leave it.
- the effects of the blessing aura are **entirely determined by your chosen patron**.
- blessing aura has no innate effects of its own and instead serves as the vessel through which your patron expresses their divine influence.
- your blessing aura is considered a **sacred domain** for the purpose of patron abilities and future cleric talents.
- if multiple blessing auras overlap, a creature can only be affected by one blessing aura at a time. if a conflict occurs, the gm determines which aura takes precedence.
- blessing aura is considered **divine magic**.

### lore

only the most devoted servants are entrusted with carrying such a powerful manifestation of their patron's presence. across asteria, these clerics are regarded not merely as priests but as living sanctuaries, capable of bringing a fragment of the divine into even the darkest corners of the world.

pilgrims often travel great distances simply to witness a master cleric invoke their blessing aura. some seek healing, others guidance or judgement, while many come only to experience what it feels like to stand within the unmistakable presence of a god.

the oldest scriptures teach that the strength of a blessing aura is not measured by its brilliance or size, but by the depth of the bond between patron and servant. those chosen to wield such power are forever changed, carrying a part of their deity wherever they walk.

> *"when the faithful gather around their cleric, they do not stand beside a priest—they stand within the shadow of a god."*
>
> — grand hierophant solenar, keeper of the eternal sanctum

## rank 5
### description

your faith has reached its pinnacle, allowing you to become a true vessel of your patron's divine presence. your blessing aura no longer represents a fleeting miracle—it is a manifestation of your deity's will upon the mortal plane. wherever you walk, the influence of your patron follows, transforming the battlefield into sacred ground shaped by their domains, ideals and purpose.

the aura itself is unique to every cleric, reflecting the patron they serve. it may appear as radiant light, blooming life, drifting souls, roaring storms, flowing waters, shimmering threads of fate or countless other divine manifestations. those who stand within its boundaries cannot mistake its origin, for the presence of a god is unmistakable.

to friend and foe alike, a master cleric is more than a priest—they are the living embodiment of divine authority. entire armies have rallied around such individuals, while others have abandoned the field rather than face the overwhelming presence of a deity made manifest through mortal hands.

### effects

- as an action, expend **40 mp** to manifest your **blessing aura**.
- your blessing aura is centred on you and moves with you.
- the aura has a **15 metre radius**.
- the aura lasts for **10 rounds**.
- allies and enemies are immediately affected upon entering the aura and cease being affected when they leave it.
- the effects of the blessing aura are **entirely determined by your chosen patron**.
- blessing aura has no innate effects of its own and instead serves as the vessel through which your patron expresses their divine influence.
- your blessing aura is considered a **sacred domain** for the purpose of all cleric talents, patron abilities and divine effects.
- while your blessing aura is active, you are considered to be **channeling your patron**.
- if multiple blessing auras overlap, a creature can only be affected by one blessing aura at a time. if a conflict occurs, the gm determines which aura takes precedence.
- blessing aura is considered **divine magic**.

### lore

among the oldest religions of asteria, only a handful of clerics throughout history have achieved this level of communion with their patron. such individuals are remembered not for the miracles they performed, but for the unmistakable presence they carried wherever they travelled. entire cities would fall silent as they passed, sensing that the veil between the mortal and divine had grown impossibly thin.

scholars often debate whether these legendary clerics merely carried their patron's blessing or whether, for brief moments, the gods themselves looked upon the world through their faithful servant. whatever the truth, every account speaks of the same feeling—a presence so overwhelming that it inspired hope, fear, peace or judgement before a single word was spoken.

to master blessing aura is to surrender completely to one's faith. the cleric no longer calls upon the divine—they become the means through which the divine touches the world.

> *"the greatest miracle is not the power of the gods, but the mortal they trust to bear it."*
>
> — saint aurelius, first voice of the divine conclave
