# Blood Control

## Overview
True mastery of Sangramancy begins not with controlling another creature's blood, but with mastering your own. Every Bloodhunter must learn to regulate the blood flowing through their body, slowing its loss, resisting corruption, and preventing panic from overwhelming instinct. Blood Control is the first discipline that teaches this vital lesson.

Through rigorous training, the Bloodhunter learns to consciously direct the flow of their own blood. Wounds clot more rapidly, circulation becomes easier to regulate, and the body instinctively prioritises survival. While these techniques cannot prevent injury, they greatly reduce the effects of blood-based afflictions that would cripple an ordinary warrior.

Blood Control also strengthens the Bloodhunter's tolerance to Sangramancy itself. As they become more accustomed to manipulating the lifeblood within their own body, they are capable of safely containing greater amounts of Blood Points before Bloodlust begins to threaten their mind.

In moments of absolute desperation, a Bloodhunter may force their blood into complete obedience. This technique, known as **Emergency Blood Control**, suppresses the effects of a blood-based affliction through sheer force of will. The effort is immense, pushing the Bloodhunter closer to Bloodlust, but it may provide the precious seconds needed to survive the hunt.

## Rank 1
### Description

True mastery of Sangramancy begins not with controlling another creature's blood, but with mastering your own. Every Bloodhunter must learn to regulate the blood flowing through their body, slowing its loss, resisting corruption, and preventing panic from overwhelming instinct. Blood Control is the first discipline that teaches this vital lesson.

Through rigorous training, the Bloodhunter learns to consciously direct the flow of their own blood. Wounds clot more rapidly, circulation becomes easier to regulate, and the body instinctively prioritises survival. While these techniques cannot prevent injury, they greatly reduce the effects of blood-based afflictions that would cripple an ordinary warrior.

Blood Control also strengthens the Bloodhunter's tolerance to Sangramancy itself. As they become more accustomed to manipulating the lifeblood within their own body, they are capable of safely containing greater amounts of Blood Points before Bloodlust begins to threaten their mind.

In moments of absolute desperation, a Bloodhunter may force their blood into complete obedience. This technique, known as **Emergency Blood Control**, suppresses the effects of a blood-based affliction through sheer force of will. The effort is immense, pushing the Bloodhunter closer to Bloodlust, but it may provide the precious seconds needed to survive the hunt.

### Effects

- Permanently increase your **Maximum Blood Point Limit** by **5 BP**.
- Reduce the severity of all **Bleeding** effects affecting you by **1 Rank** (to a minimum of **Rank I**).
- **Emergency Blood Control:** After you are afflicted with **Bleeding**, you may choose to activate Emergency Blood Control **before the start of your next turn**.
- Gain **10 Blood Points (BP)**.
- The Bleeding effect deals **no damage** until the start of your next turn.
- This **does not remove** the Bleeding condition. If the condition has not been cured, its effects resume normally after the suppression ends.
- Emergency Blood Control may only be activated **once for each application** of a condition.

### Lore

The Bloodhunter Orders teach that every apprentice first learns to command the blood within themselves before attempting to influence the blood of another. Those unable to master their own body inevitably lose control when Sangramancy reaches its peak, becoming victims of Bloodlust rather than its master.

Veteran Bloodhunters often describe Blood Control as listening to the rhythm of their own heartbeat. With enough discipline, they can slow bleeding, strengthen weakened muscles, and force their body to continue fighting through wounds that would leave others helpless.

The elders consider this technique the foundation of every advanced Sangramantic discipline. A Bloodhunter who cannot command their own blood has no right to command the blood of another.

> *"Master your own blood before you ever dare command another's."*  
> — Grand Bloodhunter Serik Vaelor

## Rank 2
### Description

With greater experience, the Bloodhunter develops an even deeper understanding of the blood flowing through their body. Every heartbeat becomes deliberate, every pulse controlled, and every wound is met with instinctive resistance. Sangramancy is no longer simply a source of power—it has become a means of preserving the Bloodhunter's own life.

Through relentless training, the Bloodhunter learns to identify foreign substances entering their bloodstream and instinctively slow their spread. Poisons that would rapidly overwhelm another adventurer are instead met by blood that actively resists corruption, buying valuable moments to finish the hunt or seek treatment.

This growing mastery also expands the Bloodhunter's tolerance to Blood Points. The emotions carried within their blood remain dangerous, but the hunter has learned to endure a greater burden before Bloodlust threatens to consume them. Every battle becomes another lesson in restraint, proving that true mastery is measured not by how much power one possesses, but by how well one controls it.

When faced with overwhelming injury or venom, the Bloodhunter can once again force their blood into complete obedience. Though this momentary suppression comes at the cost of Blood Points, it allows the hunter to delay the effects long enough to continue fighting. Every use is a reminder that control is never free.

### Effects

- Permanently increase your **Maximum Blood Point Limit** by **10 BP**.
- Reduce the severity of all **Bleeding** effects affecting you by **1 Rank** (minimum **Rank I**).
- Reduce the severity of all **Poison** effects affecting you by **1 Rank** (minimum **Rank I**).
- **Emergency Blood Control:** After you are afflicted with **Bleeding** or **Poison**, you may activate Emergency Blood Control **before the start of your next turn**.
- Gain **10 Blood Points (BP)**.
- The chosen condition deals **no damage** until the start of your next turn.
- This **does not remove** the condition. If it has not been cured, its effects resume normally after the suppression ends.
- Emergency Blood Control may only be activated **once for each application** of a condition.

### Lore

Among the Bloodhunter Orders, the Second Rank is considered the point where Sangramancy becomes as much a defensive discipline as an offensive one. Apprentices are no longer merely surviving their wounds—they are actively commanding the blood within their own bodies to resist corruption and maintain control under impossible circumstances.

Veterans often compare Blood Control to commanding an army. Every drop of blood answers the Bloodhunter's will, slowing poisons, sealing wounds, and preserving strength through sheer determination. To outsiders, these feats appear impossible, but Bloodhunters know they are earned only through countless battles and painful sacrifice.

The elders remind every hunter that Blood Control is not invincibility. It merely grants the opportunity to survive long enough to complete the hunt. Every time the blood is forced into submission, Bloodlust watches patiently, waiting for the moment discipline finally falters.

> *"The blood obeys only because I have taught it discipline through pain."*  
> — Grand Bloodhunter Serik Vaelor

## Rank 3
### Description

By the Third Rank, the Bloodhunter's mastery over their own blood has become instinctive. Sangramancy no longer serves merely as a weapon against monsters—it has become a means of preserving the hunter's own life. Every heartbeat is consciously regulated, every drop of blood obeys the hunter's will, and the body instinctively resists afflictions that would overwhelm even seasoned adventurers.

The Bloodhunter has learned to isolate foreign contaminants within their bloodstream, slowing the spread of disease and preventing severe wounds from worsening as quickly. Their body becomes remarkably resilient, adapting to trauma through sheer force of discipline rather than natural endurance. To outside observers, it appears almost unnatural how quickly a Bloodhunter regains control after suffering devastating injuries.

This level of mastery also allows the Bloodhunter to contain a far greater amount of Sangramantic energy. The emotions carried within their blood remain dangerous, but the hunter has learned to suppress them beneath unwavering determination. Every battle strengthens this control, delaying the onset of Bloodlust without ever eliminating the threat entirely.

When the situation becomes desperate, the Bloodhunter can once again invoke **Emergency Blood Control**, forcing every drop of blood to obey. The effort is immense, flooding their body with Blood Points, but granting them precious moments to continue the hunt before the darkness threatens to consume them.

### Effects

- Permanently increase your **Maximum Blood Point Limit** by **15 BP**.
- Reduce the severity of all **Bleeding** effects affecting you by **1 Rank** (minimum **Rank I**).
- Reduce the severity of all **Poison** effects affecting you by **1 Rank** (minimum **Rank I**).
- Reduce the severity of all **Disease** effects affecting you by **1 Rank** (minimum **Rank I**).
- **Emergency Blood Control:** After you are afflicted with **Bleeding**, **Poison**, or **Disease**, you may activate Emergency Blood Control **before the start of your next turn**.
- Gain **15 Blood Points (BP)**.
- The chosen condition deals **no damage** until the start of your next turn.
- This **does not remove** the condition. If it has not been cured, its effects resume normally after the suppression ends.
- Emergency Blood Control may only be activated **once for each application** of a condition.

### Lore

Among the Bloodhunter Orders, Rank III is known as **The Crimson Discipline**. It marks the point where a Bloodhunter no longer merely survives their wounds—they command them. Through countless battles and relentless training, the hunter learns to slow the spread of corruption, regulate their own circulation, and force their body to endure hardships that would claim lesser warriors.

Masters often teach that true Blood Control is not about denying pain, but about refusing to let pain dictate one's actions. Every scar becomes another lesson, every wound another opportunity to strengthen the bond between hunter and blood. This unwavering discipline is what separates experienced Bloodhunters from those who eventually surrender to Bloodlust.

The elders caution that mastery is never permanent. Every hunt tests the Bloodhunter anew, and every use of Emergency Blood Control reminds them that commanding their blood requires constant vigilance. A single lapse in discipline is all Bloodlust needs to reclaim what has been held at bay.

> *"The blood remembers every wound. I simply remind it who gives the orders."*  
> — Grand Bloodhunter Serik Vaelor

## Rank 4
### Description

The Fourth Rank of Blood Control represents a level of Sangramantic mastery that few Bloodhunters ever achieve. Their blood no longer simply responds to commands—it anticipates them. Every heartbeat is deliberate, every vein carries the will of its master, and the body instinctively resists corruption before it can fully take hold.

Years of relentless training have taught the Bloodhunter to recognise the subtle changes caused by venom, disease, and catastrophic injuries. The moment these afflictions enter the bloodstream, the Bloodhunter instinctively redirects circulation, slowing their spread and reducing their severity. What would cripple another warrior becomes little more than another obstacle to overcome.

This mastery also greatly expands the Bloodhunter's capacity to contain Blood Points. The emotions that once threatened to erupt into Bloodlust are held in check through absolute discipline, allowing the hunter to draw upon far greater reserves of Sangramantic power before losing control.

In moments where death seems inevitable, the Bloodhunter may invoke **Emergency Blood Control**, overwhelming their own body with Sangramantic force. Every drop of blood obeys without hesitation, suppressing the effects of even the deadliest afflictions. The effort comes at a terrible price, rapidly increasing Blood Points, but it grants the Bloodhunter one more opportunity to finish the hunt.

### Effects

- Permanently increase your **Maximum Blood Point Limit** by **20 BP**.
- Reduce the severity of all **Bleeding** effects affecting you by **1 Rank** (minimum **Rank I**).
- Reduce the severity of all **Poison** effects affecting you by **1 Rank** (minimum **Rank I**).
- Reduce the severity of all **Disease** effects affecting you by **1 Rank** (minimum **Rank I**).
- Reduce the severity of all **Necrosis**, **Venom**, or other blood-affecting conditions by **1 Rank** (minimum **Rank I**).
- **Emergency Blood Control:** After you are afflicted with **Bleeding**, **Poison**, **Disease**, **Necrosis**, **Venom**, or another blood-affecting condition, you may activate Emergency Blood Control **before the start of your next turn**.
- Gain **20 Blood Points (BP)**.
- The chosen condition deals **no damage** until the start of your next turn.
- This **does not remove** the condition. If it has not been cured, its effects resume normally after the suppression ends.
- Emergency Blood Control may only be activated **once for each application** of a condition.

### Lore

Within the Bloodhunter Orders, Rank IV is known as **The Crimson Sovereignty**. Bloodhunters who achieve this mastery are said to rule over their own lifeblood with absolute authority. Their veins no longer serve merely as vessels—they become conduits of unwavering discipline, capable of resisting horrors that would overwhelm even legendary heroes.

Many stories tell of Bloodhunters continuing to fight after suffering venom capable of killing giants or diseases that emptied entire villages. Their survival is not due to immunity, but because their blood refuses to surrender while its master still stands. Every heartbeat becomes a declaration that Sangramancy answers only the will of the Bloodhunter.

The elders caution that this mastery walks a dangerous path. Every time Emergency Blood Control is invoked, the Bloodhunter forces their emotions deeper beneath the surface instead of confronting them. Bloodlust does not disappear—it waits patiently beneath the calm, growing stronger with every act of suppression until the hunter is once again forced to choose between control and surrender.

> *"My blood knows every poison, every wound, and every curse. It has learned to fear only one thing... my command."*  
> — Grand Bloodhunter Serik Vaelor

## Rank 5
### Description

The Fifth Rank of Blood Control is regarded as one of the greatest achievements in Sangramancy. At this stage, the Bloodhunter has attained absolute mastery over the blood flowing through their body. Every heartbeat, every vein, and every drop of blood responds instantly to their will, allowing them to resist afflictions that would claim even the mightiest of heroes.

To the Bloodhunter, blood is no longer merely a life-giving fluid—it has become a disciplined servant. The spread of toxins is slowed before they can take hold, catastrophic wounds clot with unnatural speed, and corruption carried through the bloodstream struggles to gain purchase. While these afflictions remain dangerous, the Bloodhunter has learned to deny them the opportunity to reach their full potential.

This mastery also represents the greatest control over Bloodlust that a mortal can achieve. The Bloodhunter has learned to contain immense amounts of Blood Points before surrendering to the darkness within. They understand that Bloodlust can never truly be conquered, only restrained through unwavering discipline and sacrifice.

When death appears inevitable, the Bloodhunter may invoke the ultimate expression of this mastery—**Emergency Blood Control**. Every drop of blood is forced into complete obedience, suppressing even the most devastating blood-borne afflictions for a brief moment. The strain is immense, flooding the Bloodhunter with Blood Points, but granting one final opportunity to finish the hunt before Bloodlust demands its price.

### Effects

- Permanently increase your **Maximum Blood Point Limit** by **25 BP**.
- Reduce the severity of all **Bleeding** effects affecting you by **1 Rank** (minimum **Rank I**).
- Reduce the severity of all **Poison** effects affecting you by **1 Rank** (minimum **Rank I**).
- Reduce the severity of all **Disease** effects affecting you by **1 Rank** (minimum **Rank I**).
- Reduce the severity of all **Necrosis**, **Venom**, and all other **blood-affecting conditions** by **1 Rank** (minimum **Rank I**).
- **Emergency Blood Control:** After you are afflicted with a blood-affecting condition, you may activate Emergency Blood Control **before the start of your next turn**.
- Gain **25 Blood Points (BP)**.
- The chosen condition deals **no damage and its effects are suppressed** until the start of your next turn.
- This **does not remove** the condition. If it has not been cured, its effects immediately resume after the suppression ends.
- Emergency Blood Control may only be activated **once for each application** of a condition.

### Lore

Within the Bloodhunter Orders, Rank V is known as **The Crimson Dominion**. Only the oldest and most disciplined masters ever attain this level of control, where Sangramancy ceases to be a dangerous art and instead becomes an extension of the hunter's own will. Their blood obeys without hesitation, resisting corruption, preserving life, and carrying them through battles that should have ended in death.

Legends speak of Bloodhunters who continued fighting while suffering wounds that would kill ordinary warriors many times over. They did not survive because they were immune to pain or poison, but because every drop of blood within them refused to yield until their master's task was complete. To witness such a hunter in battle is to watch determination itself take physical form.

Yet every Grandmaster teaches the same final lesson. Absolute control over one's blood does not mean victory over Bloodlust. The darkness is never destroyed—it is merely held in chains forged through discipline, sacrifice, and relentless resolve. The Bloodhunter who forgets this truth will discover that even the strongest chains can one day break.

> *"My blood no longer asks permission to fight. It waits only for my command."*  
> — Grand Bloodhunter Serik Vaelor

- **emergency blood control:** after you are afflicted with **bleeding**, **poison**, or **disease**, you may activate emergency blood control **before the start of your next turn**.
- gain **15 blood points (bp)**.
- the chosen condition deals **no damage** until the start of your next turn.
- this **does not remove** the condition. if it has not been cured, its effects resume normally after the suppression ends.
- emergency blood control may only be activated **once for each application** of a condition.

### lore

among the bloodhunter orders, rank iii is known as **the crimson discipline**. it marks the point where a bloodhunter no longer merely survives their wounds—they command them. through countless battles and relentless training, the hunter learns to slow the spread of corruption, regulate their own circulation, and force their body to endure hardships that would claim lesser warriors.

masters often teach that true blood control is not about denying pain, but about refusing to let pain dictate one's actions. every scar becomes another lesson, every wound another opportunity to strengthen the bond between hunter and blood. this unwavering discipline is what separates experienced bloodhunters from those who eventually surrender to bloodlust.

the elders caution that mastery is never permanent. every hunt tests the bloodhunter anew, and every use of emergency blood control reminds them that commanding their blood requires constant vigilance. a single lapse in discipline is all bloodlust needs to reclaim what has been held at bay.

> *"the blood remembers every wound. i simply remind it who gives the orders."*  
> — grand bloodhunter serik vaelor

## rank 4
### description

the fourth rank of blood control represents a level of sangramantic mastery that few bloodhunters ever achieve. their blood no longer simply responds to commands—it anticipates them. every heartbeat is deliberate, every vein carries the will of its master, and the body instinctively resists corruption before it can fully take hold.

years of relentless training have taught the bloodhunter to recognise the subtle changes caused by venom, disease, and catastrophic injuries. the moment these afflictions enter the bloodstream, the bloodhunter instinctively redirects circulation, slowing their spread and reducing their severity. what would cripple another warrior becomes little more than another obstacle to overcome.

this mastery also greatly expands the bloodhunter's capacity to contain blood points. the emotions that once threatened to erupt into bloodlust are held in check through absolute discipline, allowing the hunter to draw upon far greater reserves of sangramantic power before losing control.

in moments where death seems inevitable, the bloodhunter may invoke **emergency blood control**, overwhelming their own body with sangramantic force. every drop of blood obeys without hesitation, suppressing the effects of even the deadliest afflictions. the effort comes at a terrible price, rapidly increasing blood points, but it grants the bloodhunter one more opportunity to finish the hunt.

### effects

- permanently increase your **maximum blood point limit** by **20 bp**.
- reduce the severity of all **bleeding** effects affecting you by **1 rank** (minimum **rank i**).
- reduce the severity of all **poison** effects affecting you by **1 rank** (minimum **rank i**).
- reduce the severity of all **disease** effects affecting you by **1 rank** (minimum **rank i**).
- reduce the severity of all **necrosis**, **venom**, or other blood-affecting conditions by **1 rank** (minimum **rank i**).
- **emergency blood control:** after you are afflicted with **bleeding**, **poison**, **disease**, **necrosis**, **venom**, or another blood-affecting condition, you may activate emergency blood control **before the start of your next turn**.
- gain **20 blood points (bp)**.
- the chosen condition deals **no damage** until the start of your next turn.
- this **does not remove** the condition. if it has not been cured, its effects resume normally after the suppression ends.
- emergency blood control may only be activated **once for each application** of a condition.

### lore

within the bloodhunter orders, rank iv is known as **the crimson sovereignty**. bloodhunters who achieve this mastery are said to rule over their own lifeblood with absolute authority. their veins no longer serve merely as vessels—they become conduits of unwavering discipline, capable of resisting horrors that would overwhelm even legendary heroes.

many stories tell of bloodhunters continuing to fight after suffering venom capable of killing giants or diseases that emptied entire villages. their survival is not due to immunity, but because their blood refuses to surrender while its master still stands. every heartbeat becomes a declaration that sangramancy answers only the will of the bloodhunter.

the elders caution that this mastery walks a dangerous path. every time emergency blood control is invoked, the bloodhunter forces their emotions deeper beneath the surface instead of confronting them. bloodlust does not disappear—it waits patiently beneath the calm, growing stronger with every act of suppression until the hunter is once again forced to choose between control and surrender.

> *"my blood knows every poison, every wound, and every curse. it has learned to fear only one thing... my command."*  
> — grand bloodhunter serik vaelor

## rank 5
### description

the fifth rank of blood control is regarded as one of the greatest achievements in sangramancy. at this stage, the bloodhunter has attained absolute mastery over the blood flowing through their body. every heartbeat, every vein, and every drop of blood responds instantly to their will, allowing them to resist afflictions that would claim even the mightiest of heroes.

to the bloodhunter, blood is no longer merely a life-giving fluid—it has become a disciplined servant. the spread of toxins is slowed before they can take hold, catastrophic wounds clot with unnatural speed, and corruption carried through the bloodstream struggles to gain purchase. while these afflictions remain dangerous, the bloodhunter has learned to deny them the opportunity to reach their full potential.

this mastery also represents the greatest control over bloodlust that a mortal can achieve. the bloodhunter has learned to contain immense amounts of blood points before surrendering to the darkness within. they understand that bloodlust can never truly be conquered, only restrained through unwavering discipline and sacrifice.

when death appears inevitable, the bloodhunter may invoke the ultimate expression of this mastery—**emergency blood control**. every drop of blood is forced into complete obedience, suppressing even the most devastating blood-borne afflictions for a brief moment. the strain is immense, flooding the bloodhunter with blood points, but granting one final opportunity to finish the hunt before bloodlust demands its price.

### effects

- permanently increase your **maximum blood point limit** by **25 bp**.
- reduce the severity of all **bleeding** effects affecting you by **1 rank** (minimum **rank i**).
- reduce the severity of all **poison** effects affecting you by **1 rank** (minimum **rank i**).
- reduce the severity of all **disease** effects affecting you by **1 rank** (minimum **rank i**).
- reduce the severity of all **necrosis**, **venom**, and all other **blood-affecting conditions** by **1 rank** (minimum **rank i**).

- gain **25 blood points (bp)**.
- the chosen condition deals **no damage and its effects are suppressed** until the start of your next turn.
- this **does not remove** the condition. if it has not been cured, its effects immediately resume after the suppression ends.

### lore

within the bloodhunter orders, rank v is known as **the crimson dominion**. only the oldest and most disciplined masters ever attain this level of control, where sangramancy ceases to be a dangerous art and instead becomes an extension of the hunter's own will. their blood obeys without hesitation, resisting corruption, preserving life, and carrying them through battles that should have ended in death.

legends speak of bloodhunters who continued fighting while suffering wounds that would kill ordinary warriors many times over. they did not survive because they were immune to pain or poison, but because every drop of blood within them refused to yield until their master's task was complete. to witness such a hunter in battle is to watch determination itself take physical form.

yet every grandmaster teaches the same final lesson. absolute control over one's blood does not mean victory over bloodlust. the darkness is never destroyed—it is merely held in chains forged through discipline, sacrifice, and relentless resolve. the bloodhunter who forgets this truth will discover that even the strongest chains can one day break.

> *"my blood no longer asks permission to fight. it waits only for my command."*  
> — grand bloodhunter serik vaelor

# Blood Reprisal

## Overview
Every Bloodhunter knows that pain is inevitable. The difference between an ordinary warrior and a Bloodhunter is what they choose to do with that pain. Through Sangramancy, the Bloodhunter learns to transform the shock of an enemy's strike into an immediate and devastating retaliation.

The instant the Bloodhunter is wounded, the blood spilled from the injury surges with crimson energy instead of falling harmlessly to the ground. That surge of Sangramancy fuels a burst of instinctive aggression, allowing the hunter to answer the attack before the enemy can recover their footing.

Blood Reprisal is not born from anger alone. It is the culmination of discipline, timing, and absolute trust in one's own blood. Rather than recoiling from injury, the Bloodhunter steps into it, accepting the wound as the price of creating an opening. To outsiders this appears reckless, but to experienced Bloodhunters every wound is simply another opportunity to end the hunt.

The Bloodhunter Orders teach that this technique must never be used carelessly. Every reprisal feeds Bloodlust, and the exhilaration of answering pain with violence is one of the quickest paths toward losing control.

## Rank 1
### Description

Every Bloodhunter knows that pain is inevitable. The difference between an ordinary warrior and a Bloodhunter is what they choose to do with that pain. Through Sangramancy, the Bloodhunter learns to transform the shock of an enemy's strike into an immediate and devastating retaliation.

The instant the Bloodhunter is wounded, the blood spilled from the injury surges with crimson energy instead of falling harmlessly to the ground. That surge of Sangramancy fuels a burst of instinctive aggression, allowing the hunter to answer the attack before the enemy can recover their footing.

Blood Reprisal is not born from anger alone. It is the culmination of discipline, timing, and absolute trust in one's own blood. Rather than recoiling from injury, the Bloodhunter steps into it, accepting the wound as the price of creating an opening. To outsiders this appears reckless, but to experienced Bloodhunters every wound is simply another opportunity to end the hunt.

The Bloodhunter Orders teach that this technique must never be used carelessly. Every reprisal feeds Bloodlust, and the exhilaration of answering pain with violence is one of the quickest paths toward losing control.

### Effects

- **Reaction:** Activate Blood Reprisal immediately after taking damage from a creature within your melee reach.
- Spend **20 MP** and gain **10 Blood Points (BP)**.
- Immediately make **one melee weapon attack** against the creature that damaged you.
- This attack gains **+2 to the Attack Roll**.
- If the attack hits, it deals an additional **+2 damage**.
- Blood Reprisal may only be used **once every 3 Combat Rounds**.
- This attack benefits from all bonuses against your **Marked Quarry**, if applicable.

### Lore

Among the Bloodhunter Orders, Blood Reprisal is often described as the moment a hunter stops fearing pain. Apprentices spend months learning not to flinch after receiving a blow, instead conditioning themselves to recognise that every committed attack leaves the enemy exposed for the briefest of moments.

Veteran Bloodhunters become infamous for this technique. Many monsters quickly realise that striking a Bloodhunter is often the most dangerous decision they can make, for every successful wound is answered by an immediate counterstroke empowered by Sangramancy itself.

The elders warn that Blood Reprisal is intoxicating. There is a dangerous satisfaction in turning suffering into violence, and many Bloodhunters who fall to Bloodlust first became addicted to the thrill of retaliation rather than the discipline required to master it.

> *"Every wound you give me is another chance for me to end this hunt."*  
> — Grand Bloodhunter Serik Vaelor

## Rank 2
### Description

As the Bloodhunter's understanding of Sangramancy deepens, Blood Reprisal becomes more than an instinctive counterattack—it becomes a calculated punishment for those foolish enough to draw the hunter's blood. Every wound suffered is immediately analysed, every opening recognised, and every heartbeat prepares the Bloodhunter to answer with lethal precision.

The Bloodhunter no longer recoils from pain. Instead, injury fuels their focus, allowing them to retaliate with greater speed and accuracy than before. The blood spilled from their wounds surges with Sangramantic energy, briefly strengthening both body and mind before exploding into a devastating counterstrike.

Experienced Bloodhunters deliberately remain close to dangerous foes, knowing that every committed attack creates a fleeting weakness. Their enemies soon realise a terrifying truth: striking the Bloodhunter often places them in greater danger than the hunter themselves.

Yet every reprisal strengthens the emotional current flowing through the Bloodhunter's blood. Satisfaction, anger, determination, and exhilaration all feed Bloodlust, reminding the hunter that even justified vengeance comes with a price.

### Effects

- **Reaction:** Activate Blood Reprisal immediately after taking damage from a creature within your melee reach.
- Spend **25 MP** and gain **15 Blood Points (BP)**.
- Immediately make **one melee weapon attack** against the creature that damaged you.
- Gain **+3 to the Attack Roll** for this attack.
- If the attack hits, it deals an additional **+4 damage**.
- If the target is your **Marked Quarry**, gain an additional **+1 Attack Roll**.
- Blood Reprisal may only be used **once every 3 Combat Rounds**.
- This attack benefits from all bonuses granted by **Blood Rite**, **Hunter's Bane**, and other Bloodhunter talents.

### Lore

Within the Bloodhunter Orders, Rank II marks the point where Blood Reprisal becomes a feared combat technique rather than a desperate reaction. Veteran hunters no longer view taking a wound as failure—they recognise it as an opportunity. Every enemy that overextends themselves has unknowingly offered the Bloodhunter the perfect opening.

Many monsters learn this lesson only once. Those that survive often become hesitant to strike first, wary that every successful blow may be answered by an even deadlier retaliation. This hesitation alone has allowed countless Bloodhunters to seize control of battles that once seemed unwinnable.

The elders teach that Blood Reprisal must never become an excuse to seek injury. A Bloodhunter survives not because they enjoy pain, but because they have mastered the discipline to transform suffering into victory. The moment pain becomes something to chase, Bloodlust has already begun tightening its grip.

> *"Every scar teaches the same lesson... strike me once, and you'll remember why you should have struck harder."*  
> — Grand Bloodhunter Serik Vaelor

## Rank 3
### Description

By the Third Rank, Blood Reprisal has become second nature to the Bloodhunter. The moment blood is spilled, Sangramancy instinctively courses through the wound, transforming pain into purpose before the Bloodhunter has time to think. Every strike suffered becomes an opportunity to retaliate with ruthless efficiency.

The Bloodhunter no longer views incoming attacks as moments to endure, but as openings to exploit. As an enemy's weapon completes its swing, their balance shifts, their guard weakens, and for a single heartbeat they become vulnerable. Sangramancy amplifies the Bloodhunter's instincts, allowing them to seize that fleeting opportunity with terrifying speed.

Those who witness a master of Blood Reprisal often describe it as though the Bloodhunter welcomes injury. This is not recklessness, but supreme confidence. They know exactly how much pain they can endure, and they understand that every wound accepted on their own terms can become the beginning of their enemy's downfall.

Yet this technique carries a dangerous temptation. The exhilaration of answering pain with violence becomes increasingly addictive, and every successful reprisal drives Blood Points higher, bringing the Bloodhunter ever closer to Bloodlust.

### Effects

- **Reaction:** Activate Blood Reprisal immediately after taking damage from a creature within your melee reach.
- Spend **35 MP** and gain **20 Blood Points (BP)**.
- Immediately make **one melee weapon attack** against the creature that damaged you.
- Gain **+4 to the Attack Roll** for this attack.
- If the attack hits, it deals an additional **+6 damage**.
- If the target is your **Marked Quarry**, gain an additional **+2 to the Attack Roll**.
- If Blood Reprisal reduces your **Marked Quarry** to **0 HP**, immediately reduce your current **Blood Points** by **10 BP**, as the hunt reaches its satisfying conclusion.
- Blood Reprisal may only be used **once every 2 Combat Rounds**.
- This attack benefits from all bonuses granted by **Blood Rite**, **Hunter's Bane**, **Mark of the Quarry**, and other Bloodhunter talents.

### Lore

Within the Bloodhunter Orders, Rank III is known as **The Crimson Retaliation**. It is the point where a Bloodhunter no longer fears the enemy's first strike, for they know it will almost certainly be answered before their opponent can recover. Many monsters have won the opening exchange of a battle, only to lose the fight moments later to the Bloodhunter's relentless counterattack.

Masters teach that Blood Reprisal is not a technique born from anger, but from discipline. Every movement has been practised countless times, every counterstrike refined until it becomes instinct. The Bloodhunter does not retaliate because they are enraged—they retaliate because they have already accepted the pain as part of the hunt.

The elders warn that Blood Reprisal represents one of Sangramancy's greatest temptations. There is a dangerous satisfaction in turning suffering into victory, and only those with absolute self-control can wield this technique without allowing Bloodlust to transform justice into vengeance.

> *"Pain is merely the signal. Retribution is the answer."*  
> — Grand Bloodhunter Serik Vaelor

## Rank 4
### Description

The Fourth Rank of Blood Reprisal is feared even among veteran monster hunters. At this level, Sangramancy no longer merely responds to pain—it anticipates it. The instant an enemy's attack lands, the Bloodhunter's blood surges with crimson power, their body instinctively moving to exploit the opening left behind by the attacker.

Every wound becomes a calculated exchange. The Bloodhunter willingly accepts the enemy's strike, trusting in years of discipline to transform that moment of vulnerability into overwhelming retaliation. To the untrained eye, it appears reckless. To a master Bloodhunter, it is absolute control over both body and blood.

As Sangramancy flows through the Bloodhunter's veins, the exhilaration of immediate vengeance grows stronger than ever. Every successful reprisal feeds the emotions carried within the blood, rapidly increasing Blood Points while reinforcing the dangerous satisfaction of answering pain with greater violence. Only those with unwavering discipline can prevent this intoxicating cycle from becoming Bloodlust.

Within the Bloodhunter Orders, Rank IV is considered the final trial before true mastery. Those who survive long enough to perfect Blood Reprisal become living reminders that the greatest mistake a monster can make is believing a wounded Bloodhunter has become weaker.

### Effects

- **Reaction:** Activate Blood Reprisal immediately after taking damage from a creature within your melee reach.
- Spend **45 MP** and gain **25 Blood Points (BP)**.
- Immediately make **one melee weapon attack** against the creature that damaged you.
- Gain **+5 to the Attack Roll** for this attack.
- If the attack hits, it deals an additional **+8 damage**.
- If the target is your **Marked Quarry**, gain an additional **+2 to the Attack Roll** and **+2 Damage**.
- If Blood Reprisal reduces your **Marked Quarry** to **0 HP**, immediately reduce your current **Blood Points** by **15 BP**.
- Blood Reprisal may only be used **once every 2 Combat Rounds**.
- This attack benefits from all bonuses granted by **Blood Rite**, **Hunter's Bane**, **Mark of the Quarry**, and other Bloodhunter talents.

### Lore

Among the Bloodhunter Orders, Rank IV is known as **The Crimson Counterstroke**. Hunters who reach this level have mastered the art of turning suffering into opportunity. Their enemies soon learn that every successful blow only increases the danger they face, as each wound fuels a retaliation of terrifying precision.

Stories tell of Bloodhunters who stood against creatures many times their size, allowing a single strike to land before delivering the decisive counterattack that ended the battle. Such victories are remembered not because the Bloodhunter endured the pain, but because they possessed the discipline to transform it into purpose.

The elders teach that Blood Reprisal is never an excuse to seek injury. A master does not invite pain—they simply refuse to waste it. The Bloodhunter who forgets this distinction will eventually stop hunting monsters and begin chasing the thrill of retaliation itself, the first true step toward Bloodlust.

> *"Every wound is an invitation. Every reprisal is my reply."*  
> — Grand Bloodhunter Serik Vaelor

## Rank 5
### Description

The Fifth Rank of Blood Reprisal is the pinnacle of retaliatory Sangramancy. At this stage, the Bloodhunter has forged an unbreakable connection between pain and purpose. Every wound suffered becomes a catalyst for immediate vengeance, allowing the Bloodhunter to answer violence with greater violence before their enemy has even recovered from the strike.

The Bloodhunter no longer reacts consciously. The moment blood is drawn, Sangramancy surges through every vein, driving muscles into motion with supernatural precision. Every counterattack is swift, deliberate, and devastating, transforming what should have been a moment of weakness into the greatest danger the enemy will face.

To seasoned monsters, the sight of a Bloodhunter refusing to stagger after suffering a grievous wound is deeply unsettling. They know what comes next. The crimson glow spreading through the Bloodhunter's veins is not a sign of desperation—it is the warning that Blood Reprisal has already begun.

Only the greatest Bloodhunters are entrusted with this technique. The exhilaration of turning agony into triumph is intoxicating, flooding the body with Blood Points at an alarming rate. Masters constantly remind their apprentices that the purpose of Blood Reprisal is to end the hunt swiftly—not to become addicted to the satisfaction of revenge.

### Effects

- **Reaction:** Activate Blood Reprisal immediately after taking damage from a creature within your melee reach.
- Spend **60 MP** and gain **30 Blood Points (BP)**.
- Immediately make **one melee weapon attack** against the creature that damaged you.
- Gain **+6 to the Attack Roll** for this attack.
- If the attack hits, it deals an additional **+10 damage**.
- If the target is your **Marked Quarry**, gain an additional **+2 to the Attack Roll** and **+4 Damage**.
- If Blood Reprisal reduces your **Marked Quarry** to **0 HP**, immediately reduce your current **Blood Points** by **20 BP**.
- Blood Reprisal may be used **once every Combat Round**, but only **once per triggering attack**.
- This attack benefits from all bonuses granted by **Blood Rite**, **Hunter's Bane**, **Mark of the Quarry**, and all other applicable Bloodhunter talents.

### Lore

Within the Bloodhunter Orders, the Fifth Rank is known as **The Crimson Reckoning**. It is spoken of with equal measures of admiration and caution, for only those who possess absolute discipline can wield such overwhelming retaliation without allowing Bloodlust to consume them. Every strike against these masters becomes a gamble few enemies survive.

Legends recount Bloodhunters standing alone against dragons, elder vampires, and eldritch horrors, each devastating blow answered by an even more terrifying reprisal. Their enemies soon learned that drawing a Bloodhunter's blood did not bring victory—it merely awakened the deadliest part of the hunt.

The elders teach one final truth before revealing this technique. A Bloodhunter is not defined by how much pain they endure, nor by how fiercely they retaliate. They are defined by their ability to choose when vengeance serves justice and when restraint serves it better. Only those who never forget this distinction can truly master Blood Reprisal.

> *"You mistake my blood for a weakness. It is simply the price you pay to earn my full attention."*  
> — Grand Bloodhunter Serik Vaelor

the elders teach that blood reprisal must never become an excuse to seek injury. a bloodhunter survives not because they enjoy pain, but because they have mastered the discipline to transform suffering into victory. the moment pain becomes something to chase, bloodlust has already begun tightening its grip.

> *"every scar teaches the same lesson... strike me once, and you'll remember why you should have struck harder."*  
> — grand bloodhunter serik vaelor

## rank 3
### description

by the third rank, blood reprisal has become second nature to the bloodhunter. the moment blood is spilled, sangramancy instinctively courses through the wound, transforming pain into purpose before the bloodhunter has time to think. every strike suffered becomes an opportunity to retaliate with ruthless efficiency.

the bloodhunter no longer views incoming attacks as moments to endure, but as openings to exploit. as an enemy's weapon completes its swing, their balance shifts, their guard weakens, and for a single heartbeat they become vulnerable. sangramancy amplifies the bloodhunter's instincts, allowing them to seize that fleeting opportunity with terrifying speed.

those who witness a master of blood reprisal often describe it as though the bloodhunter welcomes injury. this is not recklessness, but supreme confidence. they know exactly how much pain they can endure, and they understand that every wound accepted on their own terms can become the beginning of their enemy's downfall.

yet this technique carries a dangerous temptation. the exhilaration of answering pain with violence becomes increasingly addictive, and every successful reprisal drives blood points higher, bringing the bloodhunter ever closer to bloodlust.

### effects

- **reaction:** activate blood reprisal immediately after taking damage from a creature within your melee reach.
- spend **35 mp** and gain **20 blood points (bp)**.
- immediately make **one melee weapon attack** against the creature that damaged you.
- gain **+4 to the attack roll** for this attack.
- if the attack hits, it deals an additional **+6 damage**.
- if the target is your **marked quarry**, gain an additional **+2 to the attack roll**.
- if blood reprisal reduces your **marked quarry** to **0 hp**, immediately reduce your current **blood points** by **10 bp**, as the hunt reaches its satisfying conclusion.
- blood reprisal may only be used **once every 2 combat rounds**.
- this attack benefits from all bonuses granted by **blood rite**, **hunter's bane**, **mark of the quarry**, and other bloodhunter talents.

### lore

within the bloodhunter orders, rank iii is known as **the crimson retaliation**. it is the point where a bloodhunter no longer fears the enemy's first strike, for they know it will almost certainly be answered before their opponent can recover. many monsters have won the opening exchange of a battle, only to lose the fight moments later to the bloodhunter's relentless counterattack.

masters teach that blood reprisal is not a technique born from anger, but from discipline. every movement has been practised countless times, every counterstrike refined until it becomes instinct. the bloodhunter does not retaliate because they are enraged—they retaliate because they have already accepted the pain as part of the hunt.

the elders warn that blood reprisal represents one of sangramancy's greatest temptations. there is a dangerous satisfaction in turning suffering into victory, and only those with absolute self-control can wield this technique without allowing bloodlust to transform justice into vengeance.

> *"pain is merely the signal. retribution is the answer."*  
> — grand bloodhunter serik vaelor

## rank 4
### description

the fourth rank of blood reprisal is feared even among veteran monster hunters. at this level, sangramancy no longer merely responds to pain—it anticipates it. the instant an enemy's attack lands, the bloodhunter's blood surges with crimson power, their body instinctively moving to exploit the opening left behind by the attacker.

every wound becomes a calculated exchange. the bloodhunter willingly accepts the enemy's strike, trusting in years of discipline to transform that moment of vulnerability into overwhelming retaliation. to the untrained eye, it appears reckless. to a master bloodhunter, it is absolute control over both body and blood.

as sangramancy flows through the bloodhunter's veins, the exhilaration of immediate vengeance grows stronger than ever. every successful reprisal feeds the emotions carried within the blood, rapidly increasing blood points while reinforcing the dangerous satisfaction of answering pain with greater violence. only those with unwavering discipline can prevent this intoxicating cycle from becoming bloodlust.

within the bloodhunter orders, rank iv is considered the final trial before true mastery. those who survive long enough to perfect blood reprisal become living reminders that the greatest mistake a monster can make is believing a wounded bloodhunter has become weaker.

### effects

- **reaction:** activate blood reprisal immediately after taking damage from a creature within your melee reach.
- spend **45 mp** and gain **25 blood points (bp)**.
- immediately make **one melee weapon attack** against the creature that damaged you.
- gain **+5 to the attack roll** for this attack.
- if the attack hits, it deals an additional **+8 damage**.
- if the target is your **marked quarry**, gain an additional **+2 to the attack roll** and **+2 damage**.
- if blood reprisal reduces your **marked quarry** to **0 hp**, immediately reduce your current **blood points** by **15 bp**.
- blood reprisal may only be used **once every 2 combat rounds**.
- this attack benefits from all bonuses granted by **blood rite**, **hunter's bane**, **mark of the quarry**, and other bloodhunter talents.

### lore

among the bloodhunter orders, rank iv is known as **the crimson counterstroke**. hunters who reach this level have mastered the art of turning suffering into opportunity. their enemies soon learn that every successful blow only increases the danger they face, as each wound fuels a retaliation of terrifying precision.

stories tell of bloodhunters who stood against creatures many times their size, allowing a single strike to land before delivering the decisive counterattack that ended the battle. such victories are remembered not because the bloodhunter endured the pain, but because they possessed the discipline to transform it into purpose.

the elders teach that blood reprisal is never an excuse to seek injury. a master does not invite pain—they simply refuse to waste it. the bloodhunter who forgets this distinction will eventually stop hunting monsters and begin chasing the thrill of retaliation itself, the first true step toward bloodlust.

> *"every wound is an invitation. every reprisal is my reply."*  
> — grand bloodhunter serik vaelor

## rank 5
### description

the fifth rank of blood reprisal is the pinnacle of retaliatory sangramancy. at this stage, the bloodhunter has forged an unbreakable connection between pain and purpose. every wound suffered becomes a catalyst for immediate vengeance, allowing the bloodhunter to answer violence with greater violence before their enemy has even recovered from the strike.

the bloodhunter no longer reacts consciously. the moment blood is drawn, sangramancy surges through every vein, driving muscles into motion with supernatural precision. every counterattack is swift, deliberate, and devastating, transforming what should have been a moment of weakness into the greatest danger the enemy will face.

to seasoned monsters, the sight of a bloodhunter refusing to stagger after suffering a grievous wound is deeply unsettling. they know what comes next. the crimson glow spreading through the bloodhunter's veins is not a sign of desperation—it is the warning that blood reprisal has already begun.

only the greatest bloodhunters are entrusted with this technique. the exhilaration of turning agony into triumph is intoxicating, flooding the body with blood points at an alarming rate. masters constantly remind their apprentices that the purpose of blood reprisal is to end the hunt swiftly—not to become addicted to the satisfaction of revenge.

### effects

- **reaction:** activate blood reprisal immediately after taking damage from a creature within your melee reach.
- spend **60 mp** and gain **30 blood points (bp)**.
- immediately make **one melee weapon attack** against the creature that damaged you.
- gain **+6 to the attack roll** for this attack.
- if the attack hits, it deals an additional **+10 damage**.
- if the target is your **marked quarry**, gain an additional **+2 to the attack roll** and **+4 damage**.

- blood reprisal may be used **once every combat round**, but only **once per triggering attack**.
- this attack benefits from all bonuses granted by **blood rite**, **hunter's bane**, **mark of the quarry**, and all other applicable bloodhunter talents.

### lore

within the bloodhunter orders, the fifth rank is known as **the crimson reckoning**. it is spoken of with equal measures of admiration and caution, for only those who possess absolute discipline can wield such overwhelming retaliation without allowing bloodlust to consume them. every strike against these masters becomes a gamble few enemies survive.

legends recount bloodhunters standing alone against dragons, elder vampires, and eldritch horrors, each devastating blow answered by an even more terrifying reprisal. their enemies soon learned that drawing a bloodhunter's blood did not bring victory—it merely awakened the deadliest part of the hunt.

the elders teach one final truth before revealing this technique. a bloodhunter is not defined by how much pain they endure, nor by how fiercely they retaliate. they are defined by their ability to choose when vengeance serves justice and when restraint serves it better. only those who never forget this distinction can truly master blood reprisal.

> *"you mistake my blood for a weakness. it is simply the price you pay to earn my full attention."*  
> — grand bloodhunter serik vaelor

# Blood Rite

## Overview
Blood Rite is the first Sangramancy technique taught to every Bloodhunter. By willingly shedding their own blood, a Bloodhunter awakens the latent magical energy carried within it, binding their life force directly to a chosen weapon. This ritual transforms an ordinary weapon into a conduit of blood magic, allowing every strike to carry supernatural power.

Unlike traditional enchantments fuelled by mana, Blood Rite demands sacrifice. The Bloodhunter must willingly wound themselves, offering part of their own vitality to awaken the rite. This sacrifice is never symbolic—the pain is real, and every activation reminds the Bloodhunter that true power always demands a price.

As the ritual takes hold, crimson runes spread across the weapon before sinking beneath its surface. To outsiders the weapon appears stained with fresh blood, while those capable of sensing magic witness violent currents of crimson energy flowing through the steel. Each strike tears not only flesh but also the life essence of the target, leaving wounds that continue to bleed long after the blow has landed.

Although Blood Rite is considered the most fundamental Sangramancy technique, mastering it is a lifelong pursuit. Every future Bloodhunter ability builds upon the discipline, sacrifice, and control first learned through this ritual.

## Rank 1
### Description

Blood Rite is the first Sangramancy technique taught to every Bloodhunter. By willingly shedding their own blood, a Bloodhunter awakens the latent magical energy carried within it, binding their life force directly to a chosen weapon. This ritual transforms an ordinary weapon into a conduit of blood magic, allowing every strike to carry supernatural power.

Unlike traditional enchantments fuelled by mana, Blood Rite demands sacrifice. The Bloodhunter must willingly wound themselves, offering part of their own vitality to awaken the rite. This sacrifice is never symbolic—the pain is real, and every activation reminds the Bloodhunter that true power always demands a price.

As the ritual takes hold, crimson runes spread across the weapon before sinking beneath its surface. To outsiders the weapon appears stained with fresh blood, while those capable of sensing magic witness violent currents of crimson energy flowing through the steel. Each strike tears not only flesh but also the life essence of the target, leaving wounds that continue to bleed long after the blow has landed.

Although Blood Rite is considered the most fundamental Sangramancy technique, mastering it is a lifelong pursuit. Every future Bloodhunter ability builds upon the discipline, sacrifice, and control first learned through this ritual.

### Effects

- As an **Action**, you may activate Blood Rite by sacrificing **5 HP**.
- Activating Blood Rite generates **5 Blood Points (BP)**.
- Blood Rite may be activated **twice per Long Rest**.
- Choose one weapon you are currently wielding.
- The chosen weapon becomes empowered with Sangramancy for **3 Combat Rounds**.
- While Blood Rite is active, the weapon deals an additional **1d6 Blood Damage** on each successful hit.
- The first successful attack against a creature each turn inflicts **Minor Bleeding**.
- Minor Bleeding deals **1d4 Blood Damage** at the start of the target's next **2 turns**.
- Reapplying Minor Bleeding refreshes its duration but does not increase its damage.
- Blood Damage dealt by Blood Rite is considered **Magical Damage**.
- Only one Blood Rite may be active at a time.
- Blood Rite immediately ends if the empowered weapon leaves your possession for more than one round.
- Blood Rite may be dismissed at any time without requiring an action.

### Lore

The first Blood Rite is remembered by every Bloodhunter. It is the moment they cease relying solely upon steel and instead place their trust in their own life force. The scar left by the ritual is traditionally never healed through magic, serving as a permanent reminder that Sangramancy is founded upon sacrifice.

Among veteran Bloodhunters, Blood Rite is often described as a conversation between the hunter and the blood itself. Every activation stirs the countless emotions carried within their lifeblood—anger, grief, determination, fear, and vengeance. With each use, these emotions linger as Blood Points, slowly testing the hunter's resolve.

Those who fail to respect the burden of Sangramancy eventually lose themselves to Bloodlust. Those who endure learn that the true enemy is not the monster before them, but the darkness growing within.

> *"The first lesson of Sangramancy is not how to bleed. It is how to stop the blood from commanding you."*  
> — Grand Bloodhunter Serik Vaelor

## Rank 2
### Description

Having survived the first teachings of Sangramancy, the Bloodhunter learns to deepen their Blood Rite by sacrificing more of their own vitality. The additional blood offered strengthens the bond between hunter and weapon, allowing the crimson energy to remain stable for longer while striking with greater consistency.

At this stage, the Bloodhunter begins to understand that Blood Rite is not merely an enchantment but a living extension of their own emotions. Every heartbeat fuels the rite, every wound strengthens it, and every enemy struck feeds the growing resonance within their soul. What once felt like an act of desperation slowly becomes a deliberate act of discipline.

Veteran Bloodhunters teach that Rank II is where complacency becomes the greatest danger. The rite feels more natural to invoke, tempting hunters to rely upon its power in every battle. Those who forget that every activation feeds the growing burden of Blood Points often discover too late that Sangramancy demands payment long after the battle has ended.

Although the increased sacrifice grants greater control over the rite, it also draws stronger emotional echoes from the Bloodhunter's blood. Mastery lies not in resisting these emotions, but in acknowledging them without allowing them to take control.

### Effects

- As an **Action**, you may activate Blood Rite by sacrificing **8 HP**.
- Activating Blood Rite generates **6 Blood Points (BP)**.
- Blood Rite may be activated **twice per Long Rest**.
- Choose one weapon you are currently wielding.
- The chosen weapon becomes empowered with Sangramancy for **4 Combat Rounds**.
- While Blood Rite is active, the weapon deals an additional **1d6 Blood Damage** on each successful hit.
- The first successful attack against a creature each turn inflicts **Minor Bleeding**.
- Minor Bleeding deals **1d4 Blood Damage** at the start of the target's next **3 turns**.
- Reapplying Minor Bleeding refreshes its duration but does not increase its damage.
- Blood Damage dealt by Blood Rite is considered **Magical Damage**.
- Only one Blood Rite may be active at a time.
- Blood Rite immediately ends if the empowered weapon leaves your possession for more than one round.
- Blood Rite may be dismissed at any time without requiring an action.

### Lore

Every Bloodhunter remembers the first time they willingly shed more blood than was necessary. It is a difficult lesson to accept that greater strength can only be achieved through greater sacrifice. Many abandon their training at this stage, believing the cost too high to justify the power gained.

Those who continue soon realise that Sangramancy is not testing their endurance—it is testing their resolve. Every wound inflicted upon themselves becomes another promise that innocent lives will not bear the burden instead.

Within the Bloodhunter Orders, the scars earned through repeated Blood Rites are known as the Crimson Oath. They are proof that the hunter has chosen duty over comfort and sacrifice over fear, even while the growing weight of Blood Points whispers constantly from within.

> *"Power offered freely is rarely understood. Power bought with your own blood is never forgotten."*  
> — Grand Bloodhunter Serik Vaelor

## Rank 3
### Description

Blood Rite reaches a turning point at Rank III. No longer simply a ritual of sacrifice, it becomes a true extension of the Bloodhunter's will. The blood willingly spilled no longer merely empowers a weapon—it answers the call of its master, surging through the blade with controlled ferocity. The hunter has begun to understand that Sangramancy is not about commanding blood, but existing in harmony with the emotions carried within it.

As mastery grows, so too does the burden placed upon both body and mind. The Bloodhunter can invoke Blood Rite more frequently than before, yet every activation draws increasingly powerful emotional echoes into their soul. Hatred, grief, vengeance, and fear all linger within the growing pool of Blood Points, testing the hunter's discipline with every battle.

Veterans warn that Rank III is where many Bloodhunters fall. The rite becomes dependable enough to use in nearly every encounter, creating the dangerous illusion that Sangramancy has finally been mastered. Those who grow overconfident often discover that the blood remembers every sacrifice ever made, and eventually demands to be heard.

Only those who remain disciplined can continue walking the path without surrendering themselves to Bloodlust.

### Effects

- As an **Action**, you may activate Blood Rite by sacrificing **12 HP**.
- Activating Blood Rite generates **8 Blood Points (BP)**.
- Blood Rite may be activated **3 times per Short Rest**.
- Choose one weapon you are currently wielding.
- The chosen weapon becomes empowered with Sangramancy for **5 Combat Rounds**.
- While Blood Rite is active, the weapon deals an additional **1d8 Blood Damage** on each successful hit.
- The first successful attack against a creature each turn inflicts **Moderate Bleeding**.
- Moderate Bleeding deals **1d6 Blood Damage** at the start of the target's next **3 turns**.
- Reapplying Moderate Bleeding refreshes its duration but does not stack its damage.
- Blood Damage dealt by Blood Rite is considered **Magical Damage**.
- Only one Blood Rite may be active at a time.
- Blood Rite immediately ends if the empowered weapon leaves your possession for more than one round.
- Blood Rite may be dismissed at any time without requiring an action.

### Lore

Within every Bloodhunter Order, Rank III is known as the Threshold. It marks the point where apprentices become true hunters, trusted to undertake contracts without constant supervision. The ability to invoke Blood Rite repeatedly is seen as a privilege earned through discipline rather than a reward for strength alone.

Senior Bloodhunters teach that every drop of blood used in Sangramancy leaves behind an emotional imprint. Over time these echoes begin to accumulate, speaking louder with every battle. Some hunters describe hearing whispers at the edge of their thoughts, while others experience an unsettling calm that precedes Bloodlust.

Those who survive this stage emerge with a newfound respect for Sangramancy. They realise that true mastery will never come from greater power alone, but from maintaining control when every instinct urges them to surrender to the blood.

> *"The blood grows louder with every battle. Mastery is not silencing it—it is refusing to answer its call."*  
> — Grand Bloodhunter Serik Vaelor

## Rank 4
### Description

By the time a Bloodhunter attains the Fourth Rank of Blood Rite, Sangramancy has become second nature. The ritual no longer requires hesitation or careful preparation. The Bloodhunter instinctively understands how much blood must be sacrificed, allowing them to awaken the rite with frightening speed and unwavering precision.

The blood flowing through their veins has become increasingly responsive to their will. Crimson energy surges across their weapon with greater intensity than ever before, carving glowing runes into the air as each strike lands. Wounds inflicted by the empowered weapon refuse to close naturally, leaving enemies weakened by relentless blood loss while the Bloodhunter presses their advantage.

Yet this level of mastery comes with an equally dangerous burden. The greater sacrifice required to sustain such power causes Blood Points to accumulate at an alarming rate. Veteran Bloodhunters often describe this stage as walking beside a predator that is forever watching, waiting patiently for a single lapse in discipline before seizing control.

Only the most disciplined hunters can maintain such power repeatedly without surrendering to Bloodlust. Every battle becomes a contest between the Bloodhunter's will and the countless emotions awakened through Sangramancy.

### Effects

- As an **Action**, you may activate Blood Rite by sacrificing **16 HP**.
- Activating Blood Rite generates **10 Blood Points (BP)**.
- Blood Rite may be activated **3 times per Short Rest**.
- Choose one weapon you are currently wielding.
- The chosen weapon becomes empowered with Sangramancy for **6 Combat Rounds**.
- While Blood Rite is active, the weapon deals an additional **1d8 Blood Damage** on each successful hit.
- The first successful attack against a creature each turn inflicts **Major Bleeding**.
- Major Bleeding deals **1d8 Blood Damage** at the start of the target's next **3 turns**.
- Reapplying Major Bleeding refreshes its duration but does not stack its damage.
- Blood Damage dealt by Blood Rite is considered **Magical Damage**.
- Only one Blood Rite may be active at a time.
- Blood Rite immediately ends if the empowered weapon leaves your possession for more than one round.
- Blood Rite may be dismissed at any time without requiring an action.

### Lore

Among Bloodhunter Orders, reaching the Fourth Rank is a moment of both celebration and concern. It is proof that the hunter has survived countless battles and mastered techniques that would have claimed the lives of lesser practitioners. Yet it is also the stage where the greatest number of Bloodhunters are lost—not to monsters, but to themselves.

Masters teach that Sangramancy is never truly controlled. Instead, it is respected. Every ritual strengthens the bond between hunter and blood, but every ritual also strengthens the emotions dwelling within that blood. Those who mistake confidence for mastery often discover too late that Bloodlust has been quietly growing beneath the surface all along.

The wisest Bloodhunters learn that restraint is every bit as important as power. A hunter who knows when **not** to invoke Blood Rite is often far more dangerous than one who wields it without hesitation.

> *"The strongest Bloodhunter is not the one who bleeds the most... but the one who knows exactly when another drop is too much."*  
> — Grand Bloodhunter Serik Vaelor

## Rank 5
### Description

Blood Rite has reached its ultimate form. The Bloodhunter has become one of the few living masters capable of wielding Sangramancy without hesitation, instinctively weaving blood magic into every movement of battle. The ritual that once demanded complete concentration has become as natural as drawing breath, allowing the Bloodhunter to invoke it repeatedly throughout even the longest encounters.

The sacrifice demanded is immense. A master Bloodhunter willingly opens a grievous wound to unleash overwhelming power, allowing the blood itself to flood their weapon with ancient crimson energy. Every heartbeat fuels the rite, every strike carries devastating force, and every wound inflicted leaves behind echoes of suffering that refuse to fade.

Yet no Bloodhunter ever escapes the price of Sangramancy. While others see only unmatched skill, the master knows that each activation pushes them closer to Bloodlust. Their greater understanding has not silenced the emotions carried within the blood—it has merely allowed them to shoulder a far heavier burden before those emotions threaten to consume them.

Only the greatest Bloodhunters in history have achieved this level of mastery. Their names are remembered not because they wielded Blood Rite more powerfully than anyone else, but because they stood upon the edge of Bloodlust countless times and never surrendered their humanity.

### Effects

- As an **Action**, you may activate Blood Rite by sacrificing **20 HP**.
- Activating Blood Rite generates **15 Blood Points (BP)**.
- Blood Rite may be activated **4 times per Combat**.
- Choose one weapon you are currently wielding.
- The chosen weapon becomes empowered with Sangramancy for **8 Combat Rounds**.
- While Blood Rite is active, the weapon deals an additional **1d10 Blood Damage** on each successful hit.
- The first successful attack against a creature each turn inflicts **Severe Bleeding**.
- Severe Bleeding deals **1d10 Blood Damage** at the start of the target's next **4 turns**.
- Reapplying Severe Bleeding refreshes its duration but does not stack its damage.
- Blood Damage dealt by Blood Rite is considered **Magical Damage**.
- While Blood Rite is active, your weapon counts as magical for the purpose of overcoming resistances and immunities.
- Only one Blood Rite may be active at a time.
- Blood Rite immediately ends if the empowered weapon leaves your possession for more than one round.
- Blood Rite may be dismissed at any time without requiring an action.

### Lore

Among Bloodhunters, Rank V Blood Rite is regarded as the pinnacle of Sangramancy. Very few survive long enough to achieve it, and fewer still possess the discipline required to wield such immense power responsibly. Those who do are often feared as much as the monsters they hunt, for the line separating hunter and horror has become dangerously thin.

The greatest masters teach that Sangramancy is not a battle against Bloodlust, but a lifelong negotiation with it. Every ritual, every sacrifice, and every drop of blood strengthens both the hunter and the darkness waiting within. Those who believe they have conquered Bloodlust have already begun to lose themselves.

Legends tell of Bloodhunters who stood alone against dragons, demon lords, and ancient horrors, their weapons burning crimson until the battlefield itself became stained with blood. Survivors rarely remembered what those hunters said during the battle. They remembered only the terrifying silence, the precise movements, and the overwhelming certainty that death had come—not as a raging beast, but as a calm and methodical executioner.

> *"Mastery is not reaching the edge of Bloodlust. Mastery is standing upon its edge, hearing it whisper your name... and choosing to take one more step forward without falling."*  
> — Grand Bloodhunter Serik Vaelor
