- blood rite immediately ends if the empowered weapon leaves your possession for more than one round.
- blood rite may be dismissed at any time without requiring an action.

### lore

the first blood rite is remembered by every bloodhunter. it is the moment they cease relying solely upon steel and instead place their trust in their own life force. the scar left by the ritual is traditionally never healed through magic, serving as a permanent reminder that sangramancy is founded upon sacrifice.

among veteran bloodhunters, blood rite is often described as a conversation between the hunter and the blood itself. every activation stirs the countless emotions carried within their lifeblood—anger, grief, determination, fear, and vengeance. with each use, these emotions linger as blood points, slowly testing the hunter's resolve.

those who fail to respect the burden of sangramancy eventually lose themselves to bloodlust. those who endure learn that the true enemy is not the monster before them, but the darkness growing within.

> *"the first lesson of sangramancy is not how to bleed. it is how to stop the blood from commanding you."*  
> — grand bloodhunter serik vaelor

## rank 2
### description

having survived the first teachings of sangramancy, the bloodhunter learns to deepen their blood rite by sacrificing more of their own vitality. the additional blood offered strengthens the bond between hunter and weapon, allowing the crimson energy to remain stable for longer while striking with greater consistency.

at this stage, the bloodhunter begins to understand that blood rite is not merely an enchantment but a living extension of their own emotions. every heartbeat fuels the rite, every wound strengthens it, and every enemy struck feeds the growing resonance within their soul. what once felt like an act of desperation slowly becomes a deliberate act of discipline.

veteran bloodhunters teach that rank ii is where complacency becomes the greatest danger. the rite feels more natural to invoke, tempting hunters to rely upon its power in every battle. those who forget that every activation feeds the growing burden of blood points often discover too late that sangramancy demands payment long after the battle has ended.

although the increased sacrifice grants greater control over the rite, it also draws stronger emotional echoes from the bloodhunter's blood. mastery lies not in resisting these emotions, but in acknowledging them without allowing them to take control.

### effects

- as an **action**, you may activate blood rite by sacrificing **8 hp**.
- activating blood rite generates **6 blood points (bp)**.
- blood rite may be activated **twice per long rest**.
- choose one weapon you are currently wielding.
- the chosen weapon becomes empowered with sangramancy for **4 combat rounds**.
- while blood rite is active, the weapon deals an additional **1d6 blood damage** on each successful hit.
- the first successful attack against a creature each turn inflicts **minor bleeding**.
- minor bleeding deals **1d4 blood damage** at the start of the target's next **3 turns**.
- reapplying minor bleeding refreshes its duration but does not increase its damage.
- blood damage dealt by blood rite is considered **magical damage**.
- only one blood rite may be active at a time.
- blood rite immediately ends if the empowered weapon leaves your possession for more than one round.
- blood rite may be dismissed at any time without requiring an action.

### lore

every bloodhunter remembers the first time they willingly shed more blood than was necessary. it is a difficult lesson to accept that greater strength can only be achieved through greater sacrifice. many abandon their training at this stage, believing the cost too high to justify the power gained.

those who continue soon realise that sangramancy is not testing their endurance—it is testing their resolve. every wound inflicted upon themselves becomes another promise that innocent lives will not bear the burden instead.

within the bloodhunter orders, the scars earned through repeated blood rites are known as the crimson oath. they are proof that the hunter has chosen duty over comfort and sacrifice over fear, even while the growing weight of blood points whispers constantly from within.

> *"power offered freely is rarely understood. power bought with your own blood is never forgotten."*  
> — grand bloodhunter serik vaelor

## rank 3
### description

blood rite reaches a turning point at rank iii. no longer simply a ritual of sacrifice, it becomes a true extension of the bloodhunter's will. the blood willingly spilled no longer merely empowers a weapon—it answers the call of its master, surging through the blade with controlled ferocity. the hunter has begun to understand that sangramancy is not about commanding blood, but existing in harmony with the emotions carried within it.

as mastery grows, so too does the burden placed upon both body and mind. the bloodhunter can invoke blood rite more frequently than before, yet every activation draws increasingly powerful emotional echoes into their soul. hatred, grief, vengeance, and fear all linger within the growing pool of blood points, testing the hunter's discipline with every battle.

veterans warn that rank iii is where many bloodhunters fall. the rite becomes dependable enough to use in nearly every encounter, creating the dangerous illusion that sangramancy has finally been mastered. those who grow overconfident often discover that the blood remembers every sacrifice ever made, and eventually demands to be heard.

only those who remain disciplined can continue walking the path without surrendering themselves to bloodlust.

### effects

- as an **action**, you may activate blood rite by sacrificing **12 hp**.
- activating blood rite generates **8 blood points (bp)**.
- blood rite may be activated **3 times per short rest**.
- choose one weapon you are currently wielding.
- the chosen weapon becomes empowered with sangramancy for **5 combat rounds**.
- while blood rite is active, the weapon deals an additional **1d8 blood damage** on each successful hit.
- the first successful attack against a creature each turn inflicts **moderate bleeding**.
- moderate bleeding deals **1d6 blood damage** at the start of the target's next **3 turns**.
- reapplying moderate bleeding refreshes its duration but does not stack its damage.
- blood damage dealt by blood rite is considered **magical damage**.
- only one blood rite may be active at a time.
- blood rite immediately ends if the empowered weapon leaves your possession for more than one round.
- blood rite may be dismissed at any time without requiring an action.

### lore

within every bloodhunter order, rank iii is known as the threshold. it marks the point where apprentices become true hunters, trusted to undertake contracts without constant supervision. the ability to invoke blood rite repeatedly is seen as a privilege earned through discipline rather than a reward for strength alone.

senior bloodhunters teach that every drop of blood used in sangramancy leaves behind an emotional imprint. over time these echoes begin to accumulate, speaking louder with every battle. some hunters describe hearing whispers at the edge of their thoughts, while others experience an unsettling calm that precedes bloodlust.

those who survive this stage emerge with a newfound respect for sangramancy. they realise that true mastery will never come from greater power alone, but from maintaining control when every instinct urges them to surrender to the blood.

> *"the blood grows louder with every battle. mastery is not silencing it—it is refusing to answer its call."*  
> — grand bloodhunter serik vaelor

## rank 4
### description

by the time a bloodhunter attains the fourth rank of blood rite, sangramancy has become second nature. the ritual no longer requires hesitation or careful preparation. the bloodhunter instinctively understands how much blood must be sacrificed, allowing them to awaken the rite with frightening speed and unwavering precision.

the blood flowing through their veins has become increasingly responsive to their will. crimson energy surges across their weapon with greater intensity than ever before, carving glowing runes into the air as each strike lands. wounds inflicted by the empowered weapon refuse to close naturally, leaving enemies weakened by relentless blood loss while the bloodhunter presses their advantage.

yet this level of mastery comes with an equally dangerous burden. the greater sacrifice required to sustain such power causes blood points to accumulate at an alarming rate. veteran bloodhunters often describe this stage as walking beside a predator that is forever watching, waiting patiently for a single lapse in discipline before seizing control.

only the most disciplined hunters can maintain such power repeatedly without surrendering to bloodlust. every battle becomes a contest between the bloodhunter's will and the countless emotions awakened through sangramancy.

### effects

- as an **action**, you may activate blood rite by sacrificing **16 hp**.
- activating blood rite generates **10 blood points (bp)**.
- blood rite may be activated **3 times per short rest**.
- choose one weapon you are currently wielding.
- the chosen weapon becomes empowered with sangramancy for **6 combat rounds**.
- while blood rite is active, the weapon deals an additional **1d8 blood damage** on each successful hit.
- the first successful attack against a creature each turn inflicts **major bleeding**.
- major bleeding deals **1d8 blood damage** at the start of the target's next **3 turns**.
- reapplying major bleeding refreshes its duration but does not stack its damage.
- blood damage dealt by blood rite is considered **magical damage**.
- only one blood rite may be active at a time.
- blood rite immediately ends if the empowered weapon leaves your possession for more than one round.
- blood rite may be dismissed at any time without requiring an action.

### lore

among bloodhunter orders, reaching the fourth rank is a moment of both celebration and concern. it is proof that the hunter has survived countless battles and mastered techniques that would have claimed the lives of lesser practitioners. yet it is also the stage where the greatest number of bloodhunters are lost—not to monsters, but to themselves.

masters teach that sangramancy is never truly controlled. instead, it is respected. every ritual strengthens the bond between hunter and blood, but every ritual also strengthens the emotions dwelling within that blood. those who mistake confidence for mastery often discover too late that bloodlust has been quietly growing beneath the surface all along.

the wisest bloodhunters learn that restraint is every bit as important as power. a hunter who knows when **not** to invoke blood rite is often far more dangerous than one who wields it without hesitation.

> *"the strongest bloodhunter is not the one who bleeds the most... but the one who knows exactly when another drop is too much."*  
> — grand bloodhunter serik vaelor

## rank 5
### description

blood rite has reached its ultimate form. the bloodhunter has become one of the few living masters capable of wielding sangramancy without hesitation, instinctively weaving blood magic into every movement of battle. the ritual that once demanded complete concentration has become as natural as drawing breath, allowing the bloodhunter to invoke it repeatedly throughout even the longest encounters.

the sacrifice demanded is immense. a master bloodhunter willingly opens a grievous wound to unleash overwhelming power, allowing the blood itself to flood their weapon with ancient crimson energy. every heartbeat fuels the rite, every strike carries devastating force, and every wound inflicted leaves behind echoes of suffering that refuse to fade.

yet no bloodhunter ever escapes the price of sangramancy. while others see only unmatched skill, the master knows that each activation pushes them closer to bloodlust. their greater understanding has not silenced the emotions carried within the blood—it has merely allowed them to shoulder a far heavier burden before those emotions threaten to consume them.

only the greatest bloodhunters in history have achieved this level of mastery. their names are remembered not because they wielded blood rite more powerfully than anyone else, but because they stood upon the edge of bloodlust countless times and never surrendered their humanity.

### effects

- as an **action**, you may activate blood rite by sacrificing **20 hp**.
- activating blood rite generates **15 blood points (bp)**.
- blood rite may be activated **4 times per combat**.
- choose one weapon you are currently wielding.
- the chosen weapon becomes empowered with sangramancy for **8 combat rounds**.
- while blood rite is active, the weapon deals an additional **1d10 blood damage** on each successful hit.
- the first successful attack against a creature each turn inflicts **severe bleeding**.
- severe bleeding deals **1d10 blood damage** at the start of the target's next **4 turns**.
- reapplying severe bleeding refreshes its duration but does not stack its damage.
- blood damage dealt by blood rite is considered **magical damage**.
- while blood rite is active, your weapon counts as magical for the purpose of overcoming resistances and immunities.
- only one blood rite may be active at a time.
- blood rite immediately ends if the empowered weapon leaves your possession for more than one round.
- blood rite may be dismissed at any time without requiring an action.

### lore

among bloodhunters, rank v blood rite is regarded as the pinnacle of sangramancy. very few survive long enough to achieve it, and fewer still possess the discipline required to wield such immense power responsibly. those who do are often feared as much as the monsters they hunt, for the line separating hunter and horror has become dangerously thin.

the greatest masters teach that sangramancy is not a battle against bloodlust, but a lifelong negotiation with it. every ritual, every sacrifice, and every drop of blood strengthens both the hunter and the darkness waiting within. those who believe they have conquered bloodlust have already begun to lose themselves.

legends tell of bloodhunters who stood alone against dragons, demon lords, and ancient horrors, their weapons burning crimson until the battlefield itself became stained with blood. survivors rarely remembered what those hunters said during the battle. they remembered only the terrifying silence, the precise movements, and the overwhelming certainty that death had come—not as a raging beast, but as a calm and methodical executioner.

> *"mastery is not reaching the edge of bloodlust. mastery is standing upon its edge, hearing it whisper your name... and choosing to take one more step forward without falling."*  
> — grand bloodhunter serik vaelor

# Blood Rush

## Overview
Not every hunt is won through patience. Sometimes the Bloodhunter must close the distance before their prey can flee, cast a spell, or recover from its wounds. Blood Rush is the first technique that teaches a Bloodhunter to turn the power of Sangramancy inward, accelerating their own body instead of manipulating the blood of another.

By flooding their veins with mana and forcing their heart to beat beyond its natural rhythm, the Bloodhunter enters a brief state of heightened speed and awareness. Muscles respond instantly, breathing becomes effortless, and every instinct screams for the hunt to continue. To onlookers, the Bloodhunter appears to burst forward with unnatural acceleration, driven by a determination that borders on obsession.

Unlike Blood Rite, Blood Rush requires no blood sacrifice. Instead, the strain is placed upon the body itself. Mana fuels the Sangramancy, stamina keeps the body moving, and the emotional intensity generated by the technique feeds the Bloodhunter's growing Blood Points. Every activation is another reminder that even the pursuit of prey carries the risk of Bloodlust.

The Orders teach that Blood Rush is never to be used for retreat. Once the hunt begins, the Bloodhunter commits to seeing it through.

## Rank 1
### Description

Not every hunt is won through patience. Sometimes the Bloodhunter must close the distance before their prey can flee, cast a spell, or recover from its wounds. Blood Rush is the first technique that teaches a Bloodhunter to turn the power of Sangramancy inward, accelerating their own body instead of manipulating the blood of another.

By flooding their veins with mana and forcing their heart to beat beyond its natural rhythm, the Bloodhunter enters a brief state of heightened speed and awareness. Muscles respond instantly, breathing becomes effortless, and every instinct screams for the hunt to continue. To onlookers, the Bloodhunter appears to burst forward with unnatural acceleration, driven by a determination that borders on obsession.

Unlike Blood Rite, Blood Rush requires no blood sacrifice. Instead, the strain is placed upon the body itself. Mana fuels the Sangramancy, stamina keeps the body moving, and the emotional intensity generated by the technique feeds the Bloodhunter's growing Blood Points. Every activation is another reminder that even the pursuit of prey carries the risk of Bloodlust.

The Orders teach that Blood Rush is never to be used for retreat. Once the hunt begins, the Bloodhunter commits to seeing it through.

### Effects

- As a **Bonus Action**, activate Blood Rush.
- Spend **15 MP**, **15 SP**, and gain **5 Blood Points (BP)**.
- Blood Rush lasts for **2 Combat Rounds**.
- While Blood Rush is active:
  - Your movement speed increases by **3 metres**.
  - If you move at least **3 metres** towards your **Marked Prey**, gain **+1 to your first melee Attack Roll** against that target each turn.
- While Blood Rush is active, if you willingly end your movement **farther away from your Marked Prey** than where you started your movement, Blood Rush immediately ends.
- Blood Rush may only have one active instance at a time.

### Lore

Blood Rush is one of the first mobility techniques taught to Bloodhunters after they master Blood Rite. While many warriors rely upon disciplined footwork or physical training, Bloodhunters instead trust the power flowing through their own veins. Every heartbeat becomes another step in the hunt, every breath another promise that the prey will not escape.

Veteran hunters often describe Blood Rush as surrendering to instinct without surrendering to Bloodlust. For a few precious moments, the Bloodhunter allows the predatory nature awakened through Sangramancy to guide every movement, trusting years of training to keep the darkness in check.

Among the Orders, apprentices who misuse Blood Rush to flee from battle are required to retrain the technique from the beginning. The lesson is simple: Blood Rush was never created to escape danger. It exists so that no worthy prey can ever outrun the hunter sworn to pursue it.

> *"The hunt ends when my heart does—not when yours finds somewhere to hide."*  
> — Grand Bloodhunter Serik Vaelor

## Rank 2
### Description

With greater experience, the Bloodhunter learns to sustain Blood Rush for longer without allowing the violent surge of Sangramancy to overwhelm their body. Their heart beats with unnatural speed, muscles are flooded with oxygen, and every movement becomes sharper and more deliberate. What once felt like a desperate burst of speed now becomes a controlled state of relentless pursuit.

The Bloodhunter no longer chases their prey—they pressure it. Every step forces the quarry into making mistakes, every burst of speed closes another avenue of escape, and every heartbeat reminds the Bloodhunter that the hunt is drawing to its inevitable conclusion.

Although Blood Rush no longer tears at the Bloodhunter's body, it still feeds the emotional storm within. The exhilaration of the chase, the anticipation of the kill, and the instinct to pursue all generate Blood Points, bringing the hunter ever closer to Bloodlust.

Veteran Bloodhunters teach that Blood Rush is not about moving faster than your prey. It is about making them realise that no matter how quickly they run, you are always gaining ground.

### Effects

- As a **Bonus Action**, activate Blood Rush.
- Spend **20 MP**, **20 SP**, and gain **10 Blood Points (BP)**.
- Blood Rush lasts for **2 Combat Rounds**.
- While Blood Rush is active:
  - Your movement speed increases by **4 metres**.
  - If you move at least **3 metres** towards your **Marked Prey**, gain **+1 to your first Attack Roll** and **+1 Damage** against that target each turn.
- While Blood Rush is active, if you willingly end your movement **farther away from your Marked Prey** than where you started your movement, Blood Rush immediately ends.
- Blood Rush may only have one active instance at a time.

### Lore

Among experienced Bloodhunters, Blood Rush is no longer viewed as a simple movement technique. It becomes a declaration that the hunt has entered its final stage. Once activated, the Bloodhunter abandons hesitation entirely, trusting instinct, training, and Sangramancy to guide every step toward their quarry.

Many monsters have mistaken Blood Rush for reckless aggression. Those that survive quickly realise the truth—it is a calculated pursuit. Every movement is measured, every path anticipated, and every escape route methodically closed until surrender or death becomes the prey's only remaining choice.

The elders remind every Bloodhunter that speed alone never wins a hunt. Discipline does. Blood Rush simply ensures that discipline arrives before the prey has the chance to disappear.

> *"You think I am chasing you. I stopped chasing long ago. Now I am simply deciding where this hunt ends."*  
> — Grand Bloodhunter Serik Vaelor

## Rank 3
### Description

By the Third Rank, Blood Rush has become second nature to the Bloodhunter. Their body has adapted to the immense strain placed upon it by Sangramancy, allowing them to enter a state of heightened speed without sacrificing precision. Every heartbeat echoes through their veins like a battle drum, sharpening their instincts and preparing them for the hunt before blades are ever drawn.

Veteran Bloodhunters often activate Blood Rush the instant they sense their prey. Their heightened awareness allows them to react before others have even recognised the threat, turning hesitation into overwhelming momentum. Few creatures are prepared for a hunter that seems to move the very moment combat begins.

This heightened state does not simply increase speed—it awakens the Bloodhunter's predatory instincts. Every movement is focused on closing the distance, every attack is delivered with greater confidence, and every heartbeat drives them relentlessly toward their quarry.

Yet every accelerated heartbeat feeds the Bloodhunter's Blood Points. The exhilaration of the chase is intoxicating, and many Bloodhunters have learned too late that becoming addicted to the hunt is the first step towards Bloodlust.

### Effects

- As a **Bonus Action**, activate Blood Rush.
- Spend **25 MP**, **25 SP**, and gain **15 Blood Points (BP)**.
- Blood Rush lasts for **2 Combat Rounds**.
- While Blood Rush is active:
  - Your movement speed increases by **5 metres**.
  - Gain **+2 Initiative**.
  - If you move at least **3 metres** towards your **Marked Prey**, gain **+2 to your first Attack Roll** and **+1 Damage** against that target each turn.
- While Blood Rush is active, if you willingly end your movement **farther away from your Marked Prey** than where you started your movement, Blood Rush immediately ends.
- Blood Rush may only have one active instance at a time.

### Lore

Within the Bloodhunter Orders, Rank III marks the moment a hunter truly earns the title of predator. No longer reacting to danger, they become the one dictating the pace of every encounter. Their heartbeat quickens, their senses sharpen, and their prey suddenly finds itself fighting a hunter who was ready before the battle even began.

Masters often compare Blood Rush to a wolf beginning its chase. The first few steps determine the outcome of the hunt, and hesitation is the difference between success and starvation. A Bloodhunter who has mastered this technique understands that momentum is a weapon every bit as deadly as steel.

The elders caution that Blood Rush is addictive. The thrill of moving faster than any ordinary warrior and reaching prey before it can escape is exhilarating. Those who become obsessed with that feeling often find themselves activating Blood Rush long before it is necessary, unknowingly feeding the Bloodlust that waits patiently within.

> *"The battle begins when others draw their weapons. My hunt begins with the first heartbeat."*  
> — Grand Bloodhunter Serik Vaelor

## Rank 4
### Description

At the Fourth Rank, Blood Rush becomes a terrifying display of controlled Sangramancy. The Bloodhunter has learned to regulate the violent surge of blood racing through their body, allowing them to move with incredible speed while maintaining absolute focus on the hunt. Every heartbeat is deliberately accelerated, flooding muscles with strength and sharpening instincts beyond mortal limits.

To witnesses, the Bloodhunter appears almost impossible to pin down. They weave between enemies, close impossible distances, and remain relentlessly fixed upon their prey. Those attempting to intercept them often strike nothing but empty air as the Bloodhunter slips past in pursuit of their target.

Despite this mastery, the technique remains dangerous. The Bloodhunter willingly drives their body beyond its natural limits, embracing the exhilaration of the chase while Blood Points rapidly accumulate. Veterans understand that the greatest threat is no longer physical exhaustion, but the growing temptation to remain in this heightened state forever.

Within the Bloodhunter Orders, Rank IV is known as **The Crimson Pursuit**, for it is said that once a Bloodhunter enters this state, even the fastest prey begins to realise there is nowhere left to run.

### Effects

- As a **Bonus Action**, activate Blood Rush.
- Spend **35 MP**, **30 SP**, and gain **20 Blood Points (BP)**.
- Blood Rush lasts for **2 Combat Rounds**.
- While Blood Rush is active:
  - Your movement speed increases by **6 metres**.
  - Gain **+3 Initiative**.
  - Opportunity Attacks made against you suffer **-2 to their Attack Rolls**.
  - If you move at least **3 metres** towards your **Marked Prey**, gain **+2 to your first Attack Roll** and **+2 Damage** against that target each turn.
- If you willingly end your movement **farther away from your Marked Prey** than where you started your movement, Blood Rush immediately ends.
- Blood Rush may only have one active instance at a time.

### Lore

The Fourth Rank is where Blood Rush ceases to be a burst of speed and becomes an extension of the Bloodhunter's identity. Their pursuit is no longer driven by anger or desperation, but by unwavering purpose. Every movement is efficient, every stride calculated, and every heartbeat serves a single goal—to end the hunt.

Many monsters speak of encountering Bloodhunters capable of appearing wherever escape seemed possible. They are not teleporting, nor are they bending time. They simply understand momentum so completely that every movement flows seamlessly into the next, leaving no opportunity for their prey to recover.

Masters caution that this level of Sangramancy can become intoxicating. The thrill of overwhelming speed, perfect control, and absolute pursuit is seductive. Those who begin chasing the feeling instead of the prey often discover that Bloodlust has quietly begun chasing them in return.

> *"You can outrun my footsteps... but you'll never outrun my heartbeat."*  
> — Grand Bloodhunter Serik Vaelor

## Rank 5
### Description

The Fifth Rank of Blood Rush represents the pinnacle of physical Sangramancy. Every beat of the Bloodhunter's heart becomes a catalyst for overwhelming speed, allowing them to pursue their prey with relentless precision. Their blood surges through every vein with incredible force, pushing their body to the very limits of mortal endurance while their mind remains unnervingly calm.

To those watching the hunt unfold, the Bloodhunter appears almost impossible to escape. They cover impossible distances in moments, effortlessly weaving through the chaos of battle while their eyes never leave their chosen prey. Every movement is purposeful, every stride calculated, and every heartbeat carries the certainty that the hunt will end exactly where the Bloodhunter chooses.

Yet this mastery demands immense discipline. The rush of power is intoxicating, and the Bloodhunter willingly embraces a torrent of Blood Points every time they unleash their full potential. Veterans understand that Blood Rush is no longer simply a technique—it is a constant test of self-control. One careless activation while already nearing Bloodlust can transform the hunter into the very monster they have spent their life pursuing.

Among the Bloodhunter Orders, this mastery is known as **The Crimson Pursuit**, for once a Bloodhunter reaches this stage, very few creatures ever escape alive.

### Effects

- As a **Bonus Action**, activate Blood Rush.
- Spend **45 MP**, **35 SP**, and gain **25 Blood Points (BP)**.
- Blood Rush lasts for **2 Combat Rounds**.
- While Blood Rush is active:
  - Your movement speed increases by **8 metres**.
  - Gain **+4 Initiative**.
  - Opportunity Attacks made against you suffer **-4 to their Attack Rolls**.
  - If you move at least **3 metres** towards your **Marked Prey**, gain **+3 to your first Attack Roll** and **+3 Damage** against that target each turn.
- If you willingly end your movement farther away from your **Marked Prey** than where you started your movement, Blood Rush immediately ends.
- Blood Rush may only have one active instance at a time.

### Lore

Only the greatest Bloodhunters ever master the Fifth Rank of Blood Rush. Their heartbeat has become as much a weapon as the blade they carry, allowing them to relentlessly pursue prey across battlefields, forests, and ruined cities without ever surrendering momentum. Many monsters have mistaken the sudden silence before their death as safety, only to find the Bloodhunter already standing behind them.

Masters teach that Blood Rush is not about becoming the fastest warrior alive. It is about becoming the one creature your prey can never escape. Every lesson, every sacrifice, and every hunt leads to this singular truth: the Bloodhunter decides when the chase ends.

The elders leave every apprentice with the same warning. Speed is intoxicating, and the thrill of the hunt is one of the strongest emotions Sangramancy can amplify. The Bloodhunter who begins chasing that feeling instead of their prey has already taken the first step towards Bloodlust. True masters never forget that they command the hunt—the hunt must never command them.

> *"Run until your heart bursts if you wish. Mine has already decided where yours will stop beating."*  
> — Grand Bloodhunter Serik Vaelor

not every hunt is won through patience. sometimes the bloodhunter must close the distance before their prey can flee, cast a spell, or recover from its wounds. blood rush is the first technique that teaches a bloodhunter to turn the power of sangramancy inward, accelerating their own body instead of manipulating the blood of another.

by flooding their veins with mana and forcing their heart to beat beyond its natural rhythm, the bloodhunter enters a brief state of heightened speed and awareness. muscles respond instantly, breathing becomes effortless, and every instinct screams for the hunt to continue. to onlookers, the bloodhunter appears to burst forward with unnatural acceleration, driven by a determination that borders on obsession.

unlike blood rite, blood rush requires no blood sacrifice. instead, the strain is placed upon the body itself. mana fuels the sangramancy, stamina keeps the body moving, and the emotional intensity generated by the technique feeds the bloodhunter's growing blood points. every activation is another reminder that even the pursuit of prey carries the risk of bloodlust.

the orders teach that blood rush is never to be used for retreat. once the hunt begins, the bloodhunter commits to seeing it through.

### effects

- as a **bonus action**, activate blood rush.
- spend **15 mp**, **15 sp**, and gain **5 blood points (bp)**.
- blood rush lasts for **2 combat rounds**.
- while blood rush is active:
  - your movement speed increases by **3 metres**.
  - if you move at least **3 metres** towards your **marked prey**, gain **+1 to your first melee attack roll** against that target each turn.
- while blood rush is active, if you willingly end your movement **farther away from your marked prey** than where you started your movement, blood rush immediately ends.
- blood rush may only have one active instance at a time.

### lore

blood rush is one of the first mobility techniques taught to bloodhunters after they master blood rite. while many warriors rely upon disciplined footwork or physical training, bloodhunters instead trust the power flowing through their own veins. every heartbeat becomes another step in the hunt, every breath another promise that the prey will not escape.

veteran hunters often describe blood rush as surrendering to instinct without surrendering to bloodlust. for a few precious moments, the bloodhunter allows the predatory nature awakened through sangramancy to guide every movement, trusting years of training to keep the darkness in check.

among the orders, apprentices who misuse blood rush to flee from battle are required to retrain the technique from the beginning. the lesson is simple: blood rush was never created to escape danger. it exists so that no worthy prey can ever outrun the hunter sworn to pursue it.

> *"the hunt ends when my heart does—not when yours finds somewhere to hide."*  
> — grand bloodhunter serik vaelor

## rank 2
### description

with greater experience, the bloodhunter learns to sustain blood rush for longer without allowing the violent surge of sangramancy to overwhelm their body. their heart beats with unnatural speed, muscles are flooded with oxygen, and every movement becomes sharper and more deliberate. what once felt like a desperate burst of speed now becomes a controlled state of relentless pursuit.

the bloodhunter no longer chases their prey—they pressure it. every step forces the quarry into making mistakes, every burst of speed closes another avenue of escape, and every heartbeat reminds the bloodhunter that the hunt is drawing to its inevitable conclusion.

although blood rush no longer tears at the bloodhunter's body, it still feeds the emotional storm within. the exhilaration of the chase, the anticipation of the kill, and the instinct to pursue all generate blood points, bringing the hunter ever closer to bloodlust.

veteran bloodhunters teach that blood rush is not about moving faster than your prey. it is about making them realise that no matter how quickly they run, you are always gaining ground.

### effects

- as a **bonus action**, activate blood rush.
- spend **20 mp**, **20 sp**, and gain **10 blood points (bp)**.
- blood rush lasts for **2 combat rounds**.
- while blood rush is active:
  - your movement speed increases by **4 metres**.
  - if you move at least **3 metres** towards your **marked prey**, gain **+1 to your first attack roll** and **+1 damage** against that target each turn.
- while blood rush is active, if you willingly end your movement **farther away from your marked prey** than where you started your movement, blood rush immediately ends.
- blood rush may only have one active instance at a time.

### lore

among experienced bloodhunters, blood rush is no longer viewed as a simple movement technique. it becomes a declaration that the hunt has entered its final stage. once activated, the bloodhunter abandons hesitation entirely, trusting instinct, training, and sangramancy to guide every step toward their quarry.

many monsters have mistaken blood rush for reckless aggression. those that survive quickly realise the truth—it is a calculated pursuit. every movement is measured, every path anticipated, and every escape route methodically closed until surrender or death becomes the prey's only remaining choice.

the elders remind every bloodhunter that speed alone never wins a hunt. discipline does. blood rush simply ensures that discipline arrives before the prey has the chance to disappear.

> *"you think i am chasing you. i stopped chasing long ago. now i am simply deciding where this hunt ends."*  
> — grand bloodhunter serik vaelor

## rank 3
### description

by the third rank, blood rush has become second nature to the bloodhunter. their body has adapted to the immense strain placed upon it by sangramancy, allowing them to enter a state of heightened speed without sacrificing precision. every heartbeat echoes through their veins like a battle drum, sharpening their instincts and preparing them for the hunt before blades are ever drawn.

veteran bloodhunters often activate blood rush the instant they sense their prey. their heightened awareness allows them to react before others have even recognised the threat, turning hesitation into overwhelming momentum. few creatures are prepared for a hunter that seems to move the very moment combat begins.

this heightened state does not simply increase speed—it awakens the bloodhunter's predatory instincts. every movement is focused on closing the distance, every attack is delivered with greater confidence, and every heartbeat drives them relentlessly toward their quarry.

yet every accelerated heartbeat feeds the bloodhunter's blood points. the exhilaration of the chase is intoxicating, and many bloodhunters have learned too late that becoming addicted to the hunt is the first step towards bloodlust.

### effects

- as a **bonus action**, activate blood rush.
- spend **25 mp**, **25 sp**, and gain **15 blood points (bp)**.
- blood rush lasts for **2 combat rounds**.
- while blood rush is active:
  - your movement speed increases by **5 metres**.
  - gain **+2 initiative**.
  - if you move at least **3 metres** towards your **marked prey**, gain **+2 to your first attack roll** and **+1 damage** against that target each turn.
- while blood rush is active, if you willingly end your movement **farther away from your marked prey** than where you started your movement, blood rush immediately ends.
- blood rush may only have one active instance at a time.

### lore

within the bloodhunter orders, rank iii marks the moment a hunter truly earns the title of predator. no longer reacting to danger, they become the one dictating the pace of every encounter. their heartbeat quickens, their senses sharpen, and their prey suddenly finds itself fighting a hunter who was ready before the battle even began.

masters often compare blood rush to a wolf beginning its chase. the first few steps determine the outcome of the hunt, and hesitation is the difference between success and starvation. a bloodhunter who has mastered this technique understands that momentum is a weapon every bit as deadly as steel.

the elders caution that blood rush is addictive. the thrill of moving faster than any ordinary warrior and reaching prey before it can escape is exhilarating. those who become obsessed with that feeling often find themselves activating blood rush long before it is necessary, unknowingly feeding the bloodlust that waits patiently within.

> *"the battle begins when others draw their weapons. my hunt begins with the first heartbeat."*  
> — grand bloodhunter serik vaelor

## rank 4
### description

at the fourth rank, blood rush becomes a terrifying display of controlled sangramancy. the bloodhunter has learned to regulate the violent surge of blood racing through their body, allowing them to move with incredible speed while maintaining absolute focus on the hunt. every heartbeat is deliberately accelerated, flooding muscles with strength and sharpening instincts beyond mortal limits.

to witnesses, the bloodhunter appears almost impossible to pin down. they weave between enemies, close impossible distances, and remain relentlessly fixed upon their prey. those attempting to intercept them often strike nothing but empty air as the bloodhunter slips past in pursuit of their target.

despite this mastery, the technique remains dangerous. the bloodhunter willingly drives their body beyond its natural limits, embracing the exhilaration of the chase while blood points rapidly accumulate. veterans understand that the greatest threat is no longer physical exhaustion, but the growing temptation to remain in this heightened state forever.

within the bloodhunter orders, rank iv is known as **the crimson pursuit**, for it is said that once a bloodhunter enters this state, even the fastest prey begins to realise there is nowhere left to run.

### effects

- as a **bonus action**, activate blood rush.
- spend **35 mp**, **30 sp**, and gain **20 blood points (bp)**.
- blood rush lasts for **2 combat rounds**.
- while blood rush is active:

  - gain **+3 initiative**.
  - opportunity attacks made against you suffer **-2 to their attack rolls**.
  - if you move at least **3 metres** towards your **marked prey**, gain **+2 to your first attack roll** and **+2 damage** against that target each turn.
- if you willingly end your movement **farther away from your marked prey** than where you started your movement, blood rush immediately ends.
- blood rush may only have one active instance at a time.

### lore

the fourth rank is where blood rush ceases to be a burst of speed and becomes an extension of the bloodhunter's identity. their pursuit is no longer driven by anger or desperation, but by unwavering purpose. every movement is efficient, every stride calculated, and every heartbeat serves a single goal—to end the hunt.

many monsters speak of encountering bloodhunters capable of appearing wherever escape seemed possible. they are not teleporting, nor are they bending time. they simply understand momentum so completely that every movement flows seamlessly into the next, leaving no opportunity for their prey to recover.

masters caution that this level of sangramancy can become intoxicating. the thrill of overwhelming speed, perfect control, and absolute pursuit is seductive. those who begin chasing the feeling instead of the prey often discover that bloodlust has quietly begun chasing them in return.

> *"you can outrun my footsteps... but you'll never outrun my heartbeat."*  
> — grand bloodhunter serik vaelor

## rank 5
### description

the fifth rank of blood rush represents the pinnacle of physical sangramancy. every beat of the bloodhunter's heart becomes a catalyst for overwhelming speed, allowing them to pursue their prey with relentless precision. their blood surges through every vein with incredible force, pushing their body to the very limits of mortal endurance while their mind remains unnervingly calm.

to those watching the hunt unfold, the bloodhunter appears almost impossible to escape. they cover impossible distances in moments, effortlessly weaving through the chaos of battle while their eyes never leave their chosen prey. every movement is purposeful, every stride calculated, and every heartbeat carries the certainty that the hunt will end exactly where the bloodhunter chooses.

yet this mastery demands immense discipline. the rush of power is intoxicating, and the bloodhunter willingly embraces a torrent of blood points every time they unleash their full potential. veterans understand that blood rush is no longer simply a technique—it is a constant test of self-control. one careless activation while already nearing bloodlust can transform the hunter into the very monster they have spent their life pursuing.

among the bloodhunter orders, this mastery is known as **the crimson pursuit**, for once a bloodhunter reaches this stage, very few creatures ever escape alive.

### effects

- spend **45 mp**, **35 sp**, and gain **25 blood points (bp)**.

- blood rush may only have one active instance at a time.

### lore

only the greatest bloodhunters ever master the fifth rank of blood rush. their heartbeat has become as much a weapon as the blade they carry, allowing them to relentlessly pursue prey across battlefields, forests, and ruined cities without ever surrendering momentum. many monsters have mistaken the sudden silence before their death as safety, only to find the bloodhunter already standing behind them.

masters teach that blood rush is not about becoming the fastest warrior alive. it is about becoming the one creature your prey can never escape. every lesson, every sacrifice, and every hunt leads to this singular truth: the bloodhunter decides when the chase ends.

the elders leave every apprentice with the same warning. speed is intoxicating, and the thrill of the hunt is one of the strongest emotions sangramancy can amplify. the bloodhunter who begins chasing that feeling instead of their prey has already taken the first step towards bloodlust. true masters never forget that they command the hunt—the hunt must never command them.

> *"run until your heart bursts if you wish. mine has already decided where yours will stop beating."*  
> — grand bloodhunter serik vaelor

# Blood Scent

## Overview
Blood Scent is the first true hunting technique taught to every Bloodhunter. Through the practice of Sangramancy, their senses evolve beyond those of ordinary mortals, allowing them to perceive the lingering scent carried within freshly spilled blood. To a Bloodhunter, every drop of blood tells a story, revealing the direction a creature has fled and hinting at the emotions it carried when it was shed.

Unlike common trackers who rely upon footprints or broken branches, a Bloodhunter follows the scent of blood itself. Rain may wash away tracks, wind may erase scent, and darkness may hide a quarry, but fresh blood leaves behind a trail that Sangramancy can awaken. Once the Bloodhunter discovers that trail, the hunt truly begins.

Should the Bloodhunter wish to know more than the scent alone can reveal, they may perform a sacred Sangramancy ritual known as **Blood Communion**. By absorbing a fragment of a creature's blood into themselves, the Bloodhunter experiences echoes of the creature's life force, committing its unique Blood Signature to memory. This knowledge comes at a price, for every Blood Communion strengthens the emotions carried within the blood and brings the hunter one step closer to Bloodlust.

Every great hunt begins with a single drop of blood.

## Rank 1
### Description

Blood Scent is the first true hunting technique taught to every Bloodhunter. Through the practice of Sangramancy, their senses evolve beyond those of ordinary mortals, allowing them to perceive the lingering scent carried within freshly spilled blood. To a Bloodhunter, every drop of blood tells a story, revealing the direction a creature has fled and hinting at the emotions it carried when it was shed.

Unlike common trackers who rely upon footprints or broken branches, a Bloodhunter follows the scent of blood itself. Rain may wash away tracks, wind may erase scent, and darkness may hide a quarry, but fresh blood leaves behind a trail that Sangramancy can awaken. Once the Bloodhunter discovers that trail, the hunt truly begins.

Should the Bloodhunter wish to know more than the scent alone can reveal, they may perform a sacred Sangramancy ritual known as **Blood Communion**. By absorbing a fragment of a creature's blood into themselves, the Bloodhunter experiences echoes of the creature's life force, committing its unique Blood Signature to memory. This knowledge comes at a price, for every Blood Communion strengthens the emotions carried within the blood and brings the hunter one step closer to Bloodlust.

Every great hunt begins with a single drop of blood.

### Effects

- Blood Scent is a **Passive Talent** and is always active.
- You can detect the scent of **fresh blood** within **10 metres**.
- You can follow trails created by fresh blood, even when ordinary tracks have been lost.
- You may identify the general direction a bleeding creature has travelled by following the scent of its blood.
- While actively following a blood trail, gain:
  - **+2 to Survival checks** made to track the creature.
  - **+2 to Perception checks** made to locate the creature.
- Blood Scent cannot detect creatures that have left **no blood trail**.
- You may perform **Blood Communion** on fresh blood no older than **24 hours**.
- Blood Communion requires:
  - **10 MP**
  - **1 minute of uninterrupted concentration**
- Upon completing Blood Communion:
  - You memorise that creature's unique **Blood Signature**.
  - If this is the first creature of its species you have communed with, you permanently add that species to your **Blood Codex**.
  - Gain **5 Blood Points (BP)** as you absorb the emotional resonance carried within the blood.
- You may maintain **one Active Blood Signature** at a time.
- While hunting a creature whose Blood Signature you have memorised, gain **+1 to Attack Rolls** against that creature.

### Lore

Among the Bloodhunter Orders, apprentices are forbidden from performing Blood Communion until they have first mastered Blood Scent. Elders believe that a hunter who cannot follow blood has no right to absorb it. Only after proving they can complete a hunt through patience and discipline are they permitted to experience the deeper mysteries of Sangramancy.

The ritual of Blood Communion is both revered and feared. As the blood dissolves into crimson mana, fragments of the creature's emotions briefly become the Bloodhunter's own. Terror from fleeing prey, rage from a wounded beast, or the unnatural hunger of a vampire may all be felt for a fleeting moment. Every communion leaves behind another echo within the Bloodhunter's soul.

Veteran Bloodhunters maintain a mental archive known as the **Blood Codex**, an ever-growing collection of Blood Signatures gathered throughout their lives. To them, every hunt is more than a victory—it is another lesson preserved forever. Yet every lesson carries a cost, for no Bloodhunter can absorb another creature's essence without also carrying a piece of its burden.

> *"Steel wins battles. Blood wins hunts. Learn the blood, and no prey will remain hidden from you."*  
> — Grand Bloodhunter Serik Vaelor

## Rank 2
### Description

As a Bloodhunter's understanding of Sangramancy deepens, Blood Scent evolves from a simple hunting instinct into a supernatural connection with the essence carried within blood. Every trail becomes clearer, every lingering scent more distinct, and every Blood Signature easier to distinguish from the countless others that stain the world.

At this level, the Bloodhunter no longer needs to dedicate themselves to a single quarry. Their growing Blood Codex allows them to retain multiple Blood Signatures simultaneously, making it possible to pursue several hunts without abandoning previous knowledge. Experienced Bloodhunters often compare this to recognising familiar voices in a crowded room—each Blood Signature possesses its own unmistakable identity.

Blood Communion also reveals more than simple identity. The Bloodhunter begins to understand the condition of the creature that shed the blood. A single drop can reveal signs of exhaustion, illness, corruption, or injury, allowing the hunter to prepare long before the prey is ever seen.

To outsiders, Bloodhunters appear impossibly persistent. They do not simply follow tracks—they follow the lingering echoes of life itself.

### Effects

- Blood Scent remains a **Passive Talent**.
- You can detect the scent of **fresh blood** within **20 metres**.
- Blood trails remain detectable for up to **48 hours**, provided they have not been completely destroyed by powerful magic.
- You may maintain **two Active Blood Signatures** at a time.
- While hunting a creature whose Blood Signature you have memorised, you gain:
  - **+2 to Survival checks** made to track that creature.
  - **+2 to Perception checks** made to locate that creature.
  - **+2 to Attack Rolls** against that creature.
- Blood Communion now reveals:
  - The creature's approximate size.
  - Whether it is healthy, wounded, diseased, corrupted, or poisoned.
  - Whether the blood belongs to a Humanoid, Beast, Monstrosity, Dragon, Fey, Fiend, Undead, Aberration, or another recognised creature type.
- Blood Communion requires:
  - **10 MP**
  - **1 minute of uninterrupted concentration**
- Completing Blood Communion generates **6 Blood Points (BP)**.
- If the creature's species is not already recorded, it is permanently added to your **Blood Codex**.

### Lore

Senior Bloodhunters often say that Rank II marks the beginning of true mastery. The hunter no longer relies solely upon instinct but begins building a lifetime of knowledge through their ever-growing Blood Codex. Every successful communion expands their understanding of the creatures that roam Asteria, making future hunts more efficient and far more dangerous for their prey.

Many Orders preserve the Blood Codices of legendary Bloodhunters after their deaths, allowing future generations to study centuries of accumulated knowledge. While the memories of the hunter fade with time, the lessons written in blood endure.

Yet each Blood Communion continues to exact its toll. Every absorbed Blood Signature leaves behind another fragment of emotion within the hunter's soul. The Bloodhunter learns to carry these burdens with discipline, knowing that one day the weight of too many memories may awaken the chilling calm of Bloodlust.

> *"Every hunt teaches a lesson. Every lesson is written in blood. The wise hunter never stops reading."*  
> — Grand Bloodhunter Serik Vaelor

## Rank 3
### Description

At the Third Rank, Blood Scent becomes far more than an exceptional hunting instinct—it becomes an extension of the Bloodhunter's own consciousness. Every Blood Signature committed to the Blood Codex strengthens the hunter's understanding of the creatures they pursue, allowing them to distinguish one individual from another even amongst members of the same species.

A Bloodhunter no longer follows blood alone. Tiny traces left upon weapons, armour, footprints, or vegetation are enough to awaken the lingering scent carried within a creature's life essence. Once a Blood Signature has been memorised, the Bloodhunter develops an almost supernatural intuition for that prey's movements, instinctively predicting where it will flee and recognising attempts to disguise or mislead the hunt.

Blood Communion also reveals far deeper truths. As fragments of emotion and instinct flow into the Bloodhunter, they begin to understand the creature itself. They can recognise corrupted blood, unnatural mutations, lingering curses, and even signs that another Bloodhunter has previously hunted the same prey.

Veterans often describe this stage as the point where the hunt becomes inevitable. Once a Bloodhunter has learned your Blood Signature, escaping is no longer a matter of speed—it becomes a matter of luck.

### Effects

- Blood Scent remains a **Passive Talent**.
- You can detect the scent of **fresh blood** within **30 metres**.
- Blood trails remain detectable for up to **72 hours**, unless removed by powerful magical means.
- You may maintain **three Active Blood Signatures** at a time.
- While hunting a creature whose Blood Signature you have memorised, you gain:
  - **+3 to Survival checks** made to track that creature.
  - **+3 to Perception checks** made to locate that creature.
  - **+2 to Attack Rolls** against that creature.
  - **+2 to Damage Rolls** against that creature.
- You have Advantage on checks made to follow a Blood Signature through difficult terrain or poor weather.
- Blood Communion now reveals:
  - Approximate age of the blood.
  - Signs of magical corruption, curses, disease, or mutation.
  - Whether multiple creatures have mixed blood at the scene.
- Blood Communion requires:
  - **10 MP**
  - **1 minute of uninterrupted concentration**
- Completing Blood Communion generates **8 Blood Points (BP)**.
- If the creature's species is not already recorded, it is permanently added to your **Blood Codex**.

### Lore

Only experienced Bloodhunters reach the Third Rank, for it requires absolute trust in one's Sangramancy. The Blood Codex has grown into a vast archive of living memories, each Blood Signature becoming another lesson preserved within the hunter's soul. Some masters claim they can recall the scent of a creature hunted decades earlier as clearly as if the blood had been spilled moments ago.

Blood Communion becomes increasingly dangerous at this stage. The emotions absorbed from prey linger longer than before, occasionally surfacing during moments of silence or meditation. While disciplined Bloodhunters learn to separate their own thoughts from those carried within the blood, many become haunted by echoes of every creature they have ever hunted.

Despite the danger, Rank III is widely regarded as the point where a Bloodhunter truly earns the title of Master Hunter. Few creatures can escape once their blood has been committed to the Codex, and fewer still survive long enough to be hunted a second time.

> *"A trail may fade. Footprints may vanish. But blood never forgets who it belongs to."*  
> — Grand Bloodhunter Serik Vaelor

## Rank 4
### Description

At the Fourth Rank, Blood Scent transcends mortal instinct and becomes an art perfected through decades of relentless hunts. Every Blood Signature committed to the Blood Codex deepens the Bloodhunter's understanding of life itself, allowing them to perceive not only where prey has travelled, but how it lived, fought, suffered, and survived.

The Bloodhunter no longer follows obvious blood trails alone. The faintest trace upon a weapon's hilt, a single crimson droplet caught beneath a leaf, or dried blood hidden within ancient stone is enough to awaken the memory of its owner. To the Bloodhunter, every battlefield becomes a library written in blood, each stain another page waiting to be read.

Blood Communion reaches an advanced level of mastery. By absorbing another creature's blood, the Bloodhunter can sense far more than identity. They instinctively understand the strength flowing through the creature's veins, recognise ancient bloodlines, and identify signs of magical alteration, corruption, curses, diseases, or unnatural evolution. Few secrets remain hidden from one who understands the language of blood.

Among the Bloodhunter Orders, reaching this rank is known as becoming a **Crimson Tracker**—a hunter capable of pursuing prey across kingdoms, through dense wilderness, and into the darkest ruins with unwavering certainty.

### Effects

- Blood Scent remains a **Passive Talent**.
- You can detect the scent of **fresh blood** within **50 metres**.
- Blood trails remain detectable for up to **7 days**, unless removed by powerful magical means.
- You may maintain **five Active Blood Signatures** at a time.
- While hunting a creature whose Blood Signature you have memorised, you gain:
  - **+4 to Survival checks** made to track that creature.
  - **+4 to Perception checks** made to locate that creature.
  - **+3 to Attack Rolls** against that creature.
  - **+3 to Damage Rolls** against that creature.
- You have Advantage on checks made to pursue your Marked Prey through difficult terrain, darkness, storms, or other natural obstacles.
- Blood Communion now reveals:
  - The creature's approximate power compared to your own.
  - Magical corruption, diseases, curses, mutations, and bloodline alterations.
  - Whether the blood belongs to a creature currently under magical influence or possession.
  - The approximate time since the blood was shed.
- Blood Communion requires:
  - **10 MP**
  - **1 minute of uninterrupted concentration**
- Completing Blood Communion generates **10 Blood Points (BP)**.
- If the creature's species is not already recorded, it is permanently added to your **Blood Codex**.
- Once a creature type has been permanently recorded within your Blood Codex, you automatically recognise blood belonging to that species without needing to perform Blood Communion again.

### Lore

Only the greatest Bloodhunters ever attain the Fourth Rank. By now, the Blood Codex has become a living archive of countless hunts, each Blood Signature adding another lesson to a lifetime devoted to protecting the world from horrors that ordinary warriors cannot comprehend.

Senior Bloodhunters often describe Blood Communion as less of a ritual and more of a conversation. The blood willingly reveals its history to those who have earned the right to hear it. Every triumph, every wound, every curse, and every drop of corruption leaves an echo waiting to be interpreted by an experienced Crimson Tracker.

Yet every lesson carries a burden. The Bloodhunter's own Blood Points continue to accumulate with each Communion, each hunt, and each use of Sangramancy. Veterans know that knowledge itself is dangerous, for the more blood one understands, the louder the whispers of Bloodlust become.

> *"A novice follows blood. A master listens to it. Every drop has a story—few possess the wisdom to understand what it is trying to say."*  
> — Grand Bloodhunter Serik Vaelor

## Rank 5
### Description

At the pinnacle of Sangramancy, the Bloodhunter no longer merely follows blood—they understand it. Every Blood Signature committed to their Blood Codex becomes a permanent lesson, allowing them to perceive the hidden truths carried within every drop of blood. What once began as a hunting technique has become an unparalleled mastery of life, death, and the countless emotions that bind them together.

The Bloodhunter's Blood Codex has grown into a living archive of every species they have studied. Once the blood of a creature has been absorbed through Blood Communion, its scent can never truly be forgotten. Across years, continents, and countless hunts, the Bloodhunter instinctively recognises familiar blood as though greeting an old enemy.

A master Bloodhunter no longer needs obvious trails to pursue their prey. A single dried droplet hidden upon a weapon, armour, or stone is enough to awaken the creature's Blood Signature. Through Sangramancy, they reconstruct the hunt piece by piece, predicting movements, identifying weaknesses, and uncovering truths that ordinary trackers could never hope to perceive.

Among the Bloodhunter Orders, those who reach this level are known as **Blood Sages**. They are feared not because they cannot be escaped, but because once they have learned your blood, they will never truly lose your trail.

### Effects

- Blood Scent remains a **Passive Talent**.
- You can detect the scent of **fresh blood** within **75 metres**.
- Blood trails remain detectable for up to **30 days**, unless completely destroyed by powerful magical effects.
- You may maintain an **unlimited number of Active Blood Signatures**.
- While hunting a creature whose Blood Signature you have memorised, you gain:
  - **+5 to Survival checks** made to track that creature.
  - **+5 to Perception checks** made to locate that creature.
  - **+4 to Attack Rolls** against that creature.
  - **+4 to Damage Rolls** against that creature.
- You always know the general direction of any memorised Blood Signature while it remains within your Blood Scent range.
- Blood Communion now reveals:
  - The creature's exact species and ancestry.
  - Approximate age and physical condition.
  - Magical corruption, diseases, curses, mutations, and bloodline alterations.
  - Whether the creature is currently under magical influence, possession, or transformation.
  - The approximate strength of the creature compared to your own.
- Blood Communion requires:
  - **10 MP**
  - **1 minute of uninterrupted concentration**
- Completing Blood Communion generates **15 Blood Points (BP)**.
- Every creature species successfully communed with is permanently added to your **Blood Codex**.

# blood scent

## overview
blood scent is the first true hunting technique taught to every bloodhunter. through the practice of sangramancy, their senses evolve beyond those of ordinary mortals, allowing them to perceive the lingering scent carried within freshly spilled blood. to a bloodhunter, every drop of blood tells a story, revealing the direction a creature has fled and hinting at the emotions it carried when it was shed.

unlike common trackers who rely upon footprints or broken branches, a bloodhunter follows the scent of blood itself. rain may wash away tracks, wind may erase scent, and darkness may hide a quarry, but fresh blood leaves behind a trail that sangramancy can awaken. once the bloodhunter discovers that trail, the hunt truly begins.

should the bloodhunter wish to know more than the scent alone can reveal, they may perform a sacred sangramancy ritual known as **blood communion**. by absorbing a fragment of a creature's blood into themselves, the bloodhunter experiences echoes of the creature's life force, committing its unique blood signature to memory. this knowledge comes at a price, for every blood communion strengthens the emotions carried within the blood and brings the hunter one step closer to bloodlust.

every great hunt begins with a single drop of blood.

## rank 1
### description

blood scent is the first true hunting technique taught to every bloodhunter. through the practice of sangramancy, their senses evolve beyond those of ordinary mortals, allowing them to perceive the lingering scent carried within freshly spilled blood. to a bloodhunter, every drop of blood tells a story, revealing the direction a creature has fled and hinting at the emotions it carried when it was shed.

unlike common trackers who rely upon footprints or broken branches, a bloodhunter follows the scent of blood itself. rain may wash away tracks, wind may erase scent, and darkness may hide a quarry, but fresh blood leaves behind a trail that sangramancy can awaken. once the bloodhunter discovers that trail, the hunt truly begins.

should the bloodhunter wish to know more than the scent alone can reveal, they may perform a sacred sangramancy ritual known as **blood communion**. by absorbing a fragment of a creature's blood into themselves, the bloodhunter experiences echoes of the creature's life force, committing its unique blood signature to memory. this knowledge comes at a price, for every blood communion strengthens the emotions carried within the blood and brings the hunter one step closer to bloodlust.

every great hunt begins with a single drop of blood.

### effects

- blood scent is a **passive talent** and is always active.
- you can detect the scent of **fresh blood** within **10 metres**.
- you can follow trails created by fresh blood, even when ordinary tracks have been lost.
- you may identify the general direction a bleeding creature has travelled by following the scent of its blood.
- while actively following a blood trail, gain:
  - **+2 to survival checks** made to track the creature.
  - **+2 to perception checks** made to locate the creature.
- blood scent cannot detect creatures that have left **no blood trail**.
- you may perform **blood communion** on fresh blood no older than **24 hours**.
- blood communion requires:
  - **10 mp**
  - **1 minute of uninterrupted concentration**
- upon completing blood communion:
  - you memorise that creature's unique **blood signature**.
  - if this is the first creature of its species you have communed with, you permanently add that species to your **blood codex**.
  - gain **5 blood points (bp)** as you absorb the emotional resonance carried within the blood.
- you may maintain **one active blood signature** at a time.
- while hunting a creature whose blood signature you have memorised, gain **+1 to attack rolls** against that creature.

### lore

among the bloodhunter orders, apprentices are forbidden from performing blood communion until they have first mastered blood scent. elders believe that a hunter who cannot follow blood has no right to absorb it. only after proving they can complete a hunt through patience and discipline are they permitted to experience the deeper mysteries of sangramancy.

the ritual of blood communion is both revered and feared. as the blood dissolves into crimson mana, fragments of the creature's emotions briefly become the bloodhunter's own. terror from fleeing prey, rage from a wounded beast, or the unnatural hunger of a vampire may all be felt for a fleeting moment. every communion leaves behind another echo within the bloodhunter's soul.

veteran bloodhunters maintain a mental archive known as the **blood codex**, an ever-growing collection of blood signatures gathered throughout their lives. to them, every hunt is more than a victory—it is another lesson preserved forever. yet every lesson carries a cost, for no bloodhunter can absorb another creature's essence without also carrying a piece of its burden.

> *"steel wins battles. blood wins hunts. learn the blood, and no prey will remain hidden from you."*  
> — grand bloodhunter serik vaelor

## rank 2
### description

as a bloodhunter's understanding of sangramancy deepens, blood scent evolves from a simple hunting instinct into a supernatural connection with the essence carried within blood. every trail becomes clearer, every lingering scent more distinct, and every blood signature easier to distinguish from the countless others that stain the world.

at this level, the bloodhunter no longer needs to dedicate themselves to a single quarry. their growing blood codex allows them to retain multiple blood signatures simultaneously, making it possible to pursue several hunts without abandoning previous knowledge. experienced bloodhunters often compare this to recognising familiar voices in a crowded room—each blood signature possesses its own unmistakable identity.

blood communion also reveals more than simple identity. the bloodhunter begins to understand the condition of the creature that shed the blood. a single drop can reveal signs of exhaustion, illness, corruption, or injury, allowing the hunter to prepare long before the prey is ever seen.

to outsiders, bloodhunters appear impossibly persistent. they do not simply follow tracks—they follow the lingering echoes of life itself.

### effects

- blood scent remains a **passive talent**.
- you can detect the scent of **fresh blood** within **20 metres**.
- blood trails remain detectable for up to **48 hours**, provided they have not been completely destroyed by powerful magic.
- you may maintain **two active blood signatures** at a time.
- while hunting a creature whose blood signature you have memorised, you gain:
  - **+2 to survival checks** made to track that creature.
  - **+2 to perception checks** made to locate that creature.
  - **+2 to attack rolls** against that creature.
- blood communion now reveals:
  - the creature's approximate size.
  - whether it is healthy, wounded, diseased, corrupted, or poisoned.
  - whether the blood belongs to a humanoid, beast, monstrosity, dragon, fey, fiend, undead, aberration, or another recognised creature type.
- blood communion requires:
  - **10 mp**
  - **1 minute of uninterrupted concentration**
- completing blood communion generates **6 blood points (bp)**.
- if the creature's species is not already recorded, it is permanently added to your **blood codex**.

### lore

senior bloodhunters often say that rank ii marks the beginning of true mastery. the hunter no longer relies solely upon instinct but begins building a lifetime of knowledge through their ever-growing blood codex. every successful communion expands their understanding of the creatures that roam asteria, making future hunts more efficient and far more dangerous for their prey.

many orders preserve the blood codices of legendary bloodhunters after their deaths, allowing future generations to study centuries of accumulated knowledge. while the memories of the hunter fade with time, the lessons written in blood endure.

yet each blood communion continues to exact its toll. every absorbed blood signature leaves behind another fragment of emotion within the hunter's soul. the bloodhunter learns to carry these burdens with discipline, knowing that one day the weight of too many memories may awaken the chilling calm of bloodlust.

> *"every hunt teaches a lesson. every lesson is written in blood. the wise hunter never stops reading."*  
> — grand bloodhunter serik vaelor

## rank 3
### description

at the third rank, blood scent becomes far more than an exceptional hunting instinct—it becomes an extension of the bloodhunter's own consciousness. every blood signature committed to the blood codex strengthens the hunter's understanding of the creatures they pursue, allowing them to distinguish one individual from another even amongst members of the same species.

a bloodhunter no longer follows blood alone. tiny traces left upon weapons, armour, footprints, or vegetation are enough to awaken the lingering scent carried within a creature's life essence. once a blood signature has been memorised, the bloodhunter develops an almost supernatural intuition for that prey's movements, instinctively predicting where it will flee and recognising attempts to disguise or mislead the hunt.

blood communion also reveals far deeper truths. as fragments of emotion and instinct flow into the bloodhunter, they begin to understand the creature itself. they can recognise corrupted blood, unnatural mutations, lingering curses, and even signs that another bloodhunter has previously hunted the same prey.

veterans often describe this stage as the point where the hunt becomes inevitable. once a bloodhunter has learned your blood signature, escaping is no longer a matter of speed—it becomes a matter of luck.

### effects

- blood scent remains a **passive talent**.
- you can detect the scent of **fresh blood** within **30 metres**.
- blood trails remain detectable for up to **72 hours**, unless removed by powerful magical means.
- you may maintain **three active blood signatures** at a time.
- while hunting a creature whose blood signature you have memorised, you gain:
  - **+3 to survival checks** made to track that creature.
  - **+3 to perception checks** made to locate that creature.
  - **+2 to attack rolls** against that creature.
  - **+2 to damage rolls** against that creature.

  - approximate age of the blood.
  - signs of magical corruption, curses, disease, or mutation.
  - whether multiple creatures have mixed blood at the scene.

  - **10 mp**
  - **1 minute of uninterrupted concentration**

### lore

only experienced bloodhunters reach the third rank, for it requires absolute trust in one's sangramancy. the blood codex has grown into a vast archive of living memories, each blood signature becoming another lesson preserved within the hunter's soul. some masters claim they can recall the scent of a creature hunted decades earlier as clearly as if the blood had been spilled moments ago.

blood communion becomes increasingly dangerous at this stage. the emotions absorbed from prey linger longer than before, occasionally surfacing during moments of silence or meditation. while disciplined bloodhunters learn to separate their own thoughts from those carried within the blood, many become haunted by echoes of every creature they have ever hunted.

despite the danger, rank iii is widely regarded as the point where a bloodhunter truly earns the title of master hunter. few creatures can escape once their blood has been committed to the codex, and fewer still survive long enough to be hunted a second time.

> *"a trail may fade. footprints may vanish. but blood never forgets who it belongs to."*  
> — grand bloodhunter serik vaelor

## rank 4
### description

at the fourth rank, blood scent transcends mortal instinct and becomes an art perfected through decades of relentless hunts. every blood signature committed to the blood codex deepens the bloodhunter's understanding of life itself, allowing them to perceive not only where prey has travelled, but how it lived, fought, suffered, and survived.

the bloodhunter no longer follows obvious blood trails alone. the faintest trace upon a weapon's hilt, a single crimson droplet caught beneath a leaf, or dried blood hidden within ancient stone is enough to awaken the memory of its owner. to the bloodhunter, every battlefield becomes a library written in blood, each stain another page waiting to be read.

blood communion reaches an advanced level of mastery. by absorbing another creature's blood, the bloodhunter can sense far more than identity. they instinctively understand the strength flowing through the creature's veins, recognise ancient bloodlines, and identify signs of magical alteration, corruption, curses, diseases, or unnatural evolution. few secrets remain hidden from one who understands the language of blood.

among the bloodhunter orders, reaching this rank is known as becoming a **crimson tracker**—a hunter capable of pursuing prey across kingdoms, through dense wilderness, and into the darkest ruins with unwavering certainty.

yet every lesson carries a burden. the bloodhunter's own blood points continue to accumulate with each communion, each hunt, and each use of sangramancy. veterans know that knowledge itself is dangerous, for the more blood one understands, the louder the whispers of bloodlust become.

> *"a novice follows blood. a master listens to it. every drop has a story—few possess the wisdom to understand what it is trying to say."*  
> — grand bloodhunter serik vaelor

# Blood Shield

## Overview
Blood Shield is one of the first defensive applications of Sangramancy taught within the Bloodhunter Orders. Rather than turning their blood into a weapon, the Bloodhunter willingly sacrifices a portion of their own life force, drawing fresh blood from beneath their skin and suspending it in the air through the power of mana.

The blood rapidly hardens into a thin crimson barrier that circles the Bloodhunter like a living shield. Although delicate in appearance, the enchanted blood is capable of deflecting blades, arrows, and magical attacks before instantly reforming around its master. Every strike absorbed by the shield reminds the Bloodhunter that their own blood is both their greatest weapon and their greatest defence.

Unlike conventional armour, Blood Shield demands sacrifice. The Bloodhunter willingly weakens themselves to create a barrier capable of preserving their life during the most dangerous moments of battle. Veterans often describe the technique as placing complete trust in Sangramancy, believing that a small wound now is worth surviving a fatal blow later.

The Orders teach that Blood Shield should never become a crutch. Every activation sheds blood, fuels Blood Points, and edges the Bloodhunter closer to Bloodlust. A wise hunter knows that the strongest shield is not one that is used constantly, but one that is summoned only when death is certain to follow without it.

## Rank 1
### Description
