### Effects

- As a **Bonus Action**, activate Blood Shield.
- Spend **20 MP**, sacrifice **5 HP**, and gain **5 Blood Points (BP)**.
- Blood Shield lasts for **2 Combat Rounds**.
- While Blood Shield is active, gain **+2 Armour Class (AC)**.
- Blood Shield is considered a **magical effect**.
- Only one Blood Shield may be active at a time.
- Blood Points gained through Blood Shield count towards your **Blood Point Limit** and may contribute to triggering **Bloodlust**.

### Lore

Among experienced Bloodhunters, Blood Shield is considered a symbol of absolute faith in Sangramancy. The hunter willingly spills their own blood before the enemy has the chance, trusting that the sacrifice made now will preserve their life long enough to complete the hunt.

The crimson shield has become an unmistakable sight upon battlefields across Asteria. Monsters that recognise its appearance know they face a Bloodhunter willing to sacrifice their own life to ensure the hunt continues. Many have broken their weapons against the shimmering barrier, only to watch the blood reform as though it possessed a will of its own.

The elders remind every apprentice that blood is sacred. To shape it into a shield is not merely a display of power, but a promise that every drop sacrificed will be repaid through the successful completion of the hunt.

> *"The first blood I spill in every battle is my own. Every drop after that belongs to my prey."*  
> — Grand Bloodhunter Serik Vaelor

## Rank 2
### Description

As a Bloodhunter's mastery of Sangramancy deepens, so too does their ability to shape their own lifeblood into a resilient defensive barrier. The once thin crimson shield becomes denser and more stable, its surface constantly flowing and reforming as fresh mana courses through the Bloodhunter's veins.

The shield no longer merely deflects attacks—it anticipates them. Each strike causes the living blood to ripple across its surface before instantly hardening again, dispersing the force of incoming blows. To an observer, it appears as though the Bloodhunter is surrounded by a crimson halo that instinctively moves to intercept danger.

Maintaining such a shield requires a greater sacrifice than before. More blood must be offered, more mana must sustain its form, and the Bloodhunter's emotions surge alongside the flow of Sangramancy. Every heartbeat strengthens the barrier while simultaneously feeding the Blood Points accumulating within the hunter.

Veterans often teach that Blood Shield should not be viewed as armour, but as a promise. Every drop of blood willingly sacrificed is another declaration that the hunt will continue, regardless of the wounds yet to come.

### Effects

- As a **Bonus Action**, activate Blood Shield.
- Spend **25 MP**, sacrifice **8 HP**, and gain **10 Blood Points (BP)**.
- Blood Shield lasts for **3 Combat Rounds**.
- While Blood Shield is active, gain **+2 Armour Class (AC)**.
- Blood Shield is considered a **magical effect**.
- Only one Blood Shield may be active at a time.
- Blood Points gained through Blood Shield count towards your **Blood Point Limit** and may contribute to triggering **Bloodlust**.

### Lore

Among the Bloodhunter Orders, Rank II is seen as the point where the shield begins to feel alive. Apprentices no longer force the blood into shape through sheer will alone. Instead, they learn to allow Sangramancy to guide its movement, creating a barrier that responds almost instinctively to danger.

Many Bloodhunters describe hearing the rhythm of their own heartbeat within the shield itself. Every pulse reinforces its strength, reminding the hunter that the barrier exists only because they willingly gave a part of themselves to create it.

The elders caution that Blood Shield is never truly free. Every activation strengthens the Bloodhunter's resolve, but it also deepens their connection to the darkness carried within their blood. A shield born from sacrifice will always demand another sacrifice before the hunt is over.

> *"Steel may guard the body, but only sacrifice can protect the soul."*  
> — Grand Bloodhunter Serik Vaelor

## Rank 3
### Description

At the Third Rank, Blood Shield becomes a true manifestation of Sangramancy. The Bloodhunter has mastered the delicate balance between sacrifice and control, allowing greater quantities of their own blood to leave the body without losing cohesion. The crimson barrier grows thicker, stronger, and far more resilient, rotating around the Bloodhunter in a constant orbit of living blood.

Each impact against the shield sends crimson ripples across its surface before it reforms almost instantly. Blades glance away, arrows are deflected, and spells collide against a barrier sustained by both blood and willpower. Every heartbeat reinforces the shield, binding it ever closer to the Bloodhunter's life force.

The shield is not merely protection—it is a declaration. Every enemy that witnesses Blood Shield understands they face a warrior willing to sacrifice their own life to survive long enough to complete the hunt. Such determination alone has broken the morale of many monsters before the first blow is ever struck.

Yet greater protection demands greater sacrifice. More blood is drawn from the body, more mana is consumed to sustain the barrier, and the Bloodhunter's Blood Points rise with every activation. The stronger the shield becomes, the louder the call of Bloodlust grows.

### Effects

- As a **Bonus Action**, activate Blood Shield.
- Spend **35 MP**, sacrifice **12 HP**, and gain **15 Blood Points (BP)**.
- Blood Shield lasts for **3 Combat Rounds**.
- While Blood Shield is active, gain **+3 Armour Class (AC)**.
- Blood Shield is considered a **magical effect**.
- Only one Blood Shield may be active at a time.
- Blood Points gained through Blood Shield count towards your **Blood Point Limit** and may contribute towards triggering **Bloodlust**.

### Lore

Bloodhunters who master the Third Rank are recognised throughout the Orders as warriors capable of standing against creatures far stronger than themselves. Their Blood Shield is no longer viewed as a desperate defence, but as an extension of their own resolve. Every drop of blood sacrificed becomes another promise that the hunt will not end until justice has been delivered.

Experienced Bloodhunters often describe the sensation as carrying a second heartbeat around their body. The crimson barrier pulses in perfect rhythm with their own heart, responding instinctively to danger as though it possesses a life of its own.

The elders continue to remind every apprentice that no shield lasts forever. Blood Shield is not intended to make a Bloodhunter invincible—it exists to buy precious moments when death seems inevitable. Those moments are often all a true hunter needs.

> *"Every strike against my shield reminds me that I chose this pain before my enemy ever could."*  
> — Grand Bloodhunter Serik Vaelor

## Rank 4
### Description

The Fourth Rank of Blood Shield marks the point where Sangramancy becomes an unshakable bastion rather than a simple defence. The Bloodhunter can now draw forth a far greater quantity of their own blood, shaping it into a dense crimson barrier that constantly circles their body like a vigilant guardian. Every heartbeat strengthens the shield, reinforcing its structure before the enemy can exploit even the smallest weakness.

Unlike steel or enchanted armour, Blood Shield is alive. It shifts, twists, and flows around incoming attacks, instinctively placing itself between the Bloodhunter and danger. Blades glance away, arrows are deflected from their mark, and magical energy crashes harmlessly against the crimson barrier before dissolving into crimson mist.

Such mastery demands tremendous sacrifice. The Bloodhunter willingly offers more of their own life to sustain the shield, trusting that every drop of blood given now will preserve countless more before the hunt is over. The emotions stirred by this sacrifice surge through Sangramancy, rapidly increasing the Bloodhunter's Blood Points and testing their resolve against the ever-present threat of Bloodlust.

Within the Bloodhunter Orders, reaching this rank is considered proof that a hunter has learned to trust their blood completely, knowing that the strongest defence is often forged from the greatest sacrifice.

### Effects

Stories tell of Bloodhunters standing against charging giants, dragonfire, and swarms of monsters while their crimson barrier absorbed blow after blow. The elders caution that every shield eventually fades. A Bloodhunter who believes themselves untouchable has already taken the first step toward Bloodlust. The shield exists to preserve the hunter long enough to complete the hunt—not to replace skill, discipline, or wisdom.

> *"A fortress built of stone will one day crumble. A fortress built of sacrifice stands for as long as its guardian draws breath."*  
> — Grand Bloodhunter Serik Vaelor

## Rank 5
### Description

The Fifth Rank of Blood Shield represents the pinnacle of defensive Sangramancy. Through complete mastery over their own lifeblood, the Bloodhunter can create a magnificent crimson barrier that continuously circles their body, moving with a will that mirrors their own. Every heartbeat feeds the shield, allowing it to reshape itself in an instant to intercept blades, arrows, spells, and monstrous claws before they can reach the Bloodhunter.

The barrier appears almost ethereal, formed from countless strands of enchanted blood flowing together in perfect harmony. It is neither armour nor magic alone, but a living extension of the Bloodhunter's soul. Each strike against the shield sends crimson ripples across its surface before it reforms without hesitation, standing as a testament to the hunter's willingness to sacrifice themselves for victory.

Such mastery comes at an immense price. Every activation floods their body with powerful emotions, dramatically increasing their Blood Points and bringing them perilously close to Bloodlust.

Legends tell of Bloodhunters standing alone against overwhelming armies while crimson shields danced around them like living guardians. Arrows shattered, enchanted weapons glanced away, and monstrous blows were turned aside by nothing more than blood willingly given in the name of the hunt. The true shield has always been the unwavering resolve to sacrifice everything necessary to protect others from the horrors that stalk the world. Blood may form the barrier, but conviction is what truly makes it unbreakable.

> *"Steel protects the body. Blood protects the hunter. Conviction protects the soul."*  
> — Grand Bloodhunter Serik Vaelor

# Blood Tithe

## Overview
Every Bloodhunter understands that Sangramancy is a cycle of sacrifice and reward. Blood fuels power, power fuels Bloodlust, and Bloodlust must eventually be brought back under control. Blood Tithe is the sacred ritual that maintains this balance.

Rather than drawing upon mana, the Bloodhunter willingly offers a portion of their own life force as a tithe. The sacrificed blood is consumed by Sangramancy, calming the turmoil raging within the hunter's soul while restoring the strength needed to continue the hunt. It is a painful exchange, but one every experienced Bloodhunter learns to master.

Unlike Blood Rite or Blood Shield, Blood Tithe is not an offensive technique. It is an act of discipline. The Bloodhunter acknowledges the darkness building within themselves and willingly pays a greater price before it can consume them. Many hunters perform this ritual between clashes in battle, choosing to bleed by their own hand rather than allow Bloodlust to decide their fate.

Within the Bloodhunter Orders, apprentices are taught that every hunt is measured not by the monsters slain, but by how many times the hunter successfully mastered the monster growing within themselves.

## Rank 1
### Description

Every Bloodhunter understands that Sangramancy is a cycle of sacrifice and reward. Blood fuels power, power fuels Bloodlust, and Bloodlust must eventually be brought back under control. Blood Tithe is the sacred ritual that maintains this balance.

Rather than drawing upon mana, the Bloodhunter willingly offers a portion of their own life force as a tithe. The sacrificed blood is consumed by Sangramancy, calming the turmoil raging within the hunter's soul while restoring the strength needed to continue the hunt. It is a painful exchange, but one every experienced Bloodhunter learns to master.

Unlike Blood Rite or Blood Shield, Blood Tithe is not an offensive technique. It is an act of discipline. The Bloodhunter acknowledges the darkness building within themselves and willingly pays a greater price before it can consume them. Many hunters perform this ritual between clashes in battle, choosing to bleed by their own hand rather than allow Bloodlust to decide their fate.

Within the Bloodhunter Orders, apprentices are taught that every hunt is measured not by the monsters slain, but by how many times the hunter successfully mastered the monster growing within themselves.

### Effects

- As a **Bonus Action**, activate Blood Tithe.
- Sacrifice **10 HP**.
- Choose **one** of the following:
  - Restore **15 Mana Points (MP)**.
  - Restore **15 Stamina Points (SP)**.
- Reduce your current **Blood Points (BP) by 5**.
- Blood Tithe cannot restore HP.
- Blood Tithe cannot restore MP or SP beyond their normal maximum values.
- Blood Tithe may only be used while you have at least **5 Blood Points**.

### Lore

Among the Bloodhunter Orders, Blood Tithe is regarded as one of the most important techniques a hunter can learn. Every Bloodhunter inevitably walks the razor's edge between mastery and Bloodlust, and only those who learn to temper their emotions survive long enough to become veterans.

The ritual is performed differently by every Order. Some carve symbols into their palms, others allow blood to drip onto ancient runestones, while some simply whisper a silent oath before offering their sacrifice. Regardless of tradition, the purpose remains the same—to remind the Bloodhunter that power without restraint is the quickest path to ruin.

The elders often tell apprentices that Blood Tithe is not an act of weakness. It is the greatest display of strength a Bloodhunter can perform, for it proves they still command their own blood rather than allowing their blood to command them.

> *"The greatest sacrifice is not the blood you spill upon the battlefield... it is the blood you willingly offer to remain yourself."*  
> — Grand Bloodhunter Serik Vaelor

## Rank 2
### Description

As a Bloodhunter grows stronger, so too does their understanding of balance. Every use of Sangramancy pushes them closer to Bloodlust, but Blood Tithe allows them to reclaim a measure of control through deliberate sacrifice. Rather than fearing the darkness within, experienced Bloodhunters learn to manage it, paying a blood tithe before it can overwhelm them.

At this stage, the ritual becomes far more efficient. The Bloodhunter has refined the flow of Sangramancy through their body, allowing a greater portion of the sacrificed life force to be transformed into renewed strength. Mana is restored with greater clarity, stamina returns more quickly, and the emotional burden carried within their blood begins to settle.

Veterans often perform Blood Tithe in the brief moments between battles, recognising that the hunt is rarely won through brute strength alone. Endurance, discipline, and restraint are every bit as important as the blade carried into combat.

Although the ritual calms the Bloodhunter's spirit, it never comes without consequence. The blood offered cannot be reclaimed, and every sacrifice leaves another reminder that true power is earned through suffering rather than granted freely.

### Effects

- As a **Bonus Action**, activate Blood Tithe.
- Sacrifice **15 HP**.
- Choose **one** of the following:
  - Restore **25 Mana Points (MP)**.
  - Restore **25 Stamina Points (SP)**.
- Reduce your current **Blood Points (BP) by 10**.
- Blood Tithe cannot restore HP.
- Blood Tithe cannot restore MP or SP beyond their normal maximum values.
- Blood Tithe may only be used while you have at least **10 Blood Points**.

### Lore

Within the Bloodhunter Orders, Rank II is considered the first step towards true emotional discipline. Apprentices learn that surviving a hunt requires more than defeating monsters—it requires surviving the conflict raging within themselves. Every successful Blood Tithe is proof that the Bloodhunter still commands their own destiny rather than surrendering to Bloodlust.

Many masters describe the ritual as a conversation with Sangramancy itself. The Bloodhunter willingly offers blood, and in return receives only enough strength to continue the hunt—never more than they have earned. This sacred exchange reminds every hunter that sacrifice and discipline must always remain in balance.

The elders caution that Blood Tithe should never become a crutch. A hunter who constantly relies upon it without learning restraint will eventually discover that no amount of sacrifice can restore a soul that has already surrendered to Bloodlust.

> *"Power is easy to claim. Wisdom is knowing when to surrender a little of it to remain yourself."*  
> — Grand Bloodhunter Serik Vaelor

## Rank 3
### Description

The Third Rank of Blood Tithe marks the moment a Bloodhunter truly understands the balance between sacrifice and restraint. Sangramancy is no longer viewed as an uncontrollable force that threatens to consume them, but as a living current that can be guided through discipline, experience, and unwavering resolve.

When performing Blood Tithe, the Bloodhunter willingly opens a deeper wound, offering a greater portion of their own life force to restore what has been exhausted. The ritual is painful, but it clears the mind and steadies the heart, allowing the Bloodhunter to continue the hunt with renewed focus. Every drop of blood offered is a conscious decision to remain in control rather than surrender to Bloodlust.

Veteran Bloodhunters often perform this ritual in the brief moments between fierce exchanges, knowing that the greatest enemy is not always standing before them. Sometimes the true battle is fought within, where every Blood Point tempts the hunter to abandon reason for overwhelming power.

The Orders teach that Blood Tithe is not a means of avoiding Bloodlust forever. It is simply another tool that allows a disciplined hunter to decide when they are willing to embrace the darkness—and when they are not.

### Effects

- As a **Bonus Action**, activate Blood Tithe.
- Sacrifice **20 HP**.
- Choose **one** of the following:
  - Restore **40 Mana Points (MP)**.
  - Restore **40 Stamina Points (SP)**.
- Reduce your current **Blood Points (BP)** by **15**.
- Blood Tithe cannot restore HP.
- Blood Tithe cannot restore MP or SP beyond their normal maximum values.
- Blood Tithe may only be used while you have at least **15 Blood Points**.

### Lore

Within every Bloodhunter Order, Rank III is considered the beginning of true mastery over Sangramancy. The Bloodhunter has learned that strength is not measured by how much blood they can spill, but by how much they are willing to sacrifice without losing themselves.

Masters often describe Blood Tithe as a ritual of humility. The hunter willingly weakens themselves so that they may continue protecting others, proving that sacrifice remains the foundation of every Bloodhunter's path. Those who perform the ritual without respect quickly discover that Sangramancy rewards discipline, not recklessness.

The elders remind every apprentice that Bloodlust is never defeated—it is only held at bay. Blood Tithe is one of the few techniques capable of quieting its whispers, but even the greatest Bloodhunters know those whispers will always return when the next hunt begins.

> *"Control is not the absence of darkness. It is choosing, every single day, not to let the darkness choose for you."*  
> — Grand Bloodhunter Serik Vaelor

## Rank 4
### Description

Few Bloodhunters ever master the Fourth Rank of Blood Tithe. At this stage, the ritual is no longer simply an exchange of blood for strength—it becomes an act of absolute discipline. The Bloodhunter has learned to willingly surrender a significant portion of their own life force, trusting that Sangramancy will return only what is necessary while calming the turmoil threatening to erupt into Bloodlust.

The ritual is performed with unwavering precision. A deep cut is made, blood is offered, and ancient Sangramantic runes briefly ignite around the wound before fading into crimson mist. As the offering is accepted, the Bloodhunter feels exhaustion melt away and the relentless pressure of Blood Points begin to subside. Their breathing steadies, their heartbeat slows, and clarity returns to a mind that moments before stood dangerously close to losing control.

Veterans often reserve Blood Tithe for the most desperate moments of a hunt. They understand that sacrificing more blood now may be the only reason they survive long enough to finish what they started. Every use is a reminder that true mastery is measured not by how much power one possesses, but by knowing when to relinquish it.

### Effects

- As a **Bonus Action**, activate Blood Tithe.
- Sacrifice **25 HP**.
- Choose **one** of the following:
  - Restore **60 Mana Points (MP)**.
  - Restore **60 Stamina Points (SP)**.
- Reduce your current **Blood Points (BP)** by **20**.
- Blood Tithe cannot restore HP.
- Blood Tithe cannot restore MP or SP beyond their normal maximum values.
- Blood Tithe may only be used while you have at least **20 Blood Points**.

### Lore

Within the Bloodhunter Orders, Rank IV is known as **The Crimson Offering**. It represents the moment a Bloodhunter proves they can command Sangramancy without allowing Sangramancy to command them. Every offering made through this ritual demonstrates a level of discipline few hunters ever achieve.

Many masters teach that Blood Tithe is not merely a recovery technique—it is a reminder of why the Bloodhunter fights. Every sacrifice reinforces the oath taken upon entering the Orders: to willingly endure suffering so that others never have to face the horrors lurking beyond civilisation alone.

The elders warn that even the greatest Bloodhunter must never become complacent. Bloodlust is patient. It waits beyond every battle, every victory, and every sacrifice. Blood Tithe does not destroy that darkness—it merely reminds it who remains in control.

> *"Every drop I surrender is another promise that the darkness will serve me... never the other way around."*  
> — Grand Bloodhunter Serik Vaelor

## Rank 5
### Description

At the Fifth Rank, Blood Tithe becomes the ultimate expression of a Bloodhunter's discipline over Sangramancy. Few warriors possess the resolve to willingly surrender so much of their own life force, yet the greatest Bloodhunters understand that true mastery has never been about gaining power—it has always been about knowing when to relinquish it.

The ritual has become instinctive. A single deliberate wound is enough to begin the ancient exchange. Blood leaves the body, crimson runes flare to life around the offering, and the restless emotions feeding Bloodlust are drawn away with it. The Bloodhunter feels their breathing steady, their heartbeat return to a measured rhythm, and the chaos within their soul settle into calm determination.

This technique is often performed during the most desperate moments of battle. A Bloodhunter standing on the brink of Bloodlust may willingly sacrifice their own life to regain the strength needed to continue the hunt while restoring control over the darkness within. Every use is a reminder that the greatest enemy a Bloodhunter will ever face is not standing before them—it lives within their own blood.

Among the Orders, only the most disciplined masters are entrusted with this ritual. They teach that Blood Tithe is not a means of escaping Bloodlust forever, but a sacred reminder that every hunter must choose, time and time again, whether they will command their blood or become enslaved by it.

### Effects

- As a **Bonus Action**, activate Blood Tithe.
- Sacrifice **30 HP**.
- Choose **one** of the following:
  - Restore **80 Mana Points (MP)**.
  - Restore **80 Stamina Points (SP)**.
- Reduce your current **Blood Points (BP)** by **25**.
- Blood Tithe cannot restore HP.
- Blood Tithe cannot restore MP or SP beyond their normal maximum values.
- Blood Tithe may only be used while you have at least **25 Blood Points**.

### Lore

The Fifth Rank of Blood Tithe is known throughout the Bloodhunter Orders as **The Final Offering**. It is regarded as the highest demonstration of restraint a Bloodhunter can achieve, proving that even after embracing unimaginable power through Sangramancy, they still possess the wisdom to temper it through sacrifice.

Legends tell of Bloodhunters who stood alone against impossible odds, repeatedly offering their own lifeblood to remain standing while Bloodlust clawed at the edges of their soul. Their victories were never remembered because they possessed greater strength than other warriors, but because they possessed greater control over themselves.

The elders leave every Bloodhunter with one final lesson before teaching this ritual. Sangramancy will always answer the call of blood, but it cares nothing for the one who makes the offering. Only discipline separates a master from a monster, and Blood Tithe exists to ensure that, no matter how powerful a Bloodhunter becomes, they never forget that sacrifice has always been the true price of their strength.

> *"The strongest Bloodhunter is not the one who spills the most blood... but the one who knows exactly how much of their own they are willing to give."*  
> — Grand Bloodhunter Serik Vaelor

# Bloodhunter

## Overview
The Bloodhunter is unlike any other warrior. Rather than relying solely on strength, mana, or stamina, they wield **Sangramancy**—the forbidden art of blood magic. Every technique fueled through Sangramancy draws upon the emotions carried within blood, leaving behind a lingering resonance known as **Blood Points (BP)**.

Blood Points do not represent physical blood. Instead, they represent the emotional burden accumulated through repeated use of Sangramancy. Rage, hatred, fear, sorrow, vengeance, and countless other emotions become trapped within the Bloodhunter's soul.

Learning Sangramancy is not simply mastering blood magic—it is mastering yourself.

Every Bloodhunter talent generates Blood Points unless otherwise stated.

---

# Blood Point Limit

Every Bloodhunter has a maximum Blood Point Limit representing how much emotional resonance they can safely contain before losing control.

As a Bloodhunter grows stronger, they do not generate fewer Blood Points. Instead, they learn to withstand greater emotional burdens before their mind finally fractures.

| Progression | Maximum Blood Points |
|------------|---------------------:|
| Bloodhunter | 20 BP |
| Tier II | 35 BP |
| Tier III | 50 BP |
| Tier IV | 70 BP |
| Tier V | 100 BP |

Some Bloodhunter talents and magical equipment may further increase this limit.

---

# Gaining Blood Points

Every Bloodhunter talent lists how many Blood Points it generates.

As a general guideline:

- Minor techniques generate **2–5 BP**
- Standard techniques generate **5–8 BP**
- Advanced techniques generate **8–12 BP**
- Legendary techniques generate **10–20 BP**

Blood Points are accumulated immediately after successfully activating an ability unless stated otherwise.

---

# Recovering Blood Points

Blood Points are **persistent** and do not disappear when combat ends.

### End of Combat

- Blood Points remain unchanged.

### Short Rest

- Reduce your current Blood Points by **25% (rounded up).**

### Long Rest

- Reduce your current Blood Points to **0**.

Certain Bloodhunter talents, relics, rituals, or blessings may restore additional Blood Points.

---

# Bloodlust

When a Bloodhunter's current Blood Points exceed their maximum Blood Point Limit, the emotions carried within the blood finally overwhelm their own.

The Bloodhunter immediately enters a state known as **Bloodlust**.

Bloodlust is not blind rage.

It is absolute emotional detachment.

The Bloodhunter becomes unnaturally calm. Their breathing slows. Their movements become precise. Compassion, hesitation, and mercy disappear, replaced only by an overwhelming instinct to hunt and kill.

To witness Bloodlust is to watch someone become less human with every passing moment.

---

# Effects of Bloodlust

While Bloodlust is active:

- The player immediately loses control of their character.
- The Game Master controls the Bloodhunter until Bloodlust ends.
- The Bloodhunter identifies the greatest hostile threat they can perceive and relentlessly attempts to kill it.
- The Bloodhunter ignores pain, fear, and self-preservation.
- Any creature physically preventing them from reaching their prey becomes a valid target, including allies.
- The Bloodhunter cannot willingly perform social interactions, negotiations, or acts of mercy.
- Sangramancy abilities may still be used if they aid in eliminating the chosen prey.
- Bloodlust cannot occur outside of combat.

---

# Ending Bloodlust

Bloodlust ends immediately when one of the following occurs:

- Combat ends.
- The Bloodhunter falls unconscious.
- The Bloodhunter dies.
- A powerful magical effect specifically suppresses Bloodlust.
- Another ability or talent states that it ends Bloodlust.

Once Bloodlust ends, the Bloodhunter retains their current Blood Points unless another effect removes them.

---

# Mastering Sangramancy

Every Bloodhunter walks a dangerous path.

Some spend their lives learning to increase their Blood Point Limit.

Others develop techniques to reduce Blood Point generation.

The greatest Bloodhunters are not those who possess the most power.

They are those who can stand upon the edge of Bloodlust, stare into the darkness within themselves, and choose not to fall.

---

> *"People believe blood carries life. They are wrong. Blood carries emotion... and emotion is far more dangerous."*  
> — Grand Bloodhunter Serik Vaelor

# Camouflage

## Overview
The wilderness teaches that survival is not always determined by strength or speed. Often, the creature that survives is simply the one that remains unseen. Through careful mana manipulation, the Ranger learns to alter their physical appearance to mirror the environment around them.

Unlike illusion magic, Camouflage is a genuine physical adaptation. As mana flows through the Ranger's body, their skin, clothing, armour, and equipment gradually shift in colour and texture to resemble nearby terrain. Mossy greens emerge among forest foliage, rocky greys form upon mountain slopes, and pale whites appear amidst snow-covered landscapes.

The transformation is subtle and natural, making it difficult for observers to distinguish the Ranger from their surroundings. While the effect is not powerful enough to conceal movement, it allows a patient Ranger to become remarkably difficult to spot while remaining still.

Many novice Rangers spend weeks mastering this technique. Learning to remain motionless while channeling mana is often far more challenging than the transformation itself.

---

## Rank 1
### Description

The wilderness teaches that survival is not always determined by strength or speed. Often, the creature that survives is simply the one that remains unseen. Through careful mana manipulation, the Ranger learns to alter their physical appearance to mirror the environment around them.

Unlike illusion magic, Camouflage is a genuine physical adaptation. As mana flows through the Ranger's body, their skin, clothing, armour, and equipment gradually shift in colour and texture to resemble nearby terrain. Mossy greens emerge among forest foliage, rocky greys form upon mountain slopes, and pale whites appear amidst snow-covered landscapes.

The transformation is subtle and natural, making it difficult for observers to distinguish the Ranger from their surroundings. While the effect is not powerful enough to conceal movement, it allows a patient Ranger to become remarkably difficult to spot while remaining still.

Many novice Rangers spend weeks mastering this technique. Learning to remain motionless while channeling mana is often far more challenging than the transformation itself.

---

### Effects

#### Environmental Adaptation

Upon activation:

- Spend 10 Mana.
- The Ranger must remain stationary for 10 seconds while channeling mana.
- At the end of the channel, Camouflage becomes active.

While active:

- The Ranger's body, clothing, armour, and visible equipment adapt to match the surrounding environment.
- Creatures relying on sight suffer a **-2 penalty to Perception checks** made to visually detect the Ranger.
- The effect remains active as long as the Ranger remains stationary.

#### Compatible Environments

Camouflage may function in:

- Forests
- Jungles
- Swamps
- Grasslands
- Hills
- Mountains
- Deserts
- Tundra
- Snowfields
- Natural cave systems

The GM determines whether sufficient environmental features exist for adaptation.

#### Disruption

Camouflage immediately ends if the Ranger:

- Moves from their current position.
- Makes an attack.
- Casts a spell.
- Performs a strenuous physical action.
- Is forcibly moved from their position.

The Ranger may reactivate Camouflage normally.

#### Limitations

- Camouflage is not invisibility.
- The effect only hinders visual detection.
- Creatures may still locate the Ranger through sound, scent, tracks, tremors, magical detection, or other senses.
- Camouflage grants no bonus to Stealth checks at this rank.
- The Ranger gains no protection against divination or magical detection abilities.

---

### Lore

The first Rangers to develop Camouflage were said to have spent entire seasons observing the creatures of the wild. They noticed that survival often depended not upon fighting or fleeing, but upon becoming part of the environment itself.

Through experimentation with natural mana, these early hunters discovered a way to encourage their bodies to imitate the colours and patterns of the world around them. While the transformation was initially crude, generations of refinement transformed the technique into one of the most iconic Ranger abilities in Asteria.

Many scholars classify Camouflage as a form of minor transmutation, though Rangers rarely concern themselves with academic labels. To them, the technique is simply another lesson taught by the wilderness: adapt or perish.

Among Ranger lodges, apprentices are often required to remain hidden using Camouflage for hours at a time as part of their training. Those who succeed learn patience. Those who fail learn humility.

---

> *"A predator does not ask the forest to hide it. It learns how to become another part of the forest."*
> — **Elarion Mosscloak, Warden of the Emerald Wilds**

## Rank 2
### Description

The Ranger's understanding of Camouflage deepens, allowing the adaptation process to occur far more quickly and with greater effectiveness. Rather than simply altering colouration, the mana flowing through the Ranger begins subtly affecting texture, shading, and the way light interacts with their body and equipment.

The transformation becomes smoother and more responsive, allowing the Ranger to disappear into their surroundings in a matter of moments. Leaves, bark, stone, sand, and snow are reflected with remarkable accuracy across the Ranger's appearance, making visual identification increasingly difficult.

Experienced Rangers often use this technique while scouting hostile territory, observing prey, or preparing ambush positions. Many creatures can walk within a few metres of a concealed Ranger without ever realizing they are being watched.

Despite this improvement, movement still disrupts the adaptation. The Ranger must remain motionless for the camouflage to maintain its effectiveness.

---

### Effects

#### Enhanced Environmental Adaptation

Upon activation:

- Spend 15 Mana.
- The Ranger must remain stationary for 5 seconds while channeling mana.
- At the end of the channel, Camouflage becomes active.

While active:

- The Ranger's body, clothing, armour, and visible equipment adapt to match the surrounding environment.
- Creatures relying on sight suffer a **-4 penalty to Perception checks** made to visually detect the Ranger.
- The effect remains active while the Ranger remains stationary.

#### Advanced Blending

The adaptation becomes more convincing and detailed.

- Minor movements such as breathing, shifting posture, or turning the head do not immediately break Camouflage.
- The Ranger may perform quiet observation, watch targets, and survey the area without ending the effect.
- The Ranger may slowly interact with small carried objects at the GM's discretion.

#### Environmental Harmony

While Camouflage is active:

- Creatures attempting to identify the Ranger's exact position from a distance suffer disadvantage on visual-based checks.
- The Ranger's silhouette becomes difficult to distinguish from surrounding terrain.

#### Compatible Environments

Camouflage may function in:

- Forests
- Jungles
- Swamps
- Grasslands
- Hills
- Mountains
- Deserts
- Tundra
- Snowfields
- Natural cave systems

The GM determines whether sufficient environmental features exist for adaptation.

#### Disruption

Camouflage immediately ends if the Ranger:

- Moves from their position.
- Makes an attack.
- Casts a spell.
- Performs a strenuous physical action.
- Is forcibly moved from their position.

The Ranger may reactivate Camouflage normally.

#### Limitations

- Camouflage is not invisibility.
- The effect only hinders visual detection.
- Creatures may still locate the Ranger through sound, scent, tracks, tremors, magical detection, or other senses.
- Camouflage grants no bonus to Stealth checks at this rank.
- The Ranger gains no protection against divination or magical detection abilities.

---

### Lore

Rank 2 is often called the Watcher's Veil among Ranger lodges. At this stage, the Ranger begins to understand that camouflage is more than changing colours—it is learning how the world itself is perceived.

Veteran Rangers teach that most creatures do not truly see their surroundings. Instead, they search for movement, unusual shapes, and things that seem out of place. Camouflage exploits this instinct by making the Ranger appear as though they belong exactly where they are.

Many frontier settlements owe their safety to Rangers capable of remaining hidden for hours while observing monster migrations, enemy patrols, or dangerous predators. Such information often saves lives long before a weapon is ever drawn.

Among experienced scouts, a common saying persists: if a Ranger is forced to run, the camouflage has already failed. The true purpose of the technique is not escape—it is remaining unnoticed in the first place.

---

> *"Most eyes search for what does not belong. Camouflage ensures that you do."*
> — **Lysandra Thornroot, Scout Captain of the Green Marches**

## Rank 3
### Description

The Ranger's mastery of Camouflage reaches a significant milestone. No longer restricted to complete stillness, the Ranger learns to maintain the adaptation while moving through the environment. Mana continuously flows across the body, adjusting colours, textures, and patterns as terrain changes around them.

The transformation becomes fluid rather than static. Moss-green tones shift to earthy browns beneath changing foliage, rocky textures blend into mountain terrain, and pale colours emerge when crossing snowy ground. The adaptation occurs constantly, allowing the Ranger to remain concealed even while stalking prey or scouting dangerous territory.

Maintaining such an active transformation requires greater focus and mana expenditure than previous ranks. The Ranger must carefully balance movement and concentration to prevent the camouflage from destabilizing.

Among Ranger circles, reaching this stage is often considered the moment when a hunter truly becomes a predator. No longer bound to hiding in one place, the Ranger can now move with the wilderness itself.

---

### Effects

#### Mobile Camouflage

Upon activation:

- Spend 20 Mana.
- The Ranger must remain stationary for 3 seconds while channeling mana.
- At the end of the channel, Camouflage becomes active.

While active:

- The Ranger's body, clothing, armour, and visible equipment continuously adapt to match the surrounding environment.
- Creatures relying on sight suffer a **-5 penalty to Perception checks** made to visually detect the Ranger.

#### Adaptive Movement

The Ranger may now move while maintaining Camouflage.

- Camouflage remains active while moving at up to **half movement speed**.
- The adaptation continuously adjusts as the Ranger changes environments.
- Movement greater than half movement speed immediately ends the effect.

#### Environmental Stealth

The Ranger's movement becomes synchronized with their adaptive appearance.

While Camouflage is active:

- Gain **+2 to Stealth checks**.
- This is the first rank at which Camouflage directly enhances Stealth.
- This bonus only applies while the camouflage remains active.

#### Predator's Approach

The Ranger has learned to move without drawing attention.

While Camouflage is active:

- Creatures suffer disadvantage on Perception checks made to visually track the Ranger's movement.
- The Ranger leaves fewer obvious visual signs of passage.

#### Compatible Environments

Camouflage may function in:

- Forests
- Jungles
- Swamps
- Grasslands
- Hills
- Mountains
- Deserts
- Tundra
- Snowfields
- Natural cave systems

The GM determines whether sufficient environmental features exist for adaptation.

#### Disruption

Camouflage immediately ends if the Ranger:

- Exceeds half movement speed.
- Makes an attack.
- Casts a spell.
- Performs a strenuous physical action determined by the GM.
- Is forcibly moved a significant distance.

The Ranger may reactivate Camouflage normally.

#### Limitations

- Camouflage is not invisibility.
- The effect only hinders visual detection.
- Creatures may still locate the Ranger through sound, scent, tracks, tremors, magical detection, or other senses.
- The Stealth bonus only applies while Camouflage remains active.
- Camouflage grants no protection against divination or magical detection abilities.

---

### Lore

Rank 3 is known among Rangers as the Stalker's Veil. It represents the transition from hiding within the wilderness to moving as part of it. Rangers who achieve this level of mastery are often employed as scouts, hunters, and reconnaissance specialists throughout Asteria.

The ability requires a level of mana control that few outsiders fully appreciate. Rather than maintaining a single transformation, the Ranger must constantly adjust their appearance to match every change in terrain. Even a short journey may require hundreds of subtle adaptations.

Many famous monster hunters developed this technique specifically to stalk dangerous prey without alerting them. Tales speak of Rangers shadowing wyverns through mountain passes, tracking dire beasts through ancient forests, and infiltrating enemy camps without ever being seen.

Among veteran Rangers, Rank 3 is often viewed as the first truly advanced stage of Camouflage. From this point forward, the Ranger no longer merely hides from the wilderness—they move with it.

---

> *"Stillness teaches concealment. Movement teaches mastery."*
> — **Vaelor Greenstride, Hunter of the Northern Wilds**

## Rank 4
### Description

The Ranger's command over Camouflage has evolved into an instinctive extension of their body. Mana no longer struggles to keep pace with movement, instead flowing naturally across the Ranger's skin, clothing, armour, and equipment as they traverse the wilderness. Every step, every shift in terrain, and every change in light is answered by an equally seamless transformation.

At this stage, the Ranger is no longer forced to stalk prey at a cautious pace. They can move freely through forests, mountains, deserts, and other natural environments while remaining remarkably difficult to distinguish from the world around them. To an observer, the Ranger seems to melt into the landscape, their outline constantly changing to match whatever surrounds them.

This technique is demanding, requiring exceptional mana control and awareness of one's surroundings. Rangers who master it become invaluable scouts, infiltrators, and monster hunters, capable of approaching dangerous prey without revealing their presence until the perfect moment.

Only the most experienced Rangers ever reach this level of mastery. Within the lodges of Asteria, Rank 4 is regarded as the point where Camouflage ceases to be a technique and becomes second nature.

---

### Effects

#### Advanced Environmental Adaptation

Upon activation:

- Spend **25 Mana**.
- The Ranger channels mana for **2 seconds**.
- At the end of the channel, Camouflage becomes active.

While active:

- The Ranger's body, clothing, armour, and visible equipment continuously adapt to match the surrounding environment.
- Creatures relying on sight suffer a **-7 penalty to Perception checks** made to visually detect the Ranger.

#### Adaptive Movement

The Ranger may now move at **full movement speed** without breaking Camouflage.

The adaptation continuously shifts to match changes in:

- Terrain
- Vegetation
- Rock formations
- Snow and ice
- Sand
- Natural lighting and shadows

#### Natural Stealth

While Camouflage is active:

- Gain **+4 to Stealth checks**.
- This bonus only applies while the Camouflage remains active.

#### Predator's Advance

Years of experience allow the Ranger to move through natural terrain with extraordinary precision.

While Camouflage is active:

- Difficult natural terrain does not reduce movement speed.
- Creatures suffer **Disadvantage** on visual Perception checks made to track the Ranger's movement.
- The Ranger leaves significantly fewer visual signs of passage.

#### Adaptive Persistence

Minor actions no longer disrupt Camouflage.

The Ranger may perform actions such as:

- Opening doors.
- Drawing or sheathing weapons.
- Drinking a potion.
- Interacting with simple objects.
- Communicating in a whisper.

These actions do not end Camouflage.

#### Disruption

Camouflage immediately ends if the Ranger:

- Makes an attack.
- Casts a spell.
- Performs a strenuous action determined by the GM.
- Is subjected to an effect that completely reveals their position.

The Ranger may reactivate Camouflage normally.

#### Limitations

- Camouflage is not invisibility.
- The effect only hinders visual detection.
- Creatures may still locate the Ranger through sound, scent, tremors, magical detection, or other non-visual senses.
- The Stealth bonus only applies while Camouflage remains active.
- Camouflage provides no protection against divination or similar magical effects.

---

### Lore

Among the Rangers of Asteria, Rank 4 is known as the **Hunter's Mantle**. It is said that those who reach this level no longer think about blending into nature—the wilderness accepts them as one of its own.

Veteran Rangers often spend years refining this technique. Every journey across changing landscapes teaches them how light bends through leaves, how shadows stretch across stone, and how even the smallest shift in colour can betray a careless hunter. These lessons become instinct, allowing the Ranger's mana to respond before conscious thought.

Many famous expeditions owe their success to Rangers capable of maintaining Camouflage while traversing dangerous territory. They have infiltrated enemy fortifications built deep within forests, shadowed ancient beasts across mountain ranges, and rescued lost travellers without ever revealing their presence.

To outsiders, such feats appear magical. Rangers know the truth is far simpler. The wilderness hides those who understand it, and Camouflage is merely the highest expression of that understanding.

---

> *"When your footsteps become as natural as falling leaves, even the forest forgets you are there."*  
> — **High Warden Elyndor Ashcloak, Keeper of the Emerald Trail**

## Rank 5
### Description

The Ranger has mastered Camouflage to a level few mortals ever achieve. Their body has become a living conduit for natural mana, instinctively responding to the world around them. Every step, every shift in terrain, and every change in light is mirrored across their skin, clothing, armour, and equipment in moments, making them appear as though they belong wherever they stand.

Unlike earlier ranks, the Ranger no longer consciously maintains the transformation. The mana flows continuously through their body, adapting faster than the eye can comfortably follow. Forest greens become rocky greys, snowy whites become desert browns, and shadows seem to cling naturally to their form as they move through the wilderness.

To those unfamiliar with the art, a master of Camouflage appears almost impossible to follow. One moment they are clearly visible, the next they have seemingly vanished into the landscape despite never leaving sight. Experienced hunters know the Ranger has not disappeared—they have simply become another part of the environment.

Within the Ranger Lodges of Asteria, only a handful of individuals each generation ever earn the title of **Living Veil**. These masters are entrusted with the most dangerous scouting missions, monster hunts, and reconnaissance operations, for few creatures can match their ability to move unseen through the wilds.

---

### Effects

#### Living Camouflage

Upon activation:

- Spend **30 Mana**.
- Camouflage activates after **1 second** of concentration.

While active:

- The Ranger's body, clothing, armour, weapons, and visible equipment continuously adapt to match the surrounding environment.
- The adaptation occurs seamlessly as the Ranger moves through different terrain.
- Creatures relying primarily on sight suffer a **-10 penalty to Perception checks** made to visually detect the Ranger.

#### Master of Concealment

While Camouflage is active:

- Gain **+5 to Stealth checks**.
- The Ranger may move at full movement speed without disrupting Camouflage.
- Natural difficult terrain does not reduce the Ranger's movement speed.

#### Predator's Grace

Years of experience allow the Ranger to move with almost supernatural precision.

While Camouflage is active:

- The Ranger leaves virtually no visible trail.
- Creatures tracking the Ranger by sight suffer **Disadvantage** on related Perception or Investigation checks.
- The Ranger may use natural cover that would normally be considered too small or sparse to hide behind, at the GM's discretion.

#### Adaptive Persistence

Camouflage is no longer easily broken.

The following actions do **not** end Camouflage:

- Drawing or sheathing weapons.
- Opening doors or containers.
- Drinking potions.
- Reloading weapons.
- Quiet communication.
- Interacting with simple objects.
- Normal movement.

If the Ranger makes an attack or casts a spell:

- Camouflage remains active until the attack or spell is fully resolved.
- The effect then ends immediately.

#### Perfect Adaptation

The Ranger instinctively understands how to blend with every natural environment.

Camouflage functions in:

- Forests
- Jungles
- Swamps
- Grasslands
- Mountains
- Hills
- Deserts
- Snowfields
- Tundra
- Natural cave systems
- Coastal cliffs
- Marshlands

The GM may approve additional natural environments where appropriate.

#### Limitations

- Camouflage is **not invisibility**.
- The talent only hinders **visual detection**.
- Creatures using scent, hearing, tremorsense, magical detection, blindsight, or similar abilities may still locate the Ranger.
- Camouflage provides no protection against divination or similar magical effects.

---

### Lore

The greatest Rangers speak of Camouflage not as a spell or technique, but as a conversation between the Ranger and the wilderness itself. Through years of discipline and unwavering respect for nature, the flow of mana becomes so refined that the world instinctively accepts the Ranger as part of its landscape.

Legends tell of Rangers who crossed battlefields unseen beneath the gaze of thousands, stalked Elder Dragons through ancient forests for days without detection, and watched entire armies march past from only a few metres away. Whether every tale is true is impossible to know, but each speaks to the same extraordinary mastery.

Among the oldest Ranger Lodges, masters of this talent are known as the **Living Veils**. Their teachings are reserved for only the most dedicated students, for the discipline demands patience, humility, and absolute control over one's body and mana.

To become a Living Veil is considered one of the highest honours a Ranger can achieve. It is proof that the wilderness no longer sees the Ranger as an outsider, but as one of its own.

---

> *"The greatest camouflage is not becoming invisible. It is becoming so natural that the world forgets you were ever there."*  
> — **Grandmaster Alaric Thornveil, First Living Veil of Asteria**

the ranger's mastery of camouflage reaches a significant milestone. no longer restricted to complete stillness, the ranger learns to maintain the adaptation while moving through the environment. mana continuously flows across the body, adjusting colours, textures, and patterns as terrain changes around them.

the transformation becomes fluid rather than static. moss-green tones shift to earthy browns beneath changing foliage, rocky textures blend into mountain terrain, and pale colours emerge when crossing snowy ground. the adaptation occurs constantly, allowing the ranger to remain concealed even while stalking prey or scouting dangerous territory.

maintaining such an active transformation requires greater focus and mana expenditure than previous ranks. the ranger must carefully balance movement and concentration to prevent the camouflage from destabilizing.

among ranger circles, reaching this stage is often considered the moment when a hunter truly becomes a predator. no longer bound to hiding in one place, the ranger can now move with the wilderness itself.

---

### effects

#### mobile camouflage

upon activation:

- spend 20 mana.
- the ranger must remain stationary for 3 seconds while channeling mana.
- at the end of the channel, camouflage becomes active.

while active:

- the ranger's body, clothing, armour, and visible equipment continuously adapt to match the surrounding environment.
- creatures relying on sight suffer a **-5 penalty to perception checks** made to visually detect the ranger.

#### adaptive movement

the ranger may now move while maintaining camouflage.

- camouflage remains active while moving at up to **half movement speed**.
- the adaptation continuously adjusts as the ranger changes environments.
- movement greater than half movement speed immediately ends the effect.

#### environmental stealth

the ranger's movement becomes synchronized with their adaptive appearance.

while camouflage is active:

- gain **+2 to stealth checks**.
- this is the first rank at which camouflage directly enhances stealth.
- this bonus only applies while the camouflage remains active.

#### predator's approach

the ranger has learned to move without drawing attention.

while camouflage is active:

- creatures suffer disadvantage on perception checks made to visually track the ranger's movement.
- the ranger leaves fewer obvious visual signs of passage.

#### compatible environments

camouflage may function in:

- forests
- jungles
- swamps
- grasslands
- hills
- mountains
- deserts
- tundra
- snowfields
- natural cave systems

the gm determines whether sufficient environmental features exist for adaptation.

#### disruption

camouflage immediately ends if the ranger:

- exceeds half movement speed.
- makes an attack.
- casts a spell.
- performs a strenuous physical action determined by the gm.
- is forcibly moved a significant distance.

the ranger may reactivate camouflage normally.

#### limitations

- camouflage is not invisibility.
- the effect only hinders visual detection.
- creatures may still locate the ranger through sound, scent, tracks, tremors, magical detection, or other senses.
- the stealth bonus only applies while camouflage remains active.
- camouflage grants no protection against divination or magical detection abilities.

---

### lore

rank 3 is known among rangers as the stalker's veil. it represents the transition from hiding within the wilderness to moving as part of it. rangers who achieve this level of mastery are often employed as scouts, hunters, and reconnaissance specialists throughout asteria.

the ability requires a level of mana control that few outsiders fully appreciate. rather than maintaining a single transformation, the ranger must constantly adjust their appearance to match every change in terrain. even a short journey may require hundreds of subtle adaptations.

many famous monster hunters developed this technique specifically to stalk dangerous prey without alerting them. tales speak of rangers shadowing wyverns through mountain passes, tracking dire beasts through ancient forests, and infiltrating enemy camps without ever being seen.

among veteran rangers, rank 3 is often viewed as the first truly advanced stage of camouflage. from this point forward, the ranger no longer merely hides from the wilderness—they move with it.

---

> *"stillness teaches concealment. movement teaches mastery."*
> — **vaelor greenstride, hunter of the northern wilds**

## rank 4
### description

the ranger's command over camouflage has evolved into an instinctive extension of their body. mana no longer struggles to keep pace with movement, instead flowing naturally across the ranger's skin, clothing, armour, and equipment as they traverse the wilderness. every step, every shift in terrain, and every change in light is answered by an equally seamless transformation.

at this stage, the ranger is no longer forced to stalk prey at a cautious pace. they can move freely through forests, mountains, deserts, and other natural environments while remaining remarkably difficult to distinguish from the world around them. to an observer, the ranger seems to melt into the landscape, their outline constantly changing to match whatever surrounds them.

this technique is demanding, requiring exceptional mana control and awareness of one's surroundings. rangers who master it become invaluable scouts, infiltrators, and monster hunters, capable of approaching dangerous prey without revealing their presence until the perfect moment.

only the most experienced rangers ever reach this level of mastery. within the lodges of asteria, rank 4 is regarded as the point where camouflage ceases to be a technique and becomes second nature.

---

### effects

#### advanced environmental adaptation

upon activation:

- spend **25 mana**.
- the ranger channels mana for **2 seconds**.
- at the end of the channel, camouflage becomes active.

while active:

- the ranger's body, clothing, armour, and visible equipment continuously adapt to match the surrounding environment.
- creatures relying on sight suffer a **-7 penalty to perception checks** made to visually detect the ranger.

#### adaptive movement

the ranger may now move at **full movement speed** without breaking camouflage.

the adaptation continuously shifts to match changes in:

- terrain
- vegetation
- rock formations
- snow and ice
- sand
- natural lighting and shadows

#### natural stealth

while camouflage is active:

- gain **+4 to stealth checks**.
- this bonus only applies while the camouflage remains active.

#### predator's advance

years of experience allow the ranger to move through natural terrain with extraordinary precision.

while camouflage is active:

- difficult natural terrain does not reduce movement speed.
- creatures suffer **disadvantage** on visual perception checks made to track the ranger's movement.
- the ranger leaves significantly fewer visual signs of passage.

#### adaptive persistence

minor actions no longer disrupt camouflage.

the ranger may perform actions such as:

- opening doors.
- drawing or sheathing weapons.
- drinking a potion.
- interacting with simple objects.
- communicating in a whisper.

these actions do not end camouflage.

#### disruption

camouflage immediately ends if the ranger:

- makes an attack.
- casts a spell.
- performs a strenuous action determined by the gm.
- is subjected to an effect that completely reveals their position.

the ranger may reactivate camouflage normally.

#### limitations

- camouflage is not invisibility.
- the effect only hinders visual detection.
- creatures may still locate the ranger through sound, scent, tremors, magical detection, or other non-visual senses.
- the stealth bonus only applies while camouflage remains active.
- camouflage provides no protection against divination or similar magical effects.

---

### lore

among the rangers of asteria, rank 4 is known as the **hunter's mantle**. it is said that those who reach this level no longer think about blending into nature—the wilderness accepts them as one of its own.

veteran rangers often spend years refining this technique. every journey across changing landscapes teaches them how light bends through leaves, how shadows stretch across stone, and how even the smallest shift in colour can betray a careless hunter. these lessons become instinct, allowing the ranger's mana to respond before conscious thought.

many famous expeditions owe their success to rangers capable of maintaining camouflage while traversing dangerous territory. they have infiltrated enemy fortifications built deep within forests, shadowed ancient beasts across mountain ranges, and rescued lost travellers without ever revealing their presence.

to outsiders, such feats appear magical. rangers know the truth is far simpler. the wilderness hides those who understand it, and camouflage is merely the highest expression of that understanding.

---

> *"when your footsteps become as natural as falling leaves, even the forest forgets you are there."*  
> — **high warden elyndor ashcloak, keeper of the emerald trail**

## rank 5
### description

the ranger has mastered camouflage to a level few mortals ever achieve. their body has become a living conduit for natural mana, instinctively responding to the world around them. every step, every shift in terrain, and every change in light is mirrored across their skin, clothing, armour, and equipment in moments, making them appear as though they belong wherever they stand.

unlike earlier ranks, the ranger no longer consciously maintains the transformation. the mana flows continuously through their body, adapting faster than the eye can comfortably follow. forest greens become rocky greys, snowy whites become desert browns, and shadows seem to cling naturally to their form as they move through the wilderness.

to those unfamiliar with the art, a master of camouflage appears almost impossible to follow. one moment they are clearly visible, the next they have seemingly vanished into the landscape despite never leaving sight. experienced hunters know the ranger has not disappeared—they have simply become another part of the environment.

within the ranger lodges of asteria, only a handful of individuals each generation ever earn the title of **living veil**. these masters are entrusted with the most dangerous scouting missions, monster hunts, and reconnaissance operations, for few creatures can match their ability to move unseen through the wilds.

---

### effects

#### living camouflage

upon activation:

- spend **30 mana**.
- camouflage activates after **1 second** of concentration.

while active:

- the ranger's body, clothing, armour, weapons, and visible equipment continuously adapt to match the surrounding environment.
- the adaptation occurs seamlessly as the ranger moves through different terrain.
- creatures relying primarily on sight suffer a **-10 penalty to perception checks** made to visually detect the ranger.

#### master of concealment

while camouflage is active:

- gain **+5 to stealth checks**.
- the ranger may move at full movement speed without disrupting camouflage.
- natural difficult terrain does not reduce the ranger's movement speed.

#### predator's grace

years of experience allow the ranger to move with almost supernatural precision.

while camouflage is active:

- the ranger leaves virtually no visible trail.
- creatures tracking the ranger by sight suffer **disadvantage** on related perception or investigation checks.
- the ranger may use natural cover that would normally be considered too small or sparse to hide behind, at the gm's discretion.

#### adaptive persistence

camouflage is no longer easily broken.

the following actions do **not** end camouflage:

- drawing or sheathing weapons.
- opening doors or containers.
- drinking potions.
- reloading weapons.
- quiet communication.
- interacting with simple objects.
- normal movement.

if the ranger makes an attack or casts a spell:

- camouflage remains active until the attack or spell is fully resolved.
- the effect then ends immediately.

#### perfect adaptation

the ranger instinctively understands how to blend with every natural environment.

camouflage functions in:

- forests
- jungles
- swamps
- grasslands
- mountains
- hills
- deserts
- snowfields
- tundra
- natural cave systems
- coastal cliffs
- marshlands

the gm may approve additional natural environments where appropriate.

#### limitations

- camouflage is **not invisibility**.
- the talent only hinders **visual detection**.
- creatures using scent, hearing, tremorsense, magical detection, blindsight, or similar abilities may still locate the ranger.
- camouflage provides no protection against divination or similar magical effects.

---

### lore

the greatest rangers speak of camouflage not as a spell or technique, but as a conversation between the ranger and the wilderness itself. through years of discipline and unwavering respect for nature, the flow of mana becomes so refined that the world instinctively accepts the ranger as part of its landscape.

legends tell of rangers who crossed battlefields unseen beneath the gaze of thousands, stalked elder dragons through ancient forests for days without detection, and watched entire armies march past from only a few metres away. whether every tale is true is impossible to know, but each speaks to the same extraordinary mastery.

among the oldest ranger lodges, masters of this talent are known as the **living veils**. their teachings are reserved for only the most dedicated students, for the discipline demands patience, humility, and absolute control over one's body and mana.

to become a living veil is considered one of the highest honours a ranger can achieve. it is proof that the wilderness no longer sees the ranger as an outsider, but as one of its own.

---

> *"the greatest camouflage is not becoming invisible. it is becoming so natural that the world forgets you were ever there."*  
> — **grandmaster alaric thornveil, first living veil of asteria**
