# Death Shot

## Overview
Every hunt has a final moment—the instant when the hunter knows the prey can no longer escape. Death Shot embodies that moment. Rather than relying on overwhelming force, the Ranger waits patiently until their quarry is exhausted, wounded, and vulnerable before loosing a single arrow infused with primal magic to deliver the final blow.

The technique demands exceptional discipline. A Death Shot fired too early wastes its power, while one fired at the perfect moment becomes the inevitable conclusion of the hunt. Among the Ranger Lodges, apprentices are taught that this ability is never used to begin a battle, only to end one.

---

## Rank 1
### Description

Every hunt has a final moment—the instant when the hunter knows the prey can no longer escape. Death Shot embodies that moment. Rather than relying on overwhelming force, the Ranger waits patiently until their quarry is exhausted, wounded, and vulnerable before loosing a single arrow infused with primal magic to deliver the final blow.

The technique demands exceptional discipline. A Death Shot fired too early wastes its power, while one fired at the perfect moment becomes the inevitable conclusion of the hunt. Among the Ranger Lodges, apprentices are taught that this ability is never used to begin a battle, only to end one.

---

### Effects

- **Cost:** 250 MP.
- **Uses:** 1 use per **Long Rest**.
- Make a single ranged weapon attack against a creature within your weapon's range.
- This attack must hit normally.
- Death Shot may only be used against a creature currently affected by your **Hunter's Mark**.
- If the target has **10% or less of its maximum HP** remaining when the attack hits, it is **immediately reduced to 0 HP**.
- If the target has more than **10% of its maximum HP**, Death Shot deals normal weapon damage plus **6d8 Magical Piercing Damage** instead.
- Legendary creatures, Raid Bosses, and creatures specifically designated by the GM as immune to execution effects are instead reduced to **1 HP** if they would be slain by Death Shot.

#### Limitations

- Death Shot cannot critically hit.
- Death Shot may only be used with bows, crossbows, or other ranged weapons approved by the GM.
- The execution effect only applies if the attack successfully hits.

---

### Lore

Death Shot is considered the ultimate expression of a Ranger's patience. It is not a display of strength, but of judgement. The greatest hunters know that every creature has a moment of weakness, and only those with the discipline to wait for that instant are worthy of learning this technique.

Many legendary Huntmasters became famous not for the number of arrows they loosed, but because every Death Shot marked the end of a hunt that others believed impossible. Their arrows became symbols of certainty—the final chapter in every pursuit.

---

> *"The first arrow begins the hunt. The last arrow writes its ending."*  
> — **Grand Ranger Elyas Thornwood, First Apex Predator**

## Rank 2
### Description

The Ranger's understanding of the perfect killing shot deepens, allowing them to recognise the exact instant a wounded quarry can no longer survive. Every heartbeat, every stagger, and every desperate movement reveals an opportunity invisible to ordinary hunters. Death Shot is no longer simply an execution—it is the inevitable conclusion of a hunt carried out with absolute precision.

Veteran Rangers know that the greatest hunters do not waste arrows. They wait patiently, allowing exhaustion, injury, and fear to weaken their quarry before releasing a single arrow that ends the battle. Among the Ranger Lodges, mastering the second rank of Death Shot is considered proof that a Ranger has learned patience above aggression.

---

### Effects

- **Cost:** 275 MP.
- **Uses:** 1 use per **Long Rest**.
- Make a single ranged weapon attack against a creature within your weapon's range.
- This attack must hit normally.
- The target must be affected by your **Hunter's Mark**.
- If the target has **15% or less of its maximum HP** remaining when the attack hits, it is immediately reduced to **0 HP**.
- If the target has more than **15%** of its maximum HP remaining, Death Shot instead deals normal weapon damage plus **8d8 Magical Piercing Damage**.
- Legendary creatures, Raid Bosses, and creatures designated by the GM as immune to execution effects are instead reduced to **1 HP** if they would be slain by Death Shot.

#### Limitations

- Death Shot cannot critically hit.
- Death Shot may only be used with bows, crossbows, or other GM-approved ranged weapons.
- The execution effect only occurs if the attack successfully hits.

---

### Lore

To outsiders, Death Shot appears almost supernatural. Experienced Rangers seem capable of predicting the exact instant a creature's strength finally begins to fail, striking with unwavering confidence while others still believe the battle has only just begun.

Within the Ranger Lodges, students are reminded that this technique is earned through discipline rather than talent. Every failed hunt teaches patience, and every successful hunt reinforces a single lesson: the perfect shot is never the first arrow—it is the last.

---

> *"Anyone can loose an arrow. Few possess the patience to know when only one is needed."*  
> — **Grand Ranger Elyas Thornwood**

## Rank 3
### Description

The Ranger has mastered the art of recognising a quarry's final moments. Every wound, every slowing movement, and every desperate attempt to escape reveals the precise instant when the hunt can be brought to its inevitable conclusion. Death Shot has become more than a finishing technique—it is the embodiment of absolute patience and flawless judgement.

When this technique is unleashed, the Ranger places complete trust in years of experience rather than chance. The arrow is infused with primal magic before being released with unwavering precision, seeking the perfect path to end the hunt. To seasoned Rangers, every creature has a final weakness; only the greatest possess the discipline to wait for it.

---

### Effects

- **Cost:** 300 MP.
- **Uses:** 1 use per **Long Rest**.
- Make a single ranged weapon attack against a creature within your weapon's range.
- This attack must hit normally.
- The target must be affected by your **Hunter's Mark**.
- If the target has **20% or less of its maximum HP** remaining when the attack hits, it is immediately reduced to **0 HP**.
- If the target has more than **20%** of its maximum HP remaining, Death Shot instead deals normal weapon damage plus **10d8 Magical Piercing Damage**.
- Legendary creatures, Raid Bosses, and creatures designated by the GM as immune to execution effects are instead reduced to **1 HP** if they would be slain by Death Shot.

#### Limitations

- Death Shot cannot critically hit.
- Death Shot may only be used with bows, crossbows, or other GM-approved ranged weapons.
- The execution effect only occurs if the attack successfully hits.

---

### Lore

Only the most disciplined Rangers ever reach the third rank of Death Shot. They no longer see a wounded enemy—they see the inevitable conclusion of the hunt. Every lesson learned through countless battles allows them to recognise the exact moment when resistance has ended, even if the quarry has yet to realise it.

Within the Ranger Lodges, this mastery is regarded with immense respect. Rangers capable of performing Death Shot are often entrusted with eliminating the most dangerous beasts and monsters in Asteria, where hesitation could mean the difference between victory and extinction.

---

> *"Mercy belongs to the hunter who ends the suffering with a single arrow."*  
> — **Grand Ranger Elyas Thornwood**

## Rank 4
### Description

The Ranger's mastery over Death Shot has become legendary. Their understanding of anatomy, instinct, and timing has reached a point where they can identify a quarry's final weakness with only a glance. Every heartbeat, every faltering step, and every sign of fatigue reveals the perfect opportunity to deliver the finishing blow.

The arrow itself becomes a vessel of primal magic, carrying the Ranger's unwavering intent. Once released, it represents the culmination of an entire hunt, guided by years of discipline rather than emotion. To face a Ranger capable of this technique is to know that every mistake brings the inevitable end one step closer.

---

### Effects

- **Cost:** 325 MP.
- **Uses:** 1 use per **Long Rest**.
- Make a single ranged weapon attack against a creature within your weapon's range.
- This attack must hit normally.
- The target must be affected by your **Hunter's Mark**.
- If the target has **25% or less of its maximum HP** remaining when the attack hits, it is immediately reduced to **0 HP**.
- If the target has more than **25%** of its maximum HP remaining, Death Shot instead deals normal weapon damage plus **12d8 Magical Piercing Damage**.
- Legendary creatures, Raid Bosses, and creatures designated by the GM as immune to execution effects are instead reduced to **1 HP** if they would be slain by Death Shot.
- If Death Shot successfully reduces a creature to **0 HP**, you immediately regain **100 MP** and may immediately transfer **Hunter's Mark** to another creature within your weapon's range without paying its Mana Cost.

#### Limitations

- Death Shot cannot critically hit.
- Death Shot may only be used with bows, crossbows, or other GM-approved ranged weapons.
- The execution effect only occurs if the attack successfully hits.

---

### Lore

Among the Ranger Lodges, the fourth rank of Death Shot is regarded as the mark of a true Huntmaster. Those who achieve it are no longer simply skilled archers—they are executioners of the wild, capable of ending even the fiercest hunts with a single perfectly placed arrow.

Many of Asteria's greatest monsters met their end beneath this technique. The stories speak not of prolonged battles, but of one final arrow released at precisely the right moment. To those who witnessed it, the hunt did not end with violence—it ended with certainty.

---

> *"Every hunt ends with a final breath. My arrow simply decides when that breath is taken."*  
> — **Grand Ranger Elyas Thornwood**

## Rank 5
### Description

Death Shot has become the ultimate expression of the Ranger's purpose. The hunt has reached its inevitable conclusion, and the Ranger requires only a single arrow to deliver judgement. Every lesson learned throughout a lifetime of tracking, observing, and overcoming the world's deadliest creatures culminates in this one technique.

As the arrow is infused with immense primal magic, the Ranger waits with unwavering patience for the exact instant their quarry falters. There is no hesitation, no wasted movement, and no uncertainty. When the arrow is finally released, it carries the certainty that every hunt must eventually end.

Among the Ranger Lodges, mastering the fifth rank of Death Shot is considered the highest honour a hunter can achieve. It is said that once an Apex Predator has chosen the final moment, even the greatest monsters cannot escape their fate.

---

### Effects

- **Cost:** 350 MP.
- **Uses:** 1 use per **Long Rest**.
- Make a single ranged weapon attack against a creature within your weapon's range.
- This attack must hit normally.
- The target must be affected by your **Hunter's Mark**.
- If the target has **30% or less of its maximum HP** remaining when the attack hits, it is immediately reduced to **0 HP**.
- If the target has more than **30%** of its maximum HP remaining, Death Shot instead deals normal weapon damage plus **15d8 Magical Piercing Damage**.
- Legendary creatures, Raid Bosses, Mythic creatures, and creatures designated by the GM as immune to execution effects are instead reduced to **1 HP** if they would be slain by Death Shot.
- If Death Shot reduces a creature to **0 HP**:
  - Immediately regain **150 MP**.
  - You may immediately transfer **Hunter's Mark** to another creature within your weapon's range without paying its Mana Cost.
  - You may immediately make **one standard ranged weapon attack** against the newly marked creature. This attack does **not** benefit from Death Shot.

#### Limitations

- Death Shot cannot critically hit.
- Death Shot may only be used with bows, crossbows, or other GM-approved ranged weapons.
- The execution effect only occurs if the attack successfully hits.
- The bonus ranged attack may only occur once per use of Death Shot.

---

### Lore

Only a handful of Rangers throughout Asteria's history have ever mastered the fifth rank of Death Shot. Their names have become legend not because they hunted the greatest beasts, but because they never failed to finish a hunt once they committed to it. Dragons, eldritch horrors, ancient predators, and creatures thought impossible to slay all eventually fell to a single perfectly timed arrow.

Within the Ranger Lodges, Death Shot is regarded as the final lesson every hunter strives toward. It is not a display of overwhelming strength, but the ultimate reward for patience, discipline, and absolute mastery of the hunt. To wield Death Shot is to understand that every creature, no matter how mighty, has a final moment—and a true Ranger will always recognise it.

---

> *"Every hunt begins with hope. Every hunt ends with one perfect arrow."*  
> — **Grand Ranger Elyas Thornwood, First Apex Predator**

None

only a handful of rangers throughout asteria's history have ever mastered the fifth rank of death shot. their names have become legend not because they hunted the greatest beasts, but because they never failed to finish a hunt once they committed to it. dragons, eldritch horrors, ancient predators, and creatures thought impossible to slay all eventually fell to a single perfectly timed arrow.

within the ranger lodges, death shot is regarded as the final lesson every hunter strives toward. it is not a display of overwhelming strength, but the ultimate reward for patience, discipline, and absolute mastery of the hunt. to wield death shot is to understand that every creature, no matter how mighty, has a final moment—and a true ranger will always recognise it.

---

> *"every hunt begins with hope. every hunt ends with one perfect arrow."*  
> — **grand ranger elyas thornwood, first apex predator**

# Divine Aegis

## Overview
When all hope seems lost, you may call upon your patron to manifest a Divine Aegis—a magnificent dome of sacred power that shields those within from the chaos beyond. More than a simple magical barrier, the Divine Aegis represents a fragment of your patron's divine domain, standing as an unyielding sanctuary amidst the fury of battle.

Though every Divine Aegis differs in appearance according to the patron who created it, each serves the same purpose. Some shimmer with radiant light, others swirl with celestial fire, sacred tides, spectral ravens, flourishing vines, crimson blood, or countless other divine manifestations. Whatever its form, those within know they stand beneath the protection of something far greater than themselves.

The Divine Aegis is not merely a wall—it is a declaration that, for a short time, the battlefield itself bends to the will of your patron.

## Rank 1
### Description

When all hope seems lost, you may call upon your patron to manifest a Divine Aegis—a magnificent dome of sacred power that shields those within from the chaos beyond. More than a simple magical barrier, the Divine Aegis represents a fragment of your patron's divine domain, standing as an unyielding sanctuary amidst the fury of battle.

Though every Divine Aegis differs in appearance according to the patron who created it, each serves the same purpose. Some shimmer with radiant light, others swirl with celestial fire, sacred tides, spectral ravens, flourishing vines, crimson blood, or countless other divine manifestations. Whatever its form, those within know they stand beneath the protection of something far greater than themselves.

The Divine Aegis is not merely a wall—it is a declaration that, for a short time, the battlefield itself bends to the will of your patron.

### Effects

- Spend **250 MP** and **30 SP** to create a stationary **Divine Aegis** centred on yourself.
- **Cooldown:** Long Rest.
- The Divine Aegis forms a **6-metre radius dome**.
- The Divine Aegis has **200 HP**.
- All physical and magical damage directed at the barrier is dealt to the Divine Aegis instead.
- When the Divine Aegis reaches **0 HP**, it immediately shatters and disappears.
- Creatures inside the Divine Aegis may leave it freely.
- Once a creature willingly leaves the Divine Aegis, it cannot re-enter that same Divine Aegis.
- The Divine Aegis blocks:
  - Weapon attacks.
  - Ammunition.
  - Magical projectiles.
  - Breath weapons.
  - Area effects that must pass through the barrier.
- Creatures, spells, enchantments, and effects aligned with your patron's **Divine Resonance** may pass through the Divine Aegis unhindered.
- Interactions with creatures and effects aligned with your patron's **Divine Opposition** are determined by your patron's **Religious Page**.
- Additional interactions granted through your patron's **Divine Authority** apply where applicable.

### Lore

Among the greatest miracles ever witnessed upon the battlefields of Asteria, few inspire more hope than the appearance of a Divine Aegis. Entire villages have survived impossible sieges beneath these sacred domes, while wounded champions found precious moments to recover before returning to the fight. To those sheltered within, the barrier is more than protection—it is a visible reminder that their patron has not abandoned them.

Every Divine Aegis reflects the nature of the deity who grants it. Though no two barriers appear alike, each marks the boundary between the mortal world and a fragment of the patron's divine domain. While it stands, the faithful know they are sheltered beneath the watchful gaze of something eternal.

> *"A wall of stone protects the body. A Divine Aegis protects hope itself."*  
> **— High Hierophant Cassiel, Keeper of the Sacred Covenant**

## Rank 2
### Description

Your mastery over the Divine Aegis deepens, allowing your patron's sanctuary to manifest with greater strength and stability. The barrier expands further across the battlefield, sheltering more allies beneath its sacred protection while becoming increasingly difficult for hostile forces to overcome.

Those sheltered within the Aegis stand upon consecrated ground, protected by a fragment of your patron's divine domain. Every strike that crashes against its surface is absorbed by the barrier itself, preserving those inside until its sacred power is finally exhausted. Though the Aegis remains immovable, its presence alone can alter the course of an entire battle.

As your covenant grows stronger, so too does your patron's influence upon the barrier. Its appearance becomes more vivid, its divine presence more overwhelming, and its connection to your patron's element more apparent to both ally and enemy alike.

### Effects

- Spend **300 MP** and **40 SP** to create a stationary **Divine Aegis** centred on yourself.
- **Cooldown:** Long Rest.
- The Divine Aegis forms an **8-metre radius dome**.
- The Divine Aegis has **300 HP**.
- All physical and magical damage directed at the barrier is dealt to the Divine Aegis instead.
- When the Divine Aegis reaches **0 HP**, it immediately shatters and disappears.
- Creatures inside the Divine Aegis may leave it freely.
- Once a creature willingly leaves the Divine Aegis, it cannot re-enter that same Divine Aegis.
- The Divine Aegis blocks:
  - Weapon attacks.
  - Ammunition and siege projectiles.
  - Magical projectiles.
  - Breath weapons.
  - Area effects that must pass through the barrier.
- Creatures, spells, enchantments, and effects aligned with your patron's **Divine Resonance** may pass through the Divine Aegis unhindered.
- Interactions with creatures and effects aligned with your patron's **Divine Opposition** are determined by your patron's **Religious Page**.
- Additional interactions granted through your patron's **Divine Authority** apply where applicable.

### Lore

As a Paladin's covenant strengthens, so too does the sanctuary they are able to summon. What begins as a simple refuge grows into a formidable bastion of divine protection, capable of shielding entire companies from devastation. Many military commanders throughout Asteria have witnessed hopeless battles transformed simply because a Divine Aegis stood between their soldiers and certain destruction.

The ancient chronicles describe these barriers as fragments of the divine realm itself, briefly anchored within the mortal world. While they endure, they remind all who behold them that the gods remain ever watchful over those who uphold their sacred covenants.

> *"Every blow that strikes the Aegis is one that never reaches the innocent within."*  
> **— High Hierophant Cassiel, Keeper of the Sacred Covenant**

## Rank 3
### Description

Your Divine Aegis has grown into a true sanctuary of your patron's will. The barrier no longer serves solely as protection from the chaos beyond—it becomes sacred ground where allies may gather, recover, and prepare for the battles yet to come. While the world outside rages with steel, fire, and magic, those within stand beneath the unwavering protection of your patron.

The dome radiates divine authority unique to the deity who empowers it. To the faithful it is a place of hope and refuge; to their enemies it is an unbreakable reminder that the divine still walks beside its chosen champions. Every strike against the barrier weakens its strength, yet every moment it remains standing preserves the lives of those sheltered within.

Whether raised to defend a wounded ally, hold a strategic position, or weather an overwhelming assault, the Divine Aegis stands as one of the greatest miracles a Paladin can bestow upon the battlefield.

### Effects

- Spend **350 MP** and **50 SP** to create a stationary **Divine Aegis** centred on yourself.
- **Cooldown:** Long Rest.
- The Divine Aegis forms a **10-metre radius dome**.
- The Divine Aegis has **450 HP**.
- All physical and magical damage directed at the barrier is dealt to the Divine Aegis instead.
- When the Divine Aegis reaches **0 HP**, it immediately shatters and disappears.
- Creatures inside the Divine Aegis may leave it freely.
- Once a creature willingly leaves the Divine Aegis, it cannot re-enter that same Divine Aegis.
- Creatures sheltered within the Divine Aegis gain **+2 to Saving Throws against hostile magical effects** originating from outside the barrier.
- The Divine Aegis blocks:
  - Weapon attacks.
  - Ammunition and siege projectiles.
  - Magical projectiles.
  - Breath weapons.
  - Area effects that must pass through the barrier.
- Creatures, spells, enchantments, and effects aligned with your patron's **Divine Resonance** may pass through the Divine Aegis unhindered.
- Interactions with creatures and effects aligned with your patron's **Divine Opposition** are determined by your patron's **Religious Page**.
- Additional interactions granted through your patron's **Divine Authority** apply where applicable.

### Lore

As a Paladin's covenant deepens, the Divine Aegis becomes more than a barrier—it becomes consecrated ground where the faithful gather beneath the watchful gaze of their patron. Ancient chronicles tell of armies surviving impossible sieges because a single champion raised an Aegis that refused to fall until every innocent had escaped.

Many temples teach that the Divine Aegis represents the purest form of protection. It does not exist to imprison or conquer, but to preserve life against overwhelming darkness. Every sanctuary raised upon the battlefield serves as a reminder that hope can endure even when surrounded by despair.

> *"The greatest fortress is not built from stone, but from the promise that those within shall not stand alone."*  
> **— High Hierophant Cassiel, Keeper of the Sacred Covenant**

## Rank 4
### Description

Your Divine Aegis has become a true sanctuary, a sacred refuge where the mortal world briefly yields to the divine authority of your patron. Within its radiant dome, allies find respite from relentless assault while enemies are reminded that even the greatest armies cannot break a covenant blessed by the gods.

The barrier stands unmoving against overwhelming force, absorbing devastating blows that would otherwise shatter those sheltered beneath it. Every strike against its surface echoes like thunder, yet the Aegis endures through the strength of your unwavering faith and the divine power entrusted to you.

Veteran Paladins often use the Divine Aegis not only to defend lives, but to secure battlefields, hold strategic positions, and provide sanctuary during the darkest moments of war.

### Effects

- Spend **400 MP** and **60 SP** to create a stationary **Divine Aegis** centred on yourself.
- **Cooldown:** **Long Rest**.
- The Divine Aegis forms a **12-metre radius dome**.
- The Divine Aegis has **650 HP**.
- All physical and magical damage directed at the barrier is dealt to the Divine Aegis instead.
- When the Divine Aegis reaches **0 HP**, it immediately shatters and disappears.
- Creatures inside the Divine Aegis may leave it freely.
- Once a creature willingly leaves the Divine Aegis, it cannot re-enter that same Divine Aegis.
- Allied creatures inside the Divine Aegis gain **+4 to Saving Throws against hostile magical effects** originating from outside the barrier.
- The Divine Aegis blocks:
  - Weapon attacks.
  - Ammunition and siege projectiles.
  - Magical projectiles.
  - Breath weapons.
  - Area effects that must pass through the barrier.
- Creatures, spells, enchantments, and effects aligned with your patron's **Divine Resonance** may pass through the Divine Aegis unhindered.
- Interactions with creatures and effects aligned with your patron's **Divine Opposition** are determined by your patron's **Religious Page**.
- Additional interactions granted through your patron's **Divine Authority** apply where applicable.

### Lore

Across Asteria, the appearance of a Rank IV Divine Aegis is regarded as a turning point in any battle. Soldiers who witness its formation often rally with renewed courage, knowing that for a precious time they stand beneath the direct protection of a higher power. Entire cities have survived impossible sieges because a single Paladin raised an Aegis that refused to fall.

The oldest scriptures teach that the Divine Aegis is more than a barrier—it is a fragment of the patron's domain brought into the mortal realm. While its walls remain standing, the faithful fight beneath the reassuring certainty that their patron watches over every soul sheltered within.

> *"Where the Divine Aegis stands, despair finds no refuge."*  
> **— High Hierophant Cassiel, Keeper of the Sacred Covenant**

## Rank 5
### Description

Your Divine Aegis has reached its ultimate form, becoming a true manifestation of your patron's divine domain upon the mortal battlefield. Within its radiant walls, allies find sanctuary from devastation while the forces of darkness crash endlessly against an unbreakable testament of faith. Entire armies have rallied beneath such miracles, and legends tell of kingdoms surviving impossible sieges because a single Paladin refused to let the Aegis fall.

The barrier is no longer simply a shield—it is sacred territory. Every strike that shatters against its surface serves as a reminder that divine conviction cannot be broken through force alone. Though your patron's presence lasts only a short time, those fortunate enough to stand beneath the Divine Aegis often describe the experience as standing within the halls of the divine themselves.

Only the greatest champions are ever entrusted with such power. To raise a Rank V Divine Aegis is to demonstrate absolute faith, absolute sacrifice, and an unshakable covenant between patron and protector.

### Effects

- Spend **500 MP** and **70 SP** to create a stationary **Divine Aegis** centred on yourself.
- **Cooldown:** **Long Rest**.
- The Divine Aegis forms a **15-metre radius dome**.
- The Divine Aegis has **1,000 HP**.
- All physical and magical damage directed at the barrier is dealt to the Divine Aegis instead.
- When the Divine Aegis reaches **0 HP**, it immediately shatters and disappears.
- Creatures inside the Divine Aegis may leave it freely.
- Once a creature willingly leaves the Divine Aegis, it cannot re-enter that same Divine Aegis.
- Allied creatures inside the Divine Aegis gain **+4 to Saving Throws** against hostile magical effects originating from outside the barrier.
- Allied creatures inside the Divine Aegis have **Resistance** to damage originating from your patron's **Divine Opposition**.
- The Divine Aegis blocks:
  - Weapon attacks.
  - Ammunition and siege projectiles.
  - Magical projectiles.
  - Breath weapons.
  - Area effects that must pass through the barrier.
- Creatures, spells, enchantments, and effects aligned with your patron's **Divine Resonance** may pass through the Divine Aegis unhindered.
- Interactions with creatures and effects aligned with your patron's **Divine Opposition** are determined by your patron's **Religious Page**.
- Additional interactions granted through your patron's **Divine Authority** apply where applicable.

### Lore

Throughout the recorded history of Asteria, only a handful of Divine Aegises have ever reached this level of perfection. These sacred sanctuaries are remembered not merely as miracles, but as monuments to unwavering faith. They have preserved cities from annihilation, sheltered innocents from catastrophe, and allowed the faithful to endure against impossible odds until hope returned.

The oldest temples teach that the Divine Aegis is the purest expression of a Paladin's oath. It is not raised to win glory or conquer kingdoms, but to preserve life. While its walls stand, those within know that they are protected not by stone or steel, but by the enduring promise of a patron who has not abandoned their champion.

> *"When the Divine Aegis rises, it is not merely a barrier that stands before the darkness—it is the unwavering promise that hope shall endure."*  
> **— High Hierophant Cassiel, Keeper of the Sacred Covenant**

# Divine Aegis

## Overview
When all hope seems lost, you may call upon your patron to manifest a Divine Aegis—a magnificent dome of sacred power that shields those within from the chaos beyond. More than a simple magical barrier, the Divine Aegis represents a fragment of your patron's divine domain, standing as an unyielding sanctuary amidst the fury of battle.

Though every Divine Aegis differs in appearance according to the patron who created it, each serves the same purpose. Some shimmer with radiant light, others swirl with celestial fire, sacred tides, spectral ravens, flourishing vines, crimson blood, or countless other divine manifestations. Whatever its form, those within know they stand beneath the protection of something far greater than themselves.

The Divine Aegis is not merely a wall—it is a declaration that, for a short time, the battlefield itself bends to the will of your patron.

among the greatest miracles ever witnessed upon the battlefields of asteria, few inspire more hope than the appearance of a divine aegis. entire villages have survived impossible sieges beneath these sacred domes, while wounded champions found precious moments to recover before returning to the fight. to those sheltered within, the barrier is more than protection—it is a visible reminder that their patron has not abandoned them.

every divine aegis reflects the nature of the deity who grants it. though no two barriers appear alike, each marks the boundary between the mortal world and a fragment of the patron's divine domain. while it stands, the faithful know they are sheltered beneath the watchful gaze of something eternal.

> *"a wall of stone protects the body. a divine aegis protects hope itself."*  
> **— high hierophant cassiel, keeper of the sacred covenant**

as your covenant grows stronger, so too does your patron's influence upon the barrier. its appearance becomes more vivid, its divine presence more overwhelming, and its connection to your patron's element more apparent to both ally and enemy alike.

# Divine Insight

## Overview
You offer a prayer to your patron, opening your mind to receive a fragment of their divine perception. For a short time, your senses become aligned with the ideals and domains of the deity you serve, granting insight that no mortal could achieve through their own understanding.

The form this insight takes is unique to every patron. A god of knowledge may reveal forgotten truths, a deity of life may perceive sickness and vitality, while a patron of death may sense lingering souls. Patrons of war, justice, nature and countless other domains each grant their own unique perspective upon the world.

Divine Insight does not reveal all things. Instead, it grants only the knowledge your patron chooses to share, allowing faithful servants to better carry out their divine purpose.

## Rank 1
### Description

You offer a prayer to your patron, opening your mind to receive a fragment of their divine perception. For a short time, your senses become aligned with the ideals and domains of the deity you serve, granting insight that no mortal could achieve through their own understanding.

The form this insight takes is unique to every patron. A god of knowledge may reveal forgotten truths, a deity of life may perceive sickness and vitality, while a patron of death may sense lingering souls. Patrons of war, justice, nature and countless other domains each grant their own unique perspective upon the world.

Divine Insight does not reveal all things. Instead, it grants only the knowledge your patron chooses to share, allowing faithful servants to better carry out their divine purpose.

### Effects

- Divine Insight is an **Active Talent**.
- Activate Divine Insight on yourself.
- Gain **Divine Insight I** from your chosen Patron.
- The effects of Divine Insight are determined entirely by your chosen Patron.
- Divine Insight lasts **10 minutes**.
- Divine Insight may interact with **Blessing Aura**, **Channel Divinity**, **Divine Grace**, **Divine Inspiration**, Cleric talents, spells and other Patron abilities where specified by your Patron page.
- Divine Insight can only be activated **once per Short Rest**.

### Lore

Every faith teaches that the gods perceive the world through lenses beyond mortal comprehension. While no Cleric can truly share a deity's limitless awareness, those who have earned their patron's trust may briefly glimpse creation through divine eyes.

These sacred moments have guided pilgrims to forgotten shrines, revealed hidden dangers before catastrophe struck and uncovered truths that would otherwise have remained lost to history. Such revelations are never random; they are gifts bestowed with purpose, reminding every Cleric that true wisdom comes not from seeing everything, but from seeing what their patron wishes them to see.

> *"The gods reveal only what is needed, never what is desired."*

> — High Oracle Seraphine, Keeper of the Celestial Archives

## Rank 2
### Description

Your connection with your patron has deepened, allowing you to receive clearer and more sustained moments of divine revelation. Through focused prayer and unwavering faith, you open your mind to a greater fragment of your patron's awareness, granting insight beyond mortal understanding.

No two patrons reveal the world in the same way. A deity of knowledge may uncover hidden truths and forgotten lore, while a patron of war may reveal tactical opportunities upon the battlefield. Gods of life, death, justice, nature and countless other domains each grant their own sacred perspective, ensuring that every Cleric experiences Divine Insight according to the ideals of the deity they serve.

As your faith grows, your patron entrusts you with increasingly profound guidance. These revelations are never without purpose, providing only the knowledge necessary to fulfil your patron's divine will rather than satisfying idle curiosity.

### Effects

- Divine Insight remains an **Active Talent**.
- Increase the Mana Cost to **75 MP**.
- Increase the Duration to **15 minutes**.
- Activate Divine Insight on yourself.
- Gain **Divine Insight II** from your chosen Patron.
- Retain all previously unlocked Divine Insight effects where specified by your Patron page.
- The effects of Divine Insight are determined entirely by your chosen Patron.
- Divine Insight may interact with **Blessing Aura**, **Channel Divinity**, **Divine Grace**, **Divine Inspiration**, Cleric talents, spells and other Patron abilities where specified by your Patron page.
- Divine Insight can only be activated **once per Short Rest**.

### Lore

Among experienced Clerics, Divine Insight is regarded as one of the patron's greatest gifts. It is said that those who seek wisdom with a humble heart are occasionally granted fleeting glimpses of truths that lie beyond the understanding of ordinary mortals. These moments often alter the course of quests, uncover ancient secrets or reveal dangers before they come to pass.

Senior members of the faith teach that Divine Insight should never be used for personal gain. Every revelation carries purpose, and those who abuse their patron's trust soon find that the gods have little reason to continue sharing their wisdom. The wisest Clerics therefore approach every invocation with reverence, accepting that the greatest answers are those freely given, not demanded.

> *"Wisdom is not measured by what you discover, but by what you do with the truths entrusted to you."*
>
> — **Archsage Valerius, Keeper of the Divine Archives**

## Rank 3
### Description

Your unwavering faith allows your patron to share an even greater portion of their divine perception. Upon invoking Divine Insight, your awareness briefly transcends mortal limitations, revealing the world through the unique wisdom of the deity you serve. Every vision, sensation and revelation is shaped by your patron's divine purpose, granting guidance that no amount of study or experience could ever provide.

Each patron grants their insight differently. A deity of justice may reveal deception and hidden guilt, while a god of nature may expose disturbances within the natural world. Patrons of knowledge, war, life, death and countless other divine domains each provide their own perspective, ensuring that Divine Insight remains as unique as the deity from whom it originates.

As your bond continues to deepen, your patron entrusts you with increasingly meaningful revelations. These visions are never random; they are granted to guide your actions, strengthen your faith and aid you in fulfilling the divine purpose entrusted to you.

### Effects

- Divine Insight remains an **Active Talent**.
- Increase the Mana Cost to **90 MP**.
- Increase the Duration to **20 minutes**.
- Activate Divine Insight on yourself.
- Gain **Divine Insight III** from your chosen Patron.
- Retain all previously unlocked Divine Insight effects where specified by your Patron page.
- The effects of Divine Insight are determined entirely by your chosen Patron.
- Divine Insight may interact with **Blessing Aura**, **Channel Divinity**, **Divine Grace**, **Divine Inspiration**, Cleric talents, spells and other Patron abilities where specified by your Patron page.
- Divine Insight can only be activated **once per Short Rest**.

### Lore

Throughout history, the Third Divine Insight has marked the point where a Cleric is recognised as a trusted vessel of their patron's wisdom. Many temples entrust these faithful servants with sacred relics, dangerous expeditions and matters of spiritual importance, knowing that their patron's guidance will illuminate paths hidden from ordinary eyes.

Ancient records tell of Clerics who uncovered forgotten kingdoms, exposed hidden corruption within powerful empires and discovered relics thought lost for millennia through moments of Divine Insight. Yet every account carries the same lesson: the revelation itself was never the reward. Rather, it was the responsibility that followed. Those granted divine knowledge are expected to act upon it with humility, wisdom and unwavering devotion to their patron's will.

> *"To receive divine insight is to accept the responsibility of acting upon divine truth."*
>
> — **High Hierophant Caelus, Keeper of the Eternal Scriptures**

## Rank 4
### Description

Your patron now entrusts you with profound moments of divine revelation, allowing your mind to perceive the world through an even greater measure of their wisdom. When you invoke Divine Insight, your senses transcend ordinary mortal perception, revealing truths that align with your patron's divine domain and sacred purpose.

No two revelations are ever the same. A patron of life may perceive the health and vitality of every living creature, while a deity of war may reveal the flow of battle before a single blow is struck. Gods of knowledge, death, justice, nature and countless other domains each offer their own unique understanding of the world. Every vision is purposeful, revealing only that which serves your patron's will.

By this stage, your patron's guidance has become an invaluable companion. Whether exploring forgotten ruins, confronting powerful foes or seeking answers hidden by mortal limitations, Divine Insight grants clarity where uncertainty once prevailed.

### Effects

- Divine Insight remains an **Active Talent**.
- Increase the Mana Cost to **105 MP**.
- Increase the Duration to **25 minutes**.
- Activate Divine Insight on yourself.
- Gain **Divine Insight IV** from your chosen Patron.
- Retain all previously unlocked Divine Insight effects where specified by your Patron page.
- The effects of Divine Insight are determined entirely by your chosen Patron.
- Divine Insight may interact with **Blessing Aura**, **Channel Divinity**, **Divine Grace**, **Divine Inspiration**, Cleric talents, spells and other Patron abilities where specified by your Patron page.
- Divine Insight can only be activated **once per Short Rest**.

### Lore

Within the grand cathedrals of Asteria, only the most trusted Clerics are believed capable of receiving revelations of this magnitude. Such individuals are often called upon to investigate sacred mysteries, resolve disputes between temples and confront threats that ordinary wisdom cannot overcome. Their patron's guidance has become so refined that even the smallest vision may alter the course of history.

Ancient chronicles tell of High Clerics who uncovered hidden sanctuaries, exposed ancient betrayals and prevented devastating catastrophes after receiving moments of Divine Insight. These stories are not remembered because the visions were extraordinary, but because the faithful possessed the wisdom and courage to act upon them. Every revelation is a sacred responsibility, entrusted only to those who have demonstrated unwavering devotion.

> *"The patron does not reveal the future—they reveal the path that must be walked."*
>
> — **Grand Oracle Lysandra, Keeper of the Celestial Archives**

## Rank 5
### Description

Your faith has reached such extraordinary heights that your patron entrusts you with the fullest expression of their divine perception. When you invoke Divine Insight, your mind becomes a vessel through which your deity briefly observes the mortal world, granting you profound understanding according to their divine domain and sacred purpose.

The revelations bestowed upon you are unique to your patron alone. A deity of knowledge may unveil secrets lost to history, while a patron of justice may expose deception hidden beneath the truth. Gods of war may reveal the flow of conflict, patrons of life may perceive the balance of every living soul, and deities of death may witness the unseen passage between life and the beyond. Every patron grants a perspective that no mortal could ever achieve alone.

Although this gift is immense, your patron reveals only what serves their greater purpose. Divine Insight is not omniscience—it is the privilege of seeing exactly what your patron believes you must know. Those who master this talent become trusted instruments of divine wisdom, carrying their patron's guidance into every corner of Asteria.

### Effects

- Divine Insight remains an **Active Talent**.
- Increase the Mana Cost to **120 MP**.
- Increase the Duration to **30 minutes**.
- Activate Divine Insight on yourself.
- Gain **Divine Insight V** from your chosen Patron.
- Retain all previously unlocked Divine Insight effects where specified by your Patron page.
- The effects of Divine Insight are determined entirely by your chosen Patron.
- Divine Insight may interact with **Blessing Aura**, **Channel Divinity**, **Divine Grace**, **Divine Inspiration**, Cleric talents, spells and other Patron abilities where specified by your Patron page.
- Divine Insight can only be activated **once per Short Rest**.
- You have mastered your Patron's **Divine Insight**.

### Lore

Only the greatest High Clerics are ever said to attain the Fifth Divine Insight. Throughout history, these faithful servants have stood beside kings, guided heroes and uncovered truths that reshaped entire civilizations. Their wisdom was never born from superior intellect alone, but from the humility to seek guidance from the deity they served and the courage to follow wherever that guidance led.

The sacred texts teach that the highest form of Divine Insight is not the ability to see everything, but the wisdom to recognise what truly matters. Every revelation carries responsibility, every vision demands action and every truth revealed must be used in faithful service rather than personal ambition. Those who earn this blessing become living witnesses to their patron's will, forever remembered as beacons of wisdom within their faith.

> *"The greatest revelation is not to know all things, but to understand the one truth your patron asks you to carry into the world."*
>
> — **The Book of Divine Accord**

among experienced clerics, divine insight is regarded as one of the patron's greatest gifts. it is said that those who seek wisdom with a humble heart are occasionally granted fleeting glimpses of truths that lie beyond the understanding of ordinary mortals. these moments often alter the course of quests, uncover ancient secrets or reveal dangers before they come to pass.

senior members of the faith teach that divine insight should never be used for personal gain. every revelation carries purpose, and those who abuse their patron's trust soon find that the gods have little reason to continue sharing their wisdom. the wisest clerics therefore approach every invocation with reverence, accepting that the greatest answers are those freely given, not demanded.

> *"wisdom is not measured by what you discover, but by what you do with the truths entrusted to you."*
>
> — **archsage valerius, keeper of the divine archives**

## rank 3

your unwavering faith allows your patron to share an even greater portion of their divine perception. upon invoking divine insight, your awareness briefly transcends mortal limitations, revealing the world through the unique wisdom of the deity you serve. every vision, sensation and revelation is shaped by your patron's divine purpose, granting guidance that no amount of study or experience could ever provide.

each patron grants their insight differently. a deity of justice may reveal deception and hidden guilt, while a god of nature may expose disturbances within the natural world. patrons of knowledge, war, life, death and countless other divine domains each provide their own perspective, ensuring that divine insight remains as unique as the deity from whom it originates.

as your bond continues to deepen, your patron entrusts you with increasingly meaningful revelations. these visions are never random; they are granted to guide your actions, strengthen your faith and aid you in fulfilling the divine purpose entrusted to you.

- divine insight remains an **active talent**.
- increase the mana cost to **90 mp**.
- increase the duration to **20 minutes**.

- gain **divine insight iii** from your chosen patron.

- divine insight may interact with **blessing aura**, **channel divinity**, **divine grace**, **divine inspiration**, cleric talents, spells and other patron abilities where specified by your patron page.

throughout history, the third divine insight has marked the point where a cleric is recognised as a trusted vessel of their patron's wisdom. many temples entrust these faithful servants with sacred relics, dangerous expeditions and matters of spiritual importance, knowing that their patron's guidance will illuminate paths hidden from ordinary eyes.

ancient records tell of clerics who uncovered forgotten kingdoms, exposed hidden corruption within powerful empires and discovered relics thought lost for millennia through moments of divine insight. yet every account carries the same lesson: the revelation itself was never the reward. rather, it was the responsibility that followed. those granted divine knowledge are expected to act upon it with humility, wisdom and unwavering devotion to their patron's will.

> *"to receive divine insight is to accept the responsibility of acting upon divine truth."*
>
> — **high hierophant caelus, keeper of the eternal scriptures**

your patron now entrusts you with profound moments of divine revelation, allowing your mind to perceive the world through an even greater measure of their wisdom. when you invoke divine insight, your senses transcend ordinary mortal perception, revealing truths that align with your patron's divine domain and sacred purpose.

no two revelations are ever the same. a patron of life may perceive the health and vitality of every living creature, while a deity of war may reveal the flow of battle before a single blow is struck. gods of knowledge, death, justice, nature and countless other domains each offer their own unique understanding of the world. every vision is purposeful, revealing only that which serves your patron's will.

by this stage, your patron's guidance has become an invaluable companion. whether exploring forgotten ruins, confronting powerful foes or seeking answers hidden by mortal limitations, divine insight grants clarity where uncertainty once prevailed.

> *"the patron does not reveal the future—they reveal the path that must be walked."*

your faith has reached such extraordinary heights that your patron entrusts you with the fullest expression of their divine perception. when you invoke divine insight, your mind becomes a vessel through which your deity briefly observes the mortal world, granting you profound understanding according to their divine domain and sacred purpose.

the revelations bestowed upon you are unique to your patron alone. a deity of knowledge may unveil secrets lost to history, while a patron of justice may expose deception hidden beneath the truth. gods of war may reveal the flow of conflict, patrons of life may perceive the balance of every living soul, and deities of death may witness the unseen passage between life and the beyond. every patron grants a perspective that no mortal could ever achieve alone.

# Divine Inspiration

## Overview
You call upon your patron to bestow a fragment of their divine will upon a creature within range. This blessing is not universal, but a direct expression of the deity you serve. Every patron grants inspiration differently, reflecting their ideals, domains and sacred purpose.

Whether offering hope, courage, wisdom, judgement or countless other divine gifts, Divine Inspiration allows your patron's influence to reach beyond yourself and touch another. The exact nature of this blessing is defined by your Patron page, ensuring every Cleric's Divine Inspiration remains unique to the deity they follow.

As your faith deepens, your patron entrusts you with increasingly powerful expressions of their divine inspiration, allowing this sacred gift to grow alongside your journey.

## Rank 1
### Description

You call upon your patron to bestow a fragment of their divine will upon a creature within range. This blessing is not universal, but a direct expression of the deity you serve. Every patron grants inspiration differently, reflecting their ideals, domains and sacred purpose.

Whether offering hope, courage, wisdom, judgement or countless other divine gifts, Divine Inspiration allows your patron's influence to reach beyond yourself and touch another. The exact nature of this blessing is defined by your Patron page, ensuring every Cleric's Divine Inspiration remains unique to the deity they follow.

As your faith deepens, your patron entrusts you with increasingly powerful expressions of their divine inspiration, allowing this sacred gift to grow alongside your journey.

### Effects

- Divine Inspiration is a **Cantrip**.
- Target one creature within range.
- Apply **Divine Inspiration I** from your chosen Patron.
- The effects of Divine Inspiration are determined entirely by your chosen Patron.
- Divine Inspiration may interact with **Blessing Aura**, **Channel Divinity**, **Divine Grace**, Cleric talents, spells and other Patron abilities where specified by your Patron page.
- A creature may only be affected by one instance of Divine Inspiration at a time.
- Recasting this ability refreshes its duration.

### Lore

The scriptures tell that the gods rarely speak directly to mortals. Instead, they entrust fragments of their wisdom, conviction and purpose to those who faithfully carry out their will. Through Divine Inspiration, a Cleric becomes the vessel through which that sacred influence reaches the world, allowing others to briefly experience the guiding hand of the divine.

> *"The faithful do not create inspiration—they carry it from the heavens."*
>
> — *The Book of Divine Accord*

## Rank 2
### Description

Your patron's voice grows clearer as your faith deepens, allowing you to bestow a greater measure of their divine influence upon another. What was once a fleeting blessing now lingers with increased strength, giving your patron's will more time to shape the actions of the creature you inspire.

Every patron grants Divine Inspiration according to their own divine nature. Some kindle unwavering courage before battle, others grant profound wisdom, restore hope, instil righteous conviction or pronounce sacred judgement. No two patrons inspire in the same way, for every blessing is a reflection of the deity who grants it.

As your connection to your patron strengthens, so too does your ability to act as their chosen vessel. Those touched by your Divine Inspiration become living examples of your patron's influence, carrying a fragment of their divine purpose wherever they go until the blessing fades.

### Effects

- Divine Inspiration remains a **Cantrip**.
- Increase the Mana Cost to **20 MP**.
- Increase the Range to **20 metres**.
- Increase the Duration to **4 rounds**.
- Target one creature within range.
- Apply **Divine Inspiration II** from your chosen Patron.
- Retain all previously unlocked Divine Inspiration effects where specified by your Patron page.
- The effects of Divine Inspiration are determined entirely by your chosen Patron.
- Divine Inspiration may interact with **Blessing Aura**, **Channel Divinity**, **Divine Grace**, Cleric talents, spells and other Patron abilities where specified by your Patron page.
- A creature may only be affected by one instance of Divine Inspiration at a time.
- Recasting Divine Inspiration refreshes its duration.

### Lore

Among experienced Clerics, Divine Inspiration is regarded as one of the purest expressions of a patron's favour. Rather than performing miracles directly, the deity works through those they have chosen, allowing fragments of their will to guide faithful servants and worthy souls alike.

Many legends tell of ordinary people accomplishing extraordinary deeds after receiving a Cleric's blessing. Whether standing against overwhelming darkness, uncovering forgotten truths or showing unexpected compassion, these moments are remembered not as acts of chance, but as quiet reminders that the gods continue to shape the world through those devoted to their service.

> *"The greatest blessings are not always the loudest. Often, they are the quiet voice that gives a soul the strength to take one more step."*
>
> — **High Priest Althoran, Keeper of the Sacred Covenant**

## Rank 3
### Description

Your bond with your patron has grown into a powerful conduit for divine influence. Through a simple prayer or sacred invocation, you may call forth a greater measure of your patron's inspiration, allowing their will to shape the destiny of another creature. The blessing has become more enduring, carrying the authority and purpose of the deity who bestowed it.

Every patron inspires in a different way. A deity of war may awaken indomitable resolve, while a patron of knowledge may illuminate the mind with unparalleled clarity. Gods of life, death, nature, justice and countless other divine domains each grant their own unique expression of Divine Inspiration, ensuring that no two Clerics wield the same blessing.

Those touched by your Divine Inspiration often find themselves accomplishing feats they once believed impossible. Whether through courage, wisdom, resilience or another sacred gift, they become temporary vessels for your patron's influence, carrying a fragment of divine purpose into the challenges that lie ahead.

### Effects

- Divine Inspiration remains a **Cantrip**.
- Increase the Mana Cost to **25 MP**.
- Increase the Range to **25 metres**.
- Increase the Duration to **5 rounds**.
- Target one creature within range.
- Apply **Divine Inspiration III** from your chosen Patron.
- Retain all previously unlocked Divine Inspiration effects where specified by your Patron page.
- The effects of Divine Inspiration are determined entirely by your chosen Patron.
- Divine Inspiration may interact with **Blessing Aura**, **Channel Divinity**, **Divine Grace**, Cleric talents, spells and other Patron abilities where specified by your Patron page.
- A creature may only be affected by one instance of Divine Inspiration at a time.
- Recasting Divine Inspiration refreshes its duration.

### Lore

Within the oldest temples of Asteria, Divine Inspiration is described as the sacred language through which the gods encourage their faithful without ever speaking a single word. Rather than commanding their followers directly, the patrons entrust fragments of their divine purpose to devoted Clerics, who in turn pass those blessings to others.

Those who receive such inspiration rarely describe it as overwhelming power. Instead, they speak of perfect certainty—a moment where fear fades, doubt disappears and every action feels guided by something far greater than themselves. These experiences often become lifelong memories, strengthening not only the recipient's resolve but also their faith in the patron whose grace reached them through the Cleric.

> *"The gods need not raise their voices. A single moment of true inspiration can change the course of a lifetime."*
>
> — **Saint Elyndor, Herald of the Divine Path**

## Rank 4
### Description

Your patron's favour flows through you with remarkable clarity, allowing you to bestow a profound expression of their divine will upon another creature. The inspiration you invoke is no longer a fleeting blessing but a powerful manifestation of the sacred bond between deity and disciple. Those touched by your patron's grace become living reflections of the ideals your faith represents.

No two patrons inspire in the same manner. A deity of justice may embolden unwavering conviction, while a god of nature may awaken harmony with the world around them. Patrons of war, knowledge, life, death and countless other divine domains each grant unique blessings that shape the actions and destiny of those they touch.

As your connection with your patron continues to deepen, your Divine Inspiration becomes one of the clearest demonstrations of their presence within the mortal realm. Those who receive your blessing often speak of renewed purpose, unwavering certainty and a sense that a higher power walks beside them, guiding every step they take.

### Effects

- Divine Inspiration remains a **Cantrip**.
- Increase the Mana Cost to **30 MP**.
- Increase the Range to **30 metres**.
- Increase the Duration to **6 rounds**.
- Target one creature within range.
- Apply **Divine Inspiration IV** from your chosen Patron.
- Retain all previously unlocked Divine Inspiration effects where specified by your Patron page.
- The effects of Divine Inspiration are determined entirely by your chosen Patron.
- Divine Inspiration may interact with **Blessing Aura**, **Channel Divinity**, **Divine Grace**, Cleric talents, spells and other Patron abilities where specified by your Patron page.
- A creature may only be affected by one instance of Divine Inspiration at a time.
- Recasting Divine Inspiration refreshes its duration.

### Lore

The Fourth Inspiration is regarded by many temples as a sacred milestone, reserved for Clerics whose devotion has remained unwavering through countless trials. By this stage, the patron's influence has become so refined that their blessing is recognised as more than divine magic—it is a direct expression of their will entrusted to mortal hands.

Throughout history, kings, generals and humble pilgrims alike have sought the blessing of such Clerics before undertaking journeys that would shape the fate of nations. Though each patron grants different gifts, every Divine Inspiration carries the same truth: the gods continue to guide the world through those who faithfully answer their call.

To receive such a blessing is considered a privilege. To bestow it is considered one of the greatest responsibilities a Cleric can bear.

> *"The greatest honour a servant can receive is to carry the will of their patron into the hearts of another."*
>
> — **Grand Hierophant Seraphiel, Voice of the Sacred Assembly**

## Rank 5
### Description

You have mastered the sacred art of Divine Inspiration, becoming one of the few mortals capable of serving as a flawless conduit for your patron's will. With a single invocation, you may call forth the greatest expression of your deity's inspiration, allowing their divine influence to rest upon another creature with unmatched strength and clarity.

The form this inspiration takes is determined entirely by your patron. Some grant unwavering courage in the face of impossible odds, others bestow profound wisdom, righteous judgement, serene compassion or fearsome conviction. Every patron's inspiration is unique, reflecting the ideals and purpose of the deity from whom it originates. No two Clerics share the same blessing unless they serve the same divine power.

Those who receive your Divine Inspiration often describe the experience as standing beside their patron themselves. Doubt fades, purpose becomes absolute and every action feels guided by a higher calling. Though the blessing eventually passes, its effects are often remembered for a lifetime, inspiring unwavering faith in those fortunate enough to receive it.

### Effects

- Divine Inspiration remains a **Cantrip**.
- Increase the Mana Cost to **35 MP**.
- Increase the Range to **35 metres**.
- Increase the Duration to **8 rounds**.
- Target one creature within range.
- Apply **Divine Inspiration V** from your chosen Patron.
- Retain all previously unlocked Divine Inspiration effects where specified by your Patron page.
- The effects of Divine Inspiration are determined entirely by your chosen Patron.
- Divine Inspiration may interact with **Blessing Aura**, **Channel Divinity**, **Divine Grace**, Cleric talents, spells and other Patron abilities where specified by your Patron page.
- A creature may only be affected by one instance of Divine Inspiration at a time.
- Recasting Divine Inspiration refreshes its duration.
- You have mastered your Patron's **Divine Inspiration**.

### Lore

Among the greatest legends of Asteria are tales of High Clerics whose words alone rekindled hope in broken armies, calmed kingdoms on the brink of collapse or inspired ordinary people to perform extraordinary acts of courage. While many believed these deeds were miracles, the faithful understood they were the highest expression of Divine Inspiration—a patron working through their chosen servant.

To master this blessing is to accept that you are not the source of divine power, but its vessel. Every prayer spoken, every blessing bestowed and every soul inspired serves as a reminder that the gods continue to shape the world through those who dedicate their lives to faithful service.

The greatest Clerics do not seek glory for themselves. They simply ensure that, wherever they travel, their patron's wisdom, purpose and inspiration continue to guide those who need it most.

> *"The greatest gift a god can grant is not power, but the ability to awaken greatness within another."*
>
> — **The Book of Divine Accord**

None

the form this inspiration takes is determined entirely by your patron. some grant unwavering courage in the face of impossible odds, others bestow profound wisdom, righteous judgement, serene compassion or fearsome conviction. every patron's inspiration is unique, reflecting the ideals and purpose of the deity from whom it originates. no two clerics share the same blessing unless they serve the same divine power.

those who receive your divine inspiration often describe the experience as standing beside their patron themselves. doubt fades, purpose becomes absolute and every action feels guided by a higher calling. though the blessing eventually passes, its effects are often remembered for a lifetime, inspiring unwavering faith in those fortunate enough to receive it.

### effects

- divine inspiration remains a **cantrip**.
- increase the mana cost to **35 mp**.
- increase the range to **35 metres**.
- increase the duration to **8 rounds**.
- target one creature within range.
- apply **divine inspiration v** from your chosen patron.
- retain all previously unlocked divine inspiration effects where specified by your patron page.
- the effects of divine inspiration are determined entirely by your chosen patron.
- divine inspiration may interact with **blessing aura**, **channel divinity**, **divine grace**, cleric talents, spells and other patron abilities where specified by your patron page.
- a creature may only be affected by one instance of divine inspiration at a time.
- recasting divine inspiration refreshes its duration.
- you have mastered your patron's **divine inspiration**.

### lore

among the greatest legends of asteria are tales of high clerics whose words alone rekindled hope in broken armies, calmed kingdoms on the brink of collapse or inspired ordinary people to perform extraordinary acts of courage. while many believed these deeds were miracles, the faithful understood they were the highest expression of divine inspiration—a patron working through their chosen servant.

to master this blessing is to accept that you are not the source of divine power, but its vessel. every prayer spoken, every blessing bestowed and every soul inspired serves as a reminder that the gods continue to shape the world through those who dedicate their lives to faithful service.

the greatest clerics do not seek glory for themselves. they simply ensure that, wherever they travel, their patron's wisdom, purpose and inspiration continue to guide those who need it most.

> *"the greatest gift a god can grant is not power, but the ability to awaken greatness within another."*
>
> — **the book of divine accord**
