# Divine Nova

## Overview
When the battle reaches its darkest hour, you may call upon your patron to release a devastating surge of divine power from your very soul. This sacred eruption, known throughout Asteria as a Divine Nova, unleashes divine judgement upon those who oppose your patron while simultaneously blessing those who stand within their divine favour.

No two Divine Novae are ever identical. Every patron manifests this miracle according to their own divine nature. Some erupt as radiant light, others as crimson blood, spectral ravens, celestial fire, sacred waters, blooming life, or countless other divine manifestations. Though their appearance differs, every Divine Nova carries the unmistakable presence of the deity who bestowed it.

Those aligned with your patron's Divine Resonance feel warmth, strength, and renewed vitality. Those aligned with your patron's Divine Opposition experience the full weight of divine judgement, suffering the wrath of the covenant you have sworn to uphold.

## Rank 1
### Description

When the battle reaches its darkest hour, you may call upon your patron to release a devastating surge of divine power from your very soul. This sacred eruption, known throughout Asteria as a Divine Nova, unleashes divine judgement upon those who oppose your patron while simultaneously blessing those who stand within their divine favour.

No two Divine Novae are ever identical. Every patron manifests this miracle according to their own divine nature. Some erupt as radiant light, others as crimson blood, spectral ravens, celestial fire, sacred waters, blooming life, or countless other divine manifestations. Though their appearance differs, every Divine Nova carries the unmistakable presence of the deity who bestowed it.

Those aligned with your patron's Divine Resonance feel warmth, strength, and renewed vitality. Those aligned with your patron's Divine Opposition experience the full weight of divine judgement, suffering the wrath of the covenant you have sworn to uphold.

### Effects

- Spend **150 MP** and **40 SP** to unleash a **Divine Nova** centred on yourself.
- **Cooldown:** **Long Rest**.
- The Divine Nova affects all creatures within a **10-metre radius**.
- Creatures aligned with your patron's **Divine Opposition** suffer **4d8 Patron Damage**.
- Creatures aligned with your patron's **Divine Resonance** recover **2d6 HP**.
- The **damage type**, **creatures affected**, and **visual manifestation** are determined by your chosen patron's **Religious Page**.
- Creatures with immunity, resistance, or vulnerability to your patron's damage type resolve those interactions normally.
- Additional effects granted by your patron's **Divine Authority** apply where applicable.

### Lore

Among the greatest miracles recorded throughout Asteria's history, few are spoken of with greater reverence than the Divine Nova. It is said that, for but a single heartbeat, the veil between the mortal realm and the divine grows impossibly thin, allowing a patron's will to manifest through their most devoted champion.

Those who have witnessed such miracles rarely remember the destruction alone. Instead, they speak of the overwhelming presence that accompanied it—a feeling of standing before something infinitely greater than themselves. To the faithful, it is a reminder that while mortals wage war upon the world, the gods still watch over the fate of every soul.

> *"A Divine Nova is not born from anger, nor from vengeance. It is the moment a patron reminds the world that their will still shapes the course of history."*  
> **— High Hierophant Cassiel, Keeper of the Sacred Covenant**

## Rank 2
### Description

Your Divine Nova grows in both power and reach, allowing a greater portion of your patron's will to manifest upon the battlefield. The divine energy surging through your body erupts with overwhelming force, bringing swift judgement to those who oppose your patron while extending a sacred blessing to those who stand within their favour.

Though every Divine Nova reflects the nature of its patron, its purpose remains unchanged—to remind the world that divine power is neither indiscriminate nor without purpose. Those who walk in harmony with your patron are renewed by its presence, while those who embody your patron's Divine Opposition are struck by righteous judgement.

Each invocation strengthens your connection to your patron, allowing more of their divine essence to briefly touch the mortal realm before fading once more.

### Effects

- Spend **200 MP** and **50 SP** to unleash a **Divine Nova** centred on yourself.
- **Cooldown:** **Long Rest**.
- The Divine Nova affects all creatures within a **12-metre radius**.
- Creatures aligned with your patron's **Divine Opposition** suffer **6d8 Patron Damage**.
- Creatures aligned with your patron's **Divine Resonance** recover **3d6 HP**.
- The **damage type**, **creatures affected**, and **visual manifestation** are determined by your chosen patron's **Religious Page**.
- Creatures with immunity, resistance, or vulnerability to your patron's damage type resolve those interactions normally.
- Additional effects granted through your patron's **Divine Authority** apply where applicable.

### Lore

Only those whose faith has deepened through countless trials are capable of unleashing a Divine Nova of this magnitude. Ancient texts describe these miracles as moments where the boundary between deity and disciple becomes almost imperceptible, allowing the patron's judgement to wash across the battlefield in a single overwhelming surge.

Witnesses often describe an indescribable feeling accompanying the Nova—an overwhelming certainty that they stood in the presence of something infinitely greater than themselves. Whether experienced as hope, fear, peace, or awe depends entirely upon the relationship between the observer and the patron whose will has been revealed.

> *"When a Divine Nova blossoms across the battlefield, even kings remember that every throne exists beneath the gaze of the gods."*  
> **— High Hierophant Cassiel, Keeper of the Sacred Covenant**

## Rank 3
### Description

Your Divine Nova has become a miracle worthy of the greatest champions of your patron. No longer merely a burst of divine energy, it becomes a sweeping manifestation of your patron's will, surging across the battlefield with overwhelming force. Allies embraced by your patron's favour are renewed by its sacred power, while those who stand in opposition are struck by uncompromising divine judgement.

Each invocation leaves little doubt as to whom you serve. Whether it appears as radiant light, celestial fire, spectral ravens, sacred waters, blooming life, crimson blood, or another divine manifestation, every Divine Nova carries the unmistakable presence of your chosen patron. For a single moment, the battlefield becomes an extension of their divine domain.

Those who survive such miracles often remember not the pain nor the healing, but the overwhelming sensation of standing in the presence of a power far beyond mortal comprehension.

### Effects

- Spend **250 MP** and **60 SP** to unleash a **Divine Nova** centred on yourself.
- **Cooldown:** **Long Rest**.
- The Divine Nova affects all creatures within a **15-metre radius**.
- Creatures aligned with your patron's **Divine Opposition** suffer **8d8 Patron Damage**.
- Creatures aligned with your patron's **Divine Resonance** recover **4d6 HP**.
- The **damage type**, **creatures affected**, and **visual manifestation** are determined by your chosen patron's **Religious Page**.
- Creatures with immunity, resistance, or vulnerability to your patron's damage type resolve those interactions normally.
- Additional effects granted through your patron's **Divine Authority** apply where applicable.

### Lore

Throughout history, only the most devoted Paladins have wielded a Divine Nova of this magnitude. Entire battles have been remembered for the single instant in which a champion called upon their patron's power, forever changing the course of the conflict. Such miracles remind both ally and enemy alike that the gods do not merely watch the world—they are capable of shaping its destiny through those who have earned their favour.

Within the grand temples of Asteria, these moments are studied not as acts of destruction, but as manifestations of divine purpose. Every Divine Nova serves as a reminder that the covenant between patron and champion is more than faith alone—it is a sacred bond capable of briefly allowing the will of the divine to touch the mortal realm.

> *"When a champion becomes the voice of their patron, even the battlefield falls silent to bear witness."*  
> **— High Hierophant Cassiel, Keeper of the Sacred Covenant**

## Rank 4
### Description

Your Divine Nova has become one of the greatest miracles your patron is willing to bestow upon a mortal champion. When invoked, divine power erupts from your soul in a breathtaking wave of sacred energy, washing across the battlefield with overwhelming force. For a fleeting moment, your patron's presence becomes undeniable as divine judgement falls upon those who stand in opposition while faithful allies are embraced by a surge of restorative grace.

Though every Divine Nova shares the same purpose, no two manifestations are ever alike. Some blaze with celestial radiance, others surge with raging infernos, spectral ravens, sacred tides, flourishing life, crimson blood, or countless other divine expressions. Regardless of its form, every Nova carries the unmistakable authority of the deity who empowers it.

Veteran warriors often claim that witnessing a Divine Nova changes them forever. Some describe overwhelming peace, others terrifying awe, but all leave the battlefield certain they have stood in the presence of the divine.

### Effects

- Spend **300 MP** and **70 SP** to unleash a **Divine Nova** centred on yourself.
- **Cooldown:** **Long Rest**.
- The Divine Nova affects all creatures within an **18-metre radius**.
- Creatures aligned with your patron's **Divine Opposition** suffer **10d8 Patron Damage**.
- Creatures aligned with your patron's **Divine Resonance** recover **5d6 HP**.
- The **damage type**, **creatures affected**, and **visual manifestation** are determined by your chosen patron's **Religious Page**.
- Creatures with immunity, resistance, or vulnerability to your patron's damage type resolve those interactions normally.
- Additional effects granted through your patron's **Divine Authority** apply where applicable.

### Lore

Only a handful of champions throughout Asteria's history have ever unleashed a Divine Nova of this magnitude. Entire wars have turned upon a single invocation, where the overwhelming manifestation of a patron's will inspired faithful armies while breaking the resolve of those who stood against them. Such miracles are forever remembered within the sacred histories of every temple.

The High Orders teach that a Divine Nova is never an act of anger or vengeance. It is a declaration that the covenant between patron and champion has reached such strength that, for one brief moment, a fragment of the divine is permitted to reshape the battlefield according to the patron's will.

> *"When the heavens answer a champion's call, the world remembers that mortals wage war only by the grace of the gods."*  
> **— High Hierophant Cassiel, Keeper of the Sacred Covenant**

## Rank 5
### Description

Your Divine Nova has reached its ultimate form, becoming one of the greatest miracles your patron may bestow upon a mortal champion. With a single invocation, an overwhelming surge of divine power erupts from your soul, transforming the battlefield into a fleeting reflection of your patron's domain. For a single, breathtaking moment, the mortal realm bears witness to the majesty of the divine.

Every Divine Nova is unique to the deity who grants it. Some burst forth as blinding celestial radiance, others as roaring infernos, sacred tides, spectral ravens, flourishing life, crimson blood, or manifestations beyond mortal understanding. Though each appears differently, all carry the same unmistakable truth—the will of your patron has descended upon the battlefield.

To allies who walk in harmony with your patron, the Nova is a blessing that restores hope and strength. To those who embody your patron's Divine Opposition, it is a reminder that even the mightiest mortal cannot stand forever against divine judgement.

### Effects

- Spend **400 MP** and **80 SP** to unleash a **Divine Nova** centred on yourself.
- **Cooldown:** **Long Rest**.
- The Divine Nova affects all creatures within a **20-metre radius**.
- Creatures aligned with your patron's **Divine Opposition** suffer **12d8 Patron Damage**.
- Creatures aligned with your patron's **Divine Resonance** recover **6d6 HP**.
- The **damage type**, **creatures affected**, and **visual manifestation** are determined by your chosen patron's **Religious Page**.
- Creatures with immunity, resistance, or vulnerability to your patron's damage type resolve those interactions normally.
- Additional effects granted through your patron's **Divine Authority** apply where applicable.

### Lore

Legends tell of only a handful of Divine Novae ever reaching this level of power. Entire generations remember the places where these miracles occurred, often marking them as sacred ground where the veil between the mortal and divine worlds briefly grew impossibly thin. Whether remembered as acts of salvation or judgement depends entirely upon which side of the covenant witnessed the miracle.

The High Temples teach that a Rank V Divine Nova is not merely an expression of power, but the ultimate affirmation of trust between deity and champion. Such a miracle can only be performed by one whose faith has remained unwavering through every trial, every sacrifice, and every battle fought in the patron's name.

> *"For one heartbeat, the world remembers that the gods are not myths, but living powers whose will still echoes across creation through those worthy enough to bear their light."*  
> **— High Hierophant Cassiel, Keeper of the Sacred Covenant**

None

# Divine Restoration

## Overview
You call upon your patron to restore a creature touched by divine purpose. Unlike ordinary restorative magic, Divine Restoration does not possess a universal effect. Instead, your patron grants the form of restoration most closely aligned with their divine domain and sacred ideals.

A patron of life may mend wounds and cure afflictions, while a patron of knowledge may restore clarity to a troubled mind. Gods of war may renew a warrior's endurance, patrons of nature may restore harmony to body and spirit, and deities of death may grant peaceful release from lingering curses or unnatural suffering. Every act of restoration is unique, reflecting the will of the patron who answers your prayer.

As your faith deepens, your patron entrusts you with increasingly powerful forms of Divine Restoration, allowing your blessings to better fulfil their divine purpose.

## Rank 1
### Description

You call upon your patron to restore a creature touched by divine purpose. Unlike ordinary restorative magic, Divine Restoration does not possess a universal effect. Instead, your patron grants the form of restoration most closely aligned with their divine domain and sacred ideals.

A patron of life may mend wounds and cure afflictions, while a patron of knowledge may restore clarity to a troubled mind. Gods of war may renew a warrior's endurance, patrons of nature may restore harmony to body and spirit, and deities of death may grant peaceful release from lingering curses or unnatural suffering. Every act of restoration is unique, reflecting the will of the patron who answers your prayer.

As your faith deepens, your patron entrusts you with increasingly powerful forms of Divine Restoration, allowing your blessings to better fulfil their divine purpose.

### Effects

- Divine Restoration is an **Active Talent**.
- Target one creature within range.
- Gain access to **Divine Restoration I** from your chosen Patron.
- The effects of Divine Restoration are determined entirely by your chosen Patron.
- Divine Restoration may interact with **Blessing Aura**, **Channel Divinity**, **Divine Grace**, **Divine Inspiration**, **Divine Insight**, Cleric talents, spells and other Patron abilities where specified by your Patron page.
- Divine Restoration can only be activated **once per Short Rest**.

### Lore

Every faith teaches that true restoration is more than repairing wounds—it is returning something to the state intended by the divine. Whether restoring flesh, spirit, resolve or balance, each patron heals according to their own sacred purpose.

The oldest scriptures tell of Clerics whose prayers restored far more than broken bodies. They rekindled hope within the hopeless, renewed courage in the defeated and brought harmony where corruption had taken root. Such miracles remind the faithful that restoration is not measured by what is repaired, but by what is made whole once again.

> *"The gods restore not what we desire, but what they deem worthy of renewal."*
>
> — **The Book of Divine Accord**

## Rank 2
### Description

Your patron entrusts you with a greater expression of their restorative power, allowing you to call upon blessings that reach beyond the limitations of mortal magic. As your devotion deepens, your prayers carry greater weight, enabling your patron to restore those in need according to their divine purpose.

The nature of this restoration remains unique to every deity. A patron of life may heal deeper wounds and purge greater afflictions, while a god of knowledge may restore forgotten memories or mental clarity. Patrons of war may renew a warrior's resolve, deities of nature may restore balance to corrupted lands or creatures, and gods of death may free souls from unnatural torment. Each act of restoration reflects the values of the patron who grants it rather than following a universal definition of healing.

By invoking Divine Restoration, you become a conduit through which your patron renews what they believe should be made whole. Every blessing serves a purpose beyond simple recovery, reinforcing the ideals and responsibilities of the faith you represent.

### Effects

- Divine Restoration remains an **Active Talent**.
- Increase the Mana Cost to **65 MP**.
- Increase the Range to **20 metres**.
- Target one creature within range.
- Gain access to **Divine Restoration II** from your chosen Patron.
- Retain all previously unlocked Divine Restoration effects where specified by your Patron page.
- The effects of Divine Restoration are determined entirely by your chosen Patron.
- Divine Restoration may interact with **Blessing Aura**, **Channel Divinity**, **Divine Grace**, **Divine Inspiration**, **Divine Insight**, Cleric talents, spells and other Patron abilities where specified by your Patron page.
- Divine Restoration can only be activated **once per Short Rest**.

### Lore

The faithful teach that restoration is not measured by how much power is wielded, but by the wisdom behind its use. Every patron restores the world according to their own vision of balance, and every blessing is granted with deliberate purpose. Experienced Clerics learn that the greatest miracles often repair far more than flesh, mending broken spirits, shattered convictions or bonds thought forever lost.

Those who reach this stage of Divine Restoration are often entrusted with responsibilities beyond the battlefield. They become healers, judges, counsellors and guides, called upon whenever something precious has been damaged and only divine intervention can begin the process of making it whole once more.

> *"A miracle is not the act of restoring what was lost, but knowing what must be restored first."*
>
> — **High Priest Alaric, Keeper of the Sacred Covenant**

## Rank 3
### Description

Your unwavering devotion has strengthened the sacred bond between yourself and your patron, allowing their restorative power to flow through you with far greater purpose. When you invoke Divine Restoration, you do not simply mend or recover—you become the instrument through which your deity restores what they believe should be made whole.

The form this restoration takes is entirely determined by your patron. A deity of life may mend grievous wounds or purge debilitating afflictions, while a patron of knowledge may restore forgotten memories or sharpen a clouded mind. Gods of war may rekindle a warrior's spirit, patrons of nature may restore harmony to corrupted life, and deities of death may ease unnatural suffering or return balance where death itself has been denied. Every miracle reflects the ideals of the divine being who grants it.

By this stage, your patron entrusts you with increasingly significant acts of restoration. These blessings often change the course of battles, save lives or restore that which seemed beyond recovery, demonstrating that true divine restoration extends far beyond physical healing.

### Effects

- Divine Restoration remains an **Active Talent**.
- Increase the Mana Cost to **80 MP**.
- Increase the Range to **25 metres**.
- Target one creature within range.
- Gain access to **Divine Restoration III** from your chosen Patron.
- Retain all previously unlocked Divine Restoration effects where specified by your Patron page.
- The effects of Divine Restoration are determined entirely by your chosen Patron.
- Divine Restoration may interact with **Blessing Aura**, **Channel Divinity**, **Divine Grace**, **Divine Inspiration**, **Divine Insight**, Cleric talents, spells and other Patron abilities where specified by your Patron page.
- Divine Restoration can only be activated **once per Short Rest**.

### Lore

Throughout Asteria's history, the Third Divine Restoration has marked the point where a Cleric becomes recognised as a true vessel of their patron's mercy and purpose. Their prayers are sought not merely because they possess great power, but because their patron has deemed them worthy of carrying miracles that few others can invoke.

Ancient accounts tell of devoted Clerics restoring hope to kingdoms consumed by despair, freeing souls from ancient curses and renewing sacred places that had fallen into ruin. Though the miracles themselves varied according to the patron, they all shared one truth: restoration is never granted without purpose. Every blessing carries the will of the deity who bestowed it, reminding both Cleric and recipient that divine power exists to uphold the balance their patron seeks within the world.

> *"Only when you understand what has truly been lost can you appreciate the miracle of its restoration."*
>
> — **Saint Aurelian, Keeper of the Sacred Light**

## Rank 4
### Description

Your patron now entrusts you with a profound expression of their restorative power, allowing your prayers to become vessels for miracles few mortals will ever witness. When you invoke Divine Restoration, you call not upon generic divine magic, but upon the unique will of your patron, who chooses what should be restored according to their sacred purpose.

Every deity defines restoration differently. A patron of life may mend devastating injuries or cleanse powerful afflictions, while a god of knowledge may restore forgotten truths and shattered minds. Patrons of war may reignite the spirit of a weary champion, deities of nature may return balance to corrupted creatures and lands, and gods of death may release souls bound by unnatural forces. Each blessing reflects the values and philosophy of the deity who grants it.

As your faith continues to mature, your patron's miracles become increasingly influential. Whether restoring a single life, renewing a sacred place or reversing the effects of powerful supernatural forces, Divine Restoration stands as a testament to the enduring bond between patron and Cleric.

### Effects

- Divine Restoration remains an **Active Talent**.
- Increase the Mana Cost to **95 MP**.
- Increase the Range to **30 metres**.
- Target one creature within range.
- Gain access to **Divine Restoration IV** from your chosen Patron.
- Retain all previously unlocked Divine Restoration effects where specified by your Patron page.
- The effects of Divine Restoration are determined entirely by your chosen Patron.
- Divine Restoration may interact with **Blessing Aura**, **Channel Divinity**, **Divine Grace**, **Divine Inspiration**, **Divine Insight**, Cleric talents, spells and other Patron abilities where specified by your Patron page.
- Divine Restoration can only be activated **once per Short Rest**.

### Lore

Clerics capable of invoking the Fourth Divine Restoration are regarded as living conduits of their patron's mercy and purpose. Their presence is sought during times of great hardship, when ordinary magic has failed and only the direct blessing of a deity can restore what has been lost. Many become guardians of holy sites, advisors to rulers or leaders of sacred pilgrimages, trusted to wield miracles with wisdom and restraint.

The greatest temples teach that true restoration is never about returning the world to what it once was. Instead, it is about guiding it back toward the balance envisioned by the gods. Every miracle granted through Divine Restoration serves this higher purpose, reminding both the Cleric and those they aid that divine power exists not to defy fate, but to fulfil it.

> *"The patron restores not because the world is broken, but because they know what it was always meant to become."*
>
> — **Grand Hierophant Elyndor, Keeper of the Divine Covenant**

## Rank 5
### Description

Your patron has entrusted you with the highest expression of their restorative power, allowing you to invoke miracles that embody their divine purpose in its purest form. Through unwavering faith and absolute devotion, you become the chosen conduit through which your deity restores what they deem worthy, whether it be body, mind, spirit or another aspect of creation unique to their divine domain.

Every patron's Divine Restoration is unlike any other. A deity of life may perform miracles of extraordinary healing, while a patron of knowledge may restore memories thought forever lost. Gods of war may rekindle an indomitable fighting spirit, patrons of nature may return balance to lands scarred by corruption, and deities of death may release souls from unnatural imprisonment. Each miracle is a reflection of the patron's ideals, ensuring that no two Clerics restore the world in exactly the same way.

To master Divine Restoration is to accept that true restoration is never about reversing fate. Instead, it is about fulfilling the divine design envisioned by your patron, restoring what should endure while preserving the balance they seek to maintain throughout Asteria.

### Effects

- Divine Restoration remains an **Active Talent**.
- Increase the Mana Cost to **110 MP**.
- Increase the Range to **35 metres**.
- Target one creature within range.
- Gain access to **Divine Restoration V** from your chosen Patron.
- Retain all previously unlocked Divine Restoration effects where specified by your Patron page.
- The effects of Divine Restoration are determined entirely by your chosen Patron.
- Divine Restoration may interact with **Blessing Aura**, **Channel Divinity**, **Divine Grace**, **Divine Inspiration**, **Divine Insight**, Cleric talents, spells and other Patron abilities where specified by your Patron page.
- Divine Restoration can only be activated **once per Short Rest**.
- You have mastered your Patron's **Divine Restoration**.

### Lore

Only a handful of Clerics throughout history have been recognised as masters of Divine Restoration. Their names are remembered in every major faith, not because of the miracles they performed, but because of the wisdom with which they chose to perform them. Kings sought their counsel, entire nations prayed for their arrival, and even rival faiths respected the sacred authority they carried.

The oldest scriptures teach that the greatest miracle is not the restoration itself, but the judgement required to know when restoration should be granted. Those who wield the Fifth Divine Restoration understand that every blessing carries immense responsibility, for they act not according to personal desire, but as faithful servants carrying out the will of their patron.

To those who witness such miracles, one truth becomes unmistakably clear: the gods continue to shape the world, not through overwhelming displays of power, but through devoted souls willing to become instruments of their divine purpose.

> *"To restore another is to carry the will of the divine with humility, wisdom and unwavering faith."*
>
> — **The Book of Divine Accord**

# Divine Sense

## Overview
Through unwavering devotion, a Paladin learns to quiet the distractions of the physical world and listen instead to the whispers of the divine. By opening their soul to their patron, they briefly perceive the unseen spiritual currents that flow through the world, revealing sacred presences and forces that stand in direct opposition to their deity's will.

Divine Sense is not ordinary sight, nor does it reveal every hidden creature or secret. Instead, it awakens a deeper awareness that allows a Paladin to recognise the subtle resonance of divine power. Holy places, relics, miracles and supernatural beings leave impressions upon the world that only those blessed by a patron can perceive.

As your connection to your patron deepens, so too will your understanding of these spiritual echoes. What begins as a faint awareness will eventually become the ability to discern the true nature of divine and opposing forces that shape the world around you.

## Rank 1
### Description

Through unwavering devotion, a Paladin learns to quiet the distractions of the physical world and listen instead to the whispers of the divine. By opening their soul to their patron, they briefly perceive the unseen spiritual currents that flow through the world, revealing sacred presences and forces that stand in direct opposition to their deity's will.

Divine Sense is not ordinary sight, nor does it reveal every hidden creature or secret. Instead, it awakens a deeper awareness that allows a Paladin to recognise the subtle resonance of divine power. Holy places, relics, miracles and supernatural beings leave impressions upon the world that only those blessed by a patron can perceive.

As your connection to your patron deepens, so too will your understanding of these spiritual echoes. What begins as a faint awareness will eventually become the ability to discern the true nature of divine and opposing forces that shape the world around you.

### Effects

- Spend **25 MP** to activate **Divine Sense**.
- Divine Sense remains active for **1 Minute (10 Rounds)**.
- Sense the presence of **Divine Resonance** associated with your patron deity within **10 metres**.
- Sense the presence of **Divine Opposition** associated with your patron deity within **10 metres**.
- Divine Sense reveals only the **presence** of these forces and does not reveal their exact location, identity, strength, or source.
- While Divine Sense is active, gain **+2 to Perception Checks** made to investigate or locate sensed divine presences.
- Powerful magical barriers, divine wards, or abilities specifically designed to conceal spiritual signatures may prevent Divine Sense from detecting a target at the GM's discretion.
- The creatures, magic, relics, locations, and phenomena detected by **Divine Resonance** and **Divine Opposition** are determined by your chosen patron's Religious pages.

### Lore

Every deity leaves a unique imprint upon creation. Those who devote themselves to a patron gradually learn to recognise that sacred resonance, just as they instinctively perceive the opposing forces that seek to challenge or corrupt it. To a trained Paladin, these spiritual echoes are as unmistakable as a familiar voice carried upon the wind.

The oldest holy orders teach that Divine Sense is the first true step toward becoming a champion of one's faith. Before a Paladin can confront the enemies of their patron, they must first learn to recognise the subtle signs of divine influence that surround them, whether they come from friend or foe.

> *"The divine speaks long before steel is drawn. Those who learn to listen will never truly walk blind."*  
> **— High Oracle Seraphis, Keeper of the Sacred Vigil**

## Rank 2
### Description

Your connection to your patron grows stronger, allowing you to perceive more than a simple spiritual presence. As your awareness deepens, the countless echoes of divine energy begin to separate into distinct signatures, enabling you to recognise when multiple sources are nearby instead of sensing only that something exists.

The world becomes layered with unseen currents of divine influence. While ordinary people pass through sacred and opposing powers unaware, your patron grants you the insight to distinguish individual spiritual presences hidden beneath the surface of reality. Though the details remain beyond your understanding, you can begin to judge the scale of what surrounds you.

Veteran Paladins describe this stage as learning to hear individual voices within a crowded room. The divine still speaks in whispers, but those whispers are no longer impossible to separate.

### Effects

- Spend **30 MP** to activate **Divine Sense**.
- Divine Sense remains active for **2 Minutes (20 Rounds)**.
- Sense the presence of **Divine Resonance** associated with your patron deity within **15 metres**.
- Sense the presence of **Divine Opposition** associated with your patron deity within **15 metres**.
- Determine the **number of distinct divine presences** detected within range.
- Divine Sense does not reveal the exact location, identity, strength, or source of detected presences.
- Gain **+4 to Perception Checks** made to investigate or locate sensed divine presences while Divine Sense is active.
- Powerful magical barriers, divine wards, or abilities specifically designed to conceal spiritual signatures may prevent Divine Sense from detecting a target at the GM's discretion.
- The creatures, relics, magic, locations, and phenomena detected through **Divine Resonance** and **Divine Opposition** are determined by your chosen patron's Religious pages.

### Lore

As devotion matures into unwavering faith, a Paladin begins to perceive the harmony and discord that exist between divine powers. No longer overwhelmed by the countless echoes surrounding them, they learn to distinguish one sacred presence from another, revealing a richer understanding of the unseen world.

Within the great religious orders, this level of mastery marks the point at which initiates are trusted to investigate sacred sites and spiritual disturbances without constant guidance. Their patron's voice has become clearer, allowing them to recognise not merely that something is present, but that many unseen forces may be moving together beneath the veil.

> *"The divine rarely speaks alone. Learn to count the voices before you choose which one to follow."*  
> **— High Oracle Seraphis, Keeper of the Sacred Vigil**

## Rank 3
### Description

Your soul has become finely attuned to your patron's divine influence, allowing you to perceive not only the existence of sacred and opposing spiritual forces, but also the direction from which they emanate. What once felt like distant whispers now forms a clearer path for your spirit to follow.

As your awareness deepens, the divine currents surrounding the world become easier to navigate. You can distinguish whether a presence lies ahead, behind, above, or below, allowing you to pursue hidden relics, uncover concealed sanctuaries, or prepare for encounters with opposing divine forces before they reveal themselves.

Although the finer details remain hidden, your patron's guidance grows stronger with every step. Divine Sense begins to transform from a simple warning into a trusted companion, leading faithful champions toward both sacred discoveries and dangerous confrontations.

### Effects

- Spend **35 MP** to activate **Divine Sense**.
- Divine Sense remains active for **3 Minutes (30 Rounds)**.
- Sense the presence of **Divine Resonance** associated with your patron deity within **20 metres**.
- Sense the presence of **Divine Opposition** associated with your patron deity within **20 metres**.
- Determine the **number of distinct divine presences** detected within range.
- Determine the **general direction** of each detected presence.
- Discern whether each presence is **Near**, **Moderate**, or **Distant** relative to your current position.
- Divine Sense still does not reveal the identity, exact location, or strength of detected presences.
- Gain **+6 to Perception Checks** made to investigate or locate sensed divine presences while Divine Sense is active.
- Powerful magical barriers, divine wards, or abilities specifically designed to conceal spiritual signatures may prevent Divine Sense from detecting a target at the GM's discretion.
- The creatures, relics, magic, locations, and phenomena detected through **Divine Resonance** and **Divine Opposition** are determined by your chosen patron's Religious pages.

### Lore

The greatest Paladins often describe the world as a tapestry woven from countless unseen threads of divine influence. With experience, those threads become easier to follow, guiding faithful champions toward forgotten temples, hidden relics, and the growing presence of forces that oppose their patron's divine purpose.

Religious scholars believe this marks the moment a Paladin ceases to simply perceive the divine and instead begins to navigate by it. Many legendary journeys have begun with nothing more than a quiet whisper carried upon the soul, faithfully followed until destiny revealed itself.

> *"The divine does not point with a finger. It whispers, and the faithful learn which way to walk."*  
> **— High Oracle Seraphis, Keeper of the Sacred Vigil**

## Rank 4
### Description

Your bond with your patron has matured into a profound spiritual awareness. The divine echoes surrounding the world no longer appear as indistinct whispers but as recognisable signatures, each carrying its own strength and purpose. Your soul instinctively interprets these impressions, allowing you to better understand the unseen forces shaping the world around you.

Where younger Paladins merely sense that something sacred or opposing is nearby, you begin to distinguish the nature of each presence. Ancient relics resonate differently from living champions, while consecrated temples and corrupted ground each leave their own unmistakable imprint upon the divine tapestry.

Although many mysteries still remain hidden, your patron grants you enough insight to judge which discoveries deserve caution, reverence, or immediate action.

### Effects

- Spend **40 MP** to activate **Divine Sense**.
- Divine Sense remains active for **5 Minutes (50 Rounds)**.
- Sense the presence of **Divine Resonance** associated with your patron deity within **25 metres**.
- Sense the presence of **Divine Opposition** associated with your patron deity within **25 metres**.
- Determine the **number**, **general direction**, and **relative proximity** of each detected presence.
- Discern the **relative strength** of each presence as **Faint**, **Moderate**, **Powerful**, or **Overwhelming**.
- Determine whether each detected presence originates from a **creature**, **relic**, **location**, **divine phenomenon**, or **active magical effect**, though its exact identity remains unknown.
- Gain **+8 to Perception Checks** made to investigate or locate sensed divine presences while Divine Sense is active.
- Powerful magical barriers, divine wards, or abilities specifically designed to conceal spiritual signatures may prevent Divine Sense from detecting a target at the GM's discretion.
- The creatures, relics, magic, locations, and phenomena detected through **Divine Resonance** and **Divine Opposition** are determined by your chosen patron's Religious pages.

### Lore

Only the most devoted champions reach the point where divine echoes become distinct voices. Experienced Paladins learn that every sacred relic, every consecrated sanctuary, and every being touched by divine power leaves behind a unique resonance upon the world. To the faithful, these impressions are as recognisable as a familiar face.

Masters of Divine Sense are often entrusted with recovering lost relics, investigating miraculous events, and uncovering hidden threats that would escape even the keenest mortal senses. Their patron's guidance has become more than intuition—it has become a trusted companion upon every journey.

> *"The divine leaves its mark upon everything it touches. Wisdom lies in learning how to read those marks."*  
> **— High Oracle Seraphis, Keeper of the Sacred Vigil**

## Rank 5
### Description

Your soul has become completely attuned to the divine will of your patron. No longer limited to sensing faint echoes, you briefly perceive the spiritual tapestry that binds the world together, allowing you to witness the true resonance and opposition surrounding you.

Sacred places blaze like stars within your awareness, while opposing divine forces stand out as undeniable distortions against your patron's design. Even hidden relics, disguised champions, and concealed manifestations struggle to remain unseen beneath your divine gaze. Although your patron never grants perfect omniscience, few spiritual secrets can remain hidden from one who has reached this level of devotion.

Masters of Divine Sense are often called the Eyes of the Faith. They are entrusted with uncovering forgotten sanctuaries, locating divine relics, exposing corrupted holy sites, and recognising those who secretly serve powers beyond mortal understanding.

### Effects

- Spend **50 MP** to activate **Divine Sense**.
- Divine Sense remains active for **10 Minutes (100 Rounds)**.
- Sense the presence of **Divine Resonance** associated with your patron deity within **30 metres**.
- Sense the presence of **Divine Opposition** associated with your patron deity within **30 metres**.
- Determine the **number**, **general direction**, **relative proximity**, and **relative strength** of every detected presence.
- Determine whether each presence originates from a **creature**, **relic**, **location**, **divine phenomenon**, or **active magical effect**.
- Reveal the **approximate location** of each detected presence within your sensing range.
- Hidden, invisible, disguised, or magically concealed divine presences are revealed unless protected by an exceptionally powerful divine artifact, deity, or magical effect, at the GM's discretion.
- Gain **+10 to Perception Checks** made to investigate or locate sensed divine presences while Divine Sense is active.
- The creatures, relics, magic, locations, and phenomena detected through **Divine Resonance** and **Divine Opposition** are determined by your chosen patron's Religious pages.

### Lore

Among every holy order, only a handful of Paladins ever master Divine Sense to this degree. Those who do are said to walk with one foot in the mortal realm and the other within the divine, perceiving spiritual truths hidden from all but the gods themselves.

Legends tell of champions who uncovered forgotten temples buried beneath mountains, exposed kings secretly serving rival deities, and located sacred relics thought lost for centuries. Whether these tales are fact or embellishment matters little, for every order agrees upon one truth: those who attain this gift become living instruments of their patron's will, seeing the world through eyes forever changed by divine purpose.

> *"When the veil is lifted, the world reveals what it has always been. Only the faithful possess the courage to truly see it."*  
> **— Saint Asterion, First Divine Seeker**

# Divine Smite

## Overview
A Paladin's weapon is more than forged steel—it is an extension of the sacred oath they have sworn. Through prayer and unwavering conviction, you call upon your patron's divine essence, allowing a single strike to carry the judgement of the deity you serve.

Every Divine Smite is unique to its wielder. The manifestation of the power reflects the nature of the chosen patron, surging through the weapon as radiant light, spectral souls, raging flame, shadow, living vines, celestial energy, infernal wrath, or countless other divine expressions. Though its appearance differs, each smite carries the unmistakable authority of a champion acting in their patron's name.

The power of Divine Smite is especially devastating against those who stand in direct opposition to your patron. Your deity's eternal conflict resonates through your weapon, causing the strike to burn brighter, strike harder, or manifest with greater force against those aligned with the opposing divine domain.

## Rank 1
### Description

A Paladin's weapon is more than forged steel—it is an extension of the sacred oath they have sworn. Through prayer and unwavering conviction, you call upon your patron's divine essence, allowing a single strike to carry the judgement of the deity you serve.

Every Divine Smite is unique to its wielder. The manifestation of the power reflects the nature of the chosen patron, surging through the weapon as radiant light, spectral souls, raging flame, shadow, living vines, celestial energy, infernal wrath, or countless other divine expressions. Though its appearance differs, each smite carries the unmistakable authority of a champion acting in their patron's name.

The power of Divine Smite is especially devastating against those who stand in direct opposition to your patron. Your deity's eternal conflict resonates through your weapon, causing the strike to burn brighter, strike harder, or manifest with greater force against those aligned with the opposing divine domain.

### Effects

- Spend **25 MP** immediately before or immediately after hitting a creature with a melee weapon attack.
- The triggering attack deals an additional **2d8 Patron Damage**.
- Your patron determines the **damage type**, visual manifestation, and other interactions of this damage through its Religious pages.
- If the target belongs to your patron's **Divine Opposition**, increase the additional damage to **3d8 Patron Damage**.
- Divine Smite may only be activated **once per turn**.
- Divine Smite cannot be activated if the triggering attack misses.
- Additional effects granted by your patron's **Divine Authority** are applied after resolving the damage, where applicable.

### Lore

Since the earliest days of Asteria, Divine Smite has stood as the defining miracle of every Paladin. It is not simply a stronger attack, but a moment where mortal conviction and divine purpose become one. For a brief instant, the champion's weapon ceases to belong solely to them and instead becomes a conduit for their patron's will.

Although every faith teaches the technique differently, all agree upon one truth: a Divine Smite is never an act of anger alone. It is a declaration of purpose. Every empowered strike reminds both ally and enemy that the Paladin does not fight for personal glory, but as a faithful servant carrying out the judgement of the deity they have sworn to uphold.

> *"The weapon is mine to wield. The judgement belongs to my patron."*  
> **— Grand Marshal Aurelius, First Champion of the Sacred Host**

## Rank 2
### Description

Your connection to your patron has deepened, allowing greater amounts of divine essence to flow through your weapon without overwhelming your mortal body. Each strike carries more than simple power—it becomes an unmistakable expression of your patron's will upon the battlefield.

As your faith strengthens, the divine energy responds more readily to your conviction. The manifestation of your patron's power burns brighter, strikes harder, and resonates more fiercely against those who stand in opposition to the deity you serve. Though every Paladin channels this miracle differently, all learn that true strength comes not from the weapon itself, but from the sacred bond that empowers it.

Experienced Paladins know that Divine Smite is not meant to be used recklessly. Every invocation is a reminder that divine power is entrusted to them for a purpose, and each empowered strike carries the weight of their oath.

### Effects

- Spend **35 MP** immediately before or immediately after hitting a creature with a melee weapon attack.
- The triggering attack deals an additional **4d8 Patron Damage**.
- Your patron determines the **damage type**, visual manifestation, and other interactions of this damage through its Religious pages.
- If the target belongs to your patron's **Divine Opposition**, increase the additional damage to **5d8 Patron Damage**.
- Divine Smite may only be activated **once per turn**.
- Divine Smite cannot be activated if the triggering attack misses.
- Additional effects granted by your patron's **Divine Authority** are applied after resolving the damage, where applicable.

### Lore

To witness a seasoned Paladin invoke Divine Smite is to see unwavering faith given physical form. The weapon becomes an extension of the deity's purpose, carrying divine judgement with every strike. Though the appearance differs between patrons, the conviction behind the miracle is always unmistakable.

Many holy orders teach that the strength of a Divine Smite is measured not by the destruction it causes, but by the righteousness of the purpose behind it. Only those who remain true to their oath can safely wield greater measures of their patron's power.

> *"Power without purpose is nothing more than destruction. A true smite carries the weight of an oath."*  
> **— Grand Marshal Aurelius, First Champion of the Sacred Host**

## Rank 3
### Description

The bond between you and your patron has grown beyond a simple blessing. When you invoke Divine Smite, your weapon no longer carries only a fleeting spark of divine power—it becomes temporarily infused with your patron's essence, allowing every movement to reflect the sacred purpose of your oath.

For a brief moment, the line between mortal champion and divine servant becomes blurred. Your weapon radiates the unmistakable presence of your patron, and those who oppose its divine will instinctively recoil from its judgement. Whether your deity manifests through radiant light, consuming shadow, spectral souls, celestial fire, or another sacred expression, every strike reminds friend and foe alike that you fight with power greater than your own.

Veteran Paladins often describe this stage of mastery as the moment Divine Smite ceases to be an ability and instead becomes an extension of their faith itself.

### Effects

- Spend **45 MP** immediately before or immediately after hitting a creature with a melee weapon attack.
- The triggering attack deals an additional **6d8 Patron Damage**.
- Your patron determines the **damage type**, visual manifestation, and additional interactions through its Religious pages.
- If the target belongs to your patron's **Divine Opposition**, increase the additional damage to **8d8 Patron Damage**.
- Your weapon remains **Divinely Infused** until the **end of your current turn**.
- If you make another successful melee weapon attack before the end of your turn (such as through an additional Action, Bonus Action, or Opportunity Attack), you may apply **half of the original Divine Smite damage** without paying an additional Mana Cost.
- Divine Smite may only be activated **once per turn**.
- Additional effects granted by your patron's **Divine Authority** are applied after resolving the damage, where applicable.

### Lore

Only the most devoted Paladins learn to sustain their patron's divine essence beyond a single strike. Rather than calling upon fleeting power, they become living conduits through which their deity's judgement briefly enters the mortal world.

Each patron manifests this miracle differently, yet every faith agrees upon one truth: a weapon blessed in this way is no longer merely steel. For those few heartbeats, it becomes a sacred instrument carrying the will of a god.

> *"A single strike may win a duel. A weapon guided by faith changes the course of history."*  
> **— Grand Marshal Aurelius, First Champion of the Sacred Host**

## Rank 4
### Description

Your weapon has become a true vessel of your patron's divine essence. With every invocation of Divine Smite, the power flowing through your weapon is no longer contained within a single blow. Instead, fragments of your deity's will linger upon the battlefield, leaving behind a manifestation that reflects the eternal purpose of the patron you serve.

To witness a master Paladin invoke Divine Smite is to witness a deity briefly touch the mortal world. Whether blazing with radiant light, engulfed in infernal flame, surrounded by spectral souls, or woven with the threads of fate itself, each strike becomes a declaration that your patron's influence cannot be ignored.

Those who stand in opposition to your deity quickly learn that surviving the initial blow is often only the beginning. The divine power released by your weapon continues to shape the battle long after the strike has landed.

### Effects

- Spend **60 MP** immediately before or immediately after hitting a creature with a melee weapon attack.

Some tell of radiant scars burned into the earth, others of shadows that lingered for days, while still others describe spectral echoes or impossible twists of fate. # divine smite

## overview
a paladin's weapon is more than forged steel—it is an extension of the sacred oath they have sworn. through prayer and unwavering conviction, you call upon your patron's divine essence, allowing a single strike to carry the judgement of the deity you serve.

every divine smite is unique to its wielder. the manifestation of the power reflects the nature of the chosen patron, surging through the weapon as radiant light, spectral souls, raging flame, shadow, living vines, celestial energy, infernal wrath, or countless other divine expressions. though its appearance differs, each smite carries the unmistakable authority of a champion acting in their patron's name.

the power of divine smite is especially devastating against those who stand in direct opposition to your patron. your deity's eternal conflict resonates through your weapon, causing the strike to burn brighter, strike harder, or manifest with greater force against those aligned with the opposing divine domain.

> **— grand marshal aurelius, first champion of the sacred host**

# Fortified Mind

## Overview
Through disciplined prayer, meditation and unwavering devotion to your patron, your mind becomes increasingly resilient against supernatural influence. While others may falter before overwhelming terror or malicious psychic forces, your faith provides an anchor that steadies your thoughts and strengthens your resolve.

Fortified Mind does not make you fearless, nor does it render your thoughts beyond reach. Instead, it reinforces your will, allowing you to recognise and resist attempts to overwhelm, manipulate or corrupt your mind. Every trial endured strengthens your confidence that your patron walks beside you, even in moments of doubt.

This mental discipline is considered a fundamental lesson among Clerics. Before they are entrusted with powerful miracles, they must first learn to protect the sanctuary of their own mind, ensuring that fear and deception cannot easily turn them from their sacred path.

## Rank 1
### Description

Through disciplined prayer, meditation and unwavering devotion to your patron, your mind becomes increasingly resilient against supernatural influence. While others may falter before overwhelming terror or malicious psychic forces, your faith provides an anchor that steadies your thoughts and strengthens your resolve.

Fortified Mind does not make you fearless, nor does it render your thoughts beyond reach. Instead, it reinforces your will, allowing you to recognise and resist attempts to overwhelm, manipulate or corrupt your mind. Every trial endured strengthens your confidence that your patron walks beside you, even in moments of doubt.

This mental discipline is considered a fundamental lesson among Clerics. Before they are entrusted with powerful miracles, they must first learn to protect the sanctuary of their own mind, ensuring that fear and deception cannot easily turn them from their sacred path.

### Effects

- Fortified Mind is a **Passive Talent**.
- Gain a **+2 bonus** to all saving throws made to resist the **Fear** condition.
- Gain a **+2 bonus** to all saving throws against **Psychic** spells, abilities and magical effects.
- Gain a **+2 bonus** to checks made to resist magical mental influence, including **Charm**, **Compulsion**, **Confusion**, **Possession**, or similar effects, as determined by the GM.
- This talent does not grant immunity to Fear, Psychic damage or mental conditions.
- Fortified Mind is considered a **Divine Blessing**.

### Lore

The greatest battles fought by a Cleric are not always against monsters or heretics, but within their own heart and mind. Ancient temples teach that faith without conviction is easily shaken, and that a mind left undefended becomes an easy target for those who wield fear and deception as weapons.

Every ordained Cleric spends countless hours studying sacred teachings while enduring spiritual trials designed to strengthen their resolve. These rituals teach them to remain calm in the face of terror, reject whispers of corruption and hold fast to the ideals of their patron, no matter how overwhelming the darkness before them may seem.

Those who master these teachings become renowned for their unwavering composure, standing firm where others would flee and meeting even the most horrifying supernatural threats with steadfast faith.

> *"The strongest fortress ever built is the mind that refuses to abandon its faith."*
>
> — High Inquisitor Seraphis

## Rank 2
### Description

Your unwavering devotion continues to strengthen your mind, forging a will that is increasingly difficult to break. The teachings of your patron have become second nature, allowing you to confront supernatural terror and psychic assaults with calm determination rather than panic.

As your faith deepens, your thoughts become more disciplined and resistant to outside influence. Malevolent entities find it harder to cloud your judgement, while fear loses much of its power over your actions. Though your mind remains mortal, it has become a sanctuary reinforced by conviction, prayer and divine purpose.

This growing resilience is recognised throughout the temples of Asteria as a sign of spiritual maturity. Experienced Clerics are expected to remain composed during moments of despair, inspiring allies through their unwavering resolve while resisting forces that seek to corrupt or dominate their minds.

### Effects

- Fortified Mind remains a **Passive Talent**.
- Gain a **+3 bonus** to all saving throws made to resist the **Fear** condition.
- Gain a **+3 bonus** to all saving throws against **Psychic** spells, abilities and magical effects.
- Gain a **+3 bonus** to checks made to resist magical mental influence, including **Charm**, **Compulsion**, **Confusion**, **Possession**, or similar effects, as determined by the GM.
- This talent does not grant immunity to Fear, Psychic damage or mental conditions.
- Fortified Mind is considered a **Divine Blessing**.

### Lore

Among the faithful, a disciplined mind is considered one of the greatest gifts a patron can nurture within their followers. Veteran Clerics often endure long periods of meditation, isolation and spiritual reflection, strengthening their resolve before they are entrusted with greater divine responsibilities.

Stories tell of Clerics who stood before nightmarish creatures without yielding, their prayers silencing the fear that consumed those around them. Others resisted the whispers of ancient horrors that sought to twist their thoughts, emerging with their faith stronger than before.

These tales remind every initiate that true strength begins within. Divine miracles may protect the body, but only unwavering conviction can protect the soul from those who seek to claim it.

> *"The darkness first conquers the mind. Guard it well, and the rest will follow."*
>
> — Sister Elyra, Keeper of the Sacred Mind

## Rank 3
### Description

Your faith has become an unshakable pillar within your soul, reinforcing your thoughts against even the most insidious supernatural influences. Fear no longer clouds your judgement as easily, and psychic assaults struggle to find weakness within a mind strengthened through years of devotion and spiritual discipline.

Rather than resisting through sheer will alone, your patron's teachings have become woven into your very nature. Every prayer remembered, every trial overcome and every act of faith has reinforced the sanctuary of your mind. While no mortal is beyond temptation or manipulation, your conviction allows you to confront such threats with remarkable clarity and determination.

Among experienced Clerics, Fortified Mind is seen as more than resilience—it is a reflection of complete trust in one's patron. Even when confronted by horrors beyond mortal understanding, the faithful remain steadfast, knowing that courage born of faith is stronger than fear born of darkness.

### Effects

- Fortified Mind remains a **Passive Talent**.
- Gain a **+4 bonus** to all saving throws made to resist the **Fear** condition.
- Gain a **+4 bonus** to all saving throws against **Psychic** spells, abilities and magical effects.
- Gain a **+4 bonus** to checks made to resist magical mental influence, including **Charm**, **Compulsion**, **Confusion**, **Possession**, or similar effects, as determined by the GM.
- This talent does not grant immunity to Fear, Psychic damage or mental conditions.
- Fortified Mind is considered a **Divine Blessing**.

### Lore

By this stage of their training, a Cleric's resolve has become well known among the faithful. Many are entrusted with guiding pilgrims through cursed lands, confronting creatures that feed upon terror or investigating places where madness has claimed countless lives. Their unwavering composure serves as a beacon of hope to those who travel beside them.

Ancient scriptures often describe the mind as the first battlefield upon which darkness wages war. Those who cannot defend their thoughts are easily led astray, while those whose faith remains unwavering become impossible to sway through fear alone. It is for this reason that senior members of every major faith continue to refine their mental discipline throughout their lives, believing that true devotion is measured not only by miracles performed, but by the strength of spirit shown in the face of despair.

> *"When fear knocks upon the mind, let faith be the hand that bars the door."*
>
> — High Cleric Thalorien, Keeper of the Sacred Scriptures

## Rank 4
### Description

Your mind has become a sanctuary of unwavering faith, forged through countless trials and strengthened by your patron's guidance. Supernatural terror, psychic intrusion and attempts to bend your will now struggle to find purchase against a spirit tempered by devotion and absolute conviction.

Every lesson learned and every hardship overcome has reinforced the barriers protecting your thoughts. Rather than relying solely upon determination, your faith has become instinctive, allowing you to remain calm and focused even when confronted by unimaginable horrors or malicious entities seeking to dominate your mind.

Senior Clerics are often entrusted with confronting cursed relics, eldritch beings and other manifestations capable of breaking the resolve of ordinary mortals. Their composure is not born from fearlessness, but from complete trust that their patron will guide them through even the darkest moments.

### Effects

- Fortified Mind remains a **Passive Talent**.
- Gain a **+5 bonus** to all saving throws made to resist the **Fear** condition.
- Gain a **+5 bonus** to all saving throws against **Psychic** spells, abilities and magical effects.
- Gain a **+5 bonus** to checks made to resist magical mental influence, including **Charm**, **Compulsion**, **Confusion**, **Possession**, or similar effects, as determined by the GM.
- This talent does not grant immunity to Fear, Psychic damage or mental conditions.
- Fortified Mind is considered a **Divine Blessing**.

### Lore

Within the greatest temples of Asteria, those who achieve this level of mental discipline are regarded as pillars of faith. Their unwavering resolve allows them to stand before horrors that would shatter lesser minds, offering guidance and reassurance when others falter beneath impossible pressure.

Many sacred texts describe the mind as the final sanctuary of the soul. While armour protects the body and miracles preserve life, only steadfast conviction can defend against corruption that begins within one's own thoughts. Clerics who master this teaching become living examples of their patron's strength, inspiring allies simply through their calm presence during moments of overwhelming despair.

To witness such unwavering resolve is often enough to rekindle hope in those who have begun to lose it, proving that faith can endure even where darkness seems absolute.

> *"A faithful heart may tremble, but a faithful mind will never yield."*
>
> — Grand Hierophant Altherion, Guardian of the Eternal Sanctum

## Rank 5
### Description

Your mind has become a bastion of unwavering conviction, strengthened by years of devotion and an unbreakable bond with your patron. Fear no longer clouds your judgement as it once did, and even the most insidious psychic assaults struggle to overcome a spirit forged through discipline, prayer and absolute faith.

Every lesson, trial and hardship has reinforced the sanctuary of your thoughts. Rather than resisting through determination alone, your faith has become an inseparable part of who you are. Attempts to manipulate, terrify or corrupt your mind are met by a will tempered through countless acts of devotion, allowing you to remain composed when others succumb to panic or despair.

Although no mortal is beyond the reach of the supernatural, few possess the mental resilience of a master Cleric. Your patron's teachings guide your thoughts, your conviction steadies your heart, and your faith serves as a constant reminder that even in the darkest moments, you are never truly alone.

### Effects

- Fortified Mind remains a **Passive Talent**.
- Gain a **+6 bonus** to all saving throws made to resist the **Fear** condition.
- Gain a **+6 bonus** to all saving throws against **Psychic** spells, abilities and magical effects.
- Gain a **+6 bonus** to checks made to resist magical mental influence, including **Charm**, **Compulsion**, **Confusion**, **Possession**, or similar effects, as determined by the GM.
- This talent does not grant immunity to Fear, Psychic damage or mental conditions.
- Fortified Mind is considered a **Divine Blessing**.

### Lore

Across Asteria, only the most devoted Clerics achieve this level of mental discipline. Their unwavering resolve has become legendary, allowing them to confront ancient evils, cursed relics and eldritch horrors without surrendering to fear or madness. While others see only terror, these faithful servants see another opportunity to place their trust in their patron.

The greatest temples often appoint such individuals to lead pilgrimages into dangerous lands, investigate supernatural disturbances and safeguard sacred relics from those who would misuse them. Their calm presence inspires confidence among allies, while their refusal to yield serves as a testament to the enduring strength of true faith.

Masters of Fortified Mind understand that courage is not the absence of fear, but the determination to stand firm despite it. Their patron's guidance has become a permanent foundation upon which every thought and every decision is built, creating a spirit that remains steadfast even when surrounded by overwhelming darkness.

> *"A mind devoted to faith cannot be conquered by fear—it can only be tested."*
>
> — Saint Aurelian, Guardian of the Eternal Mind
