# fortified mind

## overview
through disciplined prayer, meditation and unwavering devotion to your patron, your mind becomes increasingly resilient against supernatural influence. while others may falter before overwhelming terror or malicious psychic forces, your faith provides an anchor that steadies your thoughts and strengthens your resolve.

fortified mind does not make you fearless, nor does it render your thoughts beyond reach. instead, it reinforces your will, allowing you to recognise and resist attempts to overwhelm, manipulate or corrupt your mind. every trial endured strengthens your confidence that your patron walks beside you, even in moments of doubt.

this mental discipline is considered a fundamental lesson among clerics. before they are entrusted with powerful miracles, they must first learn to protect the sanctuary of their own mind, ensuring that fear and deception cannot easily turn them from their sacred path.

## rank 1
### description

through disciplined prayer, meditation and unwavering devotion to your patron, your mind becomes increasingly resilient against supernatural influence. while others may falter before overwhelming terror or malicious psychic forces, your faith provides an anchor that steadies your thoughts and strengthens your resolve.

fortified mind does not make you fearless, nor does it render your thoughts beyond reach. instead, it reinforces your will, allowing you to recognise and resist attempts to overwhelm, manipulate or corrupt your mind. every trial endured strengthens your confidence that your patron walks beside you, even in moments of doubt.

this mental discipline is considered a fundamental lesson among clerics. before they are entrusted with powerful miracles, they must first learn to protect the sanctuary of their own mind, ensuring that fear and deception cannot easily turn them from their sacred path.

### effects

- fortified mind is a **passive talent**.
- gain a **+2 bonus** to all saving throws made to resist the **fear** condition.
- gain a **+2 bonus** to all saving throws against **psychic** spells, abilities and magical effects.
- gain a **+2 bonus** to checks made to resist magical mental influence, including **charm**, **compulsion**, **confusion**, **possession**, or similar effects, as determined by the gm.
- this talent does not grant immunity to fear, psychic damage or mental conditions.
- fortified mind is considered a **divine blessing**.

### lore

the greatest battles fought by a cleric are not always against monsters or heretics, but within their own heart and mind. ancient temples teach that faith without conviction is easily shaken, and that a mind left undefended becomes an easy target for those who wield fear and deception as weapons.

every ordained cleric spends countless hours studying sacred teachings while enduring spiritual trials designed to strengthen their resolve. these rituals teach them to remain calm in the face of terror, reject whispers of corruption and hold fast to the ideals of their patron, no matter how overwhelming the darkness before them may seem.

those who master these teachings become renowned for their unwavering composure, standing firm where others would flee and meeting even the most horrifying supernatural threats with steadfast faith.

> *"the strongest fortress ever built is the mind that refuses to abandon its faith."*
>
> — high inquisitor seraphis

## rank 2
### description

your unwavering devotion continues to strengthen your mind, forging a will that is increasingly difficult to break. the teachings of your patron have become second nature, allowing you to confront supernatural terror and psychic assaults with calm determination rather than panic.

as your faith deepens, your thoughts become more disciplined and resistant to outside influence. malevolent entities find it harder to cloud your judgement, while fear loses much of its power over your actions. though your mind remains mortal, it has become a sanctuary reinforced by conviction, prayer and divine purpose.

this growing resilience is recognised throughout the temples of asteria as a sign of spiritual maturity. experienced clerics are expected to remain composed during moments of despair, inspiring allies through their unwavering resolve while resisting forces that seek to corrupt or dominate their minds.

### effects

- fortified mind remains a **passive talent**.
- gain a **+3 bonus** to all saving throws made to resist the **fear** condition.
- gain a **+3 bonus** to all saving throws against **psychic** spells, abilities and magical effects.
- gain a **+3 bonus** to checks made to resist magical mental influence, including **charm**, **compulsion**, **confusion**, **possession**, or similar effects, as determined by the gm.
- this talent does not grant immunity to fear, psychic damage or mental conditions.
- fortified mind is considered a **divine blessing**.

### lore

among the faithful, a disciplined mind is considered one of the greatest gifts a patron can nurture within their followers. veteran clerics often endure long periods of meditation, isolation and spiritual reflection, strengthening their resolve before they are entrusted with greater divine responsibilities.

stories tell of clerics who stood before nightmarish creatures without yielding, their prayers silencing the fear that consumed those around them. others resisted the whispers of ancient horrors that sought to twist their thoughts, emerging with their faith stronger than before.

these tales remind every initiate that true strength begins within. divine miracles may protect the body, but only unwavering conviction can protect the soul from those who seek to claim it.

> *"the darkness first conquers the mind. guard it well, and the rest will follow."*
>
> — sister elyra, keeper of the sacred mind

## rank 3
### description

your faith has become an unshakable pillar within your soul, reinforcing your thoughts against even the most insidious supernatural influences. fear no longer clouds your judgement as easily, and psychic assaults struggle to find weakness within a mind strengthened through years of devotion and spiritual discipline.

rather than resisting through sheer will alone, your patron's teachings have become woven into your very nature. every prayer remembered, every trial overcome and every act of faith has reinforced the sanctuary of your mind. while no mortal is beyond temptation or manipulation, your conviction allows you to confront such threats with remarkable clarity and determination.

among experienced clerics, fortified mind is seen as more than resilience—it is a reflection of complete trust in one's patron. even when confronted by horrors beyond mortal understanding, the faithful remain steadfast, knowing that courage born of faith is stronger than fear born of darkness.

### effects

- fortified mind remains a **passive talent**.
- gain a **+4 bonus** to all saving throws made to resist the **fear** condition.
- gain a **+4 bonus** to all saving throws against **psychic** spells, abilities and magical effects.
- gain a **+4 bonus** to checks made to resist magical mental influence, including **charm**, **compulsion**, **confusion**, **possession**, or similar effects, as determined by the gm.
- this talent does not grant immunity to fear, psychic damage or mental conditions.
- fortified mind is considered a **divine blessing**.

### lore

by this stage of their training, a cleric's resolve has become well known among the faithful. many are entrusted with guiding pilgrims through cursed lands, confronting creatures that feed upon terror or investigating places where madness has claimed countless lives. their unwavering composure serves as a beacon of hope to those who travel beside them.

ancient scriptures often describe the mind as the first battlefield upon which darkness wages war. those who cannot defend their thoughts are easily led astray, while those whose faith remains unwavering become impossible to sway through fear alone. it is for this reason that senior members of every major faith continue to refine their mental discipline throughout their lives, believing that true devotion is measured not only by miracles performed, but by the strength of spirit shown in the face of despair.

> *"when fear knocks upon the mind, let faith be the hand that bars the door."*
>
> — high cleric thalorien, keeper of the sacred scriptures

## rank 4
### description

your mind has become a sanctuary of unwavering faith, forged through countless trials and strengthened by your patron's guidance. supernatural terror, psychic intrusion and attempts to bend your will now struggle to find purchase against a spirit tempered by devotion and absolute conviction.

every lesson learned and every hardship overcome has reinforced the barriers protecting your thoughts. rather than relying solely upon determination, your faith has become instinctive, allowing you to remain calm and focused even when confronted by unimaginable horrors or malicious entities seeking to dominate your mind.

senior clerics are often entrusted with confronting cursed relics, eldritch beings and other manifestations capable of breaking the resolve of ordinary mortals. their composure is not born from fearlessness, but from complete trust that their patron will guide them through even the darkest moments.

### effects

- fortified mind remains a **passive talent**.
- gain a **+5 bonus** to all saving throws made to resist the **fear** condition.
- gain a **+5 bonus** to all saving throws against **psychic** spells, abilities and magical effects.
- gain a **+5 bonus** to checks made to resist magical mental influence, including **charm**, **compulsion**, **confusion**, **possession**, or similar effects, as determined by the gm.
- this talent does not grant immunity to fear, psychic damage or mental conditions.
- fortified mind is considered a **divine blessing**.

### lore

within the greatest temples of asteria, those who achieve this level of mental discipline are regarded as pillars of faith. their unwavering resolve allows them to stand before horrors that would shatter lesser minds, offering guidance and reassurance when others falter beneath impossible pressure.

many sacred texts describe the mind as the final sanctuary of the soul. while armour protects the body and miracles preserve life, only steadfast conviction can defend against corruption that begins within one's own thoughts. clerics who master this teaching become living examples of their patron's strength, inspiring allies simply through their calm presence during moments of overwhelming despair.

to witness such unwavering resolve is often enough to rekindle hope in those who have begun to lose it, proving that faith can endure even where darkness seems absolute.

> *"a faithful heart may tremble, but a faithful mind will never yield."*
>
> — grand hierophant altherion, guardian of the eternal sanctum

## rank 5
### description

your mind has become a bastion of unwavering conviction, strengthened by years of devotion and an unbreakable bond with your patron. fear no longer clouds your judgement as it once did, and even the most insidious psychic assaults struggle to overcome a spirit forged through discipline, prayer and absolute faith.

every lesson, trial and hardship has reinforced the sanctuary of your thoughts. rather than resisting through determination alone, your faith has become an inseparable part of who you are. attempts to manipulate, terrify or corrupt your mind are met by a will tempered through countless acts of devotion, allowing you to remain composed when others succumb to panic or despair.

although no mortal is beyond the reach of the supernatural, few possess the mental resilience of a master cleric. your patron's teachings guide your thoughts, your conviction steadies your heart, and your faith serves as a constant reminder that even in the darkest moments, you are never truly alone.

### effects

- fortified mind remains a **passive talent**.
- gain a **+6 bonus** to all saving throws made to resist the **fear** condition.
- gain a **+6 bonus** to all saving throws against **psychic** spells, abilities and magical effects.
- gain a **+6 bonus** to checks made to resist magical mental influence, including **charm**, **compulsion**, **confusion**, **possession**, or similar effects, as determined by the gm.
- this talent does not grant immunity to fear, psychic damage or mental conditions.
- fortified mind is considered a **divine blessing**.

### lore

across asteria, only the most devoted clerics achieve this level of mental discipline. their unwavering resolve has become legendary, allowing them to confront ancient evils, cursed relics and eldritch horrors without surrendering to fear or madness. while others see only terror, these faithful servants see another opportunity to place their trust in their patron.

the greatest temples often appoint such individuals to lead pilgrimages into dangerous lands, investigate supernatural disturbances and safeguard sacred relics from those who would misuse them. their calm presence inspires confidence among allies, while their refusal to yield serves as a testament to the enduring strength of true faith.

masters of fortified mind understand that courage is not the absence of fear, but the determination to stand firm despite it. their patron's guidance has become a permanent foundation upon which every thought and every decision is built, creating a spirit that remains steadfast even when surrounded by overwhelming darkness.

> *"a mind devoted to faith cannot be conquered by fear—it can only be tested."*
>
> — saint aurelian, guardian of the eternal mind

# Hallowed Ground

## Overview
Through unwavering devotion, you call upon your patron to sanctify the land beneath your feet. Divine power spreads across the battlefield, transforming ordinary ground into sacred territory where your patron's influence becomes tangible. Every deity manifests this miracle differently, yet each Hallowed Ground serves the same purpose—to establish a place where the patron's divine will is strongest.

Within this consecrated domain, creatures aligned with your patron's **Divine Resonance** are welcomed beneath its blessing, their vitality restored by the sacred power flowing through the ground. Those aligned with your patron's **Divine Opposition** experience the opposite, finding the very land rejecting their presence as divine judgement manifests beneath every step.

To stand within Hallowed Ground is to stand within your patron's realm. Whether that realm radiates brilliant light, echoes with restless souls, blooms with vibrant life, burns with infernal flame, or shimmers with threads of fate depends entirely upon the deity you serve. Though every manifestation is unique, all are unmistakable signs that the battlefield has been claimed by a higher power.

## Rank 1
### Description

Through unwavering devotion, you call upon your patron to sanctify the land beneath your feet. Divine power spreads across the battlefield, transforming ordinary ground into sacred territory where your patron's influence becomes tangible. Every deity manifests this miracle differently, yet each Hallowed Ground serves the same purpose—to establish a place where the patron's divine will is strongest.

Within this consecrated domain, creatures aligned with your patron's **Divine Resonance** are welcomed beneath its blessing, their vitality restored by the sacred power flowing through the ground. Those aligned with your patron's **Divine Opposition** experience the opposite, finding the very land rejecting their presence as divine judgement manifests beneath every step.

To stand within Hallowed Ground is to stand within your patron's realm. Whether that realm radiates brilliant light, echoes with restless souls, blooms with vibrant life, burns with infernal flame, or shimmers with threads of fate depends entirely upon the deity you serve. Though every manifestation is unique, all are unmistakable signs that the battlefield has been claimed by a higher power.

### Effects

- Spend **40 MP** to consecrate an area within **10 metres**.
- Create a **5 metre radius Hallowed Ground** that lasts for **3 Rounds**.
- The appearance, damage type, and visual effects are determined by your patron's Religious pages.
- Creatures aligned with your patron's **Divine Resonance** that begin their turn within the Hallowed Ground restore **1d8 + your Charisma Modifier HP**.
- Creatures aligned with your patron's **Divine Opposition** that begin their turn within the Hallowed Ground take **1d8 Patron Damage**.
- The exact creatures, followers, summons, and divine entities affected by **Divine Resonance** and **Divine Opposition** are determined by your patron's Religious pages.
- A creature may only benefit from or be damaged by Hallowed Ground **once per round**.
- Additional effects granted by your patron's **Divine Authority** apply while creatures remain within the Hallowed Ground, where applicable.
- Multiple Hallowed Ground effects may overlap, but creatures are only affected by the single strongest Hallowed Ground of each patron.

### Lore

Every faith teaches that the world itself remembers the footsteps of the divine. Through prayer and absolute conviction, a Paladin briefly restores a fragment of that sacred presence, allowing mortal soil to become an extension of their patron's realm. The battlefield itself bends to the deity's influence, welcoming those who walk in harmony with its purpose while rejecting those who oppose it.

Many ancient battlefields throughout Asteria are believed to have remained hallowed for centuries after legendary conflicts. Pilgrims still seek these places, claiming they can feel the lingering presence of the gods long after their champions have departed.

> *"Where my patron's will is welcomed, life is strengthened. Where it is opposed, judgement follows."*  
> **— High Hierophant Cassiel, Keeper of the Sacred Paths**

## Rank 2
### Description

Your patron's influence spreads further across the battlefield, allowing a greater portion of the world to briefly reflect their divine domain. What was once a small sanctuary now becomes a sacred territory where your patron's presence is undeniable, strengthening those who walk in harmony with its purpose while pressing ever harder against those who oppose it.

As your faith deepens, the boundary between the mortal world and your patron's divine realm becomes thinner. Every step taken within the Hallowed Ground reminds creatures aligned with your deity that they stand upon blessed soil, while those bound to opposing divine powers feel an increasing sense of unease as the land itself rejects their presence.

Experienced Paladins learn that battles are not always won through overwhelming force. Sometimes victory comes from claiming the ground beneath your feet and compelling friend and foe alike to fight upon terrain blessed by a higher power.

### Effects

- Spend **50 MP** to consecrate an area within **15 metres**.
- Create a **7 metre radius Hallowed Ground** that lasts for **4 Rounds**.
- The appearance, damage type, and visual effects are determined by your patron's Religious pages.
- Creatures aligned with your patron's **Divine Resonance** that begin their turn within the Hallowed Ground restore **2d8 + your Charisma Modifier HP**.
- Creatures aligned with your patron's **Divine Opposition** that begin their turn within the Hallowed Ground take **2d8 Patron Damage**.
- Creatures aligned with your patron's **Divine Opposition** suffer a **−2 penalty on Saving Throws** against effects originating from your patron while they remain within the Hallowed Ground.
- The exact creatures, followers, summons, and divine entities affected by **Divine Resonance** and **Divine Opposition** are determined by your patron's Religious pages.
- A creature may only benefit from or be damaged by Hallowed Ground **once per round**.
- Additional effects granted by your patron's **Divine Authority** apply while creatures remain within the Hallowed Ground, where applicable.
- Multiple Hallowed Ground effects may overlap, but creatures are only affected by the single strongest Hallowed Ground of each patron.

### Lore

The greatest temples teach that sacred ground is more than a place of worship—it is a place where the divine feels close enough to touch. As a Paladin's devotion grows, they learn to recreate a fragment of that holy presence wherever they stand, carrying their patron's influence into the heart of battle.

Many ancient battlefields became revered pilgrimage sites because the divine essence left behind by legendary Paladins lingered long after the fighting had ended. Even centuries later, worshippers claim to feel the comforting embrace—or unsettling rejection—of the patron that once claimed that ground.

> *"The world remembers every place the gods have touched. Today, this ground shall remember my patron."*  
> **— High Hierophant Cassiel, Keeper of the Sacred Paths**

## Rank 3
### Description

Your patron's influence no longer merely blesses the battlefield—it begins to reshape it. The sacred domain you create resonates with divine purpose, strengthening those who walk in harmony with your deity while steadily weakening the resolve of those who stand against it.

Within the Hallowed Ground, the boundary between the mortal realm and your patron's divine domain grows thin. Every heartbeat spent upon the consecrated earth reinforces the patron's will. Those aligned with your deity feel renewed with every passing moment, while opposing forces find their strength slowly eroded beneath the overwhelming presence of the divine.

To veteran Paladins, Hallowed Ground becomes more than a place of refuge. It is a declaration that this battlefield has been claimed, and all who enter must answer to the will of the patron who sanctified it.

### Effects

- Spend **60 MP** to consecrate an area within **20 metres**.
- Create a **10 metre radius Hallowed Ground** that lasts for **5 Rounds**.
- The appearance, damage type, and visual effects are determined by your patron's Religious pages.
- Creatures aligned with your patron's **Divine Resonance** that begin their turn within the Hallowed Ground restore **3d8 + your Charisma Modifier HP**.
- Creatures aligned with your patron's **Divine Opposition** that begin their turn within the Hallowed Ground take **3d8 Patron Damage**.
- Creatures aligned with your patron's **Divine Opposition** suffer a **−4 penalty on Saving Throws** against effects originating from your patron while they remain within the Hallowed Ground.
- Once per turn, creatures aligned with your patron's **Divine Resonance** may immediately attempt a new Saving Throw against one effect associated with your patron's **Divine Opposition**, gaining a **+2 bonus** on that Saving Throw.
- The exact creatures, followers, summons, and divine entities affected by **Divine Resonance** and **Divine Opposition** are determined by your patron's Religious pages.
- A creature may only benefit from or be damaged by Hallowed Ground **once per round**.
- Additional effects granted by your patron's **Divine Authority** apply while creatures remain within the Hallowed Ground, where applicable.
- Multiple Hallowed Ground effects may overlap, but creatures are only affected by the single strongest Hallowed Ground of each patron.

### Lore

As a Paladin's devotion matures, their patron's influence ceases to be a fleeting blessing and instead becomes a living domain upon the battlefield. Warriors who fight within it often describe feeling as though they stand beneath the direct gaze of the deity itself, their courage renewed while opposing powers seem strangely diminished.

Many of Asteria's holiest battlefields were said to have been transformed by Paladins of this mastery. Even centuries later, pilgrims claim those places still carry echoes of the divine presence that once sanctified them, while creatures opposed to that patron instinctively avoid crossing the ancient ground.

> *"Where my patron walks, the faithful are strengthened and the faithless find no comfort."*  
> **— High Hierophant Cassiel, Keeper of the Sacred Paths**

## Rank 4
### Description

Your patron's influence now extends far beyond a simple blessing upon the land. When you consecrate the battlefield, the ground itself begins to reflect a fragment of your deity's divine realm, strengthening those who embody your patron's ideals while relentlessly rejecting those who stand in opposition.

Within this sacred domain, divine power flows freely. Every step taken by those aligned with your patron renews their strength and conviction, while opposing forces feel the crushing weight of entering territory that no longer welcomes their presence. To them, the very earth seems to resist their advance.

Among the greatest Paladins, Hallowed Ground is considered the ultimate expression of battlefield control. Rather than merely fighting upon the battlefield, they transform the battlefield into an extension of their patron's divine will, allowing every miracle they perform to resonate more strongly within its sacred boundaries.

### Effects

- Spend **75 MP** to consecrate an area within **25 metres**.
- Create a **12 metre radius Hallowed Ground** that lasts for **6 Rounds**.
- The appearance, damage type, and visual manifestation are determined by your patron's Religious pages.
- Creatures aligned with your patron's **Divine Resonance** that begin their turn within the Hallowed Ground restore **4d8 + your Charisma Modifier HP**.
- Creatures aligned with your patron's **Divine Opposition** that begin their turn within the Hallowed Ground take **4d8 Patron Damage**.
- Creatures aligned with your patron's **Divine Opposition** suffer a **−6 penalty on Saving Throws** against abilities originating from your patron while they remain within the Hallowed Ground.
- Creatures aligned with your patron's **Divine Resonance** gain a **+2 bonus to Saving Throws** against effects originating from your patron's Divine Opposition while they remain within the Hallowed Ground.
- All Paladin talents that reference your patron's **Divine Authority** are considered empowered while used within your Hallowed Ground. Apply any additional effects granted by your patron's Religious pages.
- The exact creatures, followers, summons, and divine entities affected by **Divine Resonance** and **Divine Opposition** are determined by your patron's Religious pages.
- A creature may only benefit from or be damaged by Hallowed Ground **once per round**.
- Multiple Hallowed Ground effects may overlap, but creatures are only affected by the single strongest Hallowed Ground of each patron.

### Lore

Only a handful of Paladins ever reach the point where the world itself bends to reflect their patron's divine influence. Their Hallowed Ground is no longer viewed as a temporary blessing, but as a sacred territory where the deity's presence can almost be felt with every breath.

Many ancient battlefields became holy sites because legendary Paladins fought upon them with such devotion that traces of their patron's influence remained long after the conflict had ended. Pilgrims still journey to these places seeking blessings, while those opposed to the patron often refuse to set foot upon the consecrated ground.

> *"This is no longer mortal soil. For a fleeting moment, you stand within my patron's realm."*  
> **— High Hierophant Cassiel, Keeper of the Sacred Paths**

## Rank 5
### Description

Your faith has reached its pinnacle, allowing your patron to briefly manifest a fragment of their divine realm upon the mortal world. The land itself becomes an extension of your deity's will, transforming the battlefield into sacred territory where their influence reigns supreme.

Every Hallowed Ground is unique to the patron that created it. Some blossom into flourishing sanctuaries overflowing with life, while others become silent graveyards where restless spirits gather. Some shimmer with impossible threads of fate, while others burn with celestial fire or echo with infernal wrath. Though their appearance differs, they all represent the same truth—the world itself has yielded to divine authority.

Those whose souls resonate with your patron find themselves strengthened simply by standing within the domain. Those aligned against your patron feel the land reject their presence, every moment spent within it reminding them they walk upon ground claimed by a higher power.

### Effects

- Spend **90 MP** to consecrate an area within **30 metres**.
- Create a **15 metre radius Hallowed Ground** that lasts for **8 Rounds**.
- The appearance, damage type, and all additional effects are determined by your patron's Religious pages.
- Creatures aligned with your patron's **Divine Resonance** that begin their turn within the Hallowed Ground restore **5d8 + your Charisma Modifier HP**.
- Creatures aligned with your patron's **Divine Opposition** that begin their turn within the Hallowed Ground take **5d8 Patron Damage**.
- Creatures aligned with your patron's **Divine Opposition** have **Disadvantage on Saving Throws** against abilities originating from your patron while they remain within the Hallowed Ground.
- Creatures aligned with your patron's **Divine Resonance** have **Advantage on Saving Throws** against effects originating from your patron's Divine Opposition while they remain within the Hallowed Ground.
- All Paladin talents that reference your patron's **Divine Authority** are empowered while used within your Hallowed Ground. Apply all Rank V Divine Authority effects described in your patron's Religious pages.
- The exact creatures, followers, summons, and divine entities affected by **Divine Resonance** and **Divine Opposition** are determined by your patron's Religious pages.
- A creature may only benefit from or be damaged by Hallowed Ground **once per round**.
- Multiple Hallowed Ground effects may overlap, but creatures are only affected by the strongest Hallowed Ground belonging to each individual patron.

### Lore

The oldest scriptures speak of legendary champions capable of bringing a fragment of their patron's divine realm into the mortal world. Though only for a few fleeting moments, these sacred domains became places where miracles felt natural and divine judgement seemed inevitable.

Entire civilizations have built temples upon battlefields where such miracles once occurred, believing traces of the patron's presence still linger beneath the soil. Whether these stories are truth or legend, every holy order agrees that no greater expression of a Paladin's devotion exists than to allow their deity's will to reshape the very ground beneath their feet.

> *"For this brief moment, this land no longer belongs to kings or kingdoms. It belongs to my patron."*  
> **— High Hierophant Cassiel, Keeper of the Sacred Paths**

None

See individual rank details.

every hallowed ground is unique to the patron that created it. some blossom into flourishing sanctuaries overflowing with life, while others become silent graveyards where restless spirits gather. some shimmer with impossible threads of fate, while others burn with celestial fire or echo with infernal wrath. though their appearance differs, they all represent the same truth—the world itself has yielded to divine authority.

those whose souls resonate with your patron find themselves strengthened simply by standing within the domain. those aligned against your patron feel the land reject their presence, every moment spent within it reminding them they walk upon ground claimed by a higher power.

### effects

- spend **90 mp** to consecrate an area within **30 metres**.
- create a **15 metre radius hallowed ground** that lasts for **8 rounds**.
- the appearance, damage type, and all additional effects are determined by your patron's religious pages.
- creatures aligned with your patron's **divine resonance** that begin their turn within the hallowed ground restore **5d8 + your charisma modifier hp**.
- creatures aligned with your patron's **divine opposition** that begin their turn within the hallowed ground take **5d8 patron damage**.
- creatures aligned with your patron's **divine opposition** have **disadvantage on saving throws** against abilities originating from your patron while they remain within the hallowed ground.
- creatures aligned with your patron's **divine resonance** have **advantage on saving throws** against effects originating from your patron's divine opposition while they remain within the hallowed ground.
- all paladin talents that reference your patron's **divine authority** are empowered while used within your hallowed ground. apply all rank v divine authority effects described in your patron's religious pages.
- the exact creatures, followers, summons, and divine entities affected by **divine resonance** and **divine opposition** are determined by your patron's religious pages.
- a creature may only benefit from or be damaged by hallowed ground **once per round**.
- multiple hallowed ground effects may overlap, but creatures are only affected by the strongest hallowed ground belonging to each individual patron.

### lore

the oldest scriptures speak of legendary champions capable of bringing a fragment of their patron's divine realm into the mortal world. though only for a few fleeting moments, these sacred domains became places where miracles felt natural and divine judgement seemed inevitable.

entire civilizations have built temples upon battlefields where such miracles once occurred, believing traces of the patron's presence still linger beneath the soil. whether these stories are truth or legend, every holy order agrees that no greater expression of a paladin's devotion exists than to allow their deity's will to reshape the very ground beneath their feet.

> *"for this brief moment, this land no longer belongs to kings or kingdoms. it belongs to my patron."*  
> **— high hierophant cassiel, keeper of the sacred paths**

# Hardened Soul

## Overview
Every Bloodhunter knows that monsters do not always attack the body. Some prey invade the mind, whisper to the soul, or awaken fear so overwhelming that even the strongest warriors falter. A Bloodhunter cannot afford such weakness.

The countless emotions absorbed through Sangramancy gradually temper the Bloodhunter's spirit. Every fear conquered, every nightmare endured, and every brush with Bloodlust leaves their soul stronger than before. Rather than hiding from these emotions, the Bloodhunter learns to embrace them, transforming terror into determination.

This discipline is known as the **Hardened Soul**. Instead of allowing fear to control them, the Bloodhunter may willingly draw upon the darkness already growing within. By accepting additional Blood Points, they strengthen their resolve, pushing back against the forces seeking to dominate their mind.

The choice is never free.

Every time a Bloodhunter embraces the darkness, they step one pace closer to Bloodlust. A wise hunter knows there are battles worth risking their soul for—and others where restraint is the greater victory.

## Rank 1
### Description

Every Bloodhunter knows that monsters do not always attack the body. Some prey invade the mind, whisper to the soul, or awaken fear so overwhelming that even the strongest warriors falter. A Bloodhunter cannot afford such weakness.

The countless emotions absorbed through Sangramancy gradually temper the Bloodhunter's spirit. Every fear conquered, every nightmare endured, and every brush with Bloodlust leaves their soul stronger than before. Rather than hiding from these emotions, the Bloodhunter learns to embrace them, transforming terror into determination.

This discipline is known as the **Hardened Soul**. Instead of allowing fear to control them, the Bloodhunter may willingly draw upon the darkness already growing within. By accepting additional Blood Points, they strengthen their resolve, pushing back against the forces seeking to dominate their mind.

The choice is never free.

Every time a Bloodhunter embraces the darkness, they step one pace closer to Bloodlust. A wise hunter knows there are battles worth risking their soul for—and others where restraint is the greater victory.

### Effects

- Hardened Soul is a **Passive Talent**.
- Whenever you are required to make a Saving Throw against becoming **Frightened**, you may choose to activate Hardened Soul **before making the Saving Throw**.
- If you do, immediately gain **5 Blood Points (BP)**.
- You gain a **+2 bonus** to the Saving Throw.
- This decision is entirely optional and must be declared before the Saving Throw is rolled.
- Blood Points gained through Hardened Soul count towards your **Blood Point Limit** and may contribute to triggering **Bloodlust**.
- Hardened Soul may be used any number of times, provided you are willing to accept the Blood Point cost.

### Lore

Among the Bloodhunter Orders, fear is not considered an enemy to overcome—it is a weapon to master. Apprentices are taught that courage is not the absence of fear, but the willingness to continue despite it. Through years of Sangramancy, they learn that every terrifying emotion can become another source of strength if they are willing to bear its burden.

Veteran Bloodhunters often describe Hardened Soul as opening a door that should never remain open for long. For a fleeting moment, they allow the darkness carried within their blood to rise to the surface, drowning out fear with something far more dangerous. It grants clarity, resolve, and unwavering determination, but every use leaves another scar upon the soul.

Many who succumb to Bloodlust once believed they could always control the darkness. The wisest Bloodhunters understand that Hardened Soul is not about proving one's strength—it is about knowing exactly how much darkness can be embraced before it begins embracing you.

> *"Fear asked me to kneel. I offered it my blood instead."*  
> — Grand Bloodhunter Serik Vaelor

## Rank 2
### Description

The soul of a Bloodhunter is forged through countless encounters with horrors that would shatter ordinary minds. Every monster faced, every Blood Communion performed, and every step taken toward Bloodlust tempers their spirit into something far stronger than mortal resolve.

At this stage, the Bloodhunter no longer steels themselves against fear alone. They have learned that charm, temptation, and false comfort are simply different weapons wielded by the darkness. Rather than allowing these emotions to cloud their judgement, they willingly feed them into the ever-growing storm within their blood.

To outsiders, this appears reckless. A Bloodhunter knowingly embraces the very corruption that threatens to consume them. Yet experienced hunters understand that every choice is calculated. Sometimes allowing Blood Points to rise is preferable to surrendering control of the hunt.

Masters often remind their apprentices that Hardened Soul is not about becoming fearless—it is about deciding which battle is worth risking your humanity. Every use strengthens the Bloodhunter's resolve, but also brings them one step closer to the cold certainty of Bloodlust.

### Effects

- Hardened Soul remains a **Passive Talent**.
- Whenever you are required to make a Saving Throw against becoming **Frightened** or **Charmed**, you may choose to activate Hardened Soul **before making the Saving Throw**.
- If you do, immediately gain **10 Blood Points (BP)**.
- You gain a **+4 bonus** to the Saving Throw.
- This decision is entirely optional and must be declared before the Saving Throw is rolled.
- Blood Points gained through Hardened Soul count towards your **Blood Point Limit** and may contribute to triggering **Bloodlust**.
- Hardened Soul may be used any number of times, provided you are willing to accept the Blood Point cost.

### Lore

Experienced Bloodhunters eventually realise that monsters rarely rely upon brute strength alone. Vampires seduce, fey deceive, demons tempt, and eldritch horrors whisper promises that slowly erode the will of even the strongest heroes. The greatest danger is often not the monster's claws, but its ability to convince its prey to surrender willingly.

Through relentless discipline, the Bloodhunter learns to recognise these manipulations before they take hold. Instead of resisting through force of will alone, they deliberately awaken the darkness already sleeping within their blood. Terror and temptation are swallowed by Sangramancy, becoming fuel for determination rather than chains upon the mind.

This practice is considered one of the most dangerous teachings within every Bloodhunter Order. Apprentices are warned that each time they embrace the darkness, it becomes easier to do so again. One day they may discover that resisting fear is no longer difficult—not because they have mastered it, but because they have begun to feel nothing at all.

> *"The darkness offered me comfort. I answered by making it carry my burden instead."*  
> — Grand Bloodhunter Serik Vaelor

## Rank 3
### Description

A Bloodhunter who reaches the Third Rank of Hardened Soul has begun to understand one undeniable truth—every emotion is a weapon. Fear, desire, despair, and doubt are no longer obstacles to overcome, but sources of strength waiting to be embraced. Rather than resisting the darkness invading their mind, they willingly pull it into themselves, allowing Sangramancy to consume its influence before it can take hold.

The Bloodhunter's soul has become a battlefield unlike any other. Countless Blood Communions, dangerous hunts, and moments spent standing on the edge of Bloodlust have forged a spirit that refuses to break. Every choice to embrace Blood Points instead of surrendering control strengthens this inner resolve, teaching the Bloodhunter that true courage is not the absence of fear, but the willingness to weaponise it.

Yet this newfound mastery carries a frightening consequence. The Bloodhunter begins to rely upon the darkness. Each successful act of defiance makes it easier to accept more Blood Points, and easier still to justify walking ever closer to Bloodlust. Masters teach that the greatest danger is no longer the monsters outside—but the growing belief that the monster within can always be controlled.

Only the wisest Bloodhunters remember that every choice has a cost.

### Effects

- Hardened Soul remains a **Passive Talent**.
- Whenever you are required to make a Saving Throw against becoming **Frightened**, **Charmed**, or **Mentally Influenced**, you may choose to activate Hardened Soul **before making the Saving Throw**.
- If you do, immediately gain **15 Blood Points (BP)**.
- You automatically **succeed** on the Saving Throw.
- Mental Influence includes magical or supernatural effects that alter your thoughts, emotions, or judgement, as determined by the GM.
- This decision is entirely optional and must be declared before the Saving Throw is rolled.
- Blood Points gained through Hardened Soul count towards your **Blood Point Limit** and may contribute to triggering **Bloodlust**.
- Hardened Soul may be used any number of times, provided you are willing to accept the Blood Point cost.

### Lore

Among the Bloodhunter Orders, the Third Rank is known as **The Iron Mind**. It is the stage where a hunter no longer fears the whispers of darkness because they have learned to answer them with their own.

Veteran Bloodhunters describe the experience as opening a gate within the soul. For a fleeting moment, every fear, temptation, and doubt is swallowed by Sangramancy and transformed into unwavering resolve. The hunter walks forward untouched while lesser warriors falter.

But every gate opened becomes easier to open again.

The elders caution that many Bloodhunters who eventually succumb to Bloodlust never lost a battle of will—they won too many. Each victory convinced them they remained in control, until one day the darkness no longer needed permission to answer in their place.

> *"The mind can be conquered only once. Mine was conquered by my own will long before any monster had the chance."*  
> — Grand Bloodhunter Serik Vaelor

## Rank 4
### Description

Very few Bloodhunters ever attain the Fourth Rank of Hardened Soul. Those who do have spent years standing upon the edge of Bloodlust, repeatedly choosing discipline over surrender. Their soul has become a fortress forged through suffering, strengthened not by avoiding darkness, but by surviving it.

At this stage, the Bloodhunter no longer fears attempts to dominate their mind. Every supernatural assault is viewed as another opportunity to draw strength from the emotions carried within their own blood. Terror becomes determination. Temptation becomes resolve. Corruption becomes another burden willingly carried so that others never have to.

This does not mean the Bloodhunter is immune to manipulation. Instead, they possess the experience to decide when to embrace Sangramancy and when to trust their own will. Every choice is calculated, every risk deliberate. The Bloodhunter knows that accepting more Blood Points may save their life today, while simultaneously bringing them closer to the moment they lose themselves forever.

The greatest masters teach that Hardened Soul is not measured by how much darkness you can endure—it is measured by knowing exactly when not to embrace it.

### Effects

- Hardened Soul remains a **Passive Talent**.
- Whenever you are targeted by an effect that would cause **Frightened, Charmed, Possession, Mental Influence, or Magical Compulsion**, you may choose to activate Hardened Soul **before making any Saving Throw**.
- If you do, immediately gain **20 Blood Points (BP)**.
- You automatically succeed on the Saving Throw.
- If the effect does not normally allow a Saving Throw, you may instead ignore the effect entirely.
- This decision is entirely optional and must be declared before the effect is resolved.
- Blood Points gained through Hardened Soul count towards your **Blood Point Limit** and may contribute to triggering **Bloodlust**.
- Hardened Soul may be used any number of times, provided you are willing to accept the Blood Point cost.

### Lore

Within the Bloodhunter Orders, the Fourth Rank is known as **The Crimson Bastion**. Hunters who achieve this level have endured horrors capable of breaking kings, saints, and legendary heroes alike. Their souls have become scarred beyond recognition, yet every scar serves as another layer of protection against those who would seek to control them.

Elders often remind apprentices that the strongest walls are not built from stone, but from sacrifice. Every time a Bloodhunter willingly accepts Blood Points instead of surrendering their mind, they strengthen that wall while simultaneously allowing the darkness within to grow stronger.

This balance defines every master Bloodhunter. They understand that absolute control is an illusion. Instead, they choose to remain one step ahead of Bloodlust, trusting that when the day finally comes to embrace the darkness completely, it will be for a cause worthy of the price.

> *"Every scar upon the soul is another gate the darkness must break before it can claim me."*  
> — Grand Bloodhunter Serik Vaelor

## Rank 5
### Description

A Bloodhunter who achieves the Fifth Rank of Hardened Soul has reached the pinnacle of spiritual discipline. Their soul has endured years of Sangramancy, Blood Communions, and countless moments standing upon the edge of Bloodlust without surrendering completely to the darkness within. While others see corruption as something to resist, the Bloodhunter has learned to confront it, understand it, and ultimately command it.

Their spirit has become a crucible where fear, temptation, madness, and despair are consumed before they can take root. Every mental assault is met not with resistance, but with absolute resolve. The Bloodhunter chooses whether to accept the burden of Blood Points or simply reject the influence altogether, demonstrating complete mastery over the emotions carried within their blood.

This mastery does not mean the Bloodhunter is free from Bloodlust. Quite the opposite. They stand closer to it than any other hunter alive. Every decision to embrace additional Blood Points still brings them nearer to losing themselves forever. The difference is that the choice now belongs entirely to them.

Among the Bloodhunter Orders, those who reach this level are known as **Soulwardens**. They are living proof that Sangramancy can be mastered without abandoning one's humanity, though few survive long enough to earn such a title.

### Effects

- Hardened Soul remains a **Passive Talent**.
- Whenever you are targeted by an effect that would cause **Frightened, Charmed, Possession, Mental Influence, Madness, Corruption, or Magical Compulsion**, you may choose to activate Hardened Soul **before the effect is resolved**.
- You may choose one of the following options:
  - **Embrace the Darkness:** Gain **25 Blood Points (BP)** and automatically ignore the effect.
  - **Stand Firm:** Ignore the effect without gaining Blood Points.
- This decision is entirely optional and must be declared before the effect is resolved.
- Blood Points gained through Hardened Soul count towards your **Blood Point Limit** and may contribute to triggering **Bloodlust**.
- Hardened Soul may be used any number of times.
- This talent only protects against effects that directly influence, control, corrupt, or manipulate your mind or soul. It provides no protection against physical conditions or damage.

### Lore

Very few Bloodhunters ever become Soulwardens. Their souls have endured horrors beyond imagination, yet they continue to walk the line between humanity and monstrosity with unwavering purpose. They understand that the darkness within them will never disappear—it can only be acknowledged, respected, and controlled.

To younger Bloodhunters, a Soulwarden appears almost impossible to intimidate. Ancient vampires, elder demons, and eldritch horrors speak words meant to shatter the strongest minds, yet the Bloodhunter simply continues walking. They have already faced the greatest darkness imaginable—the one growing within their own soul.

The elders teach that Hardened Soul was never about becoming immune to fear or corruption. It was always about choice. Every Bloodhunter must eventually decide whether to embrace the darkness for greater strength or reject it to preserve themselves. A Soulwarden has learned that true mastery is not choosing one path over the other, but knowing precisely when each is required.

> *"The darkness has knocked upon my soul a thousand times. Now it waits politely... because it knows I decide when the door opens."*  
> — Grand Bloodhunter Serik Vaelor

None

their spirit has become a crucible where fear, temptation, madness, and despair are consumed before they can take root. every mental assault is met not with resistance, but with absolute resolve. the bloodhunter chooses whether to accept the burden of blood points or simply reject the influence altogether, demonstrating complete mastery over the emotions carried within their blood.

this mastery does not mean the bloodhunter is free from bloodlust. quite the opposite. they stand closer to it than any other hunter alive. every decision to embrace additional blood points still brings them nearer to losing themselves forever. the difference is that the choice now belongs entirely to them.

among the bloodhunter orders, those who reach this level are known as **soulwardens**. they are living proof that sangramancy can be mastered without abandoning one's humanity, though few survive long enough to earn such a title.

### effects

- hardened soul remains a **passive talent**.
- whenever you are targeted by an effect that would cause **frightened, charmed, possession, mental influence, madness, corruption, or magical compulsion**, you may choose to activate hardened soul **before the effect is resolved**.
- you may choose one of the following options:
  - **embrace the darkness:** gain **25 blood points (bp)** and automatically ignore the effect.
  - **stand firm:** ignore the effect without gaining blood points.
- this decision is entirely optional and must be declared before the effect is resolved.
- blood points gained through hardened soul count towards your **blood point limit** and may contribute to triggering **bloodlust**.
- hardened soul may be used any number of times.
- this talent only protects against effects that directly influence, control, corrupt, or manipulate your mind or soul. it provides no protection against physical conditions or damage.

### lore

very few bloodhunters ever become soulwardens. their souls have endured horrors beyond imagination, yet they continue to walk the line between humanity and monstrosity with unwavering purpose. they understand that the darkness within them will never disappear—it can only be acknowledged, respected, and controlled.

to younger bloodhunters, a soulwarden appears almost impossible to intimidate. ancient vampires, elder demons, and eldritch horrors speak words meant to shatter the strongest minds, yet the bloodhunter simply continues walking. they have already faced the greatest darkness imaginable—the one growing within their own soul.

the elders teach that hardened soul was never about becoming immune to fear or corruption. it was always about choice. every bloodhunter must eventually decide whether to embrace the darkness for greater strength or reject it to preserve themselves. a soulwarden has learned that true mastery is not choosing one path over the other, but knowing precisely when each is required.

> *"the darkness has knocked upon my soul a thousand times. now it waits politely... because it knows i decide when the door opens."*  
> — grand bloodhunter serik vaelor

# Hawk Eyes

## Overview
A Ranger's greatest weapon is not their bow, but their vision. Through years of studying birds of prey and mastering the art of observation, the Ranger develops eyesight capable of discerning details that others would never notice. Distant movement, subtle changes in terrain, and the smallest opening between obstacles become immediately apparent.

Hawk Eyes is not magical sight. Instead, it is the culmination of relentless training, allowing the Ranger to focus on distant targets with remarkable clarity. By concentrating on a creature or location, they can judge distances, identify the amount of cover protecting a target, and recognise visual details that would normally be lost to the naked eye.

This exceptional vision also makes difficult shots easier to judge. Rather than increasing the Ranger's accuracy directly, Hawk Eyes allows them to better understand the shot before it is taken, reducing the challenges posed by distance, terrain, and other visual obstacles.

---

## Rank 1
### Description

A Ranger's greatest weapon is not their bow, but their vision. Through years of studying birds of prey and mastering the art of observation, the Ranger develops eyesight capable of discerning details that others would never notice. Distant movement, subtle changes in terrain, and the smallest opening between obstacles become immediately apparent.

Hawk Eyes is not magical sight. Instead, it is the culmination of relentless training, allowing the Ranger to focus on distant targets with remarkable clarity. By concentrating on a creature or location, they can judge distances, identify the amount of cover protecting a target, and recognise visual details that would normally be lost to the naked eye.

This exceptional vision also makes difficult shots easier to judge. Rather than increasing the Ranger's accuracy directly, Hawk Eyes allows them to better understand the shot before it is taken, reducing the challenges posed by distance, terrain, and other visual obstacles.

---

### Effects

#### Enhanced Vision

The Ranger may focus on a creature, object, or location within line of sight.

While focused, the Ranger can:

- Estimate the distance to the target.
- Determine whether the target has **Light, Half, or Three-Quarters Cover**.
- Clearly distinguish visible weapons, armour, and equipment.
- Notice obvious injuries or unusual physical features.

#### Shooter's Eye

The Ranger's exceptional vision reduces the difficulty of ranged attacks.

- Reduce penalties applied to ranged attack rolls caused by **distance, target size, or environmental visibility** by **1** (minimum 0).

This benefit applies to all:

- Ranged weapon attacks.
- Ranged combat talents.
- Ranged combat skills.
- Racial traits that require a ranged attack roll.

#### Limitations

- Hawk Eyes does not grant Darkvision.
- Hawk Eyes does not reveal invisible creatures.
- Hawk Eyes cannot see through solid objects.
- Magical concealment still functions normally.
- The GM determines what information is reasonably visible.

---

### Lore

Every Ranger is taught that prey is rarely defeated through strength alone. Victory begins with observation. The slightest movement among the trees, a glint of sunlight reflecting from armour, or the faint outline of a figure behind a stone wall may reveal everything a skilled hunter needs to know.

Across Asteria, veteran Rangers spend years training their eyesight by observing wildlife from impossible distances and learning to judge terrain with remarkable precision. Many apprentices fail these lessons, not because they lack talent, but because they never learn the patience required to truly see.

Among the Ranger Lodges, Hawk Eyes is regarded as the first step towards true mastery of ranged combat. Before a Ranger learns how to strike perfectly, they must first learn how to see perfectly.

---

> *"Every perfect shot begins long before the arrow ever leaves the bow."*  
> — **Master Ranger Caelan Skywatch**

## Rank 2
### Description

The Ranger's eyesight continues to develop through years of practice and experience. Focusing on distant targets becomes second nature, allowing them to distinguish details that would be impossible for most people to perceive. Terrain, movement, and obstacles are analysed almost instinctively, giving the Ranger a clearer understanding of the battlefield before combat even begins.

As their vision improves, so too does their ability to judge difficult shots. Changes in elevation, partial cover, and environmental conditions become easier to account for, allowing the Ranger to make shots that would challenge even experienced marksmen.

Veteran Rangers often serve as scouts and lookouts, trusted to detect danger long before it reaches their companions.

---

### Effects

#### Enhanced Vision

- Increase the Ranger's **effective visual identification range by ×4**.
- Accurately estimate the distance to creatures, objects, and locations.
- Determine whether a target has **Light, Half, or Three-Quarters Cover**.
- Clearly identify visible weapons, armour, shields, ammunition, and carried equipment.
- Recognise obvious injuries, physical abnormalities, signs of exhaustion, and recent damage to equipment.

#### Shooter's Eye

- Reduce penalties applied to ranged attack rolls caused by:
  - Distance.
  - Target size.
  - Environmental visibility.
- Reduce these penalties by **2** (minimum 0).

This benefit applies to:

- Ranged weapon attacks.
- Ranged combat talents.
- Ranged combat skills.
- Racial traits that require a ranged attack roll.

#### Limitations

- Hawk Eyes does not grant Darkvision.
- Hawk Eyes cannot reveal invisible creatures.
- Hawk Eyes cannot see through solid objects or magical barriers.
- Magical concealment and visual illusions function normally.
- The GM determines what information is reasonably visible.

---

### Lore

Reaching the second rank of Hawk Eyes marks the transition from hunter to scout. Rangers possessing this level of vision are often entrusted with leading expeditions, watching over camps, and identifying threats from extraordinary distances before they pose a danger.

Within the Ranger Lodges, students spend countless hours observing wildlife from elevated perches, learning to distinguish the smallest movements across forests, mountains, and open plains. They are taught that the greatest advantage in any hunt is seeing the danger before the danger sees them.

---

> *"Distance is only an obstacle to those who have never trained their eyes."*  
> — **Master Ranger Caelan Skywatch**

## Rank 3
### Description

The Ranger's eyesight has become exceptional, allowing them to observe the world with a level of clarity few mortals can rival. Distant creatures, hidden movement, and subtle imperfections within armour or the landscape become increasingly easy to distinguish. What others dismiss as an indistinct silhouette, the Ranger sees as a wealth of valuable information.

At this stage, the Ranger begins recognising visible weaknesses from afar. Damaged armour, old wounds, poor footing, and exposed gaps stand out through careful observation. This knowledge does not directly improve the Ranger's aim, but it provides vital information that can be exploited through talents such as **Steady Aim** or shared with allies.

Among Ranger Lodges, those who reach this level are often assigned as reconnaissance specialists, capable of gathering intelligence before a battle has even begun.

---

### Effects

#### Enhanced Vision

- Increase the Ranger's **effective visual identification range by ×8**.
- Accurately estimate the distance to creatures, objects, and locations.
- Determine whether a target has **Light, Half, or Three-Quarters Cover**.
- Clearly identify visible weapons, armour, shields, ammunition, and carried equipment.
- Recognise obvious injuries, physical abnormalities, damaged equipment, and signs of exhaustion.
- Identify **visible weak points**, such as damaged armour, exposed joints, old wounds, or unstable footing. *(Information only; this grants no combat bonus by itself.)*

#### Shooter's Eye

- Reduce penalties applied to ranged attack rolls caused by:
  - Distance.
  - Target size.
  - Environmental visibility.
- Reduce these penalties by **3** (minimum 0).

This benefit applies to:

- Ranged weapon attacks.
- Ranged combat talents.
- Ranged combat skills.
- Racial traits that require a ranged attack roll.

#### Limitations

- Hawk Eyes does not grant Darkvision.
- Hawk Eyes cannot reveal invisible creatures.
- Hawk Eyes cannot see through solid objects or magical barriers.
- Magical concealment and visual illusions function normally.
- Weak points must be physically visible to be identified.
- The GM determines what information is reasonably observable.

---

### Lore

Rangers who achieve the third rank of Hawk Eyes are renowned throughout Asteria for their remarkable powers of observation. Many serve as military scouts, monster trackers, and expedition leaders, trusted to uncover dangers long before swords are drawn or arrows are loosed.

Within the Ranger Lodges, students are taught that every creature carries the marks of its life upon its body. Scars, worn armour, tired movements, and careless habits all reveal opportunities to those patient enough to look. Hawk Eyes is not about seeing farther—it is about understanding more.

---

> *"The world reveals its secrets to those who have the patience to truly observe it."*  
> — **High Ranger Elyas Stormwatch**

## Rank 4
### Description

The Ranger's vision approaches the limits of mortal perception. Their eyes effortlessly focus across vast distances, allowing them to study creatures, structures, and landscapes with extraordinary clarity. Tiny movements, subtle flaws, and distant landmarks stand out as though they were only metres away.

Through years of hunting and reconnaissance, the Ranger has learned that information is often the greatest weapon. A single glance can reveal weaknesses in fortifications, exposed paths through enemy positions, or vulnerabilities in powerful beasts long before combat begins.

Those who master this level of Hawk Eyes are highly sought after as scouts, pathfinders, and monster hunters, capable of gathering intelligence that would otherwise require entire expeditions.

---

### Effects

#### Enhanced Vision

- Increase the Ranger's **effective visual identification range by ×12**.
- Accurately estimate distances to creatures, objects, and terrain features.
- Determine whether a target has **Light, Half, Three-Quarters, or Total Cover**.
- Clearly identify visible weapons, armour, shields, equipment, ammunition, and carried items.
- Recognise obvious injuries, physical abnormalities, damaged equipment, signs of exhaustion, and environmental hazards.
- Identify visible weak points, including damaged armour, exposed joints, old wounds, unstable footing, and structural weaknesses in objects or buildings.

#### Shooter's Eye

- Reduce penalties applied to ranged attack rolls caused by:
  - Distance.
  - Target size.
  - Environmental visibility.
- Reduce these penalties by **4** (minimum 0).

This benefit applies to:

- Ranged weapon attacks.
- Ranged combat talents.
- Ranged combat skills.
- Racial traits that require a ranged attack roll.

#### Battlefield Awareness

While observing a location, the Ranger can identify:

- Likely ambush positions.
- Elevated firing positions.
- Natural chokepoints.
- Safe routes through natural terrain.

The GM determines what can reasonably be identified.

#### Limitations

- Hawk Eyes does not grant Darkvision.
- Hawk Eyes cannot reveal invisible creatures.
- Hawk Eyes cannot see through solid objects or magical barriers.
- Magical concealment and visual illusions function normally.
- Information is limited to what is physically visible.
- The GM determines what details can reasonably be observed.

---

### Lore

Rank 4 is known among the Ranger Lodges as the **Eagle's Gaze**, a title earned only by those whose perception has become legendary. Rangers of this calibre have guided armies through hostile lands, uncovered hidden monster lairs, and prevented countless ambushes simply by seeing what others could not.

Stories tell of Eagle's Gaze Rangers identifying a cracked bridge from over a kilometre away or spotting a dragon circling high above the clouds long before anyone else noticed. Whether these tales are embellished or not, they all speak to the same truth: knowledge gained through observation is often the deciding factor between victory and defeat.

---

> *"The greatest advantage is not striking first—it is knowing exactly where to strike."*  
> — **Grand Ranger Aelar Windwatch**

## Rank 5
### Description

The Ranger has reached the pinnacle of natural vision, earning the legendary title of **Predator's Vision** among the Ranger Lodges. Their eyesight rivals the greatest birds of prey in Asteria, allowing them to observe creatures and landscapes with astonishing clarity across immense distances. Every movement, flaw, and detail becomes part of a larger picture that only a master Ranger can truly understand.

To the Ranger, no battlefield is ever unknown. They instinctively recognise firing lanes, hidden dangers, structural weaknesses, and visible vulnerabilities before combat begins. What others dismiss as distant shapes, the Ranger sees as opportunities waiting to be exploited.

Predator's Vision is not magical sight—it is the culmination of decades of discipline, patience, and experience. It is the final proof that the Ranger's greatest weapon has always been their ability to observe.

---

### Effects

#### Predator's Vision

- Increase the Ranger's **effective visual identification range by ×20**.
- Accurately estimate the distance to any visible creature, object, or landmark.
- Determine whether a target has **Light, Half, Three-Quarters, or Total Cover**.
- Clearly identify visible weapons, armour, shields, equipment, ammunition, carried items, and significant magical equipment.
- Recognise visible injuries, physical abnormalities, damaged equipment, signs of exhaustion, and structural weaknesses.
- Instinctively identify visible weak points on creatures, objects, and structures.
- Greatly reduce the time required to search an area using sight, at the GM's discretion.

#### Shooter's Eye

- Reduce penalties applied to ranged attack rolls caused by:
  - Distance.
  - Target size.
  - Environmental visibility.
- Reduce these penalties by **5** (minimum 0).

This benefit applies to:

- Ranged weapon attacks.
- Ranged combat talents.
- Ranged combat skills.
- Racial traits that require a ranged attack roll.

#### Battlefield Mastery

While observing an area, the Ranger can quickly identify:

- Hidden firing positions.
- Ambush locations.
- Natural chokepoints.
- Escape routes.
- Structural weaknesses.
- Elevated vantage points.
- Environmental hazards.

The GM determines what information is reasonably visible.

#### Limitations

- Hawk Eyes does not grant Darkvision.
- Hawk Eyes cannot reveal invisible creatures.
- Hawk Eyes cannot see through solid objects or magical barriers.
- Magical concealment, illusions, and divination wards function normally unless another ability bypasses them.
- All information is limited to what is physically visible.
- The GM determines what details can reasonably be observed.

---

### Lore

Predator's Vision is considered the highest achievement of every Ranger. Throughout history, only a select few have mastered this discipline, becoming legendary scouts whose observations have changed the course of wars and brought down creatures thought impossible to hunt.

The oldest Ranger texts teach that the eyes merely collect information—it is the mind that gives it meaning. A master of Hawk Eyes does not simply see farther than others; they understand what they are seeing before anyone else has even recognised the danger.

Among the Ranger Lodges, earning the title of **Predator's Vision** is one of the greatest honours imaginable. It signifies that the Ranger has become the embodiment of patience, awareness, and precision—the perfect hunter whose greatest victories are often won before the first arrow is ever loosed.

---

> *"Before the arrow is drawn, before the bow is raised, before the hunt begins… the Ranger has already seen the outcome."*  
> — **Grandmaster Thalion Skywatch, First Bearer of Predator's Vision**

None

predator's vision is not magical sight—it is the culmination of decades of discipline, patience, and experience. it is the final proof that the ranger's greatest weapon has always been their ability to observe.

---

### effects

#### predator's vision

- increase the ranger's **effective visual identification range by ×20**.
- accurately estimate the distance to any visible creature, object, or landmark.
- determine whether a target has **light, half, three-quarters, or total cover**.
- clearly identify visible weapons, armour, shields, equipment, ammunition, carried items, and significant magical equipment.
- recognise visible injuries, physical abnormalities, damaged equipment, signs of exhaustion, and structural weaknesses.
- instinctively identify visible weak points on creatures, objects, and structures.
- greatly reduce the time required to search an area using sight, at the gm's discretion.

#### shooter's eye

- reduce penalties applied to ranged attack rolls caused by:
  - distance.
  - target size.
  - environmental visibility.
- reduce these penalties by **5** (minimum 0).

this benefit applies to:

- ranged weapon attacks.
- ranged combat talents.
- ranged combat skills.
- racial traits that require a ranged attack roll.

#### battlefield mastery

while observing an area, the ranger can quickly identify:

- hidden firing positions.
- ambush locations.
- natural chokepoints.
- escape routes.
- structural weaknesses.
- elevated vantage points.
- environmental hazards.

the gm determines what information is reasonably visible.

#### limitations

- hawk eyes does not grant darkvision.
- hawk eyes cannot reveal invisible creatures.
- hawk eyes cannot see through solid objects or magical barriers.
- magical concealment, illusions, and divination wards function normally unless another ability bypasses them.
- all information is limited to what is physically visible.
- the gm determines what details can reasonably be observed.

---

### lore

predator's vision is considered the highest achievement of every ranger. throughout history, only a select few have mastered this discipline, becoming legendary scouts whose observations have changed the course of wars and brought down creatures thought impossible to hunt.

the oldest ranger texts teach that the eyes merely collect information—it is the mind that gives it meaning. a master of hawk eyes does not simply see farther than others; they understand what they are seeing before anyone else has even recognised the danger.

among the ranger lodges, earning the title of **predator's vision** is one of the greatest honours imaginable. it signifies that the ranger has become the embodiment of patience, awareness, and precision—the perfect hunter whose greatest victories are often won before the first arrow is ever loosed.

---

> *"before the arrow is drawn, before the bow is raised, before the hunt begins… the ranger has already seen the outcome."*  
> — **grandmaster thalion skywatch, first bearer of predator's vision**
