> *"if your hatred seeks the innocent, then let it first break itself against my shield."*  
> **— sir garrick dawnshield, high protector of the argent bastion**

## rank 2
### description

your conviction grows stronger, carrying your challenge beyond a single foe. through steadfast faith and commanding presence, you draw the attention of multiple enemies, placing yourself at the centre of the battle and giving your allies the opportunity to act without constant pressure.

a seasoned paladin understands that protecting others is not achieved through brute strength alone. it requires absolute confidence, an unbreakable will, and the courage to become the enemy's greatest obstacle. those who answer your challenge find it increasingly difficult to ignore the warrior who stands before them, shield raised and oath unbroken.

every successful challenge reinforces your role as the defender of your companions, allowing you to dictate the flow of combat through unwavering resolve rather than fear or domination.

### effects

- spend **30 mp** to issue a **divine challenge**.
- choose up to **2 creatures** within **15 metres** that can see or hear you.
- each target must make a **wisdom saving throw**.
- **saving throw dc = 10 + your charisma modifier + your proficiency bonus.**
- on a failed save, the target becomes **challenged** for **2 rounds**.
- a **challenged** creature treats you as its primary combat target whenever it is reasonable to do so.
- a **challenged** creature suffers **−4 to attack rolls** made against creatures other than you.
- the challenge immediately ends for a creature if you are reduced to **0 hp**.
- a creature may ignore the challenge if you become unreachable or another ability forces it to attack a different target.
- bosses, legendary creatures, and creatures of a significantly higher threat tier may gain advantage on their saving throw at the gm's discretion.
- apply any additional bonuses granted by your patron's **divine authority**, if applicable.

### lore

as paladins gain experience, their presence alone becomes enough to command the attention of those around them. their voice carries the weight of countless vows upheld and countless battles survived, causing even disciplined warriors to hesitate before looking past them.

among the great knightly orders, mastering the challenge of multiple foes is considered a defining milestone. it marks the moment a paladin ceases to be merely a protector of individuals and becomes the steadfast guardian of the battlefield itself.

> *"a shield protects one life. a true paladin protects everyone standing behind it."*  
> **— dame elowyn, captain of the silver wardens**

## rank 3
### description

your divine authority has become impossible to ignore. your challenge now echoes across the battlefield, drawing the attention of multiple enemies and forcing them to confront the living embodiment of your oath. those who attempt to disregard your presence find their resolve shaken as the weight of your conviction bears down upon them.

veteran paladins understand that a challenge is more than a declaration of courage—it is a promise. you vow to stand between danger and those under your protection, and your enemies instinctively recognise that promise. while they may resist your authority, every moment spent ignoring you becomes increasingly difficult, allowing your allies to fight under the shelter of your unwavering resolve.

- choose up to **3 creatures** within **20 metres** that can see or hear you.
- each target must make a **wisdom saving throw**.
- **saving throw dc = 10 + your charisma modifier + your proficiency bonus.**
- on a failed save, the target becomes **challenged** for **3 rounds**.
- a **challenged** creature treats you as its primary combat target whenever it is reasonable to do so.
- a **challenged** creature suffers **−6 to attack rolls** made against creatures other than you.
- if a **challenged** creature willingly attacks another target while you are a valid target, it suffers **radiant damage equal to your charisma modifier** immediately after resolving its attack.
- the challenge immediately ends for a creature if you are reduced to **0 hp**.

the greatest defenders are remembered not for the enemies they slew, but for the lives they preserved. a seasoned paladin's challenge is no longer merely heard—it is felt. those who witness it often describe an overwhelming certainty that the warrior before them cannot simply be ignored.

> *"ignore my warning if you must. the light will remember your choice."*  
> **— high justicar alaric, keeper of the sacred bastion**

your divine presence has become impossible to ignore. rather than issuing a challenge to individual foes, your conviction radiates across the battlefield, demanding the attention of every enemy that dares approach.

your challenge no longer protects a single companion. it establishes a defensive bastion wherever you stand, allowing your allies to fight beneath the shelter of your conviction.

- on a failed save, a creature becomes **challenged** for **3 rounds**.

> *"stand behind me and fear nothing. stand before me and fear everything."*  
> **— grandmaster roland ashbourne, first shield of the dawn**

your challenge has become a divine command that echoes across the battlefield. the strength of your conviction radiates from your very presence, compelling enemies to acknowledge you as the greatest obstacle between them and their quarry.

those who stand beside you fight beneath the protection of an unbreakable oath, while those who oppose you feel the crushing weight of divine judgement. though creatures still possess the freedom to resist your challenge, few can ignore the unwavering authority carried by a legendary paladin.

masters of this technique are remembered as living bulwarks. entire battle lines have broken against their shields, not because they were impossible to defeat, but because no enemy could simply walk past them without paying a terrible price.

# Paladin's Charge

## Overview
A Paladin does not hesitate once judgement has been made.

Paladin's Charge is a disciplined burst of speed that allows you to rapidly close the distance between yourself and an enemy or objective. Rather than relying upon agility or trickery, you commit your entire body and conviction to a single, unwavering advance.

Once your charge begins there is no turning back. Your momentum carries you forward until you reach your destination, collide with an obstacle, or strike your target. Mastering this technique teaches every Paladin that commitment is a weapon in itself—one that can break enemy lines just as surely as any blade.

## Rank 1
### Description

A Paladin does not hesitate once judgement has been made.

Paladin's Charge is a disciplined burst of speed that allows you to rapidly close the distance between yourself and an enemy or objective. Rather than relying upon agility or trickery, you commit your entire body and conviction to a single, unwavering advance.

Once your charge begins there is no turning back. Your momentum carries you forward until you reach your destination, collide with an obstacle, or strike your target. Mastering this technique teaches every Paladin that commitment is a weapon in itself—one that can break enemy lines just as surely as any blade.

### Effects

- Spend **15 Stamina** to immediately charge up to **10 metres** in a straight line.
- The direction of the charge is chosen when activated.
- Once the charge begins you:
  - Cannot voluntarily stop.
  - Cannot change direction.
  - Continue until you reach the maximum distance, collide with terrain, or hit your chosen target.
- This movement does **not** provoke Opportunity Attacks from creatures you move past during the charge.

#### Impact

If your charge ends by colliding with an enemy, that creature must make an **Agility Saving Throw**.

**Save DC = 10 + Strength Modifier**

- **Success:** The target holds its ground.
- **Failure:** The target is pushed **2 metres** directly away from you.
- **Critical Failure:** The target is pushed **2 metres**, knocked **Prone**, and must spend movement to stand on its next turn.

Large or firmly anchored creatures may receive Advantage on this saving throw at the GM's discretion.

### Lore

Among the knightly orders of Asteria, recruits spend weeks learning that a charge is not merely running towards an enemy. It is an act of complete commitment. Doubt causes hesitation, hesitation weakens momentum, and lost momentum has claimed the lives of countless warriors.

Veteran Paladins are recognised by the confidence with which they advance. When they lower their shoulder and begin their charge, few stand willingly in their path. Even creatures many times their size learn that faith, discipline, and momentum can strike with astonishing force.

> *"When your conviction is true, every step becomes a weapon."*  
> — Sir Aldren, Commander of the Dawn Guard

## Rank 2
### Description

With experience comes confidence. Your charge is no longer a reckless rush, but a disciplined advance that carries greater force and purpose. Every step is measured, every impact deliberate, allowing you to cover greater ground while maintaining complete control over your momentum.

Seasoned Paladins learn that hesitation is the enemy of conviction. Once they commit to a charge, they become an unstoppable force until their objective is reached. Whether breaking an enemy's formation or crashing into a powerful foe, their momentum alone is enough to make even seasoned warriors brace for impact.

### Effects

- Spend **15 Stamina** to immediately charge up to **15 metres** in a straight line.
- The direction of the charge is chosen when activated.
- Once the charge begins you:
  - Cannot voluntarily stop.
  - Cannot change direction.
  - Continue until you reach the maximum distance, collide with terrain, or hit your chosen target.
- This movement does **not** provoke Opportunity Attacks from creatures you move past during the charge.
- Difficult Terrain does not reduce the movement distance of your charge.

#### Impact

If your charge ends by colliding with an enemy, that creature must make an **Agility Saving Throw**.

**Save DC = 10 + Strength Modifier + Proficiency Bonus**

- **Success:** The target holds its ground.
- **Failure:** The target is pushed **3 metres** directly away from you.
- **Critical Failure:** The target is pushed **3 metres**, knocked **Prone**, and must spend movement to stand on its next turn.

Creatures one or more size categories larger than you have Advantage on this saving throw unless otherwise stated by another ability.

### Lore

As Paladins mature in both faith and discipline, their charge becomes an extension of their conviction. Every stride carries the weight of unwavering purpose, driving them forward through mud, rubble, and fear alike.

Those who have stood before an experienced Paladin often recall the same feeling—a single heartbeat where the battlefield falls silent before an unstoppable wall of steel and determination crashes into them.

> *"Conviction carries farther than the strongest legs ever could."*  
> — Dame Elowyn, Knight-Captain of the Argent Bastion

## Rank 3
### Description

Your charge has become a symbol of unwavering resolve. Every step carries the weight of your conviction, allowing you to surge through difficult terrain and lesser obstacles without breaking your momentum. To those who stand against you, it is like watching a living battering ram blessed by the divine.

A seasoned Paladin understands that hesitation is defeat. Once the charge begins there is only one destination—the enemy before them. Whether leading the front line or breaking an entrenched defence, your momentum becomes as much a weapon as the blade in your hand.

### Effects

- Spend **20 Stamina** to immediately charge up to **20 metres** in a straight line.
- The direction of the charge is chosen when activated.
- Once the charge begins you:
  - Cannot voluntarily stop.
  - Cannot change direction.
  - Continue until you reach the maximum distance, collide with an immovable obstacle, or hit your chosen target.
- This movement does **not** provoke Opportunity Attacks.
- Your charge ignores **Difficult Terrain**.
- During the charge you may smash through:
  - Wooden furniture
  - Barricades
  - Doors
  - Other fragile environmental objects
  *(GM discretion.)*

#### Impact

If your charge ends by colliding with an enemy, that creature must make an **Agility Saving Throw**.

**Save DC = 10 + Strength Modifier + Proficiency Bonus**

- **Success:** The creature holds its ground.
- **Failure:** The creature is pushed **4 metres** directly away from you.
- **Critical Failure:** The creature is pushed **4 metres**, knocked **Prone**, and is **Staggered** until the end of its next turn.

**Staggered**
- Movement Speed is reduced by **50%**.
- The creature cannot take Reactions until the condition ends.

Creatures one or more size categories larger than you have Advantage on this saving throw unless otherwise stated by another ability.

### Lore

Every Paladin Order teaches that a charge is an act of faith before it is an act of war. The knight commits completely, trusting in discipline, conviction, and the strength granted by their oath. There can be no uncertainty once the first step is taken.

Veterans are remembered not for the battles they survived, but for the moments they shattered impossible odds with a single relentless advance. Entire shield walls have broken beneath the momentum of a determined Paladin, their enemies realising too late that the charge could never be stopped.

> *"Walls are built to halt armies. Conviction was never one of them."*  
> — High Marshal Edric of the Radiant Host

## Rank 4
### Description

Your charge becomes an overwhelming display of divine resolve. Few possess the strength to halt your advance, and those who stand before you are often thrown aside as your momentum carries you relentlessly toward your chosen destination.

To seasoned Paladins, the charge is no longer simply a means of closing the distance—it is a declaration. Every step announces the arrival of unwavering justice, breaking enemy formations and forcing even veteran warriors to reconsider holding their ground.

Those who attempt to stand against your advance quickly learn that conviction possesses a force all its own.

### Effects

- Spend **25 Stamina** to immediately charge up to **25 metres** in a straight line.
- The direction of the charge is chosen when activated.
- Once the charge begins you:
  - Cannot voluntarily stop.
  - Cannot change direction.
  - Continue until you reach your maximum distance or collide with an immovable obstacle.
- Your charge ignores **Difficult Terrain**.
- Your movement during the charge does **not** provoke Opportunity Attacks.
- You may smash through fragile objects such as wooden barricades, doors, fences and similar environmental obstacles (GM discretion).

#### Relentless Momentum

Your charge no longer ends after striking the first enemy.

Creatures that fail their Agility Saving Throw are knocked aside and your charge continues until:

- You reach your maximum distance.
- A creature successfully resists your charge.
- You collide with an immovable object.

#### Impact

Each enemy struck during the charge must make an **Agility Saving Throw**.

**Save DC = 10 + Strength Modifier + Proficiency Bonus**

- **Success:** The creature holds its ground and your charge immediately ends.
- **Failure:** The creature is pushed **5 metres** directly away from you as your charge continues.
- **Critical Failure:** The creature is pushed **5 metres**, knocked **Prone**, and becomes **Staggered** until the end of its next turn.

**Staggered**

- Movement Speed is reduced by **50%**.
- The creature cannot take Reactions until the condition ends.

Creatures one or more size categories larger than you have Advantage on this saving throw unless otherwise modified by another ability.

### Lore

Only the greatest Paladins ever master the Relentless Charge. To witness one is to see discipline transformed into unstoppable momentum, where neither fear nor resistance can slow their advance.

Entire battle lines have been broken by a single Paladin driving through the heart of an enemy formation, their unwavering conviction scattering soldiers before them like leaves before a storm. Veterans often say that by the time you hear the thunder of a charging Paladin, it is already too late to stand your ground.

> *"Justice does not ask for passage. It makes one."*  
> — Grand Commander Aurelius, Keeper of the Silver Host

## Rank 5
### Description

There comes a point where a Paladin's charge ceases to be simple movement and becomes an act of divine judgement. Every step echoes with unwavering conviction, every stride carrying the full weight of their oath toward those who would oppose it.

The battlefield itself seems to part before your advance. Lesser foes are scattered, obstacles crumble beneath your momentum, and only the strongest possess the resolve to stand against your charge. To witness such a charge is to witness absolute commitment—a warrior who has surrendered every hesitation in pursuit of justice.

Among the oldest knightly orders, reaching this level of mastery is considered one of the greatest honours a Paladin can achieve. Many legends begin with a single unstoppable charge.

### Effects

- Spend **30 Stamina** to immediately charge up to **30 metres** in a perfectly straight line.
- The direction is chosen when the ability is activated.
- Once the charge begins you:
  - Cannot voluntarily stop.
  - Cannot change direction.
  - Continue until reaching your maximum distance or colliding with an immovable object.
- Your charge ignores **Difficult Terrain**.
- Your movement during the charge does **not** provoke Opportunity Attacks.
- You may smash through fragile environmental objects such as doors, barricades, fences and similar obstacles (GM discretion).

#### Divine Momentum

Your charge continues through every creature that fails its Agility Saving Throw.

Your charge only ends when:

- You reach the maximum distance.
- You collide with an immovable object.
- A creature successfully resists your charge.

#### Impact

Each creature struck during your charge must make an **Agility Saving Throw**.

**Save DC = 10 + Strength Modifier + Proficiency Bonus**

- **Success**
  - The creature stands its ground.
  - Your charge immediately ends.

- **Failure**
  - The creature is pushed **6 metres** directly away from you.
  - Your charge continues.

- **Critical Failure**
  - The creature is pushed **6 metres**.
  - The creature is knocked **Prone**.
  - The creature becomes **Staggered** until the end of its next turn.

#### Divine Impact

If your charge ends by colliding with an enemy, your **next melee attack** against that creature before the end of your turn gains:

- **Advantage** on the attack roll.
- If that attack is **Divine Smite**, its Mana Cost is reduced by **20%** (rounded up).

### Lore

The greatest Paladins are remembered not for how many battles they fought, but for the moments when they broke impossible odds through unwavering conviction. Their charge is more than speed or strength—it is the physical manifestation of faith carried to its absolute conclusion.

Stories tell of champions who crashed through monstrous hordes, shattered fortress gates, and reached tyrants thought untouchable, all because they refused to let doubt interrupt their advance. Those who survive such a charge rarely remember the impact itself. They remember only the certainty with which it came.

> *"A charge without conviction is merely running. A charge with conviction becomes destiny."*  
> — Saint Garrick, First High Paladin

veterans are remembered not for the battles they survived, but for the moments they shattered impossible odds with a single relentless advance. entire shield walls have broken beneath the momentum of a determined paladin, their enemies realising too late that the charge could never be stopped.

> *"walls are built to halt armies. conviction was never one of them."*  
> — high marshal edric of the radiant host

## rank 4
### description

your charge becomes an overwhelming display of divine resolve. few possess the strength to halt your advance, and those who stand before you are often thrown aside as your momentum carries you relentlessly toward your chosen destination.

to seasoned paladins, the charge is no longer simply a means of closing the distance—it is a declaration. every step announces the arrival of unwavering justice, breaking enemy formations and forcing even veteran warriors to reconsider holding their ground.

those who attempt to stand against your advance quickly learn that conviction possesses a force all its own.

### effects

- spend **25 stamina** to immediately charge up to **25 metres** in a straight line.
- the direction of the charge is chosen when activated.
- once the charge begins you:
  - cannot voluntarily stop.
  - cannot change direction.
  - continue until you reach your maximum distance or collide with an immovable obstacle.
- your charge ignores **difficult terrain**.
- your movement during the charge does **not** provoke opportunity attacks.
- you may smash through fragile objects such as wooden barricades, doors, fences and similar environmental obstacles (gm discretion).

#### relentless momentum

your charge no longer ends after striking the first enemy.

creatures that fail their agility saving throw are knocked aside and your charge continues until:

- you reach your maximum distance.
- a creature successfully resists your charge.
- you collide with an immovable object.

#### impact

each enemy struck during the charge must make an **agility saving throw**.

**save dc = 10 + strength modifier + proficiency bonus**

- **success:** the creature holds its ground and your charge immediately ends.
- **failure:** the creature is pushed **5 metres** directly away from you as your charge continues.
- **critical failure:** the creature is pushed **5 metres**, knocked **prone**, and becomes **staggered** until the end of its next turn.

**staggered**

- movement speed is reduced by **50%**.
- the creature cannot take reactions until the condition ends.

creatures one or more size categories larger than you have advantage on this saving throw unless otherwise modified by another ability.

### lore

only the greatest paladins ever master the relentless charge. to witness one is to see discipline transformed into unstoppable momentum, where neither fear nor resistance can slow their advance.

entire battle lines have been broken by a single paladin driving through the heart of an enemy formation, their unwavering conviction scattering soldiers before them like leaves before a storm. veterans often say that by the time you hear the thunder of a charging paladin, it is already too late to stand your ground.

> *"justice does not ask for passage. it makes one."*  
> — grand commander aurelius, keeper of the silver host

## rank 5
### description

there comes a point where a paladin's charge ceases to be simple movement and becomes an act of divine judgement. every step echoes with unwavering conviction, every stride carrying the full weight of their oath toward those who would oppose it.

the battlefield itself seems to part before your advance. lesser foes are scattered, obstacles crumble beneath your momentum, and only the strongest possess the resolve to stand against your charge. to witness such a charge is to witness absolute commitment—a warrior who has surrendered every hesitation in pursuit of justice.

among the oldest knightly orders, reaching this level of mastery is considered one of the greatest honours a paladin can achieve. many legends begin with a single unstoppable charge.

### effects

- spend **30 stamina** to immediately charge up to **30 metres** in a perfectly straight line.
- the direction is chosen when the ability is activated.
- once the charge begins you:
  - cannot voluntarily stop.
  - cannot change direction.
  - continue until reaching your maximum distance or colliding with an immovable object.
- your charge ignores **difficult terrain**.
- your movement during the charge does **not** provoke opportunity attacks.
- you may smash through fragile environmental objects such as doors, barricades, fences and similar obstacles (gm discretion).

#### divine momentum

your charge continues through every creature that fails its agility saving throw.

your charge only ends when:

- you reach the maximum distance.
- you collide with an immovable object.
- a creature successfully resists your charge.

#### impact

- **success**

- **failure**
  - the creature is pushed **6 metres** directly away from you.
  - your charge continues.

- **critical failure**
  - the creature is pushed **6 metres**.
  - the creature is knocked **prone**.
  - the creature becomes **staggered** until the end of its next turn.

if your charge ends by colliding with an enemy, your **next melee attack** against that creature before the end of your turn gains:

- **advantage** on the attack roll.
- if that attack is **divine smite**, its mana cost is reduced by **20%** (rounded up).

### lore

the greatest paladins are remembered not for how many battles they fought, but for the moments when they broke impossible odds through unwavering conviction. their charge is more than speed or strength—it is the physical manifestation of faith carried to its absolute conclusion.

stories tell of champions who crashed through monstrous hordes, shattered fortress gates, and reached tyrants thought untouchable, all because they refused to let doubt interrupt their advance. those who survive such a charge rarely remember the impact itself. they remember only the certainty with which it came.

> *"a charge without conviction is merely running. a charge with conviction becomes destiny."*  
> — saint garrick, first high paladin

# Paladin's Zeal

## Overview
The unwavering faith of a Paladin does not awaken through prayer alone—it is forged upon the battlefield. Every strike, every hardship overcome, and every act of courage strengthens your resolve, building **Zeal** as combat continues. Rather than representing anger or rage, Zeal embodies your absolute conviction and the growing presence of your patron fighting beside you.

As your Zeal grows, your patron's divine essence becomes increasingly apparent. Whether it manifests as radiant light, spectral ravens, infernal embers, blooming life, celestial brilliance, or shimmering threads of fate depends entirely upon the deity you serve. Though every manifestation differs, each serves as a visible reminder that your faith grows stronger with every passing moment.

A disciplined Paladin may channel this accumulated conviction into powerful **Zeal Techniques**, sacrificing a portion of their Zeal to briefly empower themselves during the heat of battle. Knowing when to preserve your resolve and when to unleash it is the mark of a true champion.

## Rank 1
### Description

The unwavering faith of a Paladin does not awaken through prayer alone—it is forged upon the battlefield. Every strike, every hardship overcome, and every act of courage strengthens your resolve, building **Zeal** as combat continues. Rather than representing anger or rage, Zeal embodies your absolute conviction and the growing presence of your patron fighting beside you.

As your Zeal grows, your patron's divine essence becomes increasingly apparent. Whether it manifests as radiant light, spectral ravens, infernal embers, blooming life, celestial brilliance, or shimmering threads of fate depends entirely upon the deity you serve. Though every manifestation differs, each serves as a visible reminder that your faith grows stronger with every passing moment.

A disciplined Paladin may channel this accumulated conviction into powerful **Zeal Techniques**, sacrificing a portion of their Zeal to briefly empower themselves during the heat of battle. Knowing when to preserve your resolve and when to unleash it is the mark of a true champion.

### Effects

- **Paladin's Zeal** is a **Passive Talent** and is automatically active whenever combat begins.
- At the start of combat, your Zeal resets to **0**.
- Maximum Zeal: **10**.
- Zeal is lost when combat ends or if you become unconscious.

#### Generating Zeal

- Gain **1 Zeal** whenever you successfully hit with a melee weapon attack.
- Gain **1 Zeal** if your melee weapon attack misses by **2 AC or less** (**Unyielding Conviction**).
- Gain **2 Zeal** on a **Critical Hit**.
- Gain **2 Zeal** on a **Critical Success** against an effect originating from your patron's **Divine Opposition**.
- Lose **2 Zeal** on a **Critical Failure** with a melee weapon attack.
- Lose **2 Zeal** on a **Critical Failure** against an effect originating from your patron's **Divine Opposition**.
- Zeal can never exceed its maximum.

#### Broken Conviction

- If a Critical Failure reduces your Zeal to **0**, all accumulated Zeal is lost.
- If you suffer another Critical Failure while already at **0 Zeal**, you enter **Broken Conviction**.
- While suffering **Broken Conviction**, you cannot gain Zeal until the end of your next turn.
- At the end of your next turn, regain **1 Zeal** as your conviction is restored.

### Zeal Techniques

#### Divine Pursuit (2 Zeal Points)

- Spend **2 Zeal**.
- Gain **+4 metres Movement Speed** until the end of your turn.

#### Divine Strength (3 Zeal Points)

- Spend **3 Zeal**.
- Your next successful melee weapon attack gains **+2 damage**.

### Lore

The oldest Paladin Orders teach that faith is not measured by the prayers spoken before battle, but by the conviction maintained throughout it. Every trial overcome, every wound endured, and every refusal to yield strengthens the bond between champion and patron, causing divine power to grow with each passing heartbeat.

Veteran Paladins often describe Zeal as a flame carried within the soul. It burns brighter with perseverance, falters when conviction is shaken, yet never truly dies while the oath remains unbroken. Those who master this sacred discipline become living symbols of unwavering devotion, capable of calling upon their faith whenever the battle demands it.

> *"Conviction is not the absence of doubt. It is the choice to keep advancing despite it."*  
> **— Grand Marshal Aurelius, First Champion of the Sacred Host**

## Rank 2
### Description

Your conviction has grown beyond simple determination. Every battle further strengthens the sacred bond between you and your patron, allowing your Zeal to be channelled in new and more disciplined ways. Experienced Paladins no longer rely solely on instinct; they learn to direct their faith with purpose, adapting to the ever-changing flow of battle.

The greatest champions understand that conviction is a resource to be managed wisely. Recklessly expending Zeal may leave a Paladin vulnerable, while patiently building it allows them to unleash greater acts of divine prowess when the moment demands it.

### Effects

- **Paladin's Zeal** continues to follow all Zeal generation and **Broken Conviction** rules established in **Rank I**.
- Maximum Zeal remains **10**.

### Zeal Techniques

#### Divine Guard (4 Zeal Points)

- Spend **4 Zeal**.
- Gain **+2 AC** until the start of your next turn or until you are successfully hit by an attack.

#### Unbreakable Resolve (5 Zeal Points)

- Spend **5 Zeal**.
- Gain **+4 on your next Saving Throw**.
- This bonus must be declared before the Saving Throw is rolled.

### Lore

As Paladins mature in both faith and experience, they discover that true conviction is neither reckless nor impulsive. Every choice made in battle reflects their devotion, and every technique mastered is another lesson in balancing courage with discipline.

Veteran holy orders teach that Zeal is a gift entrusted to worthy champions, not simply a weapon to be unleashed without thought. Those who master its flow become calm within the fiercest storms, answering every challenge with unwavering confidence.

> *"Strength may win a battle, but conviction decides when that strength must be unleashed."*  
> **— Grand Marshal Aurelius, First Champion of the Sacred Host**

## Rank 3
### Description

Your faith has become unwavering, allowing your Zeal to surge beyond simple acts of courage and into feats worthy of the greatest champions. Every battle strengthens your resolve, and every trial overcome reinforces the sacred bond between you and your patron. With growing mastery, you learn to channel that conviction into increasingly powerful manifestations of divine strength.

Where younger Paladins fight with determination, seasoned champions fight with purpose. They know exactly when to conserve their Zeal and when to unleash it, turning the tide of battle through disciplined conviction rather than reckless emotion. To those who witness such mastery, it appears as though the patron themselves guides every movement.

### Effects

- **Paladin's Zeal** continues to follow all Zeal generation and **Broken Conviction** rules established in **Rank I**.
- Maximum Zeal remains **10**.

### Zeal Techniques

#### Righteous Fury (6 Zeal Points)

- Spend **6 Zeal**.
- Your next successful melee weapon attack deals an additional **1d6 Patron Damage**.
- The Patron Damage type is determined by your patron's Religious pages.

#### Divine Endurance (7 Zeal Points)

Choose one:

- Gain **Resistance to all damage** until the start of your next turn.

**OR**

- Gain **Temporary HP equal to your Level + your Charisma Modifier**.
- Temporary HP gained this way lasts until the end of combat or until depleted.

### Lore

The oldest Paladin Orders teach that true conviction is measured not by words, but by the willingness to stand firm when all hope seems lost. Those who master Zeal become living examples of this belief, transforming unwavering faith into miracles of endurance and righteous might upon the battlefield.

Veterans often describe the experience as feeling their patron standing beside them with every step. Whether that presence is seen as radiant light, celestial fire, spectral ravens, blooming life, or another divine manifestation depends upon the deity they serve, but the message is always the same—the faithful are never truly alone.

> *"Faith is forged in hardship. Conviction is revealed when hardship fails to break you."*  
> **— Grand Marshal Aurelius, First Champion of the Sacred Host**

## Rank 4
### Description

Your unwavering faith has become a beacon through which your patron's divine will flows with remarkable clarity. The Zeal you cultivate during battle no longer represents simple determination—it has become a sacred force that can be shaped into miracles of strength, protection, and righteous conviction.

Masters of Zeal are recognised across Asteria not by the brilliance of their armour or the sharpness of their blade, but by the calm certainty with which they face impossible odds. Their faith no longer falters under pressure, allowing them to call upon extraordinary reserves of divine power when the battle demands it most.

Every act of courage further strengthens the sacred bond between Paladin and patron, preparing them for the greatest trials still to come.

### Effects

- **Paladin's Zeal** continues to follow all Zeal generation and **Broken Conviction** rules established in **Rank I**.
- Increase your **Maximum Zeal** from **10** to **15**.

### Zeal Techniques

#### Divine Momentum (8 Zeal Points)

Choose one:

- Gain **1 additional Action Point** this turn.

**OR**

- Immediately move up to **half your Movement Speed** without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

#### Holy Restoration (9 Zeal Points)

Choose one:

- Restore **HP equal to twice your Character Level + your Charisma Modifier**.

**OR**

- End **one negative condition** currently affecting you.

### Lore

Only the greatest champions ever learn to command Zeal with such precision. What begins as determination eventually becomes a living manifestation of faith itself, allowing the Paladin to answer seemingly impossible challenges with miraculous resolve.

The sacred texts describe these warriors as carrying a fragment of their patron's presence into every battle. Though still mortal, they begin to display moments of divine greatness that inspire allies and leave even powerful enemies questioning whether they face a lone warrior or the will of a god.

> *"The greatest miracle is not power. It is the courage to stand again when every reason tells you to fall."*  
> **— Grand Marshal Aurelius, First Champion of the Sacred Host**

## Rank 5
### Description

Your conviction has reached its absolute peak, allowing your patron's divine presence to flow through you without hesitation. Every challenge faced, every oath upheld, and every battle survived has forged an unbreakable spirit capable of inspiring allies and striking fear into those who oppose your patron's divine will.

The greatest Paladins no longer fight through strength alone. Their unwavering faith becomes a beacon upon the battlefield, their determination inspiring those around them while reminding their enemies that no force can extinguish a soul truly devoted to its sacred purpose. To stand beside such a champion is to witness the very embodiment of divine conviction.

Only the most legendary heroes ever reach this level of mastery. Their Zeal is no longer merely a reflection of their faith—it is living proof that the bond between mortal and patron can transcend all doubt.

### Effects

- **Paladin's Zeal** continues to follow all Zeal generation and **Broken Conviction** rules established in **Rank I**.
- Your **Maximum Zeal** remains **15**.

### Zeal Techniques

#### Divine Ascendance (10 Zeal Points)

Choose one of the following effects:

- Gain **+2 Attack Rolls**, **+2 AC**, and **+2 Saving Throws** until the start of your next turn.

**OR**

- Gain **+2d6 Patron Damage** on every successful melee weapon attack until the end of your turn.

**OR**

- Immediately recover **10 Zeal**, up to your maximum of **15**, after reducing a creature aligned with your patron's **Divine Opposition** to 0 HP this turn.

### Lore

Every generation produces only a handful of Paladins whose conviction becomes so complete that their presence alone inspires unwavering courage. These champions are remembered not for the enemies they defeated, but for the hope they carried into battles that others believed impossible to win.

The scriptures teach that such heroes are living reflections of their patron's ideals. Though they remain mortal, their faith burns so brightly that, for a few fleeting moments during battle, it is difficult to distinguish where the champion ends and the patron's divine purpose begins.

> *"Faith is not proven when victory is certain. Faith is proven when conviction alone is enough to carry you through the impossible."*  
> **— Grand Marshal Aurelius, First Champion of the Sacred Host**

the scriptures teach that such heroes are living reflections of their patron's ideals. though they remain mortal, their faith burns so brightly that, for a few fleeting moments during battle, it is difficult to distinguish where the champion ends and the patron's divine purpose begins.

> *"faith is not proven when victory is certain. faith is proven when conviction alone is enough to carry you through the impossible."*  
> **— grand marshal aurelius, first champion of the sacred host**

# Phantom Ranger

## Overview
Among the oldest Ranger Lodges, there are whispered tales of hunters who could vanish in the middle of battle without casting a spell of invisibility. These legendary warriors learned to briefly step into the Spirit of the Wild, allowing the physical world to pass around them before emerging from an entirely unexpected position.

Phantom Ranger is the beginning of that mastery. By channelling primal magic, the Ranger momentarily shifts into a spectral state, slipping free from close-quarters combat before melting back into the surrounding wilderness. This brief transition creates the perfect opportunity to disappear from an enemy's sight and continue the hunt from the shadows.

---

## Rank 1
### Description

Among the oldest Ranger Lodges, there are whispered tales of hunters who could vanish in the middle of battle without casting a spell of invisibility. These legendary warriors learned to briefly step into the Spirit of the Wild, allowing the physical world to pass around them before emerging from an entirely unexpected position.

Phantom Ranger is the beginning of that mastery. By channelling primal magic, the Ranger momentarily shifts into a spectral state, slipping free from close-quarters combat before melting back into the surrounding wilderness. This brief transition creates the perfect opportunity to disappear from an enemy's sight and continue the hunt from the shadows.

---

### Effects

- **Cost:** 80 MP.
- **Duration:** 1 Minute.
- **Uses:** 2 uses per **Short Rest**.

While Phantom Ranger is active:

- **Once per turn**, after leaving a creature's melee reach, you may activate **Phantom Step**.
- During **Phantom Step**:
  - Move up to **6 metres**.
  - **Non-magical melee attacks**, including **Opportunity Attacks**, pass harmlessly through your spectral form.
  - **Magical melee attacks, spells, magical ranged attacks, and magical area effects** affect you normally.
  - You may move through creatures, but **not** through walls, solid objects, terrain, or magical barriers.
- At the end of the movement, you may immediately attempt a **Stealth** check to **Hide**, even while combat is ongoing.
- If successful, you become **Hidden** and gain the normal benefits of attacking from Hidden.
- If you know the **Camouflage** talent, you may immediately enter **Camouflage** after successfully becoming Hidden, ignoring Camouflage's normal requirement of being out of combat.

#### Limitations

- You are **not invisible** while using Phantom Step.
- Phantom Step must begin by **leaving a creature's melee reach**.
- You must end the movement in an **unoccupied space**.
- Creatures with magical detection or similar abilities can still detect you normally.

---

### Lore

Only a handful of Rangers ever awaken the gift of Phantom Ranger. Those who do speak of hearing the wilderness itself calling them between heartbeats, allowing them to step beyond the reach of ordinary steel before returning to continue the hunt. To their enemies, it appears as though the Ranger simply dissolves into mist before reappearing elsewhere on the battlefield.

Within the Ranger Lodges, Phantom Rangers are considered living legends. They do not rely on invisibility or illusion, but on a fleeting harmony with the primal spirits of the wild. Every disappearance is deliberate, every reappearance perfectly timed, reminding their quarry that the most dangerous hunter is the one who is never where you expect them to be.

---

> *"The prey watches where I stood. The wise hunter has already moved."*  
> — **Grand Ranger Elyas Thornwood, First Phantom Ranger**

## Rank 2
### Description

The Ranger's connection to the Spirit of the Wild grows stronger, allowing them to remain between the physical and spiritual worlds for longer periods. Each Phantom Step becomes more fluid, enabling the Ranger to disappear from one engagement before silently emerging somewhere entirely unexpected. Enemies often struggle to determine whether the Ranger truly vanished or simply moved faster than the eye could follow.

Experienced Phantom Rangers no longer rely solely on the terrain to conceal them. Their spectral movements disrupt an opponent's focus, creating brief moments of uncertainty that can be exploited to regain the advantage. Every successful disappearance allows the Ranger to dictate the flow of battle rather than react to it.

---

### Effects

- **Cost:** 90 MP.
- **Duration:** 2 Minutes.
- **Uses:** 2 uses per **Short Rest**.

While Phantom Ranger is active:

- **Once per turn**, after leaving a creature's melee reach, you may activate **Phantom Step**.
- During **Phantom Step**:
  - Move up to **9 metres**.
  - **Non-magical melee attacks**, including **Opportunity Attacks**, pass harmlessly through your spectral form.
  - **Magical melee attacks, spells, magical ranged attacks, and magical area effects** affect you normally.
  - You may move through creatures, but **not** through walls, solid objects, terrain, or magical barriers.
- At the end of the movement, immediately attempt a **Stealth** check to **Hide**, even while combat is ongoing.
- If successful, you become **Hidden** and gain the normal benefits of attacking from Hidden.
- If you possess the **Camouflage** talent, you may immediately enter **Camouflage** after successfully becoming Hidden, ignoring its normal requirement of being out of combat.
- Gain a **+2 bonus** to your Stealth check made as part of Phantom Step.

#### Limitations

- You are **not invisible** while using Phantom Step.
- Phantom Step must begin by **leaving a creature's melee reach**.
- You must end the movement in an **unoccupied space**.
- Creatures with magical detection or similar abilities can still detect you normally.

---

### Lore

To witness a Rank II Phantom Ranger is to question whether they ever occupied the space at all. Hunters trained in this ancient technique weave between the physical and spiritual worlds with remarkable grace, leaving behind only fleeting echoes of their presence. Their movements are so seamless that many foes instinctively strike at where the Ranger once stood, only to find empty air.

Within the Ranger Lodges, these hunters are often entrusted with missions requiring infiltration, reconnaissance, and the elimination of dangerous targets deep behind enemy lines. Their greatest weapon is not their bow or blade, but the uncertainty they leave in the minds of those who seek them.

---

> *"A phantom is not unseen because it is invisible. It is unseen because you looked in the wrong place."*  
> — **Grand Ranger Elyas Thornwood**

## Rank 3
### Description

The Ranger's mastery of Phantom Ranger has deepened, allowing them to walk the boundary between the physical world and the Spirit of the Wild with remarkable ease. Each Phantom Step becomes longer, quieter, and more difficult to follow, leaving enemies striking at fading afterimages while the true hunter has already repositioned.

Veteran Phantom Rangers no longer rely solely on the environment to disappear. Their movements are so fluid that they seem to dissolve into the battlefield itself, using every shadow, tree, and obstacle to remain unseen. To their quarry, the Ranger becomes an ever-present threat that appears only long enough to strike before vanishing once again.

---

### Effects

- **Cost:** 100 MP.
- **Duration:** 3 Minutes.
- **Uses:** 2 uses per **Short Rest**.

While Phantom Ranger is active:

- **Once per turn**, after leaving a creature's melee reach, you may activate **Phantom Step**.
- During **Phantom Step**:
  - Move up to **12 metres**.
  - **Non-magical melee attacks**, including **Opportunity Attacks**, pass harmlessly through your spectral form.
  - **Magical melee attacks, spells, magical ranged attacks, and magical area effects** affect you normally.
  - You may move through creatures of **Large size or smaller**, but not through walls, solid objects, terrain, or magical barriers.
- At the end of the movement, immediately attempt a **Stealth** check to **Hide**, even while combat is ongoing.
- Gain a **+4 bonus** to the Stealth check made as part of Phantom Step.
- If successful, you become **Hidden** and gain the normal benefits of attacking from Hidden.
- If you possess the **Camouflage** talent, you may immediately enter **Camouflage** after successfully becoming Hidden, ignoring its normal requirement of being out of combat.

#### Limitations

- You are **not invisible** while using Phantom Step.
- Phantom Step must begin by **leaving a creature's melee reach**.
- You must end the movement in an **unoccupied space**.
- Creatures with magical detection or similar abilities can still detect you normally.

---

### Lore

To master the third rank of Phantom Ranger is to become a living ghost upon the battlefield. The wilderness no longer simply conceals the Ranger—it seems to embrace them, allowing them to drift through the chaos of combat with uncanny precision before emerging where no enemy expected.

Within the Ranger Lodges, these hunters are entrusted with the most dangerous assignments, from infiltrating enemy strongholds to pursuing legendary beasts through dense forests and forgotten ruins. Those who survive an encounter with a Phantom Ranger often struggle to describe what happened, remembering only fleeting glimpses of a spectral figure that seemed to vanish with every heartbeat.

---

> *"The wisest prey never fears the arrow. It fears the silence before it is loosed."*  
> — **Grand Ranger Elyas Thornwood**

## Rank 4
### Description

The Ranger has become a true spectre of the battlefield, able to disappear and reappear with unnerving precision. Their mastery of Phantom Step allows them to break an opponent's focus, reposition through the chaos of combat, and strike before their quarry can recover. To those who face them, every shadow becomes a potential threat.

At this stage, Phantom Ranger is no longer simply an escape technique—it becomes an offensive tool. The Ranger uses every disappearance to create the perfect angle of attack, re-emerging from concealment with devastating precision before once again melting back into the wilderness.

---

### Effects

- **Cost:** 110 MP.
- **Duration:** 4 Minutes.
- **Uses:** 2 uses per **Short Rest**.

While Phantom Ranger is active:

- **Once per turn**, after leaving a creature's melee reach, you may activate **Phantom Step**.
- During **Phantom Step**:
  - Move up to **15 metres**.
  - **Non-magical melee attacks**, including **Opportunity Attacks**, pass harmlessly through your spectral form.
  - **Magical melee attacks, spells, magical ranged attacks, and magical area effects** affect you normally.
  - You may move through creatures of **Large size or smaller**, but not through walls, solid objects, terrain, or magical barriers.
- At the end of the movement, immediately attempt a **Stealth** check to **Hide**, even while combat is ongoing.
- Gain a **+6 bonus** to the Stealth check made as part of Phantom Step.
- If successful, you become **Hidden** and gain the normal benefits of attacking from Hidden.
- **The first attack you make after successfully becoming Hidden through Phantom Step gains a +2 bonus to its attack roll.**
- If you possess the **Camouflage** talent, you may immediately enter **Camouflage** after successfully becoming Hidden, ignoring its normal requirement of being out of combat.

#### Limitations

- You are **not invisible** while using Phantom Step.
- Phantom Step must begin by **leaving a creature's melee reach**.
- You must end the movement in an **unoccupied space**.
- Creatures with magical detection or similar abilities can still detect you normally.

---

### Lore

Only the most accomplished Phantom Rangers ever reach this level of mastery. Their movements become so fluid that enemies often question whether they are pursuing a single hunter or several spectral figures moving through the battlefield. Every disappearance creates uncertainty, and every reappearance reminds their quarry that nowhere is truly safe.

Within the Ranger Lodges, these hunters are entrusted with eliminating the most elusive prey in Asteria. They are taught that the greatest strike is not the strongest, but the one their enemy never saw coming. By mastering both concealment and timing, they transform every battlefield into the perfect hunting ground.

---

> *"A phantom never rushes the hunt. It simply appears where victory is already waiting."*  
> — **Grand Ranger Elyas Thornwood**

## Rank 5
### Description

The Ranger has achieved complete mastery of Phantom Ranger, becoming a living myth among the Ranger Lodges. During battle they appear to exist between the physical world and the Spirit of the Wild, effortlessly slipping through enemy formations before vanishing into the landscape. Every movement is deliberate, every disappearance calculated, and every reappearance marks another step toward the inevitable end of the hunt.

To the Ranger's quarry, combat becomes a nightmare. The hunter never remains in one place long enough to be cornered, striking from impossible angles before fading back into the wilderness. Those who survive rarely agree on what they witnessed—only that the Ranger was never where they expected them to be.

---

### Effects

- **Cost:** 120 MP.
- **Duration:** 5 Minutes.
- **Uses:** 2 uses per **Short Rest**.

While Phantom Ranger is active:

- **Once per turn**, after leaving a creature's melee reach, you may activate **Phantom Step**.
- During **Phantom Step**:
  - Move up to **18 metres**.
  - **Non-magical melee attacks**, including **Opportunity Attacks**, pass harmlessly through your spectral form.
  - **Magical melee attacks, spells, magical ranged attacks, and magical area effects** affect you normally.
  - You may move through creatures of **Huge size or smaller**, but not through walls, solid objects, terrain, or magical barriers.
- At the end of the movement, immediately attempt a **Stealth** check to **Hide**, even while combat is ongoing.
- Gain a **+8 bonus** to the Stealth check made as part of Phantom Step.
- If successful, you become **Hidden** and gain the normal benefits of attacking from Hidden.
- **The first attack you make after successfully becoming Hidden through Phantom Step gains a +4 bonus to its attack roll.**
- If you possess the **Camouflage** talent, you may immediately enter **Camouflage** after successfully becoming Hidden, ignoring its normal requirement of being out of combat.
- If your first attack from Hidden **hits**, you may immediately activate **Phantom Step** again **without consuming your once-per-turn Phantom Step**, provided you still have movement available. This additional Phantom Step cannot trigger another free Phantom Step.

#### Limitations

- You are **not invisible** while using Phantom Step.
- Phantom Step must begin by **leaving a creature's melee reach**.
- You must end each Phantom Step in an **unoccupied space**.
- Creatures with magical detection or similar abilities can still detect you normally.
- The additional Phantom Step may only occur **once per turn**.

---

### Lore

Only a handful of Rangers throughout Asteria's history have ever reached the fifth rank of Phantom Ranger. They are remembered not merely as exceptional hunters, but as legends who seemed to become one with the wilderness itself. Their prey often believed they had escaped, only to discover the Phantom Ranger silently waiting farther along the trail.

Within the Ranger Lodges, these masters are known as the **Ghosts of the Wild**. They embody the Ranger's highest ideal—not overwhelming strength or unmatched speed, but absolute control of the hunt. Every disappearance creates uncertainty, every reappearance creates opportunity, and every strike reminds their quarry that there is no refuge from a hunter who has become part of the wilderness.

---

> *"You cannot pursue a ghost. By the time you find where it stood, it is already deciding where you will fall."*  
> — **Grand Ranger Elyas Thornwood, First Phantom Ranger**

None

  - **non-magical melee attacks**, including **opportunity attacks**, pass harmlessly through your spectral form.
  - **magical melee attacks, spells, magical ranged attacks, and magical area effects** affect you normally.
  - you may move through creatures, but **not** through walls, solid objects, terrain, or magical barriers.
- at the end of the movement, you may immediately attempt a **stealth** check to **hide**, even while combat is ongoing.
- if successful, you become **hidden** and gain the normal benefits of attacking from hidden.
- if you know the **camouflage** talent, you may immediately enter **camouflage** after successfully becoming hidden, ignoring camouflage's normal requirement of being out of combat.

#### limitations

- you are **not invisible** while using phantom step.
- phantom step must begin by **leaving a creature's melee reach**.
- you must end the movement in an **unoccupied space**.
- creatures with magical detection or similar abilities can still detect you normally.

---

### lore

only a handful of rangers ever awaken the gift of phantom ranger. those who do speak of hearing the wilderness itself calling them between heartbeats, allowing them to step beyond the reach of ordinary steel before returning to continue the hunt. to their enemies, it appears as though the ranger simply dissolves into mist before reappearing elsewhere on the battlefield.

within the ranger lodges, phantom rangers are considered living legends. they do not rely on invisibility or illusion, but on a fleeting harmony with the primal spirits of the wild. every disappearance is deliberate, every reappearance perfectly timed, reminding their quarry that the most dangerous hunter is the one who is never where you expect them to be.

---

> *"the prey watches where i stood. the wise hunter has already moved."*  
> — **grand ranger elyas thornwood, first phantom ranger**

## rank 2
### description

the ranger's connection to the spirit of the wild grows stronger, allowing them to remain between the physical and spiritual worlds for longer periods. each phantom step becomes more fluid, enabling the ranger to disappear from one engagement before silently emerging somewhere entirely unexpected. enemies often struggle to determine whether the ranger truly vanished or simply moved faster than the eye could follow.

experienced phantom rangers no longer rely solely on the terrain to conceal them. their spectral movements disrupt an opponent's focus, creating brief moments of uncertainty that can be exploited to regain the advantage. every successful disappearance allows the ranger to dictate the flow of battle rather than react to it.

---

### effects

- **cost:** 90 mp.
- **duration:** 2 minutes.
- **uses:** 2 uses per **short rest**.

while phantom ranger is active:

- **once per turn**, after leaving a creature's melee reach, you may activate **phantom step**.
- during **phantom step**:
  - move up to **9 metres**.
  - **non-magical melee attacks**, including **opportunity attacks**, pass harmlessly through your spectral form.
  - **magical melee attacks, spells, magical ranged attacks, and magical area effects** affect you normally.
  - you may move through creatures, but **not** through walls, solid objects, terrain, or magical barriers.
- at the end of the movement, immediately attempt a **stealth** check to **hide**, even while combat is ongoing.
- if successful, you become **hidden** and gain the normal benefits of attacking from hidden.
- if you possess the **camouflage** talent, you may immediately enter **camouflage** after successfully becoming hidden, ignoring its normal requirement of being out of combat.
- gain a **+2 bonus** to your stealth check made as part of phantom step.

#### limitations

- you are **not invisible** while using phantom step.
- phantom step must begin by **leaving a creature's melee reach**.
- you must end the movement in an **unoccupied space**.
- creatures with magical detection or similar abilities can still detect you normally.

---

### lore

to witness a rank ii phantom ranger is to question whether they ever occupied the space at all. hunters trained in this ancient technique weave between the physical and spiritual worlds with remarkable grace, leaving behind only fleeting echoes of their presence. their movements are so seamless that many foes instinctively strike at where the ranger once stood, only to find empty air.

within the ranger lodges, these hunters are often entrusted with missions requiring infiltration, reconnaissance, and the elimination of dangerous targets deep behind enemy lines. their greatest weapon is not their bow or blade, but the uncertainty they leave in the minds of those who seek them.

---

> *"a phantom is not unseen because it is invisible. it is unseen because you looked in the wrong place."*  
> — **grand ranger elyas thornwood**

## rank 3
### description

the ranger's mastery of phantom ranger has deepened, allowing them to walk the boundary between the physical world and the spirit of the wild with remarkable ease. each phantom step becomes longer, quieter, and more difficult to follow, leaving enemies striking at fading afterimages while the true hunter has already repositioned.

veteran phantom rangers no longer rely solely on the environment to disappear. their movements are so fluid that they seem to dissolve into the battlefield itself, using every shadow, tree, and obstacle to remain unseen. to their quarry, the ranger becomes an ever-present threat that appears only long enough to strike before vanishing once again.

---

### effects

- **cost:** 100 mp.
- **duration:** 3 minutes.
- **uses:** 2 uses per **short rest**.

while phantom ranger is active:

- **once per turn**, after leaving a creature's melee reach, you may activate **phantom step**.
- during **phantom step**:
  - move up to **12 metres**.
  - **non-magical melee attacks**, including **opportunity attacks**, pass harmlessly through your spectral form.
  - **magical melee attacks, spells, magical ranged attacks, and magical area effects** affect you normally.
  - you may move through creatures of **large size or smaller**, but not through walls, solid objects, terrain, or magical barriers.
- at the end of the movement, immediately attempt a **stealth** check to **hide**, even while combat is ongoing.
- gain a **+4 bonus** to the stealth check made as part of phantom step.
- if successful, you become **hidden** and gain the normal benefits of attacking from hidden.
- if you possess the **camouflage** talent, you may immediately enter **camouflage** after successfully becoming hidden, ignoring its normal requirement of being out of combat.

#### limitations

- you are **not invisible** while using phantom step.
- phantom step must begin by **leaving a creature's melee reach**.
- you must end the movement in an **unoccupied space**.
- creatures with magical detection or similar abilities can still detect you normally.

---

### lore

to master the third rank of phantom ranger is to become a living ghost upon the battlefield. the wilderness no longer simply conceals the ranger—it seems to embrace them, allowing them to drift through the chaos of combat with uncanny precision before emerging where no enemy expected.

within the ranger lodges, these hunters are entrusted with the most dangerous assignments, from infiltrating enemy strongholds to pursuing legendary beasts through dense forests and forgotten ruins. those who survive an encounter with a phantom ranger often struggle to describe what happened, remembering only fleeting glimpses of a spectral figure that seemed to vanish with every heartbeat.

---

> *"the wisest prey never fears the arrow. it fears the silence before it is loosed."*  
> — **grand ranger elyas thornwood**

## rank 4
### description

the ranger has become a true spectre of the battlefield, able to disappear and reappear with unnerving precision. their mastery of phantom step allows them to break an opponent's focus, reposition through the chaos of combat, and strike before their quarry can recover. to those who face them, every shadow becomes a potential threat.

at this stage, phantom ranger is no longer simply an escape technique—it becomes an offensive tool. the ranger uses every disappearance to create the perfect angle of attack, re-emerging from concealment with devastating precision before once again melting back into the wilderness.

---

### effects

- **cost:** 110 mp.
- **duration:** 4 minutes.
- **uses:** 2 uses per **short rest**.

while phantom ranger is active:

- **once per turn**, after leaving a creature's melee reach, you may activate **phantom step**.
- during **phantom step**:
  - move up to **15 metres**.

  - **magical melee attacks, spells, magical ranged attacks, and magical area effects** affect you normally.
  - you may move through creatures of **large size or smaller**, but not through walls, solid objects, terrain, or magical barriers.
- at the end of the movement, immediately attempt a **stealth** check to **hide**, even while combat is ongoing.
- gain a **+6 bonus** to the stealth check made as part of phantom step.
- if successful, you become **hidden** and gain the normal benefits of attacking from hidden.
- **the first attack you make after successfully becoming hidden through phantom step gains a +2 bonus to its attack roll.**

- phantom step must begin by **leaving a creature's melee reach**.
- you must end the movement in an **unoccupied space**.
- creatures with magical detection or similar abilities can still detect you normally.

---

### lore

only the most accomplished phantom rangers ever reach this level of mastery. their movements become so fluid that enemies often question whether they are pursuing a single hunter or several spectral figures moving through the battlefield. every disappearance creates uncertainty, and every reappearance reminds their quarry that nowhere is truly safe.

within the ranger lodges, these hunters are entrusted with eliminating the most elusive prey in asteria. they are taught that the greatest strike is not the strongest, but the one their enemy never saw coming. by mastering both concealment and timing, they transform every battlefield into the perfect hunting ground.

---

> *"a phantom never rushes the hunt. it simply appears where victory is already waiting."*  
> — **grand ranger elyas thornwood**

## rank 5
### description

the ranger has achieved complete mastery of phantom ranger, becoming a living myth among the ranger lodges. during battle they appear to exist between the physical world and the spirit of the wild, effortlessly slipping through enemy formations before vanishing into the landscape. every movement is deliberate, every disappearance calculated, and every reappearance marks another step toward the inevitable end of the hunt.

to the ranger's quarry, combat becomes a nightmare. the hunter never remains in one place long enough to be cornered, striking from impossible angles before fading back into the wilderness. those who survive rarely agree on what they witnessed—only that the ranger was never where they expected them to be.

---

### effects

- **cost:** 120 mp.
- **duration:** 5 minutes.
- **uses:** 2 uses per **short rest**.

while phantom ranger is active:

- **once per turn**, after leaving a creature's melee reach, you may activate **phantom step**.
- during **phantom step**:
  - move up to **18 metres**.
  - **non-magical melee attacks**, including **opportunity attacks**, pass harmlessly through your spectral form.
  - **magical melee attacks, spells, magical ranged attacks, and magical area effects** affect you normally.
  - you may move through creatures of **huge size or smaller**, but not through walls, solid objects, terrain, or magical barriers.
- at the end of the movement, immediately attempt a **stealth** check to **hide**, even while combat is ongoing.
- gain a **+8 bonus** to the stealth check made as part of phantom step.
- if successful, you become **hidden** and gain the normal benefits of attacking from hidden.
- **the first attack you make after successfully becoming hidden through phantom step gains a +4 bonus to its attack roll.**
- if you possess the **camouflage** talent, you may immediately enter **camouflage** after successfully becoming hidden, ignoring its normal requirement of being out of combat.
- if your first attack from hidden **hits**, you may immediately activate **phantom step** again **without consuming your once-per-turn phantom step**, provided you still have movement available. this additional phantom step cannot trigger another free phantom step.

#### limitations

- you are **not invisible** while using phantom step.
- phantom step must begin by **leaving a creature's melee reach**.
- you must end each phantom step in an **unoccupied space**.
- creatures with magical detection or similar abilities can still detect you normally.
- the additional phantom step may only occur **once per turn**.

---

### lore

only a handful of rangers throughout asteria's history have ever reached the fifth rank of phantom ranger. they are remembered not merely as exceptional hunters, but as legends who seemed to become one with the wilderness itself. their prey often believed they had escaped, only to discover the phantom ranger silently waiting farther along the trail.

within the ranger lodges, these masters are known as the **ghosts of the wild**. they embody the ranger's highest ideal—not overwhelming strength or unmatched speed, but absolute control of the hunt. every disappearance creates uncertainty, every reappearance creates opportunity, and every strike reminds their quarry that there is no refuge from a hunter who has become part of the wilderness.

---

> *"you cannot pursue a ghost. by the time you find where it stood, it is already deciding where you will fall."*  
> — **grand ranger elyas thornwood, first phantom ranger**
