# Predator's Pursuit

## Overview
Predator's Pursuit is the moment a Ranger's hunt becomes something more than skill alone. By calling upon ancient primal magic, the Ranger forms a mystical bond with a single quarry, allowing the wilderness itself to reveal subtle traces of the creature's passage. What once required careful observation now seems to appear naturally before the hunter's eyes.

The marked quarry becomes easier to follow wherever it travels. Faint spectral signs illuminate its trail, while the Ranger instinctively senses the direction of the hunt. Although the quarry may flee, hide, or attempt to erase its tracks, the wilderness quietly guides the Ranger towards its inevitable destination.

---

## Rank 1
### Description

Predator's Pursuit is the moment a Ranger's hunt becomes something more than skill alone. By calling upon ancient primal magic, the Ranger forms a mystical bond with a single quarry, allowing the wilderness itself to reveal subtle traces of the creature's passage. What once required careful observation now seems to appear naturally before the hunter's eyes.

The marked quarry becomes easier to follow wherever it travels. Faint spectral signs illuminate its trail, while the Ranger instinctively senses the direction of the hunt. Although the quarry may flee, hide, or attempt to erase its tracks, the wilderness quietly guides the Ranger towards its inevitable destination.

---

### Effects

- **Cost:** 50 MP.
- Choose one creature you can see to become your **Quarry**.
- The mark lasts for **1 hour**, or until:
  - The Quarry dies.
  - The Quarry becomes unconscious.
  - You willingly end the effect.
  - You mark another creature.

#### Hunter's Mark Synergy

- If a creature is already affected by your **Hunter's Mark**, it automatically becomes your **Quarry** when Predator's Pursuit is activated.
- If **Hunter's Mark** is transferred to another creature, **Predator's Pursuit** immediately transfers to the same creature without requiring another Mana Cost or action.
- If no creature is affected by Hunter's Mark, choose a Quarry normally.

#### While your Quarry is marked

- The Quarry is outlined by a **faint spectral glow** visible only to you while it remains within your line of sight.
- Footprints, blood trails, broken vegetation, disturbed earth, and other signs left by the Quarry emit a **soft magical glow** visible only to you.
- You always know the **general direction** of your Quarry while it remains within **1 kilometre** and on the same plane of existence.
- Gain **Advantage** on **Survival** checks made to track your Quarry.
- While **Hidden** or benefiting from **Cover**, gain a **+2 bonus to attack rolls** against your marked Quarry.
- Your marked Quarry gains **no benefit from Half Cover** against your ranged attacks.
- Non-magical attempts to conceal or erase the Quarry's trail have **Disadvantage** against your tracking attempts.

#### Limitations

- The spectral outline does not reveal the Quarry through solid objects or magical barriers.
- The bond reveals only the Quarry's **general direction**, not its exact location or distance.
- Magical concealment, teleportation, or planar travel may suppress the connection, at the GM's discretion.
- Only one creature may be your Quarry at a time.

---

### Lore

The oldest Ranger Lodges teach that every hunt leaves an echo within the wilderness. Those who prove themselves worthy may one day learn to see these echoes, following trails that ordinary eyes could never perceive. To outsiders, Predator's Pursuit appears to be remarkable tracking. Rangers know the truth—it is the wilderness choosing to guide the hunter.

Legends tell of Huntmasters pursuing monsters across entire kingdoms, guided only by glowing footprints and an unwavering instinct that never led them astray. Once the wilderness accepts a Ranger's quarry, few creatures escape the hunt for long.

---

> *"The quarry may hide from my eyes, but it cannot hide from the wilderness."*  
> — **Grand Ranger Elyas Thornwood, First Huntmaster of the Emerald Lodge**

## Rank 2
### Description

The Ranger's bond with their quarry grows stronger, allowing the primal magic of the wilderness to reveal far more than simple tracks. Every footprint, broken branch, and drop of blood shines brighter, while even older trails become easier to follow. The hunt begins to feel less like a search and more like an invisible thread connecting hunter and prey.

Experienced Rangers speak of reaching a point where the wilderness itself refuses to let their quarry disappear. Whether travelling through dense forests, rocky mountains, or open plains, subtle signs continually guide the Ranger forward. The prey may attempt to hide its trail, but nature remembers every step it has taken.

---

### Effects

- **Cost:** 60 MP.
- Choose one creature you can see to become your **Quarry**.
- The mark lasts for **2 hours**, or until:
  - The Quarry dies.
  - The Quarry becomes unconscious.
  - You willingly end the effect.
  - You mark another creature.

#### Hunter's Mark Synergy

- If a creature is already affected by your **Hunter's Mark**, it automatically becomes your **Quarry**.
- If **Hunter's Mark** is transferred to another creature, **Predator's Pursuit** immediately transfers as well without requiring another Mana Cost or action.
- If no creature is affected by Hunter's Mark, choose a Quarry normally.

#### While your Quarry is marked

- The Quarry is surrounded by a **clear spectral outline** visible only to you while within your line of sight.
- Tracks, blood trails, disturbed vegetation, broken branches, scents, and other signs left by the Quarry emit a brighter magical glow visible only to you.
- You always know the **general direction** of your Quarry while it remains within **5 kilometres** and on the same plane of existence.
- Gain **Advantage** on **Survival** and **Perception** checks made to locate or track your Quarry.
- While **Hidden** or benefiting from **Cover**, gain a **+3 bonus to attack rolls** against your marked Quarry.
- Your marked Quarry gains **no benefit from Half Cover or Three-Quarters Cover** against your ranged attacks.
- Non-magical attempts to conceal, erase, or disguise the Quarry's trail automatically fail against your tracking attempts.

#### Limitations

- The spectral outline does not reveal the Quarry through solid objects or magical barriers.
- The bond reveals only the Quarry's general direction, not its exact location or distance.
- Powerful magical concealment, teleportation, or planar travel may suppress the connection at the GM's discretion.
- Only one creature may be your Quarry at a time.

---

### Lore

Those who master the second rank of Predator's Pursuit begin to understand that the wilderness does more than reveal tracks—it remembers them. Every trail left by the quarry becomes another page in a story only the Ranger can read, guiding them with unwavering certainty through forests, mountains, and forgotten ruins alike.

Within the Ranger Lodges, hunters capable of maintaining this bond are rarely assigned ordinary prey. They are entrusted with tracking dangerous monsters, escaped criminals, and creatures that others have long since declared impossible to find.

---

> *"A trail may vanish beneath the wind, but the wilderness never forgets who walked upon it."*  
> — **Grand Ranger Elyas Thornwood**

## Rank 3
### Description

The bond between the Ranger and their Quarry has become deeply intertwined with the primal magic of the wilderness. The marked creature can no longer easily disappear, as nature itself continuously reveals subtle signs of its passage. Even when tracks are scarce, the Ranger's instincts are guided by an unseen force that steadily draws them closer to their prey.

Veteran Rangers describe this connection as becoming one with the hunt. Every footprint shines with spectral light, every broken branch tells a story, and even the faintest disturbance in the environment becomes impossible to overlook. Once marked, the Quarry soon learns that escape is far more difficult than survival.

---

### Effects

- **Cost:** 70 MP.
- Choose one creature you can see to become your **Quarry**.
- The mark lasts for **4 hours**, or until:
  - The Quarry dies.
  - The Quarry becomes unconscious.
  - You willingly end the effect.
  - You mark another creature.

#### Hunter's Mark Synergy

- If a creature is already affected by your **Hunter's Mark**, it automatically becomes your **Quarry**.
- If **Hunter's Mark** is transferred to another creature, **Predator's Pursuit** immediately transfers to that creature without requiring another Mana Cost or action.
- If no creature is affected by **Hunter's Mark**, choose a Quarry normally.

#### While your Quarry is marked

- The Quarry is surrounded by a **bright spectral outline** visible only to you while it remains within your line of sight.
- Tracks, blood, scents, broken vegetation, and all signs of the Quarry's passage emit a vivid magical glow visible only to you.
- You always know the **general direction** of your Quarry while it remains within **20 kilometres** and on the same plane of existence.
- Gain **Advantage** on **Survival**, **Perception**, and **Investigation** checks made to locate or pursue your Quarry.
- While **Hidden** or benefiting from **Cover**, gain a **+4 bonus to attack rolls** against your marked Quarry.
- Your marked Quarry gains **no benefit from any non-magical cover** against your ranged attacks.
- **Non-magical disguises, false trails, or attempts to conceal the Quarry's tracks automatically fail** against your tracking attempts.

#### Limitations

- The spectral outline does not reveal the Quarry through solid objects or magical barriers.
- The bond reveals only the Quarry's general direction, not its exact location or distance.
- Powerful magical concealment, teleportation, or planar travel may suppress the connection at the GM's discretion.
- Only one creature may be your Quarry at a time.

---

### Lore

Rangers who achieve the third rank of Predator's Pursuit are no longer simply following tracks—they are following the will of the wilderness itself. Their connection with nature has grown so strong that the land seems eager to reveal the movements of the chosen Quarry. Every broken twig, displaced stone, and drop of blood becomes another guide along the hunt.

Within the Ranger Lodges, these hunters are often tasked with pursuing creatures that others consider impossible to track. Every step the Quarry takes leaves behind an echo only the Ranger can perceive. Ancient trees, flowing rivers, shifting winds, and the creatures of the wild all seem to quietly guide the hunter toward their destination. Though the Quarry may flee through forests, mountains, or deserts, the wilderness refuses to let it disappear completely.

Among the Ranger Lodges, those who master this rank are known as **Wildseekers**, hunters entrusted with tracking the most dangerous beasts and elusive foes across entire regions of Asteria.

# Predator's Roar

## Overview
The wilderness belongs to those who command respect, not through words, but through presence alone. Predator's Roar allows the Ranger to unleash a thunderous battle cry that echoes the dominance of the world's greatest hunters. It is not magic, but the culmination of unwavering confidence, survival instinct, and countless victories over dangerous prey.

When the Ranger roars, nearby allies are reminded that they stand beside a seasoned hunter, while enemies instinctively recognise the arrival of a predator. Even creatures that have never encountered the Ranger may hesitate for a brief moment as instinct tells them they have become the prey.

Though its effects are subtle at first, Predator's Roar becomes increasingly terrifying as the Ranger's reputation and mastery grow.

---

## Rank 1
### Description

The wilderness belongs to those who command respect, not through words, but through presence alone. Predator's Roar allows the Ranger to unleash a thunderous battle cry that echoes the dominance of the world's greatest hunters. It is not magic, but the culmination of unwavering confidence, survival instinct, and countless victories over dangerous prey.

When the Ranger roars, nearby allies are reminded that they stand beside a seasoned hunter, while enemies instinctively recognise the arrival of a predator. Even creatures that have never encountered the Ranger may hesitate for a brief moment as instinct tells them they have become the prey.

Though its effects are subtle at first, Predator's Roar becomes increasingly terrifying as the Ranger's reputation and mastery grow.

---

### Effects

#### Predator's Roar

**Cost:** 30 SP

Unleash a powerful roar affecting all creatures within **10 metres**.

**Enemies**

- Creatures of your choice must make a **Wisdom Saving Throw**.
- On a failure, they become **Shaken** until the end of their next turn.
- While Shaken:
  - They have **Disadvantage on their first attack roll**.
  - They cannot take **Reactions** until the start of their next turn.
- On a successful save, the creature is unaffected.

**Allies**

Friendly creatures within range gain:

- **+1 Morale Bonus** to their next attack roll before the end of their next turn.
- Immunity to the **Shaken** condition caused by your Predator's Roar.

#### Limitations

- Predator's Roar does not affect creatures that cannot hear you.
- A creature can only be affected by your Predator's Roar once per use.
- This is a non-magical ability and may affect creatures normally immune to magical fear, subject to GM discretion.

---

### Lore

Among the Ranger Lodges, Predator's Roar is taught only after a hunter has proven themselves against formidable prey. It is said that every great predator possesses a presence capable of unsettling even the strongest opponent before the hunt has truly begun.

Legends speak of Rangers whose roars halted charging beasts, scattered packs of wolves, and emboldened exhausted companions to fight on. While many dismiss these stories as exaggeration, those who have stood beside a master Ranger know that confidence itself can become a weapon.

To the Ranger, the roar is not a challenge—it is a declaration that the hunt has already begun, and that every creature who hears it has a choice: stand and fight, or flee.

---

> *"The loudest roar is not the one born of anger—it is the one that reminds the forest who sits at the top of the food chain."*  
> — **Grand Ranger Elyas Thornwood**

## Rank 2
### Description

The Ranger's roar carries far greater authority, echoing with the confidence of a hunter that has survived countless battles. It is no longer simply a display of dominance—it becomes an instinctive declaration that the Ranger has claimed the battlefield as their hunting ground.

Those who hear the roar often react before they even realise why. Allies stand taller, emboldened by the presence of an experienced hunter, while enemies hesitate as primal instincts warn them that they have become the prey. Even disciplined warriors can find themselves momentarily shaken by the sheer conviction behind the Ranger's voice.

Among the Ranger Lodges, this level of mastery is often called the **Call of the Alpha**, symbolising a hunter whose presence alone begins to influence the outcome of the battle.

---

### Effects

#### Predator's Roar

**Cost:** 35 SP

Unleash a powerful roar affecting all creatures of your choice within **12 metres**.

- While Shaken:
  - They have **Disadvantage on their first attack roll**.
  - They cannot take **Reactions** until the start of their next turn.
  - Their movement speed is reduced by **3 metres** until the end of their next turn.
- On a successful save, the creature is unaffected.

Friendly creatures within range gain:

- **+2 Morale Bonus** to their next attack roll.
- **+2 Morale Bonus** to their next Wisdom Saving Throw against **Fear** or **Charm** effects.

#### Limitations

As Rangers continue to master Predator's Roar, they begin to understand that true dominance is communicated long before weapons are drawn. Veteran Rangers are known for leading hunting parties through little more than their presence. Companions speak of feeling an overwhelming sense of confidence the moment the roar echoes through the wilderness, while enemies often remember it as the sound that marked the beginning of their defeat.

Within the Lodges, apprentices are taught that a roar should never be wasted. Every use is a declaration that the Ranger intends to control the battlefield from that moment forward.

> *"The strongest predator does not roar because it is angry. It roars because it already knows who will survive the hunt."*  
> — **Grand Ranger Elyas Thornwood**

At this level, the Ranger has learned to channel every hard-earned victory, every dangerous hunt, and every brush with death into a single commanding cry. Those who stand beside the Ranger find renewed courage, while enemies begin to question whether they are the hunter or the hunted.

Among the Ranger Lodges, achieving the third rank is regarded as the point where a Ranger no longer survives the wilderness—they command it.

# Predator's Stride

## Overview
A Ranger knows that every successful hunt begins by choosing a single quarry. Once a target has been identified, their focus narrows until every footprint, broken branch, disturbed blade of grass, and subtle movement contributes to the pursuit. Predator's Stride represents this unwavering commitment to the hunt.

Upon declaring a creature as their **Prey**, the Ranger instinctively adapts their movements and awareness to that individual. They become quieter, more observant, and better at following signs left behind by their quarry. While the hunt continues, the Ranger is reluctant to abandon their target, trusting patience and persistence over reckless pursuit.

Among the Ranger Lodges, changing prey before the hunt is complete is considered a mark of an inexperienced hunter. A true Ranger commits to the chase until it reaches its natural conclusion.

---

## Rank 1
### Description

A Ranger knows that every successful hunt begins by choosing a single quarry. Once a target has been identified, their focus narrows until every footprint, broken branch, disturbed blade of grass, and subtle movement contributes to the pursuit. Predator's Stride represents this unwavering commitment to the hunt.

Upon declaring a creature as their **Prey**, the Ranger instinctively adapts their movements and awareness to that individual. They become quieter, more observant, and better at following signs left behind by their quarry. While the hunt continues, the Ranger is reluctant to abandon their target, trusting patience and persistence over reckless pursuit.

Among the Ranger Lodges, changing prey before the hunt is complete is considered a mark of an inexperienced hunter. A true Ranger commits to the chase until it reaches its natural conclusion.

---

### Effects

#### Declare Prey

Choose one creature within **line of sight** as your **Prey**.

The Prey remains marked for **30 minutes**.

The Ranger cannot voluntarily choose another Prey until:

- The current Prey dies.
- The current Prey becomes unconscious.
- The duration expires.

#### Hunter's Focus

Against your declared Prey, gain:

- **+1 Stealth** checks.
- **+1 Survival** checks made to track the Prey.
- **+1 Perception** checks made to locate the Prey.
- **+1 Investigation** checks involving signs or evidence left by the Prey.

#### Relentless Pursuit

If the Prey attempts to conceal, erase, or disguise its tracks, it has **Disadvantage** on Survival checks made to do so against the Ranger.

#### Limitations

- Only one creature may be designated as your Prey at a time.
- Predator's Stride does not grant bonuses against other creatures.
- This talent does not provide bonuses to attack or damage rolls.
- If the Prey dies or becomes unconscious, the effect immediately ends.

---

### Lore

Every experienced Ranger remembers their first true hunt. Their mentor would point to a single set of tracks and give one simple instruction: *"Follow."* Days later, the lesson was never about catching the animal—it was about learning commitment.

The greatest hunters are not those who chase the fastest, but those who refuse to abandon the trail. Predator's Stride embodies this philosophy, teaching Rangers that every quarry leaves behind a story for those patient enough to read it.

Across Asteria, Rangers renowned for mastering Predator's Stride are respected as trackers without equal, capable of pursuing their chosen quarry across forests, mountains, deserts, and frozen tundra without ever losing the trail.

---

> *"Do not hunt everything. Hunt one thing, and hunt it until the world itself tells you the chase is over."*  
> — **High Ranger Toren Wolfstride**

## Rank 2
### Description

The Ranger's focus on their chosen quarry becomes unwavering. Once a creature has been declared as the Prey, the Ranger begins to anticipate its behaviour, recognise its habits, and instinctively follow the trail it leaves behind. Every broken twig, disturbed patch of earth, or displaced stone becomes another clue guiding the hunt.

With growing experience, the Ranger learns to move almost as though they are part of the landscape itself. They become increasingly difficult for their chosen quarry to detect, while their understanding of the Prey's movements allows them to close the distance without revealing their presence.

a ranger knows that every successful hunt begins by choosing a single quarry. once a target has been identified, their focus narrows until every footprint, broken branch, disturbed blade of grass, and subtle movement contributes to the pursuit. predator's stride represents this unwavering commitment to the hunt.

# Ritual Blessing

## Overview
Not all divine power is called upon in battle.

## Rank 1
### ✨ Description

Not all divine power is called upon in battle.

Some must be prepared… drawn slowly through prayer, symbol, and intent.

*Ritual Blessing* allows you to channel divine energy outside of combat, weaving temporary enchantments, protections, and minor blessings that prepare your allies for what lies ahead.

At Rank 1, your rituals are simple—but meaningful.

---

### ⚔️ Effects

| Type | Description |
|------|------------|
| Type | Active (Ritual / Preparation) |
| Core Effect | Apply a minor blessing to allies |
| Secondary Effect | Create a ritual space |
| Role | Pre-combat utility |

---

### 🎯 Ritual Mechanics

---

#### 🔮 Ritual Casting (Core System)

- Requires:
  - **10 seconds (non-combat use only)**  

- Creates:
  - A **Ritual Space (5m radius)**

- Allies within the space may receive:
  - **1 Blessing effect**

---

#### 🌟 Minor Blessing (Choose 1)

Apply to all allies within the ritual:

---

##### 🟡 Blessing of Vitality
- Gain:
  - **+5 Temporary HP**
- Duration:
  - **10 minutes**

---

##### 🔵 Blessing of Focus
- Gain:
  - **+1 to next skill check or saving roll**
- Duration:
  - Until triggered

---

##### 🟣 Blessing of Resistance
- Gain:
  - **+5% resistance to one damage type (chosen at cast)**
- Duration:
  - **10 minutes**

---

👉 Only **one blessing may be active at a time per target**

---

### ⚡ Channel Divinity Interaction

When consuming a **Divine Charge** during the ritual:

- Enhance the blessing:

- Effects:
  - **+50% duration**
  - OR
  - **Increase effect strength slightly (GM scaling)**

---

### ⚔️ Combat Interaction

- Cannot be cast in combat  
- Effects **persist into combat**  

- Encourages:
  - Preparation  
  - Strategic planning  
  - Team coordination  

---

### ✨ Status Effects

| Status | Description |
|--------|------------|
| Ritual Blessed | Target has an active blessing |
| Sacred Preparation | Buff applied before combat |

---

### ⚠️ Limitations

| Type | Description |
|------|------------|
| Non-Combat Only | Cannot be used mid-fight |
| Single Blessing | Cannot stack multiple rituals |
| Modest Effects | Bonuses are intentionally small |
| Time Requirement | Requires setup time |

---

### ⚠️ Ritual Interruption

If interrupted during casting:

- Ritual fails  
- Mana is still consumed  

---

### 🌍 Environmental Interactions

| Environment | Effect |
|------------|--------|
| Consecrated Ground | Ritual feels stronger (flavour) |
| Divine Shrines | May enhance ritual (GM discretion) |
| Corrupted Zones | Ritual feels unstable |

---

### 🔗 Synergy Hooks (Future Scaling)

- Future ranks may:
  - Add multiple blessing choices  
  - Allow stacking or layering  
  - Extend duration significantly  
  - Add combat-triggered effects  

- [[Channel Divinity]] → Enhances ritual strength  
- [[Blessing of Light]] → Sustained combat synergy  
- [[Mana Well]] → Supports repeated rituals  
- [[Fortified Mind]] → Supports long rituals  

---

### ⚖️ Design Role

- Core identity:
  - **Preparation & utility system**

- Gameplay role:
  - Pre-combat advantage  
  - Team support  
  - Strategic setup  

---

### 📖 Lore

There are powers that answer in an instant.

And there are powers that must be invited.

Through ritual, symbol, and quiet devotion, you create a space where the divine may linger—not as force, but as presence.

And those who stand within it…

Carry that presence with them.

---

### 🗨️ Flavor Text

> *“Power given in silence often lasts the longest.”*

## Rank 2
### ✨ Description

Your rituals deepen in structure and intent.

What was once a simple invocation now carries weight—your symbols are more precise, your focus more refined, and the divine presence you invite lingers longer.

At Rank 2, your blessings are no longer fleeting… they are **reliable preparation tools**.

---

### ⚔️ Effects

| Type | Description |
|------|------------|
| Type | Active (Ritual / Preparation) |
| Core Effect | Improved blessing strength |
| Secondary Effect | Increased duration |
| New Effect | Limited dual blessing option |

---

### 🎯 Ritual Mechanics

---

#### 🔮 Ritual Casting (Core System)

- Requires:
  - **10 seconds (non-combat use only)**  

- Creates:
  - A **Ritual Space (5m radius)**

- Allies within the space may receive:
  - **1 Blessing effect**

---

### 🌟 Blessings (Improved)

Choose **1 primary blessing**:

---

#### 🟡 Blessing of Vitality
- Gain:
  - **+8 Temporary HP**
- Duration:
  - **15 minutes**

---

#### 🔵 Blessing of Focus
- Gain:
  - **+2 to next skill check or saving roll**
- Duration:
  - Until triggered

---

#### 🟣 Blessing of Resistance
- Gain:
  - **+8% resistance to one damage type**
- Duration:
  - **15 minutes**

---

### ✨ Secondary Mark (NEW — Limited Dual Blessing)

You may apply a **Secondary Mark**:

- Choose **a different blessing type**

- Effect:
  - Applies at **50% effectiveness**

👉 Example:
- Vitality (primary) + Focus (secondary)

---

#### ⚠️ Secondary Mark Rules

- Only **1 secondary blessing allowed**
- Cannot duplicate the same blessing type
- Secondary effect is always reduced

---

### ⚡ Channel Divinity Interaction

When consuming a **Divine Charge** during the ritual:

- Choose one:

- **Extended Blessing**
  - +50% duration  

- **Empowered Blessing**
  - Increase primary blessing effectiveness slightly  

---

### ⚔️ Combat Interaction

- Still:
  - ❌ Cannot be cast in combat  

- Effects:
  - Persist into combat  

- Now enables:
  - More flexible pre-combat preparation  

---

### ✨ Status Effects

| Status | Description |
|--------|------------|
| Ritual Blessed | Primary blessing active |
| Secondary Mark | Reduced secondary blessing |
| Sacred Preparation | Pre-combat buff state |

---

### ⚠️ Limitations

| Type | Description |
|------|------------|
| Non-Combat Only | Cannot be used mid-fight |
| Limited Layering | Only 1 secondary effect allowed |
| Reduced Power | Secondary effect is weaker |
| Time Requirement | Requires setup time |

---

### ⚠️ Ritual Interruption

If interrupted:

- Ritual fails  
- Mana is still consumed  

---

### 🌍 Environmental Interactions

| Environment | Effect |
|------------|--------|
| Consecrated Ground | Ritual feels stronger |
| Divine Shrines | May enhance results (GM discretion) |
| Corrupted Zones | Secondary effects may feel unstable |

---

### 🔗 Synergy Hooks (Future Scaling)

- Future ranks may:
  - Allow stronger secondary effects  
  - Introduce persistent ritual zones  
  - Add combat-triggered bonuses  
  - Enable multi-ritual layering  

- [[Channel Divinity]] → Enhances blessing strength  
- [[Blessing of Light]] → Sustained combat synergy  
- [[Mana Well]] → Supports repeated rituals  
- [[Fortified Mind]] → Supports longer rituals  

---

### ⚖️ Design Role

- Evolves into:
  - **Flexible preparation system**

- Adds:
  - Choice  
  - Layering  
  - Strategic setup  

---

### 📖 Lore

The first rituals are simple.

But as your understanding deepens, you begin to weave intention into every motion—every mark, every word, every breath carrying purpose.

The divine does not simply answer you now…

It lingers where you invite it.

---

### 🗨️ Flavor Text

> *“One blessing prepares you…  
two may change what comes next.”*

## Rank 3
### ✨ Description

Your rituals no longer merely invoke power…

They express belief.

The divine presence you call upon now shapes itself according to your Path, changing not only the strength of your blessings—but their purpose.

At Rank 3, *Ritual Blessing* becomes a reflection of who you are as a Cleric.

---

### ⚔️ Effects

| Type | Description |
|------|------------|
| Type | Active (Ritual / Preparation) |
| Core Effect | Enhanced blessing strength |
| Secondary Effect | Secondary Mark retained |
| New Effect | Pathway modifies ritual behaviour |

---

### 🎯 Ritual Mechanics

---

#### 🔮 Ritual Casting (Core System)

- Requires:
  - **10 seconds (non-combat only)**  

- Creates:
  - A **Ritual Space (6m radius)**

- Allies within the space receive:
  - **1 Primary Blessing**
  - Optional **Secondary Mark**

---

### 🌟 Blessings (Improved)

Choose **1 Primary Blessing**:

---

#### 🟡 Blessing of Vitality
- Gain:
  - **+10 Temporary HP**
- Duration:
  - **20 minutes**

---

#### 🔵 Blessing of Focus
- Gain:
  - **+2 to next skill check or saving roll**
- Duration:
  - Until triggered

---

#### 🟣 Blessing of Resistance
- Gain:
  - **+10% resistance to one damage type**
- Duration:
  - **20 minutes**

---

### ✨ Secondary Mark

- Apply:
  - **1 additional blessing at 50% effectiveness**

---

### 🌌 Pathway Infusion (NEW)

---

#### 🟡 Path of Radiance — *Blessing of Renewal*

- Primary Blessing gains:
  - **+10% increased healing received (10 min)**

- Vitality:
  - Temp HP increases slightly  

👉 Focus: **Sustain & recovery**

---

#### 🔵 Path of Preservation — *Blessing of Safeguard*

- Allies gain:
  - **−2 damage taken (first hit in combat)**

- Resistance:
  - Slightly more effective  

👉 Focus: **Defense & survival**

---

#### 🟣 Path of Illumination — *Blessing of Insight*

- Allies gain:
  - **+1 to all skill checks for 10 minutes**

- Focus:
  - Slightly stronger  

👉 Focus: **Utility & control**

---

### ⚡ Channel Divinity Interaction

When consuming a **Divine Charge**:

- Choose one:

- **Extended Ritual**
  - +50% duration  

- **Empowered Ritual**
  - Increase primary effect  

- **Path Amplification (NEW)**
  - Strengthens Pathway effect  

---

### ⚔️ Combat Interaction

- Still:
  - ❌ Cannot be cast in combat  

- Effects:
  - Persist into combat  

- Now:
  - Provide stronger **pre-combat identity advantage**

---

### ✨ Status Effects

| Status | Description |
|--------|------------|
| Ritual Blessed | Primary blessing active |
| Secondary Mark | Reduced secondary effect |
| Path Infusion | Blessing modified by pathway |

---

### ⚠️ Limitations

| Type | Description |
|------|------------|
| Non-Combat Only | Cannot be used mid-fight |
| Limited Layering | Only 1 secondary effect |
| Path Lock | Pathway is permanent |
| Modest Scaling | Effects remain controlled |

---

### ⚠️ Ritual Interruption

- Ritual fails if interrupted  
- Mana is still consumed  

---

### 🌍 Environmental Interactions

| Environment | Effect |
|------------|--------|
| Consecrated Ground | Path effects feel stronger |
| Divine Shrines | May enhance ritual (GM discretion) |
| Corrupted Zones | Ritual stability reduced |

---

### 🔗 Synergy Hooks (Future Scaling)

- Future ranks may:
  - Add multi-ritual effects  
  - Create persistent ritual zones  
  - Introduce combat-triggered blessings  
  - Expand Pathway impact  

- [[Channel Divinity]] → Enhances rituals  
- [[Blessing of Light]] → Sustained synergy  
- [[Mana Well]] → Enables repeated casting  
- [[Fortified Mind]] → Supports ritual stability  

---

### ⚖️ Design Role

- Evolves into:
  - **Identity-based preparation system**

- Adds:
  - Pathway expression  
  - Strategic pre-combat advantage  
  - Role differentiation  

---

### 📖 Lore

There was a time when your rituals called upon the divine.

Now…

They reveal it.

The symbols you draw, the words you speak, the space you create—they are no longer just tradition.

They are truth made visible.

---

### 🗨️ Flavor Text

> *“The ritual does not change…  
you do.”*

## Rank 4
### ✨ Description

Your rituals no longer fade when you leave them behind.

The divine presence you invoke now lingers—woven into your allies and the battlefield itself, waiting for the moment it is needed most.

At Rank 4, your blessings are no longer just preparation…

They are **promises waiting to be fulfilled**.

---

### ⚔️ Effects

| Type | Description |
|------|------------|
| Type | Active (Ritual / Preparation / Triggered) |
| Core Effect | Enhanced blessings |
| Secondary Effect | Secondary Mark retained |
| New Effect | Delayed trigger blessing |

---

### 🎯 Ritual Mechanics

---

#### 🔮 Ritual Casting (Core System)

- Requires:

# ritual blessing

## overview
not all divine power is called upon in battle.

## rank 1
### ✨ description

not all divine power is called upon in battle.

some must be prepared… drawn slowly through prayer, symbol, and intent.

*ritual blessing* allows you to channel divine energy outside of combat, weaving temporary enchantments, protections, and minor blessings that prepare your allies for what lies ahead.

at rank 1, your rituals are simple—but meaningful.

---

  - **+5 temporary hp**
- duration:
  - **10 minutes**

##### 🔵 blessing of focus
- gain:
  - **+1 to next skill check or saving roll**
- duration:
  - until triggered

---

##### 🟣 blessing of resistance

  - **+5% resistance to one damage type (chosen at cast)**
- duration:
  - **10 minutes**

---

👉 only **one blessing may be active at a time per target**

---

when consuming a **divine charge** during the ritual:

- enhance the blessing:

- effects:
  - **+50% duration**

  - **increase effect strength slightly (gm scaling)**

- effects **persist into combat**

  - team coordination

| consecrated ground | triggers feel stronger |
| divine shrines | may enhance ritual (gm discretion) |
| corrupted zones | trigger reliability may feel unstable |

---

### 🔗 synergy hooks (future scaling)

- rank 5 may:
  - allow multiple triggers  
  - create persistent ritual zones  
  - add powerful delayed effects  
  - enable combat-linked ritual influence  

- [[channel divinity]] → enhances triggers  
- [[blessing of light]] → sustained healing synergy  
- [[mana well]] → enables repeated rituals  
- [[fortified mind]] → supports stability  

---

### ⚖️ design role

- evolves into:
  - **pre-loaded defensive / utility system**

- adds:
  - delayed impact  
  - strategic foresight  
  - pre-combat planning depth  

---

### 📖 lore

a true ritual does not end when the words are spoken.

it waits.

it lingers.

it listens.

and when the moment comes…

it answers.

---

### 🗨️ flavor text

> *“the blessing was given long before it was needed.”*

## rank 5
### ✨ description

your rituals no longer prepare for battle…

they define it.

the divine presence you call upon does not fade—it lingers, anchors, and shapes the flow of events long after the ritual is complete. what was once a blessing is now a **field of influence**, woven into those who carry it and the space they fight within.

at rank 5, *ritual blessing* becomes a true expression of foresight—power placed where it will matter most.

---

### ⚔️ effects

| type | description |
|------|------------|
| type | active (ritual / preparation / field influence) |
| core effect | enhanced blessings |
| secondary effect | secondary mark retained |
| new effect | ritual field + empowered trigger |

---

### 🎯 ritual mechanics

---

#### 🔮 ritual casting (core system)

- requires:
  - **10 seconds (non-combat only)**  

- creates:
  - a **ritual space (8m radius)**

- allies within the space receive:
  - **1 primary blessing**
  - optional **secondary mark**
  - **stored trigger effect**

---

### 🌟 blessings (final)

choose **1 primary blessing**:

---

#### 🟡 blessing of vitality
- gain:
  - **+15 temporary hp**
- duration:
  - **30 minutes**

---

#### 🔵 blessing of focus
- gain:
  - **+3 to next skill check or saving roll**
- duration:
  - until triggered

---

#### 🟣 blessing of resistance
- gain:
  - **+15% resistance to one damage type**
- duration:
  - **30 minutes**

---

### ✨ secondary mark

- apply:
  - **1 additional blessing at 50% effectiveness**

---

### ⚡ stored blessing (enhanced)

- each ally gains:
  - **1 trigger effect**

---

#### 🎯 trigger options

- hp drops below **50%**
- take a **heavy hit**
- fail a saving throw  

---

#### 💫 trigger effects (improved)

- choose at ritual:

- **healing**
  - **1d8 + faith**

- **protection**
  - **−3 damage (1 instance)**

- **guidance**
  - **+2 to next roll or reroll failed save**

👉 each effect triggers:
- **once per target**

---

### 🌌 ritual field (new — signature effect)

once per ritual, you create a lingering **ritual field**:

---

#### 🌟 field effect (choose 1)

---

##### 🟡 field of renewal
- allies within **8m**:
  - gain:
    - **+2 hp regeneration per round**
- duration:
  - **3 rounds (combat)**

---

##### 🔵 field of safeguard
- allies within **8m**:
  - gain:
    - **−2 damage taken per hit**
- duration:
  - **3 rounds**

---

##### 🟣 field of insight
- allies within **8m**:
  - gain:
    - **+1 to all rolls**
- duration:
  - **2 rounds**

---

👉 field activates:
- at start of combat  
**or**
- when first ally triggers stored blessing  

---

### 🌌 pathway infusion (final form)

---

#### 🟡 path of radiance — *sanctified renewal*

- field of renewal:
  - gains:
    - **+1 additional hp regen**

- stored healing:
  - gains:
    - **+1d6 bonus healing**

---

#### 🔵 path of preservation — *sanctified bastion*

- field of safeguard:
  - gains:
    - **−3 damage taken**

- stored protection:
  - gains:
    - **−4 damage reduction**

---

#### 🟣 path of illumination — *sanctified insight*

- field of insight:
  - gains:
    - **+2 to all rolls (instead of +1)**

- stored guidance:
  - always:
    - **grants reroll instead of +2**

---

### ⚡ channel divinity interaction

when consuming a **divine charge**:

- choose one:

- **extended ritual**
  - +50% duration  

- **empowered blessing**
  - increase primary blessing  

- **field amplification**
  - increase ritual field effectiveness  

---

### ⚔️ combat interaction

- still:
  - ❌ cannot cast in combat  

- now:
  - effects:
    - trigger  
    - persist  
    - influence battlefield  

- enables:
  - pre-combat strategy  
  - area control before engagement  
  - layered support systems  

---

### ✨ status effects

| status | description |
|--------|------------|
| ritual blessed | primary blessing active |
| secondary mark | reduced secondary effect |
| stored blessing | delayed trigger effect |
| ritual field | active area influence |
| path infusion | effects shaped by pathway |

---

### ⚠️ limitations

| type | description |
|------|------------|
| non-combat cast | cannot be used mid-fight |
| single field | only one field per ritual |
| limited duration | field is short-lived |
| controlled power | effects remain moderate |

---

### ⚠️ ritual interruption

- ritual fails if interrupted  
- mana is still consumed  

---

### 🌍 environmental interactions

| environment | effect |
|------------|--------|
| consecrated ground | field feels stronger |
| divine shrines | may enhance ritual |
| corrupted zones | field may feel unstable |

---

### 🔗 synergy hooks (end of tier 1)

- evolves into:
  - tier 2 → persistent zones / area control  
  - tier 3 → consecrated ground systems  
  - tier 4 → divine territory / domain effects  

- strong synergy with:
  - [[channel divinity]] → enhances field  
  - [[blessing of light]] → sustained aura synergy  
  - [[mana well]] → enables repeated rituals  
  - [[fortified mind]] → supports setup  

---

### ⚖️ design role

- final evolution of:
  - **preparation → layering → identity → trigger → field influence**

- defines:
  - cleric’s **pre-combat control identity**

---

### 📖 lore

a ritual is not a moment.

it is a decision made before the outcome is known.

a space where the divine is invited not to act—but to remain.

and when the moment comes…

that presence answers.

---

### 🗨️ flavor text

> *“the battle was decided… long before it began.”*

# Rooted Power

## Overview
You learn to draw strength directly from the earth beneath your feet. By remaining perfectly still, your roots of mana extend into the land, allowing you to channel greater power through your Earth magic.

Although remaining stationary leaves you vulnerable, the reward is greater control and destructive potential. Experienced Druids often prepare themselves before unleashing powerful spells, allowing the land itself to amplify their magic.

Rooted Power reflects one of the oldest teachings of the Druidic Circles: the strongest tree is not the one that moves with every wind, but the one whose roots run deepest.

---

## Rank 1
### Description

You learn to draw strength directly from the earth beneath your feet. By remaining perfectly still, your roots of mana extend into the land, allowing you to channel greater power through your Earth magic.

Although remaining stationary leaves you vulnerable, the reward is greater control and destructive potential. Experienced Druids often prepare themselves before unleashing powerful spells, allowing the land itself to amplify their magic.

Rooted Power reflects one of the oldest teachings of the Druidic Circles: the strongest tree is not the one that moves with every wind, but the one whose roots run deepest.

---

### Effects

- This is a **Passive Talent**.
- If you **do not move during your turn**, you become **Rooted** until the start of your next turn.
- While Rooted:
  - Your **Earth spells** gain **+2 Damage**.
  - Any **Earth spell** that requires a **D20 Saving Throw** increases its **Save DC by +2**.
  - Earth spells that create **Difficult Terrain** or alter the battlefield have their duration increased by **1 Round**.
- Moving before casting immediately removes the Rooted bonus.
- This talent affects **Earth spells only**.

---

### Lore

Among the oldest Druids, standing motionless before casting is not seen as hesitation—it is seen as respect. They believe the earth willingly shares its strength only with those patient enough to listen.

Many ancient stone circles were built as places where Druids could root themselves to the land before performing powerful rituals. Even today, experienced practitioners pause for a brief moment before calling upon the deepest powers of the earth.

To outsiders, the Druid appears perfectly still. Beneath the surface, however, invisible currents of natural magic flow through the ground, gathering around them until released in a single overwhelming spell.

---

> *"The mountain does not seek power. It simply stands, and power gathers around it."*  
> — **Archdruid Thalen Stoneroot, Warden of the Emerald Peaks**

## Rank 2
### Description

Your roots reach deeper into the earth, allowing greater amounts of natural energy to flow through your body before being released as powerful Earth magic.

The longer you remain still, the more stable your connection becomes. Rather than forcing mana into your spells, you allow the land itself to strengthen them. Every stone, root, and grain of soil beneath your feet becomes part of your magic.

Veteran Druids often choose their ground carefully before combat begins. Once rooted, they become living conduits of the earth, capable of shaping the battlefield with remarkable precision.

---

### Effects

- This is a **Passive Talent**.
- If you **do not move during your turn**, you become **Rooted** until the start of your next turn.
- While Rooted:
  - Your **Earth spells** gain **+4 Damage**.
  - Any **Earth spell** that requires a **D20 Saving Throw** increases its **Save DC by +3**.
  - Earth spells that create **Difficult Terrain** or alter the battlefield have their duration increased by **2 Rounds**.
  - The range of your Earth spells increases by **5 metres**.
- Moving before casting immediately removes the Rooted bonuses.
- This talent affects **Earth spells only**.

---

### Lore

As Druids continue their training, they discover that true strength does not come from standing firm—it comes from becoming part of the land itself.

Every heartbeat, every breath, and every pulse of mana sinks into the earth before returning many times stronger. Ancient Druids believed that the land remembers those who stand with patience, rewarding them with power that cannot be gained through haste alone.

Many sacred stone circles throughout Asteria were built for this very purpose, allowing Druids to root themselves in places where the world's natural energies are strongest.

---

> *"The earth gives freely to those willing to stand and listen. Those who rush hear only silence."*  
> — **Stonewarden Brynn Earthsong, Circle of the Ancient Stones**

## Rank 3
### Description

Your bond with the earth has become second nature. The moment you plant your feet, invisible roots of mana spread deep beneath the ground, drawing strength from the land and feeding it into your spells.

The earth no longer simply empowers your magic—it stabilises it. Every spell is cast with greater force and precision, while the ground itself resists any attempt to move you from your chosen position.

Experienced Druids know that sacrificing mobility is a small price to pay for commanding the overwhelming power of the earth. Once rooted, they become as steadfast as the mountains they call upon.

---

### Effects

- This is a **Passive Talent**.
- If you **do not move during your turn**, you become **Rooted** until the start of your next turn.
- While Rooted:
  - Your **Earth spells** gain **+6 Damage**.
  - Any **Earth spell** that requires a **D20 Saving Throw** increases its **Save DC by +4**.
  - The range of your Earth spells increases by **10 metres**.
  - Earth spells that create **Difficult Terrain** or alter the battlefield have their duration increased by **3 Rounds**.
  - You gain **Advantage on Strength Checks and Saving Throws** made to resist being **pushed, pulled, knocked prone, or forcibly moved**.
- Moving before casting immediately removes all Rooted bonuses.
- This talent affects **Earth spells only**.

---

### Lore

The oldest Druids speak of becoming one with the mountains—not in body, but in spirit. Through years of practice, they learn to anchor themselves so completely that even powerful magic struggles to break their connection with the earth.

Many legendary battles tell of Druids standing unmoved while the world around them crumbled. Storms raged, armies charged, and the ground split beneath their feet, yet they remained steadfast, drawing endless strength from the land below.

Among the Circle of Stone, reaching this level of Rooted Power marks the beginning of true Earth mastery, where patience becomes strength and stillness becomes power.

---

> *"A mountain does not resist the storm because it is stronger. It endures because it refuses to move."*  
> — **Stonewarden Brynn Earthsong, Circle of the Ancient Stones**

## Rank 4
### Description

Your connection to the earth has become unwavering. The moment you root yourself, the land embraces you as one of its own, anchoring your body and amplifying every Earth spell you cast.

The natural mana flowing beneath the surface surges through you with incredible force, allowing your spells to reshape the battlefield with unmatched precision. Stone walls rise taller, fissures spread farther, and every tremor carries greater destructive force.

Few enemies can move a Druid who has mastered this level of Rooted Power. They stand as immovable pillars amidst chaos, drawing strength from the world itself while unleashing the fury of the earth.

---

### Effects

- This is a **Passive Talent**.
- If you **do not move during your turn**, you become **Rooted** until the start of your next turn.
- While Rooted:
  - Your **Earth spells** gain **+8 Damage**.
  - Any **Earth spell** that requires a **D20 Saving Throw** increases its **Save DC by +5**.
  - The range of your Earth spells increases by **15 metres**.
  - Earth spells that create **Difficult Terrain** or alter the battlefield have their duration increased by **4 Rounds**.
  - You gain **Advantage on Strength Checks and Saving Throws** made to resist being **pushed, pulled, knocked prone, or forcibly moved**.
  - You gain **Resistance to Forced Movement**. If an effect would move you, reduce the distance by **half** (rounded down).
- Moving before casting immediately removes all Rooted bonuses.
- This talent affects **Earth spells only**.

---

### Lore

The ancient Stone Circles teach that the earth is never truly still. Beneath every mountain and valley lies an endless current of natural power, waiting for those patient enough to become part of it.

Druids who master Rooted Power are no longer visitors upon the land—they are accepted by it. Their footsteps become lighter, yet their presence becomes impossible to ignore. Even the oldest mountains recognise them as guardians rather than wanderers.

Legends tell of Druids who stood alone against charging armies, refusing to yield a single step. Though battered by wind, steel, and magic, they remained rooted until the battle was won, their unwavering resolve becoming as legendary as the mountains themselves.

---

> *"A tree survives because of its roots. A mountain endures because it has nowhere else to be. Learn from both."*  
> — **High Stonewarden Kaelor Granitebloom, Circle of the Worldroot**

## Rank 5
### Description

Your mastery of Earth magic reaches its pinnacle. The moment you root yourself, your body becomes one with the land beneath you, drawing upon the endless strength of the world itself. The flow of natural mana is no longer merely borrowed—it is welcomed, amplified, and released through you with overwhelming force.

While rooted, every Earth spell is cast with exceptional precision and destructive power. The ground answers your call without hesitation, raising walls of stone, opening deep fissures, and reshaping the battlefield as though the land itself has become your ally.

The oldest Druids refer to this state as becoming **Worldrooted**. Few ever achieve it, for it requires complete trust in the natural world. Those who do are said to stand as living pillars between civilisation and the untamed wilds, immovable until they choose to walk once more.

---

### Effects

- This is a **Passive Talent**.
- If you **do not move during your turn**, you become **Rooted** until the start of your next turn.
- While Rooted:
  - Your **Earth spells** gain **+10 Damage**.
  - Any **Earth spell** that requires a **D20 Saving Throw** increases its **Save DC by +6**.
  - The range of your Earth spells increases by **20 metres**.
  - Earth spells that create **Difficult Terrain** or alter the battlefield have their duration increased by **5 Rounds**.
  - You gain **Advantage on Strength Checks and Saving Throws** made to resist being **pushed, pulled, knocked prone, or forcibly moved**.
  - You **cannot be forcibly moved** by non-legendary abilities or effects while Rooted.
  - Your Earth spells ignore **Half Cover** and **Three-Quarters Cover** created by natural terrain.
- Moving before casting immediately removes all Rooted bonuses.
- This talent affects **Earth spells only**.

---

### Lore

To become Worldrooted is to earn the complete trust of the earth itself. The oldest legends speak of Druids who stood unmoving for days upon sacred mountains, allowing their spirits to intertwine with the heartbeat of the world until they could no longer tell where they ended and the land began.

These Druids became living extensions of the earth. Wherever they stood, stone rose to defend them, cliffs answered their commands, and the ground itself refused to allow them to fall.

Modern Druids rarely witness such mastery, yet every Circle preserves the stories as a reminder that true power is not found in movement or speed, but in unwavering resolve. The earth has endured since the beginning of Asteria, and those who become one with it inherit a fraction of that timeless strength.

---

> *"Stand long enough for the world to know your name, and one day it will answer when you call."*  
> — **Grand Earthwarden Kaelor Granitebloom, Keeper of the Worldroot**

# Sacred Aegis

## Overview
You invoke your patron's divine protection, surrounding yourself or another creature with a sacred aegis that shields them from harm. While every Cleric can call upon this protective blessing, each patron shapes the aegis according to their own divine ideals, causing every manifestation to feel unique despite sharing the same sacred foundation.

The aegis strengthens the target against incoming attacks through divine protection rather than physical armour. Whether it manifests as radiant light, spectral armour, swirling leaves, celestial flames, shadowed wings or another sacred form depends entirely upon the patron who answers your prayer. Regardless of its appearance, the blessing serves as a visible reminder that the target stands beneath the watchful gaze of a higher power.

As your faith deepens, your Sacred Aegis grows stronger, allowing your patron to reinforce the blessing with additional divine effects unique to their domain.

## Rank 1
### Description

You invoke your patron's divine protection, surrounding yourself or another creature with a sacred aegis that shields them from harm. While every Cleric can call upon this protective blessing, each patron shapes the aegis according to their own divine ideals, causing every manifestation to feel unique despite sharing the same sacred foundation.

The aegis strengthens the target against incoming attacks through divine protection rather than physical armour. Whether it manifests as radiant light, spectral armour, swirling leaves, celestial flames, shadowed wings or another sacred form depends entirely upon the patron who answers your prayer. Regardless of its appearance, the blessing serves as a visible reminder that the target stands beneath the watchful gaze of a higher power.

As your faith deepens, your Sacred Aegis grows stronger, allowing your patron to reinforce the blessing with additional divine effects unique to their domain.

### Effects

- Sacred Aegis is a **Cantrip**.
- Target yourself or one creature within range.
- The target gains **+2 AC** for the duration.
- Sacred Aegis lasts **3 rounds**.
- The target also gains any **Sacred Aegis I** effects granted by your chosen Patron.
- Patron effects are additional benefits and do not replace the base effects of Sacred Aegis.
- A creature may only benefit from one Sacred Aegis at a time.
- Recasting Sacred Aegis refreshes its duration.

### Lore

Throughout Asteria, every faith tells stories of divine protection appearing when hope seemed lost. Some speak of radiant shields that turned aside deadly blows, while others describe ghostly guardians, living vines, celestial feathers or silent shadows that stood between the faithful and certain death. Though these manifestations differ, they all share a single truth—they are tangible signs that a patron has chosen to intervene.

Experienced Clerics understand that Sacred Aegis is more than a defensive blessing. It is a symbol of trust between deity and disciple, demonstrating that divine protection is not always about preventing harm, but ensuring the faithful endure long enough to fulfil the purpose laid before them.

> *"When faith becomes your shield, even the impossible may be endured."*
>
> — **Saint Valen, Guardian of the First Temple**

## Rank 2
### Description

Your patron's divine protection grows stronger, allowing you to reinforce yourself or another creature with a more resilient Sacred Aegis. The blessing not only endures longer but offers greater protection against the dangers of battle, serving as a steadfast reminder that your patron watches over those who remain faithful.

Although every Cleric can invoke Sacred Aegis, no two manifestations are ever identical. The blessing takes the form most befitting your patron's divine nature, whether it appears as radiant light, celestial armour, sacred vines, spectral guardians or another divine manifestation. Regardless of its appearance, the aegis always provides a reliable shield that stands between the target and approaching danger.

As your connection with your patron deepens, they further empower your Sacred Aegis with blessings unique to their divine domain, allowing the protection to become more than a simple barrier against harm.

### Effects

- Sacred Aegis remains a **Cantrip**.
- Increase the Mana Cost to **25 MP**.
- Increase the Range to **20 metres**.
- Increase the Duration to **4 rounds**.
- Target yourself or one creature within range.
- The target gains **+3 AC** for the duration.
- The target also gains any **Sacred Aegis II** effects granted by your chosen Patron.
- Patron effects are additional benefits and do not replace the base effects of Sacred Aegis.
- A creature may only benefit from one Sacred Aegis at a time.
- Recasting Sacred Aegis refreshes its duration.

### Lore

As a Cleric's faith matures, so too does the strength of the divine protection entrusted to them. Veteran members of every faith are recognised not only by the miracles they perform, but by their ability to stand as guardians of others, placing themselves between danger and those under their patron's care.

Many ancient records tell of Sacred Aegis protecting champions during impossible battles, allowing them to survive blows that should have ended their lives. While historians often argue over the appearance of these blessings, every account agrees on one truth—the protection was never born from the Cleric's power alone, but from the unwavering faith that connected them to their patron.

> *"A shield forged by faith is strengthened by every trial it endures."*
>
> — **High Protector Aleron, Warden of the Sacred Bastion**

## Rank 3
### Description

Your faith has become a steadfast bastion through which your patron's protection flows with unwavering strength. When you invoke Sacred Aegis, divine power surrounds yourself or another creature, forming a resilient ward that shields them from danger while carrying the unmistakable mark of your patron's influence.

Although every Sacred Aegis provides the same fundamental protection, each patron leaves their own divine signature upon the blessing. Some manifest as radiant halos, others as spectral armour, shimmering runes, living branches, celestial wings or countless other sacred forms. Regardless of its appearance, the aegis stands as a visible declaration that the protected creature is under the watchful care of a higher power.

As your connection to your patron deepens, the divine blessing grows more formidable. The protection itself strengthens, while your patron weaves additional miracles into the aegis, allowing it to serve as both a shield against harm and a reflection of their divine domain.

### Effects

- Sacred Aegis remains a **Cantrip**.
- Increase the Mana Cost to **30 MP**.
- Increase the Range to **25 metres**.
- Increase the Duration to **5 rounds**.
- Target yourself or one creature within range.
- The target gains **+4 AC** for the duration.
- The target also gains any **Sacred Aegis III** effects granted by your chosen Patron.
- Patron effects are additional benefits and do not replace the base effects of Sacred Aegis.
- A creature may only benefit from one Sacred Aegis at a time.
- Recasting Sacred Aegis refreshes its duration.

### Lore

The Third Sacred Aegis marks the point where a Cleric is recognised as a trusted protector within their faith. Veteran adventurers often seek such Clerics before embarking upon dangerous expeditions, knowing that their patron's blessing has turned aside countless fatal blows throughout history.

Ancient scriptures describe Sacred Aegis as more than a defensive miracle. It is a sacred promise between patron and disciple that the faithful will never stand alone while fulfilling their divine purpose. Though the form of the blessing differs from one deity to another, every manifestation carries the same enduring message—that courage is strongest when shielded by unwavering faith.

> *"The divine does not promise a life without hardship. It promises that the faithful shall never face it alone."*
>
> — **Archbishop Seraphis, Guardian of the Eternal Bastion**

## Rank 4
### Description

Your patron's protection has become a formidable divine safeguard, allowing you to envelop yourself or another creature within an aegis capable of withstanding even the fiercest assaults. Through unwavering faith, you have become a trusted conduit for your patron's protective power, calling upon a blessing that few Clerics are capable of wielding.

Every Sacred Aegis shares the same sacred foundation, yet each patron leaves an unmistakable mark upon the blessing. To some it appears as radiant armour forged from holy light, while others witness celestial feathers, shimmering runes, spectral guardians, sacred vines or manifestations known only to followers of that deity. Though their appearances differ, each aegis serves the same purpose—to shield the faithful while reinforcing them with the unique blessings of their patron.

As your devotion continues to deepen, the protective barrier grows ever stronger, allowing your patron to weave increasingly powerful divine gifts into the blessing. Those protected by your Sacred Aegis often find themselves standing firm against overwhelming adversity, sustained by both the universal protection of the aegis and the additional favour granted by their patron.

### Effects

- Sacred Aegis remains a **Cantrip**.
- Increase the Mana Cost to **35 MP**.
- Increase the Range to **30 metres**.
- Increase the Duration to **6 rounds**.
- Target yourself or one creature within range.
- The target gains **+5 AC** for the duration.
- The target also gains any **Sacred Aegis IV** effects granted by your chosen Patron.
- Patron effects are additional benefits and do not replace the base effects of Sacred Aegis.
- A creature may only benefit from one Sacred Aegis at a time.
- Recasting Sacred Aegis refreshes its duration.

### Lore

Among the great temples of Asteria, those capable of invoking the Fourth Sacred Aegis are often appointed as guardians of holy relics, protectors of sacred sites and defenders of those unable to defend themselves. Their patron's blessing has become so refined that even seasoned warriors feel a renewed sense of confidence beneath its protection.

Many ancient chronicles tell of battles where a single Cleric stood at the heart of a desperate defence, their Sacred Aegis preserving allies against impossible odds until victory could be won. Though each patron manifested their protection differently, every account reached the same conclusion: divine protection is not measured by the brilliance of the shield, but by the lives preserved beneath it.

> *"The strongest fortress is not built of stone, but of faith shared between the divine and the faithful."*
>
> — **Grand Protector Althorin, Warden of the Sacred Citadel**

## Rank 5
### Description

You have mastered the sacred art of divine protection, allowing your patron's aegis to reach its fullest expression. With a single invocation, you may surround yourself or another creature in an exceptionally powerful ward, shielding them from harm while carrying the unmistakable blessing of the deity you serve. Few Clerics ever attain this level of divine favour, and those who do are recognised as living guardians of their faith.

Every Sacred Aegis shares the same unbreakable foundation of divine protection, yet every patron shapes the blessing according to their own sacred nature. One deity may cloak their faithful in radiant light, another in celestial armour, living branches, spectral wings or ancient runic sigils. Though the appearance differs, the purpose remains constant—to preserve those chosen by the divine while empowering them with blessings unique to their patron.

At its highest rank, Sacred Aegis stands as both a shield and a symbol. It represents the unwavering covenant between patron and disciple, protecting those entrusted to your care while reminding all who witness it that true strength is found through faith, devotion and the enduring favour of the divine.

### Effects

- Sacred Aegis remains a **Cantrip**.
- Increase the Mana Cost to **40 MP**.
- Increase the Range to **35 metres**.
- Increase the Duration to **8 rounds**.
- Target yourself or one creature within range.
- The target gains **+6 AC** for the duration.
- The target also gains any **Sacred Aegis V** effects granted by your chosen Patron.
- Patron effects are additional benefits and do not replace the base effects of Sacred Aegis.
- A creature may only benefit from one Sacred Aegis at a time.
- Recasting Sacred Aegis refreshes its duration.
- You have mastered **Sacred Aegis**.

### Lore

Throughout the history of Asteria, only the greatest champions of the faith have wielded the Fifth Sacred Aegis. Their names are remembered not because they stood above others, but because they stood before them. They became the first line of defence against darkness, placing themselves between danger and those unable to protect themselves, trusting completely in the blessing granted by their patron.

The oldest scriptures teach that the greatest shield is not one that makes its bearer invincible, but one that allows others to endure long enough to fulfil their purpose. Every manifestation of Sacred Aegis reflects this truth. Whether protecting a lone traveller, an entire adventuring party or the defenders of a kingdom, the blessing exists to preserve hope when all other defences have failed.

Those who master Sacred Aegis become living symbols of their patron's protection. Wherever they walk, the faithful take comfort knowing that even amidst overwhelming darkness, the divine continues to stand beside those who refuse to yield.

> *"The measure of a guardian is not how many blows they withstand, but how many lives remain standing because they chose to protect them."*
>
> — **Saint Valen, First Shield of the Divine**

# sacred aegis

## overview
you invoke your patron's divine protection, surrounding yourself or another creature with a sacred aegis that shields them from harm. while every cleric can call upon this protective blessing, each patron shapes the aegis according to their own divine ideals, causing every manifestation to feel unique despite sharing the same sacred foundation.

the aegis strengthens the target against incoming attacks through divine protection rather than physical armour. whether it manifests as radiant light, spectral armour, swirling leaves, celestial flames, shadowed wings or another sacred form depends entirely upon the patron who answers your prayer. regardless of its appearance, the blessing serves as a visible reminder that the target stands beneath the watchful gaze of a higher power.

as your faith deepens, your sacred aegis grows stronger, allowing your patron to reinforce the blessing with additional divine effects unique to their domain.

## rank 1
### description

you invoke your patron's divine protection, surrounding yourself or another creature with a sacred aegis that shields them from harm. while every cleric can call upon this protective blessing, each patron shapes the aegis according to their own divine ideals, causing every manifestation to feel unique despite sharing the same sacred foundation.

the aegis strengthens the target against incoming attacks through divine protection rather than physical armour. whether it manifests as radiant light, spectral armour, swirling leaves, celestial flames, shadowed wings or another sacred form depends entirely upon the patron who answers your prayer. regardless of its appearance, the blessing serves as a visible reminder that the target stands beneath the watchful gaze of a higher power.

as your faith deepens, your sacred aegis grows stronger, allowing your patron to reinforce the blessing with additional divine effects unique to their domain.

### effects

- sacred aegis is a **cantrip**.
- target yourself or one creature within range.
- the target gains **+2 ac** for the duration.
- sacred aegis lasts **3 rounds**.
- the target also gains any **sacred aegis i** effects granted by your chosen patron.
- patron effects are additional benefits and do not replace the base effects of sacred aegis.
- a creature may only benefit from one sacred aegis at a time.
- recasting sacred aegis refreshes its duration.

### lore

throughout asteria, every faith tells stories of divine protection appearing when hope seemed lost. some speak of radiant shields that turned aside deadly blows, while others describe ghostly guardians, living vines, celestial feathers or silent shadows that stood between the faithful and certain death. though these manifestations differ, they all share a single truth—they are tangible signs that a patron has chosen to intervene.

experienced clerics understand that sacred aegis is more than a defensive blessing. it is a symbol of trust between deity and disciple, demonstrating that divine protection is not always about preventing harm, but ensuring the faithful endure long enough to fulfil the purpose laid before them.

> *"when faith becomes your shield, even the impossible may be endured."*
>
> — **saint valen, guardian of the first temple**

## rank 2
### description

your patron's divine protection grows stronger, allowing you to reinforce yourself or another creature with a more resilient sacred aegis. the blessing not only endures longer but offers greater protection against the dangers of battle, serving as a steadfast reminder that your patron watches over those who remain faithful.

although every cleric can invoke sacred aegis, no two manifestations are ever identical. the blessing takes the form most befitting your patron's divine nature, whether it appears as radiant light, celestial armour, sacred vines, spectral guardians or another divine manifestation. regardless of its appearance, the aegis always provides a reliable shield that stands between the target and approaching danger.

as your connection with your patron deepens, they further empower your sacred aegis with blessings unique to their divine domain, allowing the protection to become more than a simple barrier against harm.

### effects

- sacred aegis remains a **cantrip**.
- increase the mana cost to **25 mp**.
- increase the range to **20 metres**.
- increase the duration to **4 rounds**.
- target yourself or one creature within range.
- the target gains **+3 ac** for the duration.
- the target also gains any **sacred aegis ii** effects granted by your chosen patron.
- patron effects are additional benefits and do not replace the base effects of sacred aegis.
- a creature may only benefit from one sacred aegis at a time.
- recasting sacred aegis refreshes its duration.

### lore

as a cleric's faith matures, so too does the strength of the divine protection entrusted to them. veteran members of every faith are recognised not only by the miracles they perform, but by their ability to stand as guardians of others, placing themselves between danger and those under their patron's care.

many ancient records tell of sacred aegis protecting champions during impossible battles, allowing them to survive blows that should have ended their lives. while historians often argue over the appearance of these blessings, every account agrees on one truth—the protection was never born from the cleric's power alone, but from the unwavering faith that connected them to their patron.

> *"a shield forged by faith is strengthened by every trial it endures."*
>
> — **high protector aleron, warden of the sacred bastion**

## rank 3
### description

your faith has become a steadfast bastion through which your patron's protection flows with unwavering strength. when you invoke sacred aegis, divine power surrounds yourself or another creature, forming a resilient ward that shields them from danger while carrying the unmistakable mark of your patron's influence.

although every sacred aegis provides the same fundamental protection, each patron leaves their own divine signature upon the blessing. some manifest as radiant halos, others as spectral armour, shimmering runes, living branches, celestial wings or countless other sacred forms. regardless of its appearance, the aegis stands as a visible declaration that the protected creature is under the watchful care of a higher power.

as your connection to your patron deepens, the divine blessing grows more formidable. the protection itself strengthens, while your patron weaves additional miracles into the aegis, allowing it to serve as both a shield against harm and a reflection of their divine domain.

### effects

- sacred aegis remains a **cantrip**.
- increase the mana cost to **30 mp**.
- increase the range to **25 metres**.
- increase the duration to **5 rounds**.
- target yourself or one creature within range.
- the target gains **+4 ac** for the duration.
- the target also gains any **sacred aegis iii** effects granted by your chosen patron.
- patron effects are additional benefits and do not replace the base effects of sacred aegis.
- a creature may only benefit from one sacred aegis at a time.
- recasting sacred aegis refreshes its duration.

### lore

the third sacred aegis marks the point where a cleric is recognised as a trusted protector within their faith. veteran adventurers often seek such clerics before embarking upon dangerous expeditions, knowing that their patron's blessing has turned aside countless fatal blows throughout history.

ancient scriptures describe sacred aegis as more than a defensive miracle. it is a sacred promise between patron and disciple that the faithful will never stand alone while fulfilling their divine purpose. though the form of the blessing differs from one deity to another, every manifestation carries the same enduring message—that courage is strongest when shielded by unwavering faith.

> *"the divine does not promise a life without hardship. it promises that the faithful shall never face it alone."*
>
> — **archbishop seraphis, guardian of the eternal bastion**

## rank 4
### description

your patron's protection has become a formidable divine safeguard, allowing you to envelop yourself or another creature within an aegis capable of withstanding even the fiercest assaults. through unwavering faith, you have become a trusted conduit for your patron's protective power, calling upon a blessing that few clerics are capable of wielding.

every sacred aegis shares the same sacred foundation, yet each patron leaves an unmistakable mark upon the blessing. to some it appears as radiant armour forged from holy light, while others witness celestial feathers, shimmering runes, spectral guardians, sacred vines or manifestations known only to followers of that deity. though their appearances differ, each aegis serves the same purpose—to shield the faithful while reinforcing them with the unique blessings of their patron.

as your devotion continues to deepen, the protective barrier grows ever stronger, allowing your patron to weave increasingly powerful divine gifts into the blessing. those protected by your sacred aegis often find themselves standing firm against overwhelming adversity, sustained by both the universal protection of the aegis and the additional favour granted by their patron.

### effects

- sacred aegis remains a **cantrip**.
- increase the mana cost to **35 mp**.
- increase the range to **30 metres**.
- increase the duration to **6 rounds**.
- target yourself or one creature within range.
- the target gains **+5 ac** for the duration.
- the target also gains any **sacred aegis iv** effects granted by your chosen patron.
- patron effects are additional benefits and do not replace the base effects of sacred aegis.
- a creature may only benefit from one sacred aegis at a time.
- recasting sacred aegis refreshes its duration.

### lore

among the great temples of asteria, those capable of invoking the fourth sacred aegis are often appointed as guardians of holy relics, protectors of sacred sites and defenders of those unable to defend themselves. their patron's blessing has become so refined that even seasoned warriors feel a renewed sense of confidence beneath its protection.

many ancient chronicles tell of battles where a single cleric stood at the heart of a desperate defence, their sacred aegis preserving allies against impossible odds until victory could be won. though each patron manifested their protection differently, every account reached the same conclusion: divine protection is not measured by the brilliance of the shield, but by the lives preserved beneath it.

> *"the strongest fortress is not built of stone, but of faith shared between the divine and the faithful."*
>
> — **grand protector althorin, warden of the sacred citadel**

## rank 5
### description

you have mastered the sacred art of divine protection, allowing your patron's aegis to reach its fullest expression. with a single invocation, you may surround yourself or another creature in an exceptionally powerful ward, shielding them from harm while carrying the unmistakable blessing of the deity you serve. few clerics ever attain this level of divine favour, and those who do are recognised as living guardians of their faith.

every sacred aegis shares the same unbreakable foundation of divine protection, yet every patron shapes the blessing according to their own sacred nature. one deity may cloak their faithful in radiant light, another in celestial armour, living branches, spectral wings or ancient runic sigils. though the appearance differs, the purpose remains constant—to preserve those chosen by the divine while empowering them with blessings unique to their patron.

at its highest rank, sacred aegis stands as both a shield and a symbol. it represents the unwavering covenant between patron and disciple, protecting those entrusted to your care while reminding all who witness it that true strength is found through faith, devotion and the enduring favour of the divine.

### effects

- sacred aegis remains a **cantrip**.
- increase the mana cost to **40 mp**.
- increase the range to **35 metres**.
- increase the duration to **8 rounds**.
- target yourself or one creature within range.
- the target gains **+6 ac** for the duration.
- the target also gains any **sacred aegis v** effects granted by your chosen patron.
