# Fire Pixie

## Overview
# Pixie Lore

Pixies are among the **oldest manifested fae** known to exist, born not of flesh but of **Avalon’s will and magic**. They are living expressions of elemental harmony, curiosity, and the unstable boundary between realms.

Though small in stature, pixies have left **outsized marks on history**, often unnoticed by mortals until centuries later.

---

## Origins of the Pixie

Pixies first emerged during the **Early Bloom of Avalon**, when the Fae Realm stabilised after its initial formation. Unlike other fae who formed courts or hierarchies, pixies manifested as **free-roaming spirits**, each bound to a single elemental truth.

Pixies were never meant to rule, conquer, or guide.  
They were created to **observe, influence, and subtly correct** the flow of magic between realms.

From their first moments, pixies were incomplete.

Each pixie was born with **half a soul**, the other half forming separately as a **Sprite**. Together they form a complete metaphysical whole, though separated by form and purpose.

---

## The Split Soul Doctrine

Pixie lore teaches that a soul divided can better perceive reality.

- Pixies experience the **active world** — emotion, action, impulse
- Sprites experience the **reflective world** — memory, intuition, balance

Ancient pixies believe this division prevents corruption, arrogance, and stagnation. A whole soul, they claim, grows rigid. A split soul remains adaptable.

This belief has never been universally accepted among the fae.

---

## The Worldroot Gate (Tree Portal)

Pixies do not freely cross between realms.

Instead, they rely on a living construct known as the **Worldroot Gate** — an immense, ancient tree whose roots exist simultaneously in **Avalon** and **Asteria**.

### Key Facts
- The gate opens **once every 50 years**
- It remains open for **a single full lunar cycle**
- Only pixies, sprites, and bonded fae may pass freely
- Mortals who attempt passage rarely survive unchanged

To pixies, this event is known as **The Crossing Bloom**.

---

## The Crossing Bloom

The Crossing Bloom is a time of:
- Celebration
- Mourning
- Oaths
- Long journeys

Pixies born in Avalon may choose to:
- Visit Asteria
- Remain behind permanently
- Escort bonded sprites or fae envoys
- Observe the state of magic in the mortal realm

Pixies who pass through often do not return for centuries — if at all.

Those who miss the Crossing Bloom must wait **another 50 years**, a delay that can feel unbearable to beings defined by curiosity.

---

## Pixies in Asterian History

Pixies rarely appear in written mortal records, but their influence is undeniable.

They prefer to act as:
- Whispered guides
- Unseen helpers
- Saboteurs of great evils
- Inspirers of invention and art

Many pivotal moments in Asterian history coincide with **Crossing Bloom years**, though few mortals recognise the pattern.

---

## Notable Pixie Figures

### ✦ Queen Lythiriel of the Shimmergrove
The only pixie ever acknowledged as a **queen**.

Lythiriel united scattered pixie enclaves during a time when the Worldroot Gate was damaged by planar instability. Her reign lasted only one Crossing Bloom, after which she dissolved her crown and vanished into Avalon’s upper canopies.

Pixies still swear rare oaths **“by Lythiriel’s Leaves.”**

---

### ✦ King Bramblethorn (The Unwilling King)
A title bestowed by mortals, not pixies.

Bramblethorn led a resistance against a demonic incursion that attempted to corrupt the Worldroot Gate during a Crossing Bloom. Though victorious, he rejected all authority afterward and shattered his staff into seeds scattered across Asteria.

Some believe those seeds still grow into **warded trees**.

---

### ✦ Nyx-of-the-Falling-Ash
A pixie hero bound to fire.

Nyx is credited with:
- Diverting a volcanic eruption
- Burning a lich’s phylactery without destroying the soul cycle
- Teaching early fire-mages restraint

Nyx never returned to Avalon and is believed to have **faded into pure flame**.

---

## Pixie Artisans & Crafters

Pixies rarely craft physical goods, but when they do, their work is legendary.

### ✦ The Glimmerhands
A collective of pixie artisans known for crafting:
- Ever-burning lanterns
- Floating instruments
- Soul-safe crystal foci

Each item crafted by a Glimmerhand is said to contain a **single truthful memory** of its maker.

---

### ✦ Thistlewick the Binder
An eccentric pixie who specialised in **binding magic to form**.

Thistlewick helped design early enchantment frameworks still used by Asterian artificers today. Many do not realise the “odd inefficiencies” in these designs were intentional safety limits.

---

## Pixies & Mortals

Pixies regard mortals with fascination and caution.

They admire:
- Creativity
- Defiance
- Emotional depth

They fear:
- Obsession
- Exploitation of magic
- Attempts to control the Worldroot Gate

Pixies may aid mortals they find interesting, but will abandon those who attempt to command or bind them.

---

## Modern Pixie Beliefs

In the current age, pixies believe:
- The realms are drifting further apart
- Crossing Blooms feel more dangerous
- Magic in Asteria is becoming volatile

Some whisper that the Worldroot Gate may **one day fail entirely**.

If that happens, pixies will be forced to choose:
- Remain forever in Avalon  
- Or become permanent residents of the mortal realm

---

## Final Words of Pixie Lore

> *“We are not small because we are weak.  We are small so the world forgets to fear us.”*  
> — Old Pixie Proverb

## 🧠 Notes

- Native to **Avalon (Fae Realm)**  
- Do not form structured societies  

Common habitats:
- Elemental groves  
- Floating crystal formations  
- Hidden fae sanctuaries  

Values:
- Freedom  
- Expression  
- Balance with nature  
- Soul connection

## Racial Features
- Height Range:
  - 15 cm to 60 cm  

- Weight Range:
  - 2 kg to 6 kg  

- Wings:
  - Insect-like, semi-translucent magical wings  
  - Shape varies depending on elemental affinity  

- Skin:
  - Soft, glowing, slightly translucent  
  - Colour Range:
    - Pastel → vibrant → elemental hues  

- Hair:
  - Light, flowing as if weightless  
  - Colour Range:
    - White → silver → elemental tones  

- Eyes:
  - Bright and glowing with elemental energy  
  - Colour Range:
    - Matches elemental affinity  

- Hands:
  - Tiny, delicate fingers  
  - Highly precise control for fine manipulation  

- Face:
  - Soft, expressive features  
  - Emotions often visible through subtle glow changes  

- Ears:
  - Small and pointed  

- Markings:
  - Faint glowing patterns tied to elemental nature  

- Body:
  - Extremely lightweight  
  - Movements are erratic, fluttering, and quick  

---

## Racial Characteristics
| Characteristic | Buff/Debuff | Stat Rolls | Characteristic Tier Cap |
| -------------- | :---------: | :--------: | :---------------------: |
| Strength       |     -3      |    2d4     |         Tier 1          |
| Dexterity      |     +1      |    4d6     |         Tier 5          |
| Agility        |     +2      |    4d6     |         Tier 5          |
| Constitution   |     -2      |    2d4     |         Tier 3          |
| Endurance      |      0      |    2d4     |         Tier 3          |
| Intelligence   |     +1      |    4d6     |         Tier 5          |
| Wisdom         |      0      |    4d6     |         Tier 5          |
| Charisma       |     +1      |    4d6     |         Tier 5          |
| Luck           |      0      |    3d6     |         Tier 5          |

---

## Racial Traits
### Magical Affinity (Innate)

#### Description
Every Pixie is born with a perfect bond to a single element. This magical affinity defines their soul, shapes their appearance, and can never naturally be altered or diminished.

#### Effects
- Born with **100% Affinity** in one chosen magical element.
- This affinity cannot be naturally changed, reduced, or replaced.
- Gain reduced magical backlash when casting spells of your aligned element.
- Wing colour, eye colour, hair accents and mana aura naturally reflect the chosen element.
- Unlock the corresponding **Elemental Gift** racial trait.

---

### Racial Bond: Split Soul

#### Description
A Pixie's soul is incomplete at birth, with its missing half manifesting as a Sprite. Together they form a single spiritual existence connected beyond distance and ordinary magic.

#### Effects
- Every Pixie possesses a spiritually linked **Sprite**.
- Pixie and Sprite always know the general direction of one another.
- The bond functions across any distance on the same plane.
- While close together, magical energy flows more efficiently between the pair.
- If the bond is damaged, suppressed, or severed, both become **Soul Unstable**, suffering narrative and mechanical consequences determined by the GM.

---

### Fey Perception

#### Description
Pixies instinctively perceive the subtle currents of Fey magic, allowing them to notice illusions, enchantments, and magical disturbances that often escape ordinary senses.

#### Effects
- Naturally detect magical illusions and glamours.
- Sense nearby magical distortions and unstable mana.
- Gain heightened intuition toward hidden magical intent.
- Gain bonuses when identifying Fey magic or magical anomalies.

---

### Fey Wings

#### Description
Pixie wings are living extensions of their soul, formed from condensed mana rather than flesh. They provide effortless flight and continually regenerate while their soul remains whole.

#### Effects
- Gain a natural Flight Speed.
- Can hover without requiring forward movement.
- Descend safely while conscious, greatly reducing falling damage.
- Wings naturally regenerate if damaged.
- Wing appearance permanently reflects the Pixie's elemental affinity.

---

- native to **avalon (fae realm)**  
- do not form structured societies  

common habitats:
- elemental groves  
- floating crystal formations  
- hidden fae sanctuaries  

values:
- freedom  
- expression  
- balance with nature  
- soul connection

## racial features
- height range:
  - 15 cm to 60 cm  

- weight range:
  - 2 kg to 6 kg  

- wings:
  - insect-like, semi-translucent magical wings  
  - shape varies depending on elemental affinity  

- skin:
  - soft, glowing, slightly translucent  
  - colour range:
    - pastel → vibrant → elemental hues  

- hair:
  - light, flowing as if weightless  
  - colour range:
    - white → silver → elemental tones  

- eyes:
  - bright and glowing with elemental energy  
  - colour range:
    - matches elemental affinity  

- hands:
  - tiny, delicate fingers  
  - highly precise control for fine manipulation  

- face:
  - soft, expressive features  
  - emotions often visible through subtle glow changes  

- ears:
  - small and pointed  

- markings:
  - faint glowing patterns tied to elemental nature  

- body:
  - extremely lightweight  
  - movements are erratic, fluttering, and quick

## racial traits
### magical affinity (innate)

#### description
every pixie is born with a perfect bond to a single element. this magical affinity defines their soul, shapes their appearance, and can never naturally be altered or diminished.

#### effects
- born with **100% affinity** in one chosen magical element.
- this affinity cannot be naturally changed, reduced, or replaced.
- gain reduced magical backlash when casting spells of your aligned element.
- wing colour, eye colour, hair accents and mana aura naturally reflect the chosen element.
- unlock the corresponding **elemental gift** racial trait.

---

### racial bond: split soul

#### description
a pixie's soul is incomplete at birth, with its missing half manifesting as a sprite. together they form a single spiritual existence connected beyond distance and ordinary magic.

#### effects
- every pixie possesses a spiritually linked **sprite**.
- pixie and sprite always know the general direction of one another.
- the bond functions across any distance on the same plane.
- while close together, magical energy flows more efficiently between the pair.
- if the bond is damaged, suppressed, or severed, both become **soul unstable**, suffering narrative and mechanical consequences determined by the gm.

---

### fey perception

#### description
pixies instinctively perceive the subtle currents of fey magic, allowing them to notice illusions, enchantments, and magical disturbances that often escape ordinary senses.

#### effects
- naturally detect magical illusions and glamours.
- sense nearby magical distortions and unstable mana.
- gain heightened intuition toward hidden magical intent.
- gain bonuses when identifying fey magic or magical anomalies.

---

### fey wings

#### description
pixie wings are living extensions of their soul, formed from condensed mana rather than flesh. they provide effortless flight and continually regenerate while their soul remains whole.

#### effects
- gain a natural flight speed.
- can hover without requiring forward movement.
- descend safely while conscious, greatly reducing falling damage.
- wings naturally regenerate if damaged.
- wing appearance permanently reflects the pixie's elemental affinity.

---

## lore
# pixie lore

pixies are among the **oldest manifested fae** known to exist, born not of flesh but of **avalon’s will and magic**. they are living expressions of elemental harmony, curiosity, and the unstable boundary between realms.

though small in stature, pixies have left **outsized marks on history**, often unnoticed by mortals until centuries later.

---

## origins of the pixie

pixies first emerged during the **early bloom of avalon**, when the fae realm stabilised after its initial formation. unlike other fae who formed courts or hierarchies, pixies manifested as **free-roaming spirits**, each bound to a single elemental truth.

pixies were never meant to rule, conquer, or guide.  
they were created to **observe, influence, and subtly correct** the flow of magic between realms.

from their first moments, pixies were incomplete.

each pixie was born with **half a soul**, the other half forming separately as a **sprite**. together they form a complete metaphysical whole, though separated by form and purpose.

---

## the split soul doctrine

pixie lore teaches that a soul divided can better perceive reality.

- pixies experience the **active world** — emotion, action, impulse
- sprites experience the **reflective world** — memory, intuition, balance

ancient pixies believe this division prevents corruption, arrogance, and stagnation. a whole soul, they claim, grows rigid. a split soul remains adaptable.

this belief has never been universally accepted among the fae.

---

## the worldroot gate (tree portal)

pixies do not freely cross between realms.

instead, they rely on a living construct known as the **worldroot gate** — an immense, ancient tree whose roots exist simultaneously in **avalon** and **asteria**.

### key facts
- the gate opens **once every 50 years**
- it remains open for **a single full lunar cycle**
- only pixies, sprites, and bonded fae may pass freely
- mortals who attempt passage rarely survive unchanged

to pixies, this event is known as **the crossing bloom**.

---

## the crossing bloom

the crossing bloom is a time of:
- celebration
- mourning
- oaths
- long journeys

pixies born in avalon may choose to:
- visit asteria
- remain behind permanently
- escort bonded sprites or fae envoys
- observe the state of magic in the mortal realm

pixies who pass through often do not return for centuries — if at all.

those who miss the crossing bloom must wait **another 50 years**, a delay that can feel unbearable to beings defined by curiosity.

---

## pixies in asterian history

pixies rarely appear in written mortal records, but their influence is undeniable.

they prefer to act as:
- whispered guides
- unseen helpers
- saboteurs of great evils
- inspirers of invention and art

many pivotal moments in asterian history coincide with **crossing bloom years**, though few mortals recognise the pattern.

---

## notable pixie figures

### ✦ queen lythiriel of the shimmergrove
the only pixie ever acknowledged as a **queen**.

lythiriel united scattered pixie enclaves during a time when the worldroot gate was damaged by planar instability. her reign lasted only one crossing bloom, after which she dissolved her crown and vanished into avalon’s upper canopies.

pixies still swear rare oaths **“by lythiriel’s leaves.”**

---

### ✦ king bramblethorn (the unwilling king)
a title bestowed by mortals, not pixies.

bramblethorn led a resistance against a demonic incursion that attempted to corrupt the worldroot gate during a crossing bloom. though victorious, he rejected all authority afterward and shattered his staff into seeds scattered across asteria.

some believe those seeds still grow into **warded trees**.

---

### ✦ nyx-of-the-falling-ash
a pixie hero bound to fire.

nyx is credited with:
- diverting a volcanic eruption
- burning a lich’s phylactery without destroying the soul cycle
- teaching early fire-mages restraint

nyx never returned to avalon and is believed to have **faded into pure flame**.

---

## pixie artisans & crafters

pixies rarely craft physical goods, but when they do, their work is legendary.

### ✦ the glimmerhands
a collective of pixie artisans known for crafting:
- ever-burning lanterns
- floating instruments
- soul-safe crystal foci

each item crafted by a glimmerhand is said to contain a **single truthful memory** of its maker.

---

### ✦ thistlewick the binder
an eccentric pixie who specialised in **binding magic to form**.

thistlewick helped design early enchantment frameworks still used by asterian artificers today. many do not realise the “odd inefficiencies” in these designs were intentional safety limits.

---

## pixies & mortals

pixies regard mortals with fascination and caution.

they admire:
- creativity
- defiance
- emotional depth

they fear:
- obsession
- exploitation of magic
- attempts to control the worldroot gate

pixies may aid mortals they find interesting, but will abandon those who attempt to command or bind them.

---

## modern pixie beliefs

in the current age, pixies believe:
- the realms are drifting further apart
- crossing blooms feel more dangerous
- magic in asteria is becoming volatile

some whisper that the worldroot gate may **one day fail entirely**.

if that happens, pixies will be forced to choose:
- remain forever in avalon  
- or become permanent residents of the mortal realm

---

## final words of pixie lore

> *“we are not small because we are weak.  we are small so the world forgets to fear us.”*  
> — old pixie proverb

# Flowborn Undien

## Overview
- Race Category: Demi-Race
- Race Type: Spiritborn Humanoid
- Parent Race: River Spirit × Humanoid
- Playable: Yes
- Rarity: Uncommon

## Racial Features
- Height Range:
  - Male: 165cm - 190cm
  - Female: 155cm - 180cm

- Weight Range:
  - 55kg - 95kg

- Skin:
  - Smooth and healthy appearance
  - Warm to the touch
  - Colour Range:
    - Light Blue
    - River Green
    - Pale Teal
    - Soft Silver
    - Natural Human Tones with aquatic hues

- Hair:
  - Flows naturally even in still air
  - Colour Range:
    - Brown
    - Black
    - Blue
    - Green
    - Silver

- Eyes:
  - Bright and vibrant
  - Colour Range:
    - Emerald
    - Teal
    - Blue
    - Silver
    - Gold

- Hands:
  - Long graceful fingers
  - Slight webbing

- Face:
  - Gentle and welcoming features
  - Soft expressions

- Ears:
  - Slightly elongated
  - Smooth fin-like ridges

- Markings:
  - Flowing river-like patterns
  - Often glow softly when healing magic is used

- Body:
  - Lean and athletic
  - Built for endurance and movement
  - Naturally graceful posture

---

## Racial Characteristics
| Characteristic | Buff/Debuff | Stat Rolls | Characteristics Tier Cap |
| -------------- | ----------- | ---------- | ------------------------ |
| Strength       | -2          | 4d6        | Tier 3                   |
| Dexterity      | +1          | 3d6        | Tier 5                   |
| Agility        | +2          | 3d6        | Tier 5                   |
| Constitution   | 0           | 4d6        | Tier 4                   |
| Endurance      | +1          | 4d6        | Tier 4                   |
| Intelligence   | 0           | 4d6        | Tier 4                   |
| Wisdom         | 0           | 4d6        | Tier 5                   |
| Charisma       | +1          | 4d6        | Tier 4                   |
| Luck           | 0           | 3d6        | Tier 5                   |

---

## Racial Traits
### Flow Sense

#### Description
Flowborn can instinctively feel the movement of water around them. Rivers, streams, rainfall, and currents act as extensions of their awareness.

#### Gameplay Effect
- Gain +2 Perception while within 30 metres of flowing water.
- Can determine the direction of nearby water sources.
- Gain advantage on Survival checks involving rivers, streams, and wetlands.
- Cannot become naturally lost while following a waterway.

---

### Spirit of Renewal

#### Description
Flowborn embody the restorative nature of rivers and freshwater springs.

#### Gameplay Effect
- Healing effects received are increased by 10%.
- Recover Stamina 25% faster during short rests.
- Gain +1 to all healing magic rolls.
- Natural healing is doubled while resting near fresh water.

---

### River Walker

#### Description
The currents support the Flowborn wherever they travel.

#### Gameplay Effect
- Ignore movement penalties caused by shallow water, mud, marshes, and wetlands.
- Gain advantage on Balance checks.
- Swim speed equals double normal movement speed.
- Can move across flowing water surfaces for up to 3 seconds before sinking.

---

### Breath of the Current

#### Description
Flowborn are equally comfortable above and below the water's surface.

#### Gameplay Effect
- Can breathe underwater indefinitely.
- Ignore underwater combat penalties.
- Gain resistance to exhaustion caused by swimming.
- Never suffer penalties from strong river currents.

---

## Traits & Biology
- Swim Speed: 18m
- Ignore difficult terrain caused by rivers, marshes, wetlands, and shallow water.
- Gain +3m movement speed while travelling alongside natural waterways.
- Can swim continuously without fatigue for extended periods.

---

### ✅ Bonuses
- Enhanced Healing
- Excellent Endurance
- Strong Survival Skills
- Superior River Navigation
- Natural Adaptability

### ⚠️ Drawbacks
- Less effective in deserts and arid climates.
- Reduced comfort in saltwater environments.
- Strong emotional connection to nature can make environmental destruction distressing.

# Frostborn Undien

## Overview
- Race Category: Demi-Race
- Race Type: Spiritborn Humanoid
- Parent Race: Frost Spirit × Humanoid
- Playable: Yes
- Rarity: Rare

## Racial Features
- Height Range:
  - Male: 170cm - 200cm
  - Female: 160cm - 190cm

- Weight Range:
  - 65kg - 120kg

- Skin:
  - Cool to the touch
  - Smooth with subtle crystalline textures
  - Colour Range:
    - Ice Blue
    - Frost White
    - Pale Silver
    - Glacier Grey
    - Arctic Blue

- Hair:
  - Often resembles flowing snow or frozen silk
  - Colour Range:
    - White
    - Silver
    - Pale Blue
    - Frost Grey
    - Crystal Blonde

- Eyes:
  - Bright and reflective like frozen lakes
  - Colour Range:
    - Ice Blue
    - Silver
    - White
    - Pale Violet
    - Crystal Cyan

- Hands:
  - Long fingers
  - Naturally resistant to cold
  - Slightly crystalline fingernails

- Face:
  - Elegant features
  - Calm and reserved expressions
  - High cheekbones common

- Ears:
  - Slightly elongated
  - Frost-like fin ridges

- Markings:
  - Naturally occurring frost patterns
  - Glowing snowflake-like runes
  - Intensify during ice magic use

- Body:
  - Lean and athletic
  - Built for endurance in harsh climates
  - Graceful but deliberate movement

---

## Racial Characteristics
| Characteristic | Buff/Debuff | Stat Rolls | Characteristics Tier Cap |
| -------------- | ----------- | ---------- | ------------------------ |
| Strength       | -2          | 4d6        | Tier 3                   |
| Dexterity      | 0           | 3d6        | Tier 4                   |
| Agility        | 0           | 3d6        | Tier 5                   |
| Constitution   | +1          | 4d6        | Tier 5                   |
| Endurance      | +2          | 4d6        | Tier 4                   |
| Intelligence   | +1          | 4d6        | Tier 4                   |
| Wisdom         | +1          | 4d6        | Tier 5                   |
| Charisma       | 0           | 4d6        | Tier 4                   |
| Luck           | 0           | 3d6        | Tier 5                   |

---

## Racial Traits
### Frost Sense

#### Description
Frostborn can feel changes in temperature, ice formations, snowfall, and cold mana currents around them.

#### Gameplay Effect
- Gain +2 Perception in snowy, icy, or cold environments.
- Can sense approaching blizzards and severe weather several hours in advance.
- Detect nearby sources of ice magic within 18 metres.
- Gain advantage on Survival checks in frozen environments.

---

### Heart of Winter

#### Description
The essence of eternal winter flows through every Frostborn.

#### Gameplay Effect
- Resistant to Cold damage.
- Immune to natural environmental cold.
- Ignore penalties from snow, ice, and freezing temperatures.
- Ice and Frost spells cost 10% less Mana.

---

### Frozen Resolve

#### Description
Like ancient glaciers, Frostborn possess patience and resilience beyond most mortal races.

#### Gameplay Effect
- Gain +2 on rolls against Fear effects.
- Gain +2 on rolls against environmental exhaustion caused by cold climates.
- Recover Stamina 25% faster while in cold environments.
- Gain advantage against effects that force panic or emotional manipulation.

---

### Breath of the Glacier

#### Description
The body of a Frostborn is naturally adapted to survive beneath frozen waters.

#### Gameplay Effect
- Can breathe underwater indefinitely.
- Ignore underwater combat penalties.
- Swimming speed is doubled.
- Can safely swim in freezing waters without harm.

---

## Lore
Information coming soon.

Information coming soon.

## Historical Figures
Information coming soon.

## Settlements
Information coming soon.

## Relations
Information coming soon.

## Traits & Biology
- Swim Speed: 18m
- Ignore movement penalties caused by snow and ice.
- Move normally across frozen lakes and icy terrain.
- Gain +3m movement speed during blizzards or snowstorms.
- No penalties from freezing water.

---

### ✅ Bonuses
- Superior Cold Resistance
- Enhanced Ice Magic
- Excellent Survival Skills
- High Endurance
- Strong Mental Resilience

### ⚠️ Drawbacks
- Sensitive to extreme heat.
- Fire Magic deals increased damage.
- Reduced comfort in tropical climates.
- Require more hydration in hot environments.

---

# Life Pixie

## Overview
# Pixie Lore

Pixies are among the **oldest manifested fae** known to exist, born not of flesh but of **Avalon’s will and magic**. They are living expressions of elemental harmony, curiosity, and the unstable boundary between realms.

Though small in stature, pixies have left **outsized marks on history**, often unnoticed by mortals until centuries later.

---

## Origins of the Pixie

Pixies first emerged during the **Early Bloom of Avalon**, when the Fae Realm stabilised after its initial formation. Unlike other fae who formed courts or hierarchies, pixies manifested as **free-roaming spirits**, each bound to a single elemental truth.

Pixies were never meant to rule, conquer, or guide.  
They were created to **observe, influence, and subtly correct** the flow of magic between realms.

From their first moments, pixies were incomplete.

Each pixie was born with **half a soul**, the other half forming separately as a **Sprite**. Together they form a complete metaphysical whole, though separated by form and purpose.

---

## The Split Soul Doctrine

Pixie lore teaches that a soul divided can better perceive reality.

- Pixies experience the **active world** — emotion, action, impulse
- Sprites experience the **reflective world** — memory, intuition, balance

Ancient pixies believe this division prevents corruption, arrogance, and stagnation. A whole soul, they claim, grows rigid. A split soul remains adaptable.

This belief has never been universally accepted among the fae.

---

## The Worldroot Gate (Tree Portal)

Pixies do not freely cross between realms.

Instead, they rely on a living construct known as the **Worldroot Gate** — an immense, ancient tree whose roots exist simultaneously in **Avalon** and **Asteria**.

### Key Facts
- The gate opens **once every 50 years**
- It remains open for **a single full lunar cycle**
- Only pixies, sprites, and bonded fae may pass freely
- Mortals who attempt passage rarely survive unchanged

To pixies, this event is known as **The Crossing Bloom**.

---

## The Crossing Bloom

The Crossing Bloom is a time of:
- Celebration
- Mourning
- Oaths
- Long journeys

Pixies born in Avalon may choose to:
- Visit Asteria
- Remain behind permanently
- Escort bonded sprites or fae envoys
- Observe the state of magic in the mortal realm

Pixies who pass through often do not return for centuries — if at all.

Those who miss the Crossing Bloom must wait **another 50 years**, a delay that can feel unbearable to beings defined by curiosity.

---

## Pixies in Asterian History

Pixies rarely appear in written mortal records, but their influence is undeniable.

They prefer to act as:
- Whispered guides
- Unseen helpers
- Saboteurs of great evils
- Inspirers of invention and art

Many pivotal moments in Asterian history coincide with **Crossing Bloom years**, though few mortals recognise the pattern.

---

## Notable Pixie Figures

### ✦ Queen Lythiriel of the Shimmergrove
The only pixie ever acknowledged as a **queen**.

Lythiriel united scattered pixie enclaves during a time when the Worldroot Gate was damaged by planar instability. Her reign lasted only one Crossing Bloom, after which she dissolved her crown and vanished into Avalon’s upper canopies.

Pixies still swear rare oaths **“by Lythiriel’s Leaves.”**

---

### ✦ King Bramblethorn (The Unwilling King)
A title bestowed by mortals, not pixies.

Bramblethorn led a resistance against a demonic incursion that attempted to corrupt the Worldroot Gate during a Crossing Bloom. Though victorious, he rejected all authority afterward and shattered his staff into seeds scattered across Asteria.

Some believe those seeds still grow into **warded trees**.

---

### ✦ Nyx-of-the-Falling-Ash
A pixie hero bound to fire.

Nyx is credited with:
- Diverting a volcanic eruption
- Burning a lich’s phylactery without destroying the soul cycle
- Teaching early fire-mages restraint

Nyx never returned to Avalon and is believed to have **faded into pure flame**.

---

## Pixie Artisans & Crafters

Pixies rarely craft physical goods, but when they do, their work is legendary.

### ✦ The Glimmerhands
A collective of pixie artisans known for crafting:
- Ever-burning lanterns
- Floating instruments
- Soul-safe crystal foci

Each item crafted by a Glimmerhand is said to contain a **single truthful memory** of its maker.

---

### ✦ Thistlewick the Binder
An eccentric pixie who specialised in **binding magic to form**.

Thistlewick helped design early enchantment frameworks still used by Asterian artificers today. Many do not realise the “odd inefficiencies” in these designs were intentional safety limits.

---

## Pixies & Mortals

Pixies regard mortals with fascination and caution.

They admire:
- Creativity
- Defiance
- Emotional depth

They fear:
- Obsession
- Exploitation of magic
- Attempts to control the Worldroot Gate

Pixies may aid mortals they find interesting, but will abandon those who attempt to command or bind them.

---

## Modern Pixie Beliefs

In the current age, pixies believe:
- The realms are drifting further apart
- Crossing Blooms feel more dangerous
- Magic in Asteria is becoming volatile

Some whisper that the Worldroot Gate may **one day fail entirely**.

If that happens, pixies will be forced to choose:
- Remain forever in Avalon  
- Or become permanent residents of the mortal realm

---

## Final Words of Pixie Lore

> *“We are not small because we are weak.  We are small so the world forgets to fear us.”*  
> — Old Pixie Proverb

## 🧠 Notes

- Native to **Avalon (Fae Realm)**  
- Do not form structured societies  

Common habitats:
- Elemental groves  
- Floating crystal formations  
- Hidden fae sanctuaries  

Values:
- Freedom  
- Expression  
- Balance with nature  
- Soul connection

## Racial Features
- Height Range:
  - 15 cm to 60 cm  

- Weight Range:
  - 2 kg to 6 kg  

- Wings:
  - Insect-like, semi-translucent magical wings  
  - Shape varies depending on elemental affinity  

- Skin:
  - Soft, glowing, slightly translucent  
  - Colour Range:
    - Pastel → vibrant → elemental hues  

- Hair:
  - Light, flowing as if weightless  
  - Colour Range:
    - White → silver → elemental tones  

- Eyes:
  - Bright and glowing with elemental energy  
  - Colour Range:
    - Matches elemental affinity  

- Hands:
  - Tiny, delicate fingers  
  - Highly precise control for fine manipulation  

- Face:
  - Soft, expressive features  
  - Emotions often visible through subtle glow changes  

- Ears:
  - Small and pointed  

- Markings:
  - Faint glowing patterns tied to elemental nature  

- Body:
  - Extremely lightweight  
  - Movements are erratic, fluttering, and quick  

---

## Racial Characteristics
| Characteristic | Buff/Debuff | Stat Rolls | Characteristic Tier Cap |
| -------------- | :---------: | :--------: | :---------------------: |
| Strength       |     -3      |    2d4     |         Tier 1          |
| Dexterity      |     +1      |    4d6     |         Tier 5          |
| Agility        |     +2      |    4d6     |         Tier 5          |
| Constitution   |     -2      |    2d4     |         Tier 3          |
| Endurance      |      0      |    2d4     |         Tier 3          |
| Intelligence   |     +1      |    4d6     |         Tier 5          |
| Wisdom         |      0      |    4d6     |         Tier 5          |
| Charisma       |     +1      |    4d6     |         Tier 5          |
| Luck           |      0      |    3d6     |         Tier 5          |

---

## Racial Traits
### Magical Affinity (Innate)

#### Description
Every Pixie is born with a perfect bond to a single element. This magical affinity defines their soul, shapes their appearance, and can never naturally be altered or diminished.

#### Effects
- Born with **100% Affinity** in one chosen magical element.
- This affinity cannot be naturally changed, reduced, or replaced.
- Gain reduced magical backlash when casting spells of your aligned element.
- Wing colour, eye colour, hair accents and mana aura naturally reflect the chosen element.
- Unlock the corresponding **Elemental Gift** racial trait.

---

### Racial Bond: Split Soul

#### Description
A Pixie's soul is incomplete at birth, with its missing half manifesting as a Sprite. Together they form a single spiritual existence connected beyond distance and ordinary magic.

#### Effects
- Every Pixie possesses a spiritually linked **Sprite**.
- Pixie and Sprite always know the general direction of one another.
- The bond functions across any distance on the same plane.
- While close together, magical energy flows more efficiently between the pair.
- If the bond is damaged, suppressed, or severed, both become **Soul Unstable**, suffering narrative and mechanical consequences determined by the GM.

---

### Fey Perception

#### Description
Pixies instinctively perceive the subtle currents of Fey magic, allowing them to notice illusions, enchantments, and magical disturbances that often escape ordinary senses.

#### Effects
- Naturally detect magical illusions and glamours.
- Sense nearby magical distortions and unstable mana.
- Gain heightened intuition toward hidden magical intent.
- Gain bonuses when identifying Fey magic or magical anomalies.

---

### Fey Wings

#### Description
Pixie wings are living extensions of their soul, formed from condensed mana rather than flesh. They provide effortless flight and continually regenerate while their soul remains whole.

#### Effects
- Gain a natural Flight Speed.
- Can hover without requiring forward movement.
- Descend safely while conscious, greatly reducing falling damage.
- Wings naturally regenerate if damaged.
- Wing appearance permanently reflects the Pixie's elemental affinity.

---

## racial traits
### magical affinity (innate)

#### description
every pixie is born with a perfect bond to a single element. this magical affinity defines their soul, shapes their appearance, and can never naturally be altered or diminished.

#### effects
- born with **100% affinity** in one chosen magical element.
- this affinity cannot be naturally changed, reduced, or replaced.
- gain reduced magical backlash when casting spells of your aligned element.
- wing colour, eye colour, hair accents and mana aura naturally reflect the chosen element.
- unlock the corresponding **elemental gift** racial trait.

---

### racial bond: split soul

#### description
a pixie's soul is incomplete at birth, with its missing half manifesting as a sprite. together they form a single spiritual existence connected beyond distance and ordinary magic.

#### effects
- every pixie possesses a spiritually linked **sprite**.
- pixie and sprite always know the general direction of one another.
- the bond functions across any distance on the same plane.
- while close together, magical energy flows more efficiently between the pair.
- if the bond is damaged, suppressed, or severed, both become **soul unstable**, suffering narrative and mechanical consequences determined by the gm.

---

### fey perception

#### description
pixies instinctively perceive the subtle currents of fey magic, allowing them to notice illusions, enchantments, and magical disturbances that often escape ordinary senses.

#### effects
- naturally detect magical illusions and glamours.
- sense nearby magical distortions and unstable mana.
- gain heightened intuition toward hidden magical intent.
- gain bonuses when identifying fey magic or magical anomalies.

---

### fey wings

#### description
pixie wings are living extensions of their soul, formed from condensed mana rather than flesh. they provide effortless flight and continually regenerate while their soul remains whole.

#### effects
- gain a natural flight speed.
- can hover without requiring forward movement.
- descend safely while conscious, greatly reducing falling damage.
- wings naturally regenerate if damaged.
- wing appearance permanently reflects the pixie's elemental affinity.

The only pixie ever acknowledged as a **queen**.

Lythiriel united scattered pixie enclaves during a time when the Worldroot Gate was damaged by planar instability. Her reign lasted only one Crossing Bloom, after which she dissolved her crown and vanished into Avalon’s upper canopies.

Pixies still swear rare oaths **“by Lythiriel’s Leaves.”**

---

### ✦ King Bramblethorn (The Unwilling King)
A title bestowed by mortals, not pixies.

Bramblethorn led a resistance against a demonic incursion that attempted to corrupt the Worldroot Gate during a Crossing Bloom. Though victorious, he rejected all authority afterward and shattered his staff into seeds scattered across Asteria.

Some believe those seeds still grow into **warded trees**.

---

### ✦ Nyx-of-the-Falling-Ash
A pixie hero bound to fire.

Nyx is credited with:
- Diverting a volcanic eruption
- Burning a lich’s phylactery without destroying the soul cycle
- Teaching early fire-mages restraint

Nyx never returned to Avalon and is believed to have **faded into pure flame**.

---

## Pixie Artisans & Crafters

Pixies rarely craft physical goods, but when they do, their work is legendary.

### ✦ The Glimmerhands
A collective of pixie artisans known for crafting:
- Ever-burning lanterns
- Floating instruments
- Soul-safe crystal foci

Each item crafted by a Glimmerhand is said to contain a **single truthful memory** of its maker.

---

### ✦ Thistlewick the Binder
An eccentric pixie who specialised in **binding magic to form**.

Thistlewick helped design early enchantment frameworks still used by Asterian artificers today. Many do not realise the “odd inefficiencies” in these designs were intentional safety limits.

---

## Pixies & Mortals

Pixies regard mortals with fascination and caution.

They admire:
- Creativity
- Defiance
- Emotional depth

They fear:
- Obsession
- Exploitation of magic
- Attempts to control the Worldroot Gate

Pixies may aid mortals they find interesting, but will abandon those who attempt to command or bind them.

---

## Modern Pixie Beliefs

In the current age, pixies believe:
- The realms are drifting further apart
- Crossing Blooms feel more dangerous
- Magic in Asteria is becoming volatile

Some whisper that the Worldroot Gate may **one day fail entirely**.

If that happens, pixies will be forced to choose:
- Remain forever in Avalon  
- Or become permanent residents of the mortal realm

---

## Final Words of Pixie Lore

> *“We are not small because we are weak.  We are small so the world forgets to fear us.”*  
> — Old Pixie Proverb

- Native to **Avalon (Fae Realm)**

Common habitats:

- Floating crystal formations  
- Hidden fae sanctuaries  

Values:
- Freedom

- Balance with nature

## Racial Traits
### Magical Affinity (Innate)

#### Description
Every Pixie is born with a perfect bond to a single element. This magical affinity defines their soul, shapes their appearance, and can never naturally be altered or diminished.

#### Effects
- Born with **100% Affinity** in one chosen magical element.
- This affinity cannot be naturally changed, reduced, or replaced.
- Gain reduced magical backlash when casting spells of your aligned element.
- Wing colour, eye colour, hair accents and mana aura naturally reflect the chosen element.
- Unlock the corresponding **Elemental Gift** racial trait.

---

### Racial Bond: Split Soul

#### Description
A Pixie's soul is incomplete at birth, with its missing half manifesting as a Sprite. Together they form a single spiritual existence connected beyond distance and ordinary magic.

#### Effects
- Every Pixie possesses a spiritually linked **Sprite**.
- Pixie and Sprite always know the general direction of one another.
- The bond functions across any distance on the same plane.
- While close together, magical energy flows more efficiently between the pair.
- If the bond is damaged, suppressed, or severed, both become **Soul Unstable**, suffering narrative and mechanical consequences determined by the GM.

---

### Fey Perception

#### Description
Pixies instinctively perceive the subtle currents of Fey magic, allowing them to notice illusions, enchantments, and magical disturbances that often escape ordinary senses.

#### Effects
- Naturally detect magical illusions and glamours.
- Sense nearby magical distortions and unstable mana.
- Gain heightened intuition toward hidden magical intent.
- Gain bonuses when identifying Fey magic or magical anomalies.

---

### Fey Wings

#### Description
Pixie wings are living extensions of their soul, formed from condensed mana rather than flesh. They provide effortless flight and continually regenerate while their soul remains whole.

#### Effects
- Gain a natural Flight Speed.
- Can hover without requiring forward movement.
- Descend safely while conscious, greatly reducing falling damage.
- Wings naturally regenerate if damaged.
- Wing appearance permanently reflects the Pixie's elemental affinity.

---

---

## Origins of the Pixie

Pixies first emerged during the **Early Bloom of Avalon**, when the Fae Realm stabilised after its initial formation. Unlike other fae who formed courts or hierarchies, pixies manifested as **free-roaming spirits**, each bound to a single elemental truth.

Pixies were never meant to rule, conquer, or guide.  
They were created to **observe, influence, and subtly correct** the flow of magic between realms.

From their first moments, pixies were incomplete.

Each pixie was born with **half a soul**, the other half forming separately as a **Sprite**. Together they form a complete metaphysical whole, though separated by form and purpose.

---

## The Split Soul Doctrine

Pixie lore teaches that a soul divided can better perceive reality.

- Pixies experience the **active world** — emotion, action, impulse
- Sprites experience the **reflective world** — memory, intuition, balance

This belief has never been universally accepted among the fae.

---

Pixies do not freely cross between realms.

- The gate opens **once every 50 years**
- It remains open for **a single full lunar cycle**
- Only pixies, sprites, and bonded fae may pass freely
- Mortals who attempt passage rarely survive unchanged

The Crossing Bloom is a time of:
- Celebration
- Mourning
- Oaths
- Long journeys

Pixies born in Avalon may choose to:
- Visit Asteria
- Remain behind permanently
- Escort bonded sprites or fae envoys
- Observe the state of magic in the mortal realm

Pixies who pass through often do not return for centuries — if at all.

Those who miss the Crossing Bloom must wait **another 50 years**, a delay that can feel unbearable to beings defined by curiosity.

- highly agile, erratic movement pattern  
- can hover and change direction instantly  

⚠️ limitations:
- vulnerable in strong winds  
- reduced effectiveness in confined spaces  

---

### ⚠️ drawbacks
- very fragile (low hp potential)  
- extremely low strength  
- reliant on magic and positioning  
- vulnerable if grounded or restrained  

---

— lirael, emberwing pixie

# Polaris Ursa

## Overview
### Population

**Current Population:** 10,000–12,000

The Polaris Ursa are considered a declining race. Though still respected throughout the frozen regions of Asteria, their numbers have never fully recovered from the devastation of the Great War approximately 1,000 years ago.

Before the war, the Polaris Ursa population was estimated between **30,000 and 35,000 individuals**, spread across numerous clans, settlements, and noble families throughout the southern polar regions of Altarin.

The war resulted in:

- The destruction of dozens of clans
- The loss of countless settlements
- The extinction of many noble bloodlines
- The near-collapse of Polaris Ursa civilization

Today every Polaris Ursa birth is celebrated as a blessing from Nevara and a sign that their people continue to endure.

---

### Homeland

**Original Homeland:** Altarin

**Secondary Homeland:** Noran

All Polaris Ursa were originally born and raised within the frozen southern continent of **Altarin**, where they lived alongside the Ice Elves for thousands of years.

Following the Great War, the surviving leaders feared that keeping their remaining population concentrated within a single continent could eventually lead to their extinction.

To preserve the future of their people, the surviving clans divided their population between two continents.

Today the Polaris Ursa maintain homes in both Altarin and Noran.

---

### The Four Great Clans

Only four major clans survived the Great War.

These clans became the foundation upon which modern Polaris Ursa civilization was rebuilt.

#### Frostclaw Clan
**Ruling Family:** House Frostbjorn

Known for:
- Leadership
- Nobility
- Military command
- Diplomacy

The Frostclaw Clan is considered the oldest and most politically influential of the surviving clans.

---

#### Glacierheart Clan
**Ruling Family:** House Ishald

Known for:
- Priests
- Shamans
- Lorekeepers
- Runecrafters

The Glacierheart Clan preserves much of the race's surviving history, traditions, and religious teachings.

---

#### Snowshadow Clan
**Ruling Family:** House Skjoldr

Known for:
- Hunters
- Rangers
- Scouts
- Explorers

The Snowshadow Clan serves as the eyes and ears of the Polaris Ursa people.

---

#### Stormmaw Clan
**Ruling Family:** House Hrimvald

Known for:
- Warriors
- Sailors
- Frontier defenders
- Monster hunters

The Stormmaw Clan led much of the migration to Noran and remains renowned for its courage and martial traditions.

---

### Clan Distribution

#### Altarin Clans

- Frostclaw Clan
- Glacierheart Clan

#### Noran Clans

- Snowshadow Clan
- Stormmaw Clan

---

### Creation Myth

According to Polaris Ursa tradition, the **Ice Elves were the first children of Nevara**, Goddess of Winter.

The Ice Elves were gifted beauty, wisdom, magic, and longevity.

Yet Nevara soon realized that her first children lacked the physical strength necessary to defend the frozen world she had created.

From the heart of a glacier, the breath of a blizzard, and the spirit of the polar winds, she forged her second children:

**The Polaris Ursa.**

Where the Ice Elves were graceful, the Polaris Ursa were mighty.

Where the Ice Elves were scholars, the Polaris Ursa were guardians.

Where the Ice Elves preserved knowledge, the Polaris Ursa protected it.

Together they became the Twin Children of Winter.

---

### Sacred Relationship with the Ice Elves

The Polaris Ursa do not view the Ice Elves as rivals.

Instead they refer to them as:

> **The Firstborn of Winter**

Many Ice Elves in turn refer to the Polaris Ursa as:

> **The Wardens of Winter**

For thousands of years the two races lived side by side throughout the frozen regions of Altarin, forming one of the oldest alliances in Asterian history.

---

### The Great War

Approximately **1,000 years ago**, the Great War devastated the southern polar regions of Altarin.

The conflict nearly wiped out both the Ice Elves and the Polaris Ursa.

Entire settlements disappeared beneath ice and snow.

Ancient temples were destroyed.

Countless bloodlines vanished forever.

By the war's conclusion, the Polaris Ursa population had fallen from approximately **30,000–35,000 individuals** to fewer than **2,000 survivors**.

Only four great clans remained.

---

### The Divine Command

Following the war, the surviving shamans and priests of the Aetherion Faith gathered to seek guidance.

Legend states that Nevara herself appeared to them through dreams and visions.

She warned that if all her remaining children stayed together, another catastrophe could one day destroy them entirely.

At that same time, an Ice Elf Prince was preparing an expedition to the distant northern continent of Noran.

Nevara commanded:

> *"Let winter take root in two lands, so that neither may perish."*

Obeying her decree, the Polaris Ursa divided their remaining population.

#### Remained in Altarin
- Frostclaw Clan
- Glacierheart Clan

#### Journeyed to Noran
- Snowshadow Clan
- Stormmaw Clan

Accompanied by the Ice Elf Prince and his followers, the northern clans crossed the seas and established new settlements upon the frozen continent of Noran.

---

### Modern Beliefs

The Polaris Ursa believe they have two sacred responsibilities:

#### Preserve the Legacy of Altarin
The homeland of their ancestors and birthplace of their people.

#### Protect the Future of Noran
The refuge granted to them by Nevara after the Great War.

This belief is reflected in one of their most famous sayings:

> *"One paw remains in the south. One paw stands in the north."*

A proverb symbolizing the eternal bond between the Polaris Ursa of Altarin and Noran.

---

> *"We endure the storm. We honor our ancestors. We protect what is sacred."*
>
> — Ancient Polaris Ursa Oath

## Racial Features
- Height Range:
  - 180 cm to 230 cm (Head to Foot)

- Weight Range:
  - 140 kg to 300 kg  

- Fur:
  - Thick, dense fur designed for extreme cold survival  
  - Colour Range:
    - White → cream → pale grey  
    - Often tinted with faint blue or silver  

- Skin:
  - Tough, insulated beneath fur  
  - Colour Range:
    - Deep black → bluish-grey  

- Eyes:
  - Calm, heavy-lidded with strong focus  
  - Colour Range:
    - Ice blue → grey → silver → pale brown  

- Hands:
  - Large, powerful hands with thick claws  
  - Claws can be used for:
    - Climbing  
    - Combat (natural weapon potential)  

- Face:
  - Broad facial structure with strong jawline  
  - Heavy brow ridge giving a stern expression  

- Ears:
  - Rounded and fur-covered  
  - Highly sensitive to environmental sounds  

- Markings:
  - Often decorated with:
    - Bone beads  
    - Carved tusks  
    - Runic tattoos (ash + oil pigments)  

- Body:
  - Massive, muscular build  
  - Built for endurance and strength  
  - Movement is heavy but controlled  

---

## Racial Characteristics
| Characteristic | Buff/Debuff | Stat Rolls | Characteristic Tier Cap |
| -------------- | ----------- | ---------- | ----------------------- |
| Strength       | +3          | 4d8        | Tier 5                  |
| Dexterity      | -1          | 2d6        | Tier 4                  |
| Agility        | -1          | 2d6        | Tier 3                  |
| Constitution   | +2          | 4d8        | Tier 5                  |
| Endurance      | +2          | 4d8        | Tier 5                  |
| Intelligence   | 0           | 3d6        | Tier 4                  |
| Wisdom         | +1          | 3d6        | Tier 3                  |
| Charisma       | -1          | 3d6        | Tier 4                  |
| Luck           | 0           | 3d6        | Tier 5                  |

---

## Racial Traits
### Frostborn Resilience

#### Description
Generations surviving Altarin's frozen wilderness have made Polaris Ursa naturally resistant to extreme cold, allowing them to thrive where lesser races quickly succumb to winter's relentless embrace.

#### Effects
- Resistant to **Cold Damage**.
- Immune to **natural frostbite**.
- Immune to **natural hypothermia**.
- Non-magical environmental cold cannot inflict movement or survival penalties.

---

### Ice Strider

#### Description
Polaris Ursa move confidently across frozen landscapes, their powerful build and instinctive balance allowing effortless travel over snow and ice without losing speed or secure footing.

#### Effects
- Ignore movement penalties caused by **natural snow**.
- Ignore movement penalties caused by **natural ice**.
- Cannot slip or fall due to naturally frozen terrain.
- Natural snow and ice are not treated as difficult terrain.

---

### Polar Endurance

#### Description
Life beneath endless winters has forged exceptional endurance, enabling Polaris Ursa to withstand exhaustion, hunger, and relentless environmental hardship long after others would collapse from fatigue.

#### Effects
- Gain Advantage on saving throws against **Exhaustion**.
- Gain Advantage on saving throws against **Starvation**.
- Gain Advantage on saving throws caused by **extreme cold**.
- Increase the time before suffering environmental fatigue in frozen climates.

---

### Mighty Swimmer

#### Description
Despite their immense size, Polaris Ursa are powerful swimmers capable of crossing icy waters with remarkable endurance while holding their breath far longer than most humanoids.

#### Effects
- Gain a **Swimming Speed of 15 metres**.
- Can hold their breath for **20 minutes**.
- Ignore penalties for swimming in naturally freezing water.
- Gain Advantage on Athletics checks made while swimming.

---

### Guardian's Fury

#### Description
The Polaris Ursa possess an instinctive protective nature, erupting into fierce determination whenever companions are threatened, striking back with overwhelming strength to defend those under their care.

#### Effects
- When an ally within **3 metres** is damaged by an enemy, this trait activates.
- Gain Advantage on your next melee attack against the triggering enemy before the end of your next turn.
- This effect may trigger **once per round**.
- Counts as a protective racial ability and may benefit from abilities that enhance guardian or protector effects.

---

| intelligence   | 0           | 3d6        | tier 4                  |
| wisdom         | +1          | 3d6        | tier 3                  |
| charisma       | -1          | 3d6        | tier 4                  |
| luck           | 0           | 3d6        | tier 5                  |

---

## racial traits
### frostborn resilience

#### description
generations surviving altarin's frozen wilderness have made polaris ursa naturally resistant to extreme cold, allowing them to thrive where lesser races quickly succumb to winter's relentless embrace.

#### effects
- resistant to **cold damage**.
- immune to **natural frostbite**.
- immune to **natural hypothermia**.
- non-magical environmental cold cannot inflict movement or survival penalties.

---

### ice strider

#### description
polaris ursa move confidently across frozen landscapes, their powerful build and instinctive balance allowing effortless travel over snow and ice without losing speed or secure footing.

#### effects
- ignore movement penalties caused by **natural snow**.
- ignore movement penalties caused by **natural ice**.
- cannot slip or fall due to naturally frozen terrain.
- natural snow and ice are not treated as difficult terrain.

---

### polar endurance

#### description
life beneath endless winters has forged exceptional endurance, enabling polaris ursa to withstand exhaustion, hunger, and relentless environmental hardship long after others would collapse from fatigue.

#### effects
- gain advantage on saving throws against **exhaustion**.
- gain advantage on saving throws against **starvation**.
- gain advantage on saving throws caused by **extreme cold**.
- increase the time before suffering environmental fatigue in frozen climates.

---

### mighty swimmer

#### description
despite their immense size, polaris ursa are powerful swimmers capable of crossing icy waters with remarkable endurance while holding their breath far longer than most humanoids.

#### effects
- gain a **swimming speed of 15 metres**.
- can hold their breath for **20 minutes**.
- ignore penalties for swimming in naturally freezing water.
- gain advantage on athletics checks made while swimming.

---

### guardian's fury

#### description
the polaris ursa possess an instinctive protective nature, erupting into fierce determination whenever companions are threatened, striking back with overwhelming strength to defend those under their care.

#### effects
- when an ally within **3 metres** is damaged by an enemy, this trait activates.
- gain advantage on your next melee attack against the triggering enemy before the end of your next turn.
- this effect may trigger **once per round**.
- counts as a protective racial ability and may benefit from abilities that enhance guardian or protector effects.

---

## lore
### population

**current population:** 10,000–12,000

the polaris ursa are considered a declining race. though still respected throughout the frozen regions of asteria, their numbers have never fully recovered from the devastation of the great war approximately 1,000 years ago.

before the war, the polaris ursa population was estimated between **30,000 and 35,000 individuals**, spread across numerous clans, settlements, and noble families throughout the southern polar regions of altarin.

the war resulted in:

- the destruction of dozens of clans
- the loss of countless settlements
- the extinction of many noble bloodlines
- the near-collapse of polaris ursa civilization

today every polaris ursa birth is celebrated as a blessing from nevara and a sign that their people continue to endure.

---

### homeland

**original homeland:** altarin

**secondary homeland:** noran

all polaris ursa were originally born and raised within the frozen southern continent of **altarin**, where they lived alongside the ice elves for thousands of years.

following the great war, the surviving leaders feared that keeping their remaining population concentrated within a single continent could eventually lead to their extinction.

to preserve the future of their people, the surviving clans divided their population between two continents.

today the polaris ursa maintain homes in both altarin and noran.

---

### the four great clans

only four major clans survived the great war.

these clans became the foundation upon which modern polaris ursa civilization was rebuilt.

#### frostclaw clan
**ruling family:** house frostbjorn

known for:
- leadership
- nobility
- military command
- diplomacy

the frostclaw clan is considered the oldest and most politically influential of the surviving clans.

---

#### glacierheart clan
**ruling family:** house ishald

known for:
- priests
- shamans
- lorekeepers
- runecrafters

the glacierheart clan preserves much of the race's surviving history, traditions, and religious teachings.

---

#### snowshadow clan
**ruling family:** house skjoldr

known for:
- hunters
- rangers
- scouts
- explorers

the snowshadow clan serves as the eyes and ears of the polaris ursa people.

---

#### stormmaw clan
**ruling family:** house hrimvald

known for:
- warriors
- sailors
- frontier defenders
- monster hunters

the stormmaw clan led much of the migration to noran and remains renowned for its courage and martial traditions.

---

### clan distribution

#### altarin clans

- frostclaw clan
- glacierheart clan

#### noran clans

- snowshadow clan
- stormmaw clan

---

### creation myth

according to polaris ursa tradition, the **ice elves were the first children of nevara**, goddess of winter.

the ice elves were gifted beauty, wisdom, magic, and longevity.

yet nevara soon realized that her first children lacked the physical strength necessary to defend the frozen world she had created.

from the heart of a glacier, the breath of a blizzard, and the spirit of the polar winds, she forged her second children:

**the polaris ursa.**

where the ice elves were graceful, the polaris ursa were mighty.

where the ice elves were scholars, the polaris ursa were guardians.

where the ice elves preserved knowledge, the polaris ursa protected it.

together they became the twin children of winter.

---

### sacred relationship with the ice elves

the polaris ursa do not view the ice elves as rivals.

instead they refer to them as:

> **the firstborn of winter**

many ice elves in turn refer to the polaris ursa as:

> **the wardens of winter**

for thousands of years the two races lived side by side throughout the frozen regions of altarin, forming one of the oldest alliances in asterian history.

---

### the great war

approximately **1,000 years ago**, the great war devastated the southern polar regions of altarin.

the conflict nearly wiped out both the ice elves and the polaris ursa.

entire settlements disappeared beneath ice and snow.

ancient temples were destroyed.

countless bloodlines vanished forever.

by the war's conclusion, the polaris ursa population had fallen from approximately **30,000–35,000 individuals** to fewer than **2,000 survivors**.

only four great clans remained.

---

### the divine command

following the war, the surviving shamans and priests of the aetherion faith gathered to seek guidance.

legend states that nevara herself appeared to them through dreams and visions.

she warned that if all her remaining children stayed together, another catastrophe could one day destroy them entirely.

at that same time, an ice elf prince was preparing an expedition to the distant northern continent of noran.

nevara commanded:

> *"let winter take root in two lands, so that neither may perish."*

obeying her decree, the polaris ursa divided their remaining population.

#### remained in altarin
- frostclaw clan
- glacierheart clan

#### journeyed to noran
- snowshadow clan
- stormmaw clan

accompanied by the ice elf prince and his followers, the northern clans crossed the seas and established new settlements upon the frozen continent of noran.

---

### modern beliefs

the polaris ursa believe they have two sacred responsibilities:

#### preserve the legacy of altarin
the homeland of their ancestors and birthplace of their people.

#### protect the future of noran
the refuge granted to them by nevara after the great war.

this belief is reflected in one of their most famous sayings:

> *"one paw remains in the south. one paw stands in the north."*

a proverb symbolizing the eternal bond between the polaris ursa of altarin and noran.

---

> *"we endure the storm. we honor our ancestors. we protect what is sacred."*
>
> — ancient polaris ursa oath

# Tempestborn Undien

## Overview
- Race Category: Demi-Race
- Race Type: Spiritborn Humanoid
- Parent Race: Tempest Spirit × Humanoid
- Playable: Yes
- Rarity: Rare

## Racial Features
- Height Range:
  - Male: 175cm - 205cm
  - Female: 165cm - 195cm

- Weight Range:
  - 65kg - 110kg

- Skin:
  - Smooth skin infused with storm mana
  - Faint electrical energy may dance across the body during heightened emotions
  - Colour Range:
    - Storm Grey
    - Slate Blue
    - Silver Grey
    - Pale Blue
    - Thundercloud Black

- Hair:
  - Constantly appears windswept
  - Often crackles with static electricity
  - Colour Range:
    - White
    - Silver
    - Blue
    - Black
    - Dark Grey

- Eyes:
  - Bright and luminous
  - Often glow during storms
  - Colour Range:
    - Electric Blue
    - Silver
    - White
    - Violet
    - Golden Yellow

- Hands:
  - Long dexterous fingers
  - Often emit tiny static discharges

- Face:
  - Sharp features
  - Intense expressions
  - Highly expressive eyes

- Ears:
  - Slightly elongated
  - Wind-shaped fin ridges

- Markings:
  - Lightning-like bioluminescent patterns
  - Glow brightly during spellcasting
  - Most commonly appear along arms, neck, chest, and face

- Body:
  - Lean athletic build
  - Fast reflexes
  - Constant subtle movement even when standing still

---

## Racial Characteristics
| Characteristic | Buff/Debuff | Stat Rolls | Characteristics Tier Cap |
| -------------- | ----------- | ---------- | ------------------------ |
| Strength       | +2          | 4d6        | Tier 3                   |
| Dexterity      | 0           | 3d6        | Tier 4                   |
| Agility        | 0           | 3d6        | Tier 5                   |
| Constitution   | 0           | 4d6        | Tier 4                   |
| Endurance      | +2          | 4d6        | Tier 5                   |
| Intelligence   | -2          | 4d6        | Tier 4                   |
| Wisdom         | 0           | 4d6        | Tier 5                   |
| Charisma       | +1          | 4d6        | Tier 4                   |
| Luck           | 0           | 3d6        | Tier 5                   |

---

## Racial Traits
### Water Spirit Heritage

#### Description
Every Undien carries a fragment of a Water Spirit's soul, granting an unbreakable connection to Water Magic. This spiritual bond forms the foundation of every Undien lineage from birth.

#### Effects
- Gain **100% Water Magic Affinity**.
- Water is permanently one of your natural elemental affinities.
- This affinity cannot be removed or replaced by any normal means.

---

### Amphibious

#### Description
The essence of a Water Spirit allows every Undien to live effortlessly between land and sea, breathing naturally in both environments without restriction or discomfort throughout their lifetime.

#### Effects
- Can breathe underwater indefinitely.
- Can breathe air normally.
- Cannot drown through natural causes.

---

### Storm Sense

#### Description
Tempestborn instinctively perceive atmospheric changes before they occur. Their connection to the skies allows them to sense storms, shifting winds, and dangerous weather long before others notice.

#### Effects
- Gain Advantage on Survival checks involving weather prediction.
- Can sense approaching storms up to 24 hours in advance.
- Always know the current wind direction and approximate wind strength.
- Gain Advantage on Perception checks during storms, heavy rain, or high winds.

---

### Stormforged Constitution

#### Description
Born beneath relentless storms, Tempestborn have bodies adapted to rain, humidity, and violent weather. Their storm-blessed constitution protects them from illnesses and hardships carried by the elements.

#### Effects
- Gain immunity to natural illnesses caused by wet, cold, or humid environments.
- Gain immunity to diseases contracted through contaminated water.
- Gain Advantage on checks to resist weather-related exhaustion.
- Ignore environmental penalties caused by heavy rain, thunderstorms, strong winds, and severe storms.

---

### Lightning Reflexes

#### Description
Storm energy races through every Tempestborn, granting extraordinary speed and lightning-fast reactions. Their movements are sudden, precise, and as unpredictable as the storms from which they were born.

#### Effects
- Gain **+2 Initiative**.
- Gain **+1 Agility**.
- Gain Advantage on reaction-based Agility checks.
- Reduce fall damage by **50%**.

---

## Traits & Biology
- Swim Speed: 18m
- Ignore difficult terrain caused by storms and heavy rain.
- Gain +3m movement speed during storms.
- Suffer no penalties from strong winds.
- Can maintain balance on unstable surfaces during severe weather.

---

### ✅ Bonuses
- Enhanced Storm Magic
- Enhanced Lightning Magic
- Exceptional Mobility
- Superior Reflexes
- Advanced Weather Awareness

### ⚠️ Drawbacks
- Emotionally volatile during intense storms.
- Lightning-based magical overload can occur during extreme mana usage.
- Less tolerant of enclosed underground environments.
- Often struggle with patience and long periods of inactivity.

  - colour range:

## racial traits
### tide sense

#### description
tideborn possess an innate awareness of the ocean's movements. they can feel shifts in currents, tides, and nearby bodies of water as naturally as breathing.

#### gameplay effect
- gain +2 perception while within 30 metres of a natural body of water.
- can determine the direction of nearby coastlines and large bodies of water.
- gain advantage on navigation checks while travelling at sea.
- can sense incoming tidal changes several hours in advance.

---

### child of the ocean

#### description
the blessing of the ocean spirits flows strongly through tideborn bloodlines.

#### gameplay effect
- water spells cost 10% less mana.
- gain +1 to water spell rolls.
- resistant to cold damage.
- gain advantage on checks involving ocean survival and navigation.

---

### ocean's grace

#### description
tideborn move through water with effortless elegance, as though carried by unseen currents.

#### gameplay effect
- swim speed is doubled.
- ignore difficult terrain while underwater.
- gain advantage on agility checks while swimming.
- suffer no penalties from rough seas or strong currents.

---

### breath of the sea

#### description
the ocean accepts the tideborn as one of its own.

#### gameplay effect
- can breathe underwater indefinitely.
- ignore underwater combat penalties.
- cannot drown through natural means.
- gain +2 endurance while submerged.

---
